review_text: "Ich war für 7 Nächte Gast bei Aska Lara in Antalya ich war im Großen und Ganzen zufrieden mit dem Hotel und auch der Anlage. Ich muss sagen das personal ist echt sehr höflich und freundlich. Ein nagtiven Punkt hab ich und das hat mich echt sehr genervt, im Essen Bereich hat das sehr streng gerochen ich hab das mehrmals dem Personal gesagt. Hat sich aber nichts geändert das fand ich sehr schade. Ich empfehle es trotzdem weiter weil alles andere super war"
translated_text: "I was a guest at Aska Lara in Antalya for 7 nights. I was generally satisfied with the hotel and the facility. I have to say the staff is really very polite and friendly. I have one negative point and that really annoyed me, there was a very strong smell in the dining area. I told the staff that several times. But nothing has changed, which I found a shame. I still recommend it because everything else was great."

review_text: "スタッフのホスピタリティを感じる素晴らしいホテルでした。"
translated_text: "It was a wonderful hotel with great hospitality from the staff."

review_text: "Im Gesamten sehr gut. Würde dieses Hotel gerne wieder besuchen!"

review_text: "Cok guzel bir tatil gecirdik ve cok memnun kaldik. Butun personelin servisi cok profesyonel ve guzeldi. 1’i katdaki temizlik personeli ve özellikle Gülcan hanimin yardimseverligi ve musteriye karsi servisi muhtesemdi. Yine görusmek dilegiyle!"
translated_text: "We had a very nice holiday and were very satisfied. The service of all the staff was very professional and nice. The helpfulness and customer service of the cleaning staff on the 1st floor and especially Ms. Gülcan were excellent. Hope to see you again!"

review_text: "Points positifs:Hôtel idéal pour les familles , une belle piscine avec des toboggans , des animations . Points négatifs : on a pris plusieurs fois des hôtels en Turquie dans plusieurs régions mais je n’ai jamais vu un restaurant qui fait la même bouffe pendant 12 jours c’était horrible les mêmes entrées les même déserts les mêmes spécialité vraiment on avait hâte de rentrer ! Et ils avaient pas d’autres restaurants où d’autres spécialités .pour le personnel aucun sourir ni bonjour ni rien ."
translated_text: "Positive points: Ideal hotel for families, a beautiful swimming pool with slides, entertainment. Negative points: we have stayed in hotels in Turkey several times in several regions but I have never seen a restaurant that does the same food for 12 days it was horrible the same starters the same deserts the same specialties really we couldn't wait to go back! And they had no other restaurants or other specialties. for the staff no smile or hello or anything."

review_text: "Der Pool sehr dreckig haben am ersten Tag erlebt, wie Pool abgesperrt haben, wegen kot Am nächsten Tag war das Kinder Pool gesperrt auch wegen kot!!! Haben auch nicht richtig gesehen ob die den Pool sauber machen, ich glaube die benutzen auch kein Chlor!! Haben uns so geäckelt das wir nur am Strand waren. Det Strand war das schlimmste, wo Ich bisher war!!! Im Wasser waren lauter weißer Schaum!!!!!! Es ist kein Getränke Service!!!!! Der Personal ist nur beschäftigt mit einem sehr dreckigen Wagen das Geschirr abzuräumen, wenn Mann die Wagen sieht wo das schmutzige Geschirr reinkommt, ist der Appetit weg Das ist auf keinen Fall ein 5 Sterne Hotel!!!! Die Bewertungen sind falsch oder auch gefälscht. Ein Morgen waren wir um 10.15 Uhr frühstücken, das Frühstücksbuffet war 10.30 Uhr haben es noch geschafft und Kleinigkeiten zu nehmen, es saßen auch noch viele Gäste im Restaurant, als es 10.40 Uhr war, ging die Lichter und die Klimaanlage aus und Mann konnte nicht mehr im Restaurant sitzen, weil Mann richtig geschwitzt hat. Was ich sagen möchte, der Personal ist fixiert zum abräumen, und versuchen sauber zu mach was sie auch nicht richtig schaffen. Die Toiletten sind sowas dreckig, in der Lobby und auch draußen. Wir mussten immer ins Zimmer laufen. Trotz das wir aufgepasst hatten, haben meine 2 Kinder und ich Magendarm mit Durchfall gehabt.!!!!! Vor ist ein Arztraum aber kein Arzt da, da saß ein Pfleger und sagte ich soll ins Krankenhaus Zum Glück hatte ich Medikamente dabei!"
translated_text: "The pool was very dirty on the first day, we had the pool closed because of excrement. The next day the children's pool was closed also because of excrement!!! We didn't really see if they were cleaning the pool either, I don't think they use chlorine either!! We were so annoyed that we were only on the beach. The beach was the worst I've ever been to!!! There was a lot of white foam in the water!!!!!! There is no drinks service!!!!! The staff is just busy clearing the dishes with a very dirty cart You can see the carts where the dirty dishes come in, your appetite is gone. This is definitely not a 5 star hotel!!!! The reviews are wrong or fake. One morning we had breakfast at 10:15 a.m., the breakfast buffet was at 10:30 a.m. and we still managed to take little things, there were also a lot of guests sitting in the restaurant, when it was 10:40 a.m. the lights and the air conditioning went out and we couldn't sit in the restaurant anymore, because man "I was really sweating. What I want to say is that the staff is busy clearing up and trying to clean what they can't do properly. The toilets are so dirty, in the lobby and outside. Despite being careful, my two children and I had stomach problems with diarrhea.!!!!! There was a doctor there and I had to go to the hospital."

review_text: "Hotel sehr sauber, tolles Abendprogramm, auch für Kinder viel Programm und Animation, sehr großes leckeres Buffett, Betten sind etwas hart,"
translated_text: "Hotel very clean, great evening program, lots of program and entertainment for children too, very large delicious buffet, beds are a bit hard,"

review_text: "Hinta laatusuhde on erittäin hyvä valinta"
translated_text: "The price-quality ratio is a very good choice"

review_text: "Prima hotel om te verblijven. Iedereen doet zijn best."
translated_text: "Great hotel to stay in. Everyone does their best."

review_text: "Ein tolles und sauberes Hotel, die angestellten sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ein besonderer Dank geht an Barkeeperin HACER die tolle Cocktails zaubert. Zudem gibt es ein tolles Animationsteam besteht aus SEFA, TAHA, FERDO und viele mehr, die jeden Tag tolle und spannende Programme anbieten. Zudem sind mir auch Service Mitarbeiter wie Celal, Baybal oder auch Merve aufgefallen. Die Zimmer werden täglich sauber gemacht, zudem wird immer minibar aufgefüllt (die Getränke sind inklusive). Wir sind als Familie gereist und meine kleine Tochter hat sich im Hotel sehr wohl gefühlt, da das Animations Team vor Ort oder auch das Programm wie die BALLON SHOW und anschließend Seifenblasen sehr gemocht. Das Buffet ist sehr reichhaltig und für jedermann ist immer was dabei. Das Hotel ist eine klare Empfehlung. Vielen Dank an das gesamte Orange County Team."
translated_text: "A great and clean hotel, the employees are very friendly and helpful. A special thanks goes to bartender HACER who conjures up great cocktails. There is also a great animation team consisting of SEFA, TAHA, FERDO and many more who offer great and exciting programs every day. I also noticed service employees like Celal, Baybal and Merve. The rooms are cleaned daily and the minibar is always refilled (drinks are included). We traveled as a family and my little daughter felt very comfortable in the hotel because of the animation team on site and the program like the BALLON SHOW and then bubbles. The buffet is very rich and there is always something for everyone. The hotel is a clear recommendation. "

review_text: "Établissement idéal pour séjour familiale, aménagements spacieux et entretenus."
translated_text: “Ideal establishment for a family stay, spacious and well-maintained facilities.”

review_text: "Es ist ein schönes Hotel mit viel Angebot an Animation, Zeitverbringung und Essen. Unser Zimmer war schön und sauber, mit großem Fernseher und Kühlschrank, der jeden Tag mit neuen Getränken nachgefüllt wurde. Vom Balkon aus konnten wir das Meer und den Pool sehen. Das Zimmer wurde täglich sehr gut gereinigt. Leider gab es einen ständigen Tropfgeräusch in der Toilette, was Nachts gestört hat. Da das Hotel sehr groß ist, sind sehr viele Besucher da, es ist permanent laut, besonders beim Essen in der großen Mensa. Die Liegen sind ständig durch ein Tuch reserviert, dabei werden sie kaum benutzt. Das Personal spricht meistens mehrere Sprachen, wir konnten uns gut verständigen. Allerdings fiel auf, dass einige Mitarbeiter genervt/unfreundlich/wie abwesend waren. Was uns besonders gut gefallen hat, ist der Riesenpool, wo für alle genug Platz war, viele Spiel-und Tobemöglichkeiten wie z.B. Wasserrutschen für Groß und Klein und tolle Shows jeden Abend. Aber auch, dass es überall schnell und ordentlich geputzt wurde. Der Strand war etwas zu steinig für uns."
translated_text: "It is a nice hotel with a lot of entertainment, spending time and food. Our room was nice and clean, with a large TV and a fridge that was refilled with new drinks every day. From the balcony we could see the sea and the pool. The room was cleaned very well every day. Unfortunately there was a constant dripping noise in the toilet, which was annoying at night. Since the hotel is very large, there are a lot of visitors, it is constantly loud, especially when eating in the large cafeteria. The loungers are constantly covered by a cloth reserved, but they are hardly used. The staff mostly spoke several languages, we were able to communicate well. However, we noticed that some employees were annoyed/unfriendly/absent. What we particularly liked was the huge pool, where there was enough space for everyone, lots of opportunities to play and run around, such as water slides for young and old, and great shows every evening.

review_text: "Generelt fint hotel. Mad var godt men dessert manglede kvalitet, fokuser på kvalitet fremfor kvantitet. Min datter var ude for en hændelse ulykke da personalet var uopmærksom. Løsningen var ringe da de burde stoppe ulykken og tale med den anden barns familie samt deres personale. Nuray Alp som lavede "Gözleme" gjorde fantastisk arbejde og lækker mad. Ville godt kunne opholde mig der igen."
translated_text: "Overall nice hotel. Food was good but dessert lacked quality, focus on quality over quantity. My daughter had an incident accident when the staff was inattentive. The solution was poor as they should stop the accident and talk to the other child's family and their staff. Nuray Alp who made "Gözleme" did a great job and delicious food. Would be able to stay there again."

review_text: "Een hele fijne hotel met vriendelijk en hard werkend personeel. Ze doen hun uiterste best om je op een nette manier tevreden te houden, en het lukt ze ook. Het is zoals er beschreven staat echt een familie hotel, waar je zonder zorgen kan komen met je gezin. Er is voor iedereen wel iets wat hij kan eten, en het eten smaakt ook heel lekker. Ze zijn ook heel schoon in en buiten het hotel. Animaties zijn ook leuk geregeld zodat kinderen en volwassenen zich kunnen vermaken. Ik kom hier zeker vaker terug!"
translated_text: "A very nice hotel with friendly and hard-working staff. They do their utmost to keep you satisfied in a courteous manner, and they succeed. As described, it is really a family hotel, where you can come with your family without any worries. There is something for everyone to eat, and the food also tastes very good. They are also very clean in and outside the hotel. Animations are also nicely arranged so that children and adults can enjoy themselves. I will definitely come back here more often!"

review_text: "Établissement familiale, bon acceuil, situé idéalement."
translated_text: “Family establishment, good welcome, ideally located.”

review_text: "Közel a városközponthoz, parkolási lehetőség a ház előtt. A reggeli minden nap ugyanaz volt, unalmas."
translated_text: "Close to the city center, parking in front of the house. Breakfast was the same every day, boring."

review_text: "Die Unterkunft hat einige positive Aspekte, aber auch einige Mängel. Die Lage in der Altstadt ist wirklich toll und bietet viele Möglichkeiten zur Erkundung. Das Frühstück war in Ordnung und es wurde sich bemüht: Es gab jeden Morgen einen Korb mit Semmeln und für jeden einen Teller mit verschiedenen süßen und herzhaften Sachen. Tee und Insantkaffee konnte man sich selbst nehmen. Leider war die Sauberkeit nicht zufriedenstellend. Unter dem Bett fand sich eine fremde Flasche, was nicht gerade ein gutes Gefühl vermittelt. Zudem funktionierte der Ablauf der Dusche nicht richtig, was den Komfort beeinträchtigt hat. Auch die Lautstärke war ein Problem, da es oft recht laut war. Insgesamt gibt es Raum für Verbesserungen, insbesondere in Bezug auf Sauberkeit und Lärmschutz."
translated_text: "The accommodation has some positive aspects, but also some shortcomings. The location in the old town is really great and offers a lot of opportunities to explore. The breakfast was okay and an effort was made: there was a basket of rolls every morning and a plate with various sweet and savory things for everyone. You could take your own tea and instant coffee. Unfortunately, the cleanliness was not satisfactory. There was a foreign bottle under the bed, which doesn't exactly give a good feeling. In addition, the shower drain didn't work properly, which reduced the comfort "The noise level was also an issue as it was often quite loud. Overall, there is room for improvement, particularly in terms of cleanliness and noise control."

review_text: "La chambre été humide semble avec des cafards énorme mon séjour a été un véritable cauchemar j’ai demandé à changer de chambre le patron m’as envoyé balader je suis très déçus et déconseillé je me suis fait avoir alors je partage ma mauvaise expérience pour avisé !"
translated_text: "The room was humid and seemed to have huge cockroaches. My stay was a real nightmare. I asked to change rooms. The boss sent me away. I am very disappointed and not recommended. I was fooled, so I am sharing my bad experience for the wise! "

review_text: "Das einzig Positive an Sabah Pansiyon ist eigentlich die tolle Lage, ansonsten kann ich nicht viel dazu sagen oder schreiben, weil wir dort nur geschlafen haben. Etwas notgedrungen, weil wir die Buchung nicht mehr stornieren konnten und ich den Fehler gemacht habe, direkt für 4 Tage zu buchen. Jedenfalls sind die Zimmer nicht dem Preis entsprechend, der hohe Preis lässt sich wohl auf Grund der zentralen Lage erklären. Kurz gesagt, ich habe mich wegen der unverständlich hohen Anzahl von positiven Bewertungen wohl blenden lassen, die ich ehrlich gesagt auch nicht ganz nachvollziehen kann. Ich würde hier nie wieder buchen, wünsche der Familie dieser Pension aber alles erdenklich Gute und weiterhin viel Erfolg."
translated_text: "The only positive thing about Sabah Pansiyon is actually the great location, otherwise I can't say or write much about it because we only slept there. A bit out of necessity because we couldn't cancel the booking and I made the mistake of booking directly for 4 days. In any case, the rooms don't correspond to the price, the high price can probably be explained by the central location. In short, I was probably blinded by the incomprehensibly high number of positive reviews, which to be honest I don't quite understand I would never book here again, but I wish the family of this guesthouse all the best and continued success."

review_text: "Nous avons séjourné 2 nuits courant Août en chambre 404. Chambre au calme ne dont pas sur la rue donc idéale pour se reposer tout en gardant une proximité sur la vieille ville. La chambre dispose d’une bonne Clim! L’hôtel est idéalement situé : en plein cœur du centre. Accueil sympathique, nous sommes arrivés à 8h du matin et nous avons eut le droit au petit déjeuner gratuitement. Le petit déjeuner est simple et toujours similaire donc pas de surprise, pas déçu pas conquis. Piscine qui pourrait être entretenu/ nettoyé plus régulièrement : le jet d’eau ne fonctionne pas et il y a du sable et des feuilles. Elle reste idéale pour se rafraîchir. Je recommande tout de même."
translated_text: "We stayed for 2 nights in August in room 404. Quiet room not facing the street so ideal for resting while still being close to the old town. The room has good air conditioning! The hotel is ideally located: right in the heart of the center. Friendly welcome, we arrived at 8 a.m. and we were entitled to breakfast for free. Breakfast is simple and always similar so no surprises, not disappointed, not won over. Swimming pool which could be maintained/cleaned more regularly: the water jet does not work and there is sand and leaves. It remains ideal for cooling off. I still recommend it.

review_text: "Pas très propre, en plus d'être cher pour ce que c'est. Les photos sont trompeuses."
translated_text: “Not very clean, in addition to being expensive for what it is. The photos are deceiving.”

review_text: "Herşey mükemmeldi,iyiki burayı tercih etmişiz,tam bir aile işletmesi, biz apart dairede kaldık tam havuz karşısı, evimizi hiç aratmadı Herşey için çok teşekkürler"
translated_text: "Everything was perfect, we are glad we chose this place, it is a complete family business, we stayed in an apartment right in front of the pool, it was like our home, thank you very much for everything"

review_text: "Super Lage, schöne Zimmer, sehr nettes Personal, tolles Frühstück!"

review_text: "Le personnel était au top, souriant et accueillant. Nous sommes une petite famille de 5 et avons adoré nos 10 jours. Petit couac : le frigo ne fonctionnait pas mais on avait au moins le congélateur. La Clim est super fonctionnelle, indispensable face à la chaleur. Concert la propreté, le lieu et propre et bien entretenu mis à part dans les chambres, où il manquait un peu de propreté."
translated_text: "The staff was great, smiling and welcoming. We are a small family of 5 and loved our 10 days. Small hiccup: the fridge didn't work but we at least had the freezer. The air conditioning is super functional, essential in the heat. Concert cleanliness, the place is clean and well maintained apart from in the rooms, where it lacked a little cleanliness."

review_text: "Mycket trevligt och peronligt hotell ! Bra läge. Fin personal som är serviceinriktad och vill väl. Hade bokat den nyrenoverade lägenheten som var fin! Kan verkligen rekommendera och åker gärna tillbaka igen"
translated_text: "Very nice and personable hotel! Good location. Nice staff who are service oriented and want well. Had booked the newly renovated apartment which was nice! Can really recommend and would love to go back again"

review_text: "Personnel extrêmement accueillant et serviable On se croirait presque en famille Petit déjeuner inclus et copieux Très bonne localisation Une superbe expérience Bravo"
translated_text: “Extremely welcoming and helpful staff It almost feels like family Breakfast included and generous Very good location A superb experience Well done”

review_text: "Muy buen servicio, desayuno muy completo, habitación cómoda, limpia y con lo necesario. Muy buena ubicación, cerca a todo!"
translated_text: "Very good service, very complete breakfast, comfortable, clean room with everything you need. Very good location, close to everything!"

review_text: "Harika bir konaklama.Kurban bayramı boyunca 8 gece kaldığım bu hotelde çok rahat ve keyifli bir konaklama yaptım. Otel Antalya Kaleiçinde oldukça iyi bir konumda. Fayda fiyat dengesine baktığımda oldukça başarılı bulduğum otelin kahvaltısı da oldukça iyiydi. Çalışanları oldukça kibar ve güler yüzlü olan otelde özellikle Faruk Bey'in ilgili ve bilgilendirici tavrından dolayı çok teşekkür ederim."
translated_text: "It was a wonderful stay. I had a very comfortable and pleasant stay in this hotel, where I stayed for 8 nights during the Eid al-Adha. The hotel is in a very good location in Antalya Kaleiçi. The breakfast of the hotel, which I found very successful when I looked at the benefit-price balance, was also very good. The staff of the hotel were very polite and friendly, and I would like to thank especially Mr. Faruk for his caring and informative attitude."

review_text: "Klimanın yönlendirme fonksiyonu bozuktu. Gece ses olduğunu bilerek tercih ettik. Fakat bu kadar ses olacağını düşünmezdim. İlk yerleştirdikleri oda ve yatak çok küçüktü sonrasında daha normal bir oda verdiler. F/p olarak tercih edilebilir."
translated_text: "The directing function of the air conditioner was broken. We chose it knowing that there would be noise at night. But I did not think there would be this much noise. The first room and bed they placed in were very small, then they gave me a more normal room. It may be preferred as an F/P."

review_text: "Super bien !.Hôtel très sympathique, personnel gentil, chambre confortable, propre, nous recomendons."
translated_text: “Super good!.Very friendly hotel, kind staff, comfortable room, clean, we recommend.”

review_text: "Excelente.Hôtel bien situé, à 3 min de la vielle ville, à 30 min à pie de la plage, tranquille, rue calme, personnel sympa, attentionné, chambre propre, lit confortable, bonne climatisation. Petit détail: manque un torchon pour la cuisine, cuisine bien équipée et fonctionnelle."
translated_text: "Excellent. Hotel well located, 3 minutes from the old town, 30 minutes walk from the beach, quiet, quiet street, friendly, attentive staff, clean room, comfortable bed, good air conditioning. Small detail: missing a kitchen towel, well-equipped and functional kitchen."

review_text: "El personal en general es amable, pero el hotel tiene mucho que mejorar, las fotos que aparecen en Expedia, no son para nada lo que encuentras en la propiedad, el cuarto olía a caño y a cigarro, que decir del olor a humedad, las camas están en muy mal estado estado, con marcas y manchas de dudosa procedencia, lo bueno que tiene es que está cerca del casco antiguo y hay muchas ofertas de comida alrededor. Nuevamente, insisto, el personal es amable."
translated_text: "The staff in general is friendly, but the hotel has a lot to improve, the photos that appear on Expedia are not at all what you find on the property, the room smelled of sewage and cigarettes, what can I say about the musty smell, the beds are in very poor condition, with marks and stains of dubious origin, the good thing about it is that it is close to the old town and there are many food offers around. Again, I insist, the staff is friendly."

review_text: "Das Hotel liegt sehr nah am Schiffhafen und direkt im Zentrum, gute Busverbindung und Straßenbahn in der Umgebung . Unser Zimmer hatte eine Küche , was sehr praktisch war. Das Personal war sehr nett."
translated_text: "The hotel is very close to the ship port and right in the center, good bus connections and trams in the area. Our room had a kitchen, which was very practical. The staff was very nice."

review_text: "Temizlik oldukça kötüydü. Jakuzinin içi de pisti. Çok konforlu bir otel olacakken hijyene önem gösterilmemesinden bakımsız bir otel olmuş."
translated_text: "The cleanliness was quite bad. The inside of the jacuzzi was also dirty. Although it was supposed to be a very comfortable hotel, it turned into a poorly maintained hotel due to lack of attention to hygiene."

review_text: "Mükemmel konum.Konum mükemmel. Kahvaltı yok ama çevredeki marketlerden malzeme alabilir mutfakta hazırlayabilirsiniz.otel Çevresinde birçok yeme içme alternatifleri mrvcut."
translated_text: "Excellent location. The location is perfect. There is no breakfast, but you can buy ingredients from the surrounding markets and prepare them in the kitchen. There are many eating and drinking alternatives around the hotel."

review_text: "Bir daha kalmam ve tavsiye etmem.Öncelikle odada wi-fi çekmiyordu. Sadece "Özel banyo" var demek için odanın içine yapılmış. üstü yarım açık bırakılmış ve dolayısıyla oda ile bağlantısı kesilmemiş bir bölümdü. Bundan dolayı banyo-tuvalet bölümünde oluşan kokular odaya geliyordu. Yine aynı bölümde duşakabin. küvet veya duş teknesi konulmamıştı. Bundan dolayı yerler tamamen su içinde kalıyor, klozeti sulara badarak kullanmak zorunda kalıyorsunuz. Ayrıca bu bölmenin eni 1 m civarında. boyu da belki 3 m. Yani içeride dönmekte zorlanıyorsunız. Lavabosu iki avuç büyüklüğünde ve tam duvar dibine sıfırlanmış, bel değil, bacak hizasında, aynada kendinizi görebilmeniz büyük başarı, kısaca bu da "lavabo var" demek için konulmuş. Bir de lavaboya ulaşabilmek için önce kapıyı tamamen kapatmanız gerekiyor. Ancak o da tam kapanmıyor. Bunların dışında klima aşırı sesli çalışıyor. Ayrıca  aynı kattaki diğer odaların kullandığı ortak banyo hemen bitişik ve sanırım mukavva panelle bölünmüş. Aşırı gürültü geliyor. Tatminkar olan özellik olarak bir tek ortam temizliğini söyleyebilirim. Özet olarak ise alı ücreti hak etmediğini söyleyebilirim. Bir daha kalmam ve kalınmasını da tavsiye etmem."
translated_text: "I wouldn't stay again and I wouldn't recommend it. First of all, there was no Wi-Fi connection in the room. It was built inside the room just to say there was a "private bathroom". It was a section that was left half open and therefore was not disconnected from the room. Therefore, the odors from the bathroom-toilet section were coming into the room. Again, there was no shower cabin, bathtub or shower tray in the same section. For this reason, the floors are completely submerged in water and you have to use the toilet by submerging it in water. Also, the width of this section is around 1 m and the length is maybe 3 meters. m. So, you have a hard time turning around inside. The sink is the size of two palms and is positioned right at the foot of the wall, not at waist level. It is a great success to be able to see yourself in the mirror. In short, you have to close the door completely to reach the sink. Apart from these, the air conditioner is extremely loud. Also, the shared bathroom used by the other rooms on the same floor is right next door and I think it is divided by a cardboard panel. The only thing that is satisfactory is the atmosphere. "I can say that it is clean. In summary, I can say that it is not worth the price. I would not stay there again and I would not recommend it."

review_text: "Personal, piscina y entorno perfecto. Pension bastante vieja, necesita renovacion. Desayuno mejorable. El precio es razonablemente bueno. Personal super amable"
translated_text: "Perfect staff, pool and environment. Quite old pension, needs renovation. Breakfast could be improved. Price is reasonably good. Super friendly staff"

review_text: "Sehr gute Lage mitten in der Altstadt von Antalya. Alles fußläufig erreichbar. Sehr nettes Personal."
translated_text: "Very good location in the middle of the old town of Antalya. Everything within walking distance. Very nice staff."

review_text: "オーナーが（特に日本人には）色々教えてくれたり面倒を見てくれるので快適に滞在できる。 朝食は一応朝8時からということになってるが、だいたい9時くらいから。 中庭ではwifiはバッチリ使えるが、宿泊した部屋では電波が入らなかった点が残念。 これはペンションの評価とは無関係ながら、はす向かいのレストランがライブやベリーダンスショーを夜中？までしていて、気になる人は眠れないかもしれないので、耳栓など持参するとよいかも。"
translated_text: "The owner (especially for Japanese people) teaches us various things and takes care of us, so we can stay comfortably. Breakfast is supposed to start at 8 a.m., but it usually starts around 9 a.m. The Wi-Fi works perfectly in the courtyard, but unfortunately there was no signal in the room we stayed in. This has nothing to do with the rating of the pension, but the restaurant across the street is holding live music and belly dance shows until midnight, so if you're worried about it, you might not be able to sleep, so it might be a good idea to bring earplugs.

review_text: "Gidilebilir.Tuvalet kapısının kırık olması ve klimanın damlatması dışında çok büyük bir sıkıntı göremedim ama fiyat performans açısından çok iyi bir yer idi."
translated_text: "It's okay to go. I didn't see any major problems other than the broken toilet door and the air conditioner dripping, but it was a very good place in terms of price and performance."

review_text: "Lå hygli Svært at finde, godt taxa manden kendte vejen"
translated_text: "Lå hygli Hard to find, good taxi the man knew the way"

review_text: "1 günlük merkezi ve temiz bir oteldi bizim için"
translated_text: "It was a central and clean hotel for 1 day"

review_text: "Fiyat performans.Herşey çok güzeldi, otel görevlisi, güler yüzlü ve oldukça yardımcı birisi ancak duvarlar çok ses geçirdiği için uyumak büyük bir sorun oluyor. (gecenin bir vakti temizlik ve düzenleme gürültülüsü)"
translated_text: "Price/performance. Everything was very good, the hotel staff is friendly and very helpful, but sleeping is a big problem because the walls transmit a lot of sound (noise from cleaning and arrangement at night)"

review_text: "Sehr freundliches Personal , Zimmer sind gepflegt Check in spätestens ohne Probleme."
translated_text: "Very friendly staff, rooms are well maintained. Check in was no problem at the latest."

review_text: "Memnun kalmadığım bir deneyim oldu.Çok daha iyi bir performans beklerken süzün siz ekonomik odayı tercih etmişsiniz diyerek en fazla bu olur size gibicesine bir oda verildi bize. Oda çok küçüktü, klima gürültülü çalıştığından ara dura kapatıp kafamızı dinlendirdik. Odada buz dolabı olmadığından gece canımız soğuk bir şey istese de maalesef ki içemedik. Temizlık konusunda fena değillerdi. Oda merdivenlerin yanında olduğu İçin diğer misafirlerin merdiven çıkarken konuştukları bizim odamızdan komple duyuluyordu. Antalya bölgesinde ve Türkiye’nin genelinde bu ücretlere konaklama yaptım. En memnuniyetsiz kaldığım otellerden biriydi. Bunlar kişisel deneyimimdi. Herkesin kişisel deneyimi ve fikri farklı olabilir tabiki. Konum olarak mükemmel bir konumda çok rahatlıkla her yere ulaşılabilir. Gece geldiğimizde resepsiyon görevlisi uyuyordu çok güvenlik beklemeyin odanızı kitlemeden uyumayın"
translated_text: "It was an experience that I was not satisfied with. While we were expecting a much better performance, we were given a room with the impression that this would be the most that would happen to you. The room was very small, and since the air conditioner was noisy, we turned it off and rested our heads from time to time. Since there was no refrigerator in the room, we wanted something cold at night, but unfortunately we couldn't drink it. They were not bad in terms of cleanliness. Since the room was next to the stairs, we could hear the other guests talking while climbing the stairs. We were in the Antalya region and Turkey. It was one of the hotels I stayed at for this price. These were my personal experiences. Of course, everyone's personal experience and opinion may be different. The location is perfect, everywhere is easily accessible. When we arrived at night, the receptionist was sleeping. Do not sleep without locking your room."

review_text: "Önceden de konakladığımız otel olduğu için tercih ettik. Otel sahipleri çok ilgili ve her istediğiniz konuda yardımcı oluyor. Ayrıca otelin güzel bir terası ve restoranı var oralarda vakit geçirebilirsiniz. Her şey için teşekkürler"
translated_text: "We chose it because it was the hotel we stayed in before. The hotel owners are very attentive and help you with anything you want. Additionally, the hotel has a nice terrace and restaurant where you can spend time. Thank you for everything."

review_text: "Resepsiyondakiler ilgiliydi. Konaklamamızda hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık. Sadece minibar olsa daha iyi olurdu. Yan odaların ve koridorun sesi biraz fazla geliyordu. Odalar biraz küçüktü. Onun haricinde her şey mükemmeldi."
translated_text: "The people at the reception were attentive. We had no problems during our stay. It would have been better if there was only a minibar. The noise from the side rooms and the corridor was a little too loud. The rooms were a little small. Other than that, everything was perfect."

review_text: "Debería mejorar las camas, se sienten los resortes. Las toallas son muy ásperas, un poco de suavizante haría la diferencia. En general muy buena ubicación y por el precio el hotel es adecuado."
translated_text: "The beds should be improved, the springs feel good. The towels are very rough, a little fabric softener would make a difference. In general, a very good location and for the price the hotel is adequate."

review_text: "2nachten verbleven ,goed onthaal,redelijke ontbijt(redelijke plateau da ze direkt klaarmaken als je aan tafel gaat) ,loopafstand van winkels,restaurants,strand,etc.kaer was ruim genoeg miste alleen tafeltje voor koffer op te zetten. Voor die prijs ,goed hotel"

For that price, good hotel"

review_text: "Temizlik çok iyi, oda dar, ama otantik. ek yatak istedik, sadece baza geldi,üzerine battaniye koyarak yatak yaptılar. 3 kişi için yeterli, 4 değil. Gece geç saatte çevre gürültüsü çok. It is enough for 3 people, not 4. There is a lot of environmental noise late at night. It is more suitable for young families or families without children who want to be close to entertainment venues. There is no need to buy breakfast, packaged jam and cheese."

review_text: "Bra, du får det du betaler for.Hadde et bra opphold, hyggelige folk som arbeider der. Noe lav standard på bad, litt gammelt og slitt, men rent. God AC som fungerte uten problem. Veldig nær sentrum med klubber i nærheten, kan være en del lyd om natten."
translated_text: "Good, you get what you pay for. Had a good stay, nice people working there. Somewhat low standard in bathroom, a bit old and worn, but clean. Good AC that worked without problems. Very close to the center with clubs nearby, can be quite noisy at night."

review_text: "İyi, memnun oldum, tavsiye ederim.Bu otelde geçtiğimiz hafta 4 gün kaldım. Fiyatına göre çok iyi uygun ekonomik. Hizmet iyi resepsiyon 7/24 açık. İlgililer anlayışlı kibar ve çözüm odaklılar yardımcı oluyorlar. Odaların temizliği günlük yapılıyor, temiz. Odq temizligi Duş malzemeleri, pecete, havlu, çöp günlük kontrol ediliyor. Klima ve mini dolap var çay ve nescafe için kettle var. Havuz var küçük temiz Kahvaltı var başka bir otele bağlı yakın ve güzel Kahvaltı yapabiliyorsunuz önem verilerek hazırlanıyor çesit seçenek çok. Çevre aksamları hareketli kaleiçinde olduğu icin ziyaretci çok müzikli mekanlar var geç saatlere kadar ses oluyor fakat rahatsız etmedi. Merkeze yakın kaleiçi liman, konyaaltı, muratpasa çok yakın tramvaya yakın. Genel olarak fiyatına göre çevredeki otellere göre iyi. Tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "Good, I am satisfied, I recommend it. I stayed at this hotel for 4 days last week. It is very good and economical for the price. The service is good, the reception is open 24/7. The people involved are understanding, polite and solution-oriented and they help. The rooms are cleaned daily, clean. The room is clean. Shower equipment, napkins, towels, garbage are checked daily. There is air conditioning and a mini cupboard, there is a kettle for tea and Nescafe. The pool is small and clean. It is connected to another hotel. It is close and you can have a nice breakfast. It is important." There are a lot of options. Since the surrounding area is lively in Kaleiçi, there are many places with music, but it was not disturbing. It is close to the center, Kaleiçi port, Konyaalti and Muratpasa. In general, it is better than the surrounding hotels.

review_text: "Her konuda yardımcı olduğunuz için teşekkür ediyorum"
translated_text: "Thank you for your help in everything"

review_text: "Fiyat/Performans Şampiyonu.Çok başarılı bir fiyat/performans oteli. Tek başınıza/grup olarak, kısa süreli ve yalnızca konaklama amaçlı bir otel arayanlar için ideal. Kaleiçi'nde olması nedeniyle hem limana hem de ulaşım araçlarının geçtiği güzergahlara çok yakın. Otobüs ve tramvay kullanarak birçok yere ulaşım mümkün. Otel personeli son derece kibar ve güleryüzlüydü. Odalar oldukça temiz. Tek kişilik yatak konforluydu fakat yastıkların içine biraz daha dolgu eklemek gerekli. Baş içerisine gömüldüğü için neredeyse yokmuş gibi olabiliyor. Odanın günlük temizliği, havluların değişimi zamanında yapıldı. Yakındaki barlardan gelen sesler rahatsız edici olabiliyor fakat bu da yine kişiden kişiye değişebilecek bir etkiye sahip. Le manager s'efforçait pour que notre sejour se passe parfaitement et je le remercie de sa bienveillance. Je prenais aussi un plaisir à discuter la nuit avec Mehmet, un salarié du personnel, à l'entrée de l'hôtel. Ces instants me manqueront car nous ne voyions pas le temps passé tant nos discussions étaient passionnantes. La chambre avec balcon était parfaite et propre (seulement, il serait intéressant de passer tous les jours l'aspirateur car par moment, nous retrouvions encore des cheveux sur le sol). Hormis ce detail, la litterie et la chambre sont parfaites. Enfin, la piscine est le petit plus de l'hôtel. Cest une grande piscine, spacieuse et l'eau etait propre et chaude. Un excellent hôtel que je recommande et ne manquerai pas de revenir dans cet hôtel à l'occasion dun prochain séjour à Antalya."

The breakfast, included in our stay, was exquisite, with an excellent Turkish coffee to start the day. The hotel staff was perfect and behaved wonderfully. The manager did his best to ensure that our stay went perfectly and I thank him for his kindness. I also took pleasure in chatting at night with Mehmet, an employee of the staff, at the entrance to the hotel. I will miss these moments because we did not see the time passing as our discussions were so fascinating. The room with balcony was perfect and clean (only, it would be interesting to vacuum it every day because at times, we still found hair on the floor). Apart from this detail, the bedding and the room are perfect. An excellent hotel that I recommend and will not fail to return to this hotel during a next stay in Antalya."

Nous étions dans une chambre non-fumeur, une des deux seules chambres non fumeurs de notre côté de l’étage et malheureusement selon qui sera votre voisin, vous aurez l’odeur de la cigarette qui rentrera dans votre chambre. Le sol de notre chambre n’a pas été une seule fois nettoyé correctement. Hôtel avec du bon et du moins bon mais le prix est tout de même trop cher pour le manque de changement de serviettes et de nettoyage des chambres lors du séjour."

“Overall correct but lacking in cleanliness.

Clean swimming pool and accessible all day until 7:30 p.m. We had a room on the street side and unfortunately we were right above the Irish Pub which certainly played nice music but the resonance was still very present even after midnight. The floor in our room was not once cleaned properly. Hotel with good and bad but the price is still too expensive for the lack of change of towels and cleaning of rooms during the stay."

hotel_name: My Home Hotel Antalya City Center
review_text: "Elendig hotel.Så elendig. Man sov på fjedre hvilket gav massive rygsmerter. Værelset var lille, man følte sig lukket inde i et kosteskab. Morgenmaden var kedelig. Total overpris for det man får. Vil fraråde dette hotel, tænker at et hostel vil give mere."

review_text: "Samimi, temiz ve becerikli işletmecilik.Aile konaklaması için her şey düşünülmüş. Bulaşık süngerinden çamaşır ipine kadar her şey mevcut. Mükemmel temizlikte, personel çok samimi."

review_text: "Anbefaler ikke ..Værelserne var beskidte, blev ikke ordentlig rengjort . Håndklæder og sengesæt blev ikke udskiftet under opholdet . Meget ringe morgenmad. Eneste positive var deres pool som var god til børn."
translated_text: "Do not recommend..The rooms were dirty, not properly cleaned. Towels and bedding were not changed during the stay. Very poor breakfast. Only positive was their pool which was good for children."

review_text: "Çok teşekkür ederiz. Hizmetleriniz çok mükemmel. Resepsiyon, restoran, ve temizlik elemanı hizmetleri profesyonel."

review_text: "Kötü bir yer"

review_text: "Sehr angenehmes kleines „Familienhotel“. Es ist ruhig, sehr angenehm. Essen ist reichhaltig und abwechslungsreich und gut. Personal ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Gerne wieder."

review_text: "Nettes freundliches Personal und nah am Strand."

review_text: "Dejligt rent og gode faciliteter"

review_text: "Top Lage, super Hotel! Hotel top! Lage Top! wir hatten kein frühstück nur zum übernachten und fürs Pool gebucht! Die Lage war besser als erwartet. Mitten in der Stadt. Bazar zu fuss erreichbar, Strand zu fuss erreichbar, die Clubs, Pubs und Bars und Kaleici welche bekannt ist für das Nachtleben auch zu fuss erreichbar. haben Kein taxi benötigt. taxi in antalya soll auch wohl sehr teuer sein, nicht vergleichbar mit istanbul."
translated_text: "Top location, great hotel! Hotel top! Location top! We didn't book breakfast just to stay overnight and for the pool! The location was better than expected. Right in the middle of the city. Bazaar within walking distance, beach within walking distance, the clubs, pubs and bars and Kaleici, which is known for its nightlife, also within walking distance. No taxi needed. Taxi in Antalya is also said to be very expensive, not comparable to Istanbul."

review_text: "Hotellet passar för övernattning innan nästa flyg. Inget lyx. Omtänksam personal."
translated_text: "The hotel is suitable for an overnight stay before the next flight. No luxury. Caring staff."

review_text: "Hat mir super gefallen war für eine Nacht da"
translated_text: “I really enjoyed staying there for one night”

review_text: "Mittelmäßig.Nur oberflächlich geputzt, ziemlich herunterkommen, draußen stinkte es extremst nach fäkalien und das Fenster war offen somit stinkte es im Zimmer auch ziemlich und roch die ganze Nacht unangenehm"
translated_text: "Mediocre. Only superficially cleaned, pretty run down, outside it smelled extremely like feces and the window was open so the room also smelled quite a bit and smelled unpleasant all night long"

review_text: "Super Service, laut (Flugzeuge), super gelegen! Das Hotel ist super central am Flughafen gelegen, ich konnte sogar mit mini Koffer zu Fuß die knapp 3 Kilometer hinlaufen, da mir nach dem langen Sitzen nach Bewegung war. Das Personal ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, es gibt ein Café, Restaurant und kleinen Shop mit dabei. Das Zimmer ist geräumig und sehr sauber, aber leider gab es nur zwei Kleiderbügel, keinen Stuhl im Zimmer zum Sitzen, einen Tisch auf dem großen Balkon und der Wasserkocher ging nicht. Meine Bitte, ihn zu ersetzen, wurde zwar gehört, aber nicht umgesetzt. Schade. Im Bad gab es kleine Annehmlichkeiten (Seife, Zahnkit etc)., die Bettwäsche war sauber, die Matratze bequem. Das Hotel liegt direkt in der Ein- und Abflugschneise des Flughafens, das war mir klar und bewusst, und die Flugzeuge über dem Haus machten mir deshalb nichts aus, da ich sie liebe, wer aber Lärmempfindlich ist, dem ist diese Unterkunft nicht zu empfehlen, die Flieger gehen echt direkt über das Haus! Für Planespotter dafür ideal! :-) Der Abschied war etwas holprig. Ich habe am Vorabend dreimal nach einem Shuttleservice zum Flughafen um 03:30 Uhr am Morgen gefragt, dreimal wurde mir das bestätigt, am nächsten Morgen ging das dann aber aus irgendwelchen Gründen nicht, Uber war nicht verfügbar und man bot mir an, für 10€ zum Flughafen zu fahren, oder ein Taxi zu rufen. Ich habe dann das Taxi rufen lassen und zahlte dafür mit Trinkgeld umgerechnet 5,20€"
translated_text: "Great service, noisy (planes), great location! The hotel is very centrally located at the airport, I was even able to walk the 3 kilometers with a small suitcase because I felt like moving after sitting for so long. The staff is very friendly and helpful, there is a café, restaurant and small shop. The room is spacious and very clean, but unfortunately there were only two hangers, no chair in the room to sit on, a table on the large balcony and the kettle didn't work. My request to replace it was granted It's a shame. There were small amenities in the bathroom (soap, dental kit, etc.), the bed linen was clean, the mattress was comfortable. The hotel was right in the airport's entry and departure path, and I didn't mind the planes over the house, but I don't recommend this accommodation for anyone who is sensitive to noise, the planes go directly over the house! The evening before, I asked three times for a shuttle service to the airport at 3:30 a.m., it was confirmed three times, but for some reason it didn't work the next morning, Uber wasn't available and I was offered a ride to the airport for €10 or a taxi. I then called the taxi and paid the equivalent of €5.20 with a tip.

review_text: "Alles war super nette personal gerne wieder"
translated_text: “Everything was great, nice staff would happily come back”

review_text: "Je recommande, pas loin de l'aéroport et du mall d'Antalya"
translated_text: “I recommend, not far from the airport and the Antalya mall”

review_text: "Sauber und gut, aber schlechte Umgebung.Hotel, Zimmer und Ausstattung waren sauber und sehr gut. Das Hotel befindet sich nahe am Flughafen, ist jedoch nur per Auto erreichbar. Die Bilder sind irreführend, es gibt keinen Pool. Neben dem Hotel befindet sich ein Restaurant. Ich habe mich als alleinreisende Frau etwas unsicher gefühlt, da die Umgebung sehr heruntergekommen ist und im Lokal nur türkische Männer saßen. Ungefähr alle 10 Minuten fliegt ein Flugzeug im Landeanflug sehr niedrig übers Hotel, auch in der Nacht. Der Zugang zum Balkon war mit Hilfe eines Stuhles blockiert. Ob das zum Schutz vor Einbrechern war, weiß ich nicht. Aus diesen Gründen fand ich den Preis zu hoch. Für eine Übernachtung im Anschluss an einen Flug ist es in Ordnung, sollte aber günstiger sein."
translated_text: "Clean and good, but poor environment. Hotel, rooms and facilities were clean and very good. The hotel is close to the airport, but can only be reached by car. The pictures are misleading, there is no pool. There is a restaurant next to the hotel. As a woman traveling alone, I felt a bit unsafe as the area was very run down and there were only Turkish men in the restaurant. Approximately every 10 minutes a plane approaches very low over the hotel, even at night. Access to the balcony was blocked with the help of a chair. I don't know whether this was to protect against burglars. For these reasons I found the price to be too high for an overnight stay following a flight, but it should be cheaper."

review_text: "Personnel très serviable et agréable de jour comme de nuit."
translated_text: “Very helpful and pleasant staff day and night.”

review_text: "Oteli bir aile işletiyor. Çok güleryüzlü ve yardımcılar. Biz havaalanına yakınlığı sebebi ile bir gece kaldık. Memnun kaldık."
translated_text: "The hotel is run by a family. They are very friendly and helpful. We stayed for one night because of its proximity to the airport. We were satisfied."

review_text: "Trevligt hotell som uppfyller förväntningarna. Rummet var rent och sängen bekväm. Inget spektakulärt, men ett bra och prisvärt val för en kort vistelse. Tack för oss"
translated_text: "Nice hotel that meets expectations. The room was clean and the bed comfortable. Nothing spectacular, but a good and affordable choice for a short stay. Thank you for us"

review_text: "Es war alles super, sehr freundliches Personal. Ich würde dieses Hotel jederzeit wieder Buchen"
translated_text: "Everything was great, very friendly staff. I would book this hotel again at any time"

review_text: "teşekkürler, her zamanki standart.."
translated_text: "thanks, usual standard.."

review_text: "Lara’da konum olarak harika civarında her şey mevcut 3 gün konakladık plajlar 15 dk uzaklıkta alkollü mekanlara yakın kahvaltıcılara yakın. Biz çok memnun kaldık odalar seçeneklere göre bizim gibi sadece uyumaya giden biri için güzeldi. Odamız günlük olarak temizlendi havlular değiştirildi sadece şampuan vs yenilenmedi. Odalara ekstra eklemeler yapılabilir. Güvenli ve merkezi bi yerde olması tercih sebebimizdi. Teşekkür ederim."
translated_text: "The location in Lara is great, everything is available around it. We stayed for 3 days, the beaches are 15 minutes away, close to alcoholic places and breakfast places. We were very pleased with the room options, it was nice for someone like us who only goes to sleep. Our room was cleaned daily, towels were changed, only shampoo etc. were not renewed. Extra additions can be made to the rooms. Being in a safe and central location was the reason for our preference. Thank you."

review_text: "Bir gece konakladık. Tertemizdi. Karşılayan bey çok kibardı. Deniz olanağı çok da iyi değildi.Denize girmeyi düşünmenden kalacaksanız ok. Otelin bulunduğu cadde üzerinde herşey var. Manzaralı oda tercih edin. Klima temiz havlu Bu fiyata daha ne olsun."
translated_text: "We stayed for one night. It was spotless. The gentleman who welcomed us was very polite. The sea access was not very good. If you are thinking of swimming in the sea, it is ok. There is everything on the street where the hotel is located. Choose a room with a view. Air conditioning, clean towels. What more could you ask for for this price?"

review_text: "Manzara gerçekten resimlerdekiyle bire bir aynı . Klima yeterli derecede soğutuyor . Terasta gün batımı ve gün doğumu çok keyifli . Sabah resepsiyondaki beyefendi de çok ilgiliydi. Kesinlikle tercih sebebi"
translated_text: "The view is exactly the same as in the pictures. The air conditioner cools it sufficiently. Sunset and sunrise on the terrace are very enjoyable. The gentleman at the reception in the morning was also very attentive. Definitely a choice."

review_text: "Alles gut"
translated_text: "It's all ok"

review_text: "Check in ve check out çok hızlı gerçekleşti. Oda temizdi. Sadece çok hafif bir sigara kokusu vardı. Otel konum olarak çok başarılı. Merkezi bir konumda idi."
translated_text: "Check-in and check-out were very fast. The room was clean. There was only a slight cigarette smell. The hotel was very well located. It was in a central location."

review_text: "Eine schöne Unterkunft mit sehr netten Personal. Lage top! Haben uns wie zuhause gefühlt. Bei Sonnenaufgang oder Sonnenuntergang saßen wir auf der Terrasse. Ein Traum. Eines der schönsten anblicke die wir je gesehen haben."
translated_text: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.

review_text: "Klima sorunu.Odadaki klima asla soğutmuyordu. Bebekle gittiğimiz için klima çok önemliydi çünkü bebek asla uyuyamadı her tarafı pişik oldu. Gece otelden çıkıp araba klimasıyla rahatlatmaya çalıştık. Resepsiyondaki çalışana durumu söyledik ancak yapabilecekleri bir şey olmadığını söylediler en azından müsait bir odaya geçirebilirlerdi."
translated_text: "Air conditioner problem. The air conditioner in the room was never cooling. Since we went with the baby, the air conditioner was very important because the baby could never sleep and had a rash all over. We left the hotel at night and tried to comfort him with the car air conditioner. We told the employee at the reception about the situation, but they said there was nothing they could do, at least they could have moved him to an available room."

review_text: "Yeni bir otel elbette eksikleri var ancak güler yüzlü, samimi ve saygılı ekibi ile oldukca başarılı buldum. Özellike odaya getirdikleri kahvalti cok guzeldi. Tebrik ediyorum."
translated_text: "It is a new hotel, of course it has its shortcomings, but I found it very successful with its friendly, sincere and respectful team. Especially the breakfast they brought to the room was very nice. Congratulations."

review_text: "El insaf.Geçen seneye nazaran pek memnun kalmağımı belirtmek isterim. Hotele geldiğim anda hiçbir şey ikram edilmedi. Geçen sene gelir gelmez odaya soğuk su meyve tabağı ikramı gelmişti lakin bu sene hiçbiri yoktu. Bu durum beni rahatsız etti."
translated_text: "It's fair. I would like to say that I am much more satisfied than last year. When I arrived at the hotel, I was not offered anything. Last year, as soon as I arrived, cold water and a fruit plate were offered to the room, but this year there was none. This disturbed me."

review_text: "Gutes und nettes Personal."
translated_text: "Good and nice staff."

review_text: "Konum olarak oldukça başarılı ve merkezi bir noktada yer alıyor. Ancak ne yazık ki konaklama deneyimimiz beklentimizin oldukça altında kaldı. Odada bulunan kahve setup’ında su ve temel ikramlar yer almıyordu; 3 kez söylememizin ardından iletildi. Temizlik konusunda ciddi eksikler vardı, özellikle banyo hijyeni ve detaylara gösterilen özen yetersizdi. Duş alanındaki giderin tıkalı olması gibi basit ama rahatsız edici problemlerle karşılaştık. Otelin potansiyeli yüksek ama hizmet ve temizlik açısından kesinlikle geliştirilmesi gerekiyor"
translated_text: "The location is quite successful and located in a central point. However, unfortunately, our accommodation experience was well below our expectations. The coffee setup in the room did not include water and basic refreshments; after we asked for it 3 times, it was communicated. There were serious deficiencies in cleanliness, especially bathroom hygiene and attention to detail were insufficient. We encountered simple but disturbing problems such as the clogged drain in the shower area. The hotel has high potential, but it definitely needs to be improved in terms of service and cleanliness."

hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Hotel Antalya, bir IHG oteli
review_text: "Bir yıl önce aynı otelde ailecek konaklamıştık, odalar temiz değildi ve banyo/WC sürekli kötü kokuyordu. Sigara içilmeyen oda istememize rağmen yoğun sigara kokusu vardı. Aradan bir yıl geçti, tekrar konakladık ama hiçbir şey değişmemiş. Banyo havalandırması çalışmıyor, yan odalardan sürekli gürültü geliyor. Yataklar geçen yıl gıcırdıyordu, bu defa daha da kötüydü. Hatta gece yarısı oda değişikliği talep ettik, başka oda verdiler ama sorunlar aynen devam etti: sigara kokusu, gürültü ve yatak gıcırtısı. Yan dönmek isteseniz bile ses çıkıyor. Kısacası, burada kalmayı düşünüyorsanız en az beş kere düşünün derim. Kesinlikle tavsiye etmiyorum."
translated_text: "We stayed in the same hotel as a family a year ago, the rooms were not clean and the bathroom/WC constantly smelled bad. Even though we requested a non-smoking room, there was a strong cigarette smell. A year passed, we stayed again, but nothing had changed. The bathroom ventilation is not working, there is constant noise from the adjacent rooms. The beds were squeaking last year, this time it was even worse. We even requested a room change at midnight, they gave us another room, but the problems continued the same: cigarette smell, noise and bed squeaking. Even if you wanted to turn around, In short, if you are thinking of staying here, think at least five times. I definitely do not recommend it.

hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Hotel Antalya, bir IHG oteli
review_text: "Pour un sejour plage/piscine. Tout le personnel est professionnel et très sympathique, à l'accueil, au restaurant, les femmes de chambre. Les chambres sont grandes et propres. La piscine en extérieure est grande, avec suffisamment de chaises longues. Seul bemol au niveau de la piscine, le carrelage est très glissant, il faut vraiment faire attention. Le petit dejeuner est varié et bon. Le restaurant du dernier etage est bon mais il était en rupture de 2 boissons (dont un jus d orange frais!) et d'un dessert, dommage surtout que la carte n'est pas immense . Il y a plusieurs excellents restaurants aux alentours. Il est facile de se garer puisqu'il y a un grand parking. Une bonne adresse."
translated_text: "For a beach/swimming pool stay. All the staff are professional and very friendly, at reception, in the restaurant, the housekeepers. The rooms are large and clean. The outdoor swimming pool is large, with enough deck chairs. The only downside at the swimming pool is that the tiling is very slippery, you really have to be careful. The breakfast is varied and good. The restaurant on the top floor is good but it was out of 2 drinks (including a fresh orange juice!) and a dessert, especially a shame as the menu is not huge. There are several excellent restaurants nearby. It is easy to park since there is a large parking lot.

hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Hotel Antalya, bir IHG oteli
review_text: "Die Lage des Hotels ist wirklich gut, allerdings merkt man dem Gebäude und der Ausstattung das Alter an. Besonders die Dusche war leider nicht zufriedenstellend – kaum Wasserdruck, und das Wasser verteilte sich unkontrolliert. Hier wäre eine Modernisierung sehr wünschenswert."
translated_text: "The location of the hotel is really good, but the building and the furnishings are showing their age. Unfortunately, the shower in particular was not satisfactory - there was hardly any water pressure and the water was distributed uncontrollably. Modernization would be very desirable here."

hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Hotel Antalya, bir IHG oteli
review_text: "Akşam yemeği berbattı. Otel personelinin akşam yemeğinde sadece gelen kalabalık uzakdoğu (çin) turist kafilesi ile ilgilendi. Yemek yememiz için bizi pis bir masaya oturttular. Servis kötüydü, yemekler kötüydü. Kimse ilgilenmedi. Sinekler havada uçuştu. Su servisi yapılmadı istememize rağmen."
translated_text: "Dinner was terrible. The hotel staff only cared about the crowded Far East (Chinese) tourist group during dinner. They sat us at a dirty table to eat. The service was bad, the food was bad. Nobody paid attention. Flies were flying in the air. Water was not served even though we requested it."

hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Hotel Antalya, bir IHG oteli
review_text: "Crowne plaza markasına güvenerek yaptırmış olduğumuz rezervasyon ve konaklamamızda maalesef hayal kırıklığı yaşadık. Öncelikle otel eski tadilat ve bakım gerekiyor. Otadoğu ya da arap ülkelerinden çok misafir vardı ve çok gürültü yapıyorlardı."
translated_text: "Unfortunately, we were disappointed with our reservation and accommodation, which we made by trusting the Crowne plaza brand. First of all, the hotel is old and needs renovation and maintenance. There were many guests from the Middle East or Arab countries and they were making a lot of noise."

hotel_name: Crowne Plaza Hotel Antalya, bir IHG oteli
review_text: "Güzel bir anıydı. Otelin konumu harika, havuzu temiz ve nezih. Tünel vasıtasıyla havuzlu alandan direk beach’e geçiş olması güzel. They did not charge for the water we requested from the room service and used from the minibar. Of course, it is not a big deal, but it is a nice thing as a courtesy. It was quite late due to our flight time and a little delay." "We went out, it was almost two o'clock, but there was no problem with that, and I appreciated that."

The only negative thing I would say is that it is time for some places to be renovated."

Quiet small hotel with green garden and swimming pool, across the noise of airplanes that fly frequently, but it's clear because it's only a 5-minute drive from the airport. Free transfer. But take one of the yellow taxis at the airport and tell the taxi driver that Holel will pay. They have such an agreement. It's easy. You can have a buffet dinner for 22 euros."

Sehr ruhig und sauber. Das Pool war sehr groß und sauber meine Kinder hatten sehr viel spaß. Werden definitiv wieder kommen. Wir hatten Frühstück gebucht. War sehr vielfälltig. Wenn man Abendbuffet haben möchte hat es 20€ gekostet 10€ für Kinder. Getränke waren sehr günstig, Dosen haben 2€ gekostet Coktails 4€ . Hambürger war 8€ etc. Man muss nicht all inklusive Buchen die Preise waren gut."

The pool was very large and clean, my children had a lot of fun. Will definitely come back. We had booked breakfast. It was very varied. If you wanted an evening buffet it cost €20, €10 for children. Drinks were very cheap, cans cost €2. Cocktails cost €4. Hambürger was 8€ etc. You don't have to book all inclusive, the prices were good."

review_text: "La struttura offere la colazione inclusa, le camere sono molto spaziose. Prima di arrivare in hotel ci hanno informato che arrivando dall’aeroporto col taxi giallo, lo avrebbe pagato l’hotel, sono stati gentilissimi. E anche se si trova molto vicino all’aeroporto, con le finestre chiuse non si sente tanto. Al uscita dal hotel ( nel caso devessimo andare in aeroporto) ci offre lo shuttle organizzato gratuito. Sono molto soddisfatta dalla scelta del hotel. Grazie mille."
translated_text: "The property offers breakfast included, the rooms are very spacious. Before arriving at the hotel they informed us that arriving from the airport by yellow taxi, the hotel would pay for it, they were very kind. And even though it is very close to the airport, with the windows closed you can't hear much. Upon leaving the hotel (in case we had to go to the airport) they offer us the free organized shuttle. I am very satisfied with the choice of the hotel. Thank you very much."

review_text: "Uçak seyahatimize göre oteli tercih ettiğimizi söylemem gerekir. Konumu avantajlı. Check-in işlemleri oldukça hızlı. Odalar temiz ve gereken konforu sağlıyor. Sunulan yemek hizmeti temiz ve kaliteli. Personel son derece kibar. Bu nedenle memnun kaldığımızı söyleyebilirim."

The food service offered is clean and of high quality. The staff is extremely polite. Therefore, I can say that we are satisfied."

I think dedicated staff are key personnel in the hotel industry. IC hotels persenoli definitely shows a praiseworthy performance."

review_text: "Memnun kaldık.Otel konforlu ve temiz ,çalışanlar ilgili ve saygılı,kahvaltı çok güzel,akşam yemeği gayet güzel ve makul fiyattaydı."
translated_text: "We were satisfied. The hotel is comfortable and clean, the employees are attentive and respectful, the breakfast was very good, the dinner was very good and at a reasonable price."

review_text: "Veramente un albergo di alto livello. Libertà assoluta e rispetto e gentilezza verso il cliente. Un servizio taxi da e per aeroporto eccezionale. La camera comoda e pulita. Avrei dato più stelle."
translated_text: "Truly a high level hotel. Absolute freedom and respect and kindness towards the customer. An exceptional taxi service to and from the airport. The room was comfortable and clean. I would have given more stars."

review_text: "Immer wieder gerne.wir waren öftes hier und wir lieben dieses Hotel! Frühstück gibt es ab 04:00 Uhr. Manchmal bekommt man auch Zimmer Upgrade."
translated_text: "Always happy. We've been here often and we love this hotel! Breakfast is available from 4 a.m. Sometimes you can also get a room upgrade."

translated_text: "It is a great hotel. During our stay as a family, the team at the reception and the service side were friendly and did their job with pleasure. I would like to thank them. The breakfast was very good, the food in the restaurant was very delicious. The price was also very reasonable."

review_text: "Her şey çok güzeldi. Personel ilgili ve güler yüzlü. Odamız trmiz ve beklediğimden büyüktü. Her gün temizlediler. Havuzu çok güzel. Kahvaltısı çok güzeldi. Kesinlikle bir daha gidersek de tercihimiz bu otelden yana olur"
translated_text: "Everything was very nice. The staff was attentive and friendly. Our room was clean and larger than I expected. They cleaned it every day. The pool is very nice. The breakfast was very nice. If we go again, we will definitely choose this hotel."

review_text: "Otel gibi, otel. Makul fiyata kaliteli hizmet."
translated_text: "Like a hotel, a hotel. Quality service at a reasonable price."

review_text: "Otelin konumu amacına hizmet ediyor.Çevre ve ambiance mükemmeldi.Personel güler yüzlü ve yardımsever. Tek eleştirebileceğim şey otelin eskimiş olması havlular,klima eski kalmış. Çok memnun kaldık,rahatlıkla tavsiye edebilirim"
translated_text: "The location of the hotel serves its purpose. The environment and ambiance were perfect. The staff is friendly and helpful. The only thing I can criticize is that the hotel is old, the towels and the air conditioner are old. We were very pleased, I can easily recommend it."

review_text: "酒店很漂亮，有超大的泳池，自助早餐是我在土耳其一行中吃过最丰富的，房间为正常标间大小，隔音效果不错，但设施有些老旧，有些地方需要维修，我们的房间淋浴花洒高低调节的装置松了，无法调整花洒高度，一进门的廊灯也是坏的，会一闪一闪的，除此以外酒店的配置还是很好的，有很多空乘人员在这里入住。我们选择这里的原因是因为要搭乘早班飞机，而且这间酒店提供非常便利的机场接驳服务，如果有搭乘早班飞机的朋友，我还是很推荐这间酒店的。"
translated_text: "The hotel is very beautiful, with a huge swimming pool. The buffet breakfast is the richest I have ever had in Turkey. The room is a normal standard room size and has good sound insulation. However, the facilities are a bit old and need repair in some places. The height adjustment device of the shower head in our room was loose and the height of the shower head cannot be adjusted. The same is true for the corridor light when entering the door. The bad thing is that it flickers, but otherwise the hotel is very well equipped and there are many flight attendants staying here. The reason why we chose this hotel is because we have an early flight, and this hotel provides a very convenient airport shuttle service. If you have friends who take an early flight, I still recommend this hotel. "

review_text: "Heel dichtbij de luchthaven, en ik kreeg gratis taxi van het hotel. Ontbijt en diner opties waren overweldigend! En ik vond het personeel heel professioneel en behulpzaam."
translated_text: "Very close to the airport, and I got a free taxi from the hotel. Breakfast and dinner options were overwhelming! And I found the staff very professional and helpful."

review_text: "Goede locatie en netjes."
translated_text: "Good location and tidy."

review_text: "Ailece uçuş öncesi ve sonrası konakladığımız iC hotel. Her defasında memnun ayrıldığımız! Tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "iC hotel, where we stayed as a family before and after our flight. We left satisfied every time! I recommend it."

review_text: "Öncelikle artısı ve eksisi olan bir otel artısı sakin bir otel kahvaltısı güzel ve çalışanların güler yüzlü olması eksisi ise otopark sorunu otopark otelden uzak, bina dışarıdan güzel gözükse de içi restore edilmeli yenilenmeli eski bazı aksesuarlar çalışmıyor ve çoğu şeye bakım yapılmamış."
translated_text: "First of all, it is a hotel with its pros and cons. Its plus is that it is quiet, the breakfast is nice and the staff is friendly. Its minus is that there is a parking problem. The car park is far from the hotel. Although the building looks nice from the outside, the inside should be restored and renewed. Some old accessories do not work and most things have not been maintained."

review_text: "Fint hotell med god beliggenhet og fint bassengområde. Litt små rom og veldig enkel frokost. Veldig trivelig og hjelpsom vertinne."
translated_text: "Nice hotel with a good location and nice pool area. Slightly small rooms and very simple breakfast. Very pleasant and helpful hostess."

review_text: "Billederne snyder!!! Hvad der skulle have været en romantisk getaway, blev til et mareridt. Vi valgte hotellet for dens centrale beliggenhed og de flotte billeder, men ved ankomsten fik vi et værelse, der slet ikke svarede til vores reservation. Værelset var ekstremt lille, uden plads til vores kufferter, og vinduet kunne ikke åbnes. Receptionen viste ekstrem irritation og kunne ikke hjælpe, så vi måtte vente til næste dag. Den nat fik vi ikke sovet, og næste morgen blev vi tilbudt et nyt værelse på første sal. Selvom det var større, blæste aircondition direkte på sengen, og vinduet vendte mod hotellets støjende kompressorer, hvilket gjorde værelset ubrugeligt. Vi blev derefter tilbudt et tredje værelse i kælderen, som var fyldt med kloaklugt og fugt. Personalet anerkendte problemet, men gjorde intet og vi forblev på værelset resten af vores ophold. Det skabte desværre en dårlig stemning for resten af vores ophold. Hotellet er ifølge vores oplevelse ikke værd at få 4 stjerner. Det er slidt, dårligt vedligeholdt, og det eneste positive er den centrale beliggenhed. Poolen er lille, og morgenmadsbuffeten er skuffende. Billederne på nettet er vildledende; hotellet lever ikke op til forventningerne. Vi vil ikke anbefale stedet til nogen."
translated_text: "The pictures are deceiving!!! What should have been a romantic getaway turned into a nightmare. We chose the hotel for its central location and the nice pictures, but on arrival we were given a room that did not correspond to our reservation at all. The room was extremely small, with no space for our suitcases and the window could not be opened. The reception showed extreme irritation and could not help, so we had to wait until the next day. We did not sleep that night and the next morning we were offered a new room on the first floor. Although it was bigger, the aircon was facing the hotel's noisy compressors, which made the room unusable. The staff acknowledged the problem and we stayed in the room for the rest of our stay. The hotel is not worth 4 stars, and that only positive is the central location. The pool is disappointing. The pictures on the web do not live up to expectations. We would not recommend the place to anyone."

review_text: "Hôtel très bien situé en bordure de la vielle ville. Nombreux restaurants autour. Personnel très sympathique."
translated_text: "Hotel very well located on the edge of the old town. Many restaurants around. Very friendly staff."

Tüm personele teşekkürler."

The reception was very helpful in everything from entry to exit. It was good to have a parking lot. Even though we missed the breakfast time, the kitchen staff helped us without any problem. Thank you to all the staff."

Bassenget ser bra ut på bildet, men realiteten er at det ligger 2 meter fra gaten og innbyr ikke til bruk."

Clean and relatively new hotel, but already marked by some wear and tear, especially in the bathroom, which can be attributed to the choice of poor quality interior solutions. The pool looks good in the picture, but the reality is that it is 2 meters from the street and does not invite use."

Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ediyorum."
translated_text: "WONDERFUL. The hotel has been newly renovated and even the smallest details have not been overlooked. Our room was given very cleanly. You can rest assured that there is absolutely no noise from the entertainment venues. We had a quiet night. All the employees are friendly, energetic and helpful. It is very close to the Kaleiçi area and the main street. You can reach all locations on foot. I recommend it wholeheartedly."

review_text: "Très bon séjour rien à signaler à part un jour où le ménage n’a pas était fait et puis la femme de ménage c’est permise de regarder dans ma trousse de toilette ou j’avais mit les petit gels douche et shampooing pour ne pas en remettre Sinon mon séjour c’est très bien passé les petits déjeuner étaient corrects et variés L’hôtel est plutôt bien situé pour les personnes qui souhaitent sortir il y a le Moon lara pour les soirées chicha et le Gaga Club pour l’ambiance boîte festive avec des danseuses Sinon il y a plusieurs restaurants très sympathique L’accès aux plages de Lara beach et Konyaaltı Halk beach sont fastidieux car vraiment pas à côté mais il y à plusieurs corniche dans les environs pour pouvoir se baigner et se poser sur un transat comme Muratpaşa Belediyesi Antalya İnciraltı Plajı La piscine de l’hôtel n’est pas très utilisé car donne sur la rue bien qu’elle ne soit pas passante je n’ai vue personne s’y baigner juste certains profitent des transats et des différentes places pour se relaxer"
translated_text: "Very good stay, nothing to report apart from one day when the cleaning was not done and then the cleaning lady was allowed to look in my toiletry bag where I had put the little shower gels and shampoo so as not to use them again. Otherwise my stay was very good the breakfasts were correct and varied The hotel is rather well located for people who want to go out there is the Moon Lara for shisha evenings and the Gaga Club for the festive club atmosphere with dancers Otherwise there are several very nice restaurants Access to the beaches of Lara beach and Konyaaltı Halk beach are tedious because they are really not nearby but there are several ledges in the surrounding area to be able to swim and relax on a deckchair like Muratpaşa Belediyesi Antalya İnciraltı Plajı The hotel swimming pool is not very used because it overlooks the street although it is not busy I did not view no one swims there just some take advantage of the deckchairs and different places to relax"

review_text: "Nous avons énormément apprécié notre séjour à l'hôtel PERGE. La gentillesse du personnel, la qualité de la literie, la chambre spacieuse, le calme de l’hôtel, ainsi que l’accès à la mer ont vraiment contribué à rendre notre expérience mémorable. La restauration est excellente aussi. À noter, quelques petits détails de finitions de plinthes et de peinture dans les couloirs et la chambre et un manque d’entretien au niveau des terrasses du bord de mer et de certains transats. Peut-être sommes nous mal habitués, un peu dommage pour un hôtel de cette qualité. Malgré ces petites remarques, nous envisageons sérieusement de revenir pour un autre séjour dans cet établissement."
translated_text: "We greatly enjoyed our stay at the PERGE hotel. The friendliness of the staff, the quality of the bedding, the spacious room, the calm of the hotel, as well as the access to the sea, really contributed to making our experience memorable. The catering is also excellent. Please note, a few small details in the finishing of plinths and paint in the corridors and the room and a lack of maintenance on the seaside terraces and certain deckchairs. Perhaps we are not used to it, a bit of a shame for a hotel of this quality Despite these small comments, we are seriously considering returning for another stay at this establishment."

review_text: "Hersey icin tesekkurler.Otel konumu, yenilenmis odalari ve tum calisanlariyla cok guzel"
translated_text: "Thank you for everything. The hotel is very nice with its location, renovated rooms and all the staff."

review_text: "Güzel bir tatil.Harikaydı, özellikle çalışanlar çok yardımseverdi ve hepsi çok güler yüzlüydü!"
translated_text: "It was a nice holiday. It was great, especially the staff were very helpful and all very friendly!"

review_text: "구시가지에서 가까운데 조용하고 해변비치가 있어 수영도 할수있는 호텔입니다. 바다전망이 훌륭하고 공원이 가까워 산책하며 힐링할수있는 호텔입니다. 다만 lundry서비스는 세탁상태와 다림질 상태가 그다지 좋지않아 추천하지 않습니다."

review_text: "Alles sauber und modern der Zugang zum Meer phantastisch, Frühstück sehr reichhaltig. Wir haben dort nur Salat gegessen und gefrühstückt war sehr gut allerdings Aperol Spritz 20 EUR, Cola 2,50 EUR also alles ausser Alkohol passt. Direkt neben einem Park und nur 10 min von der Altstadt zu Fuß."

We only ate salad there and breakfast was very good, but Aperol Spritz 20 EUR, Cola 2.50 EUR so everything except alcohol is fine. Right next to a park and only 10 minutes on foot from the old town."

review_text: "1 gece kaldık ama her şey güzeldi. Personel sıcakkanlıydı. Her yer temizdi. Güzel hizmet için teşekkürler."
