review_text: "Otelin kahvaltısı seçenek olarak sınırlıydı ve kötüydü. Oda geniş ve ferahtı. Otoparkın olmaması kötüydü"
translated_text: "The hotel's breakfast had limited options and was bad. The room was large and spacious. The lack of parking was bad."

review_text: "La chambre était juste un peu petite avec les valises mais sinon tout était nickel dans l’ensemble nous en sommes très content. L’hôtel est vraiment a proximité de tout à Antalya"
translated_text: "The room was just a little small with the suitcases but otherwise everything was perfect overall we are very happy with it. The hotel is really close to everything in Antalya"

review_text: "İlk giriş işleminden, çıkış anına kadar muhteşem bir ev sahipliği deneyimledim. Olumsuz olarak söyleyebilecek hiç bir konu yok. Yeni, temiz ve güzel odalar, bir konaklamada arayacağım her imkan mevcuttu. Özellikle Çağla Hanım özel bir teşekkürü hak ediyor. Güler yüzle karşılaması, mesleğine hakimiyeti, analitik çözümlemesi ile konaklamamı mükemmel hale getirdi. Otel konumu da çok güzel. Aracınızı da güvenle ve kolay bir şekilde park edebiliyorsunuz."
translated_text: "I experienced a wonderful hosting experience from the first check-in to the moment of check-out. There is nothing that I can say negatively. New, clean and beautiful rooms, all the facilities I could look for in an accommodation were available. Especially Ms. Çağla deserves a special thank you. She made my stay perfect with her friendly welcome, mastery of her profession and analytical analysis. The location of the hotel is also very good. You can park your car safely and easily."

review_text: "Ich durfte eine Stunde eher aufs Zimmer dank dem freundlichen Herrn an der Rezeption Kemal, wirklich sehr freundlich. An sich ist es ein City Hotel und für eine Nacht war es super."
translated_text: "I was allowed to go to the room an hour earlier thanks to the friendly gentleman at reception Kemal, really very friendly. It's actually a city hotel and it was great for one night."

review_text: "Hastane için gelmiştik yeterli uzaklıktaydı. Çok ilgili güleryüzlüler."
translated_text: "We came for the hospital, it was far enough away. They were very friendly and helpful."

review_text: "Nuca homesde kaldığım süre boyunca çok iyiydi herşey a dan z ye"
translated_text: "During my stay at Nuca Homes, everything was very good from A to Z."

review_text: "Sehr schön ruhig undcsauber ...freubdliches Personal"
translated_text: "Very nice, quiet and clean...friendly staff"

review_text: "Superior oda seçimi yapmama rağmen otelin en küçük odasını verdiler. Bu Hotels sitesi ile Otel yönetiminin koordineli çalışmaması ve yazılımsal bir alt yapıyla birbirlerine bağlı olmaması sonucu olabilir. Sonuç olarak fazla para ödeyip hizmet olarak karşılığını almamış oldum. Otel genel olarak iş seyahatleri için oldukça kullanışlı, rahat ve temiz. Ancak kahvaltı yapılan mekanın akşam üstü 16:00 da kapanması doğru değil. Ana caddeye çıkış için bile o mekanın en az 21:00 e kadar açık olması gerekir."
translated_text: "Even though I chose a superior room, they gave me the smallest room in the hotel. This may be the result of the Hotels site and the hotel management not working in coordination and not being connected to each other with a software infrastructure. As a result, I paid too much and did not get what I got in return for the service. The hotel is generally very useful, comfortable and clean for business trips. However, it is not right for the place where breakfast is served to close at 16:00 in the evening. Even for access to the main street, that place must be open until at least 21:00."

review_text: "❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️Veldig bra!"

"Bizim için ilk izlenim çok önemlidir.Butun çalışanları kibar ve güler yüzlü.Profesyonel yaklaşımlı nezih bir yerdi. Bina ve odalar yeniydi.Odalarin temizliği harikaydı.Kahvaltiyi çok beğendik . Özenle hazırlanmıştı.Çalisan arkadaşlar da işlerini çok iyi yapıyordu.Gelmek isteyenlerin kesinlikle düşünmeden değerlendirmesi gerektiğini mekan."
translated_text: "The first impression is very important for us. All the employees were polite and friendly. It was a decent place with a professional approach. The building and the rooms were new. The cleanliness of the rooms was great. We liked the breakfast very much. It was prepared with care. The employees were also doing their job very well. Those who want to come should definitely consider this place without thinking."

review_text: "Schlimmste Hotelerfahrung meines Lebens absolut nicht zu empfehlen Wir hatten nur einen sehr kurzen Aufenthalt, aber es war mit Abstand die schlechteste Hotelerfahrung, die ich je gemacht habe. Schon bei der Anreise ging es los: Das Hotel hat keinen Zugang von der Hauptstraße, sondern nur einen Eingang in einer extrem engen, chaotischen Hintergasse, in der man nicht einmal ordentlich ausladen kann völlig unpraktisch, vor allem mit Gepäck. Im Zimmer dann der nächste Schock: Gelbe Flecken an der Decke (siehe Bild) absolut schlimm und ein No-Go für jedes Hotel. Doch es kam noch schlimmer: Ein schlimmer Geruch kam aus dem Badezimmer, der sich kaum in Worte fassen lässt. Es roch nach Abfluss, unerträglich. Offenbar ist das Problem nicht neu, denn in anderen Bewertungen wurde es bereits mehrfach erwähnt. Und was war die Lösung des Hotels? Man hatte einfach zwei Urinalsiebe in eine Ecke des Bads gelegt. Kein Witz. So etwas habe ich wirklich noch nie erlebt. Wir haben ernsthaft darüber nachgedacht, sofort abzureisen.Weitere Mängel: Wände so dünn, dass man jedes Geräusch aus den Nachbarzimmern mitbekommt. Es gibt kein Buffet stattdessen bekommt man eine Karte mit fünf oder sechs Omelett-Varianten. Das war’s. Wenn ihr euch einen schönen Aufenthalt in Antalya wünscht: Gebt lieber mehr aus und bucht ein anderes Hotel. Diese Unterkunft ist ein abschreckendes Beispiel."
translated_text: "Worst hotel experience of my life, absolutely not recommended. We only had a very short stay, but it was by far the worst hotel experience I have ever had. As soon as we arrived, it started: The hotel has no access from the main street, only an entrance in an extremely narrow, chaotic back alley where you can't even unload properly. Completely inconvenient, especially with luggage. In the room, the next shock: yellow stains on the ceiling (see picture) absolutely bad and a no-go for jedes Hotel. Doch es kam noch schlimmer: Ein schlimmer Geruch kam aus dem Badezimmer, der sich kaum in Worte fassen lässt. Es roch nach Abfluss, unerträglich. Offenbar ist das Problem nicht neu, denn in anderen Bewertungen wurde es bereits mehrfach erwähnt. Und was war die Lösung des Hotels? Man hatte einfach zwei Urinalsiebe in eine Ecke des Bads gelegt. Kein Witz. So etwas habe ich wirklich noch nie erlebt. Wir haben ernsthaft darüber nachgedacht, sofort abzureisen.Weitere Mängel: Wände so dünn, dass man jedes Geräusch aus den Neighboring rooms. There is no buffet instead you get a menu with five or six omelet options. That's it. If you want a nice stay in Antalya, spend more and book another hotel.

review_text: "Oldukça memnun kaldığım bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Otel yeni, temiz ve zevkle dekore edilmiş. Lokasyon son derece avantajlı, şehrin birçok noktasına kolay erişim sağlıyor. Personel ilgili ve güler yüzlüydü. Hem iş hem de turistik amaçlı seyahatler için rahatlıkla tavsiye edebileceğim bir otel."
translated_text: "It was an accommodation experience that I was very pleased with. The hotel is new, clean and tastefully decorated. The location is extremely advantageous, providing easy access to many points of the city. The staff was attentive and friendly. It is a hotel that I can easily recommend for both business and touristic trips."

review_text: "İlgili personel temiz otel"
translated_text: "Careful staff, clean hotel"

review_text: "Odalar temiz ve eşyalar yeniydi. Çok zevkli ve sade bir şekilde dizayn edilmiş. Tüm personel çok nazik. Özellikle kat görevlisi Kezban Hanım’dan çok memnun kaldık. Oldukça kibar ve güleryüzlüydü. Odamızda gürültü sorunu yaşamıştık. Resepsiyon hiç ikiletmeden bize üst katlarda yeni bir oda verdi. Tamamiyle memnun kaldığımız bir deneyim oldu. Herkese teşekkürler."
translated_text: "The rooms were clean and the furnishings were new. They were designed very tastefully and simply. All the staff were very polite. We were especially pleased with the housekeeper Ms. Kezban. She was very polite and friendly. We had a noise problem in our room. The reception gave us a new room on the upper floors without any hesitation. It was an experience that we were completely satisfied with. Thank you everyone."

review_text: "Çok güzel, modern ve temiz bir otel. Antalya'da ne kadar kalacak olursak olalım yine orayı tercih ederiz. Personel çok kibar ve ilgili. Odalar ve otel oldukça modern ve kullanışlı dizayn edilmiş. Kahvaltı otelin ön tarafındaki restoranda veriliyor. Serpme değildi ancak çeşitli ve doyurucu bir kahvaltı tabağıydı. Odadaki televizyonda digitürk erişimi bile vardı. Konumu da gayet iyi, her gideceğiniz yere arabayla kolay ulaşım sağlayabilirsiniz."
translated_text: "It is a very nice, modern and clean hotel. No matter how long we stay in Antalya, we will choose it again. The staff is very polite and attentive. The rooms and the hotel are very modern and conveniently designed. Breakfast is served at the restaurant at the front of the hotel. It was not rich, but it was a varied and satisfying breakfast plate. The television in the room even had digital access. The location is also very good, you can easily reach anywhere you go by car."

review_text: "Otel yeni eşyalara sahip oldukça temiz ve güzel. Kezban hanım her gün odamızı temizledi ve çok sıcakkanlıydı. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "The hotel is very clean and nice with new furnishings. Ms. Kezban cleaned our room every day and was very friendly. I definitely recommend it."

review_text: "Alles bestens, modern, sauber und super Lage. Frühstück ausreichend und lecker. Immer gerne wieder."
translated_text: "Everything was great, modern, clean and great location. Breakfast was sufficient and tasty. Always happy to come back."

review_text: "Leider sehr hellhörig und viele Gäste waren sehr laut in der Nacht und haben die Türen zugeknallt. Frühstück fast jeden Tag das selbe und man durfte sich nichts selbst aussuchen. Wenn man nicht genau 1h vor Ende des Frühstücks kam bekam man nicht mal mehr Orangensaft. Personal sonst sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Lage sehr gut nah am Meer und an Bushaltestellen. Leider ist der nächste Badestrand sehr weit weg."
translated_text: "Unfortunately the soundproofing was very poor and many guests were very noisy at night and slammed the doors. Breakfast was the same almost every day and you weren't allowed to choose anything yourself. If you didn't arrive exactly 1 hour before the end of breakfast you didn't even get any orange juice. Staff otherwise very nice and helpful. Location very good close to the sea and bus stops. Unfortunately the nearest beach is very far away."

review_text: "Konumu ve yapısal özellikleriyle konforlu ve nezih bir otel. Temizlik son derece güzel. Sessiz zakin ve huzurlu. Personel, özellikle resepsiyondaki hanımefendi güleryüzle misafirlerle yakından ilgileniyor. Kahvaltısı sağlıklı, lezzetli ve kaliteli. Tüm çalışanlara teşekkür ederim."
translated_text: "It is a comfortable and decent hotel with its location and structural features. The cleanliness is extremely good. It is quiet, gentle and peaceful. The staff, especially the lady at the reception, takes care of the guests with a smile. The breakfast is healthy, delicious and of high quality. I thank all the employees."

review_text: "Bir gece kaldık oldukça temiz ve güzel"
translated_text: "We stayed for one night, it was very clean and nice"

review_text: "Die Lage vom Hotel ist sehr Gut und in der Nähe sind auch Einkaufsläden und Restaurants. Das Hotel ist sehr Sauber und Neu. Am Empfang die Mitarbeiter sehr Hilfsbereit."
translated_text: "The location of the hotel is very good and there are shops and restaurants nearby. The hotel is very clean and new. The staff at reception are very helpful."

review_text: "Otel güzeldi yeni yapılmış ve temizdi konumu iyiydi bence fiyatina göre gidilecek en iyisi diyebiliriz benim için sorunsuz bir tatildi teşekkürler"
translated_text: "The hotel was nice, newly built and clean, the location was good, I think we can say that it is the best place to go considering the price, it was a problem-free holiday for me, thank you."

review_text: "Rien à dife"
translated_text: “Nothing to differ”

review_text: "Schönes neues Hotel."
translated_text: "Nice new hotel."

review_text: "Anbefaler stede hyggelig ansatte veldig behjelpelig 10/10 service Kanskje endre frokosten sånn at man slipper og få samme frokost servert vær dag"
translated_text: "Recommend present pleasant staff very helpful 10/10 service Maybe change the breakfast so that you don't have to have the same breakfast served any day"

review_text: "1 gece kaldık gayet sakin ve konforlu çalışanlar ilgiliydi"
translated_text: "We stayed for 1 night, it was very quiet and comfortable, the staff was helpful"

review_text: "Das Hotel ist sehr neu. Dementsprechend sind alle Räume sowohl optisch als auch technisch auf dem neusten Stand. Folgende Mängel sind uns aufgefallen: Check in: Leider gab es hier nur auf Nachfrage eine Auskunft über die Frühstückszeiten. Das Wifi passwort wurde uns ebenfalls nicht mitgeteilt. Am nächsten Tag haben wir das Passwort ebenfalls erst auf Nachfrage erhalten. Dusche: Wie oben beschrieben sind die Räume zwar sehr neu,jedoch mussten wir feststellen, dass die Dusche jedes mal übergelaufen ist und man eine Überschwemmung hatte. Hier musste man dann die Handtücher alle auf den Boden werfen um zu verhindern, dass man ausrutscht. Mülltonnen: Zunächst dachten wir, dass die Platzierung von Mülltonnen im Zimmer vergessen wurde. Im Verlaufe der Tage hat sich dann rausgestellt, dass es scheinbar garkeine Mülltonnen gibt. Die einzige Mülltonne die es gab war im Bad zu finden. Lichter: Im Eingangsbereich vor dem Kleiderschrank waren die Lichter defekt. Frühstück: Die Frühstücksplatte die man erhält ist qualitativ hochwertig. Nur ist wichtig zu erwähnen, dass das Hotel hier auch Gäste von außerhalb empfängt. Von einer ruhigen Atmosphere ist hier eher weniger die Rede. Es konnte nicht übersehen werden, dass hauptsächlich Männergruppen den Raum dominierten. Zudem wurde hier ebenfalls geraucht obwohl es klar geschlossene Räumlichkeiten sind. Management: Leider mussten wir sehr unprofessionelles Verhalten von Führungskräften des Hotels feststellen. Obwohl ein ausgeschildertes"
translated_text: "The hotel is very new. Accordingly, all rooms are up to date both visually and technically. We noticed the following deficiencies: Check in: Unfortunately, information about breakfast times was only available upon request. We were also not given the WiFi password. The next day we only received the password when we asked. Shower: As described above, the rooms are very new, but we found that the shower overflowed every time and there was a flood. Here we then had to put all the towels on the towels Throw trash cans on the floor: At first we thought that the placement of trash cans in the room turned out that there were apparently no trash cans in the bathroom. The lights were broken in the entrance area. Breakfast: The breakfast plate you receive is of high quality There is less talk about the quiet atmosphere here. It couldn't be overlooked that the room was dominated by groups of men. There was also smoking here, even though it was clearly a closed area. Management: Unfortunately, we noticed very unprofessional behavior from the hotel's managers.

review_text: "Top Service, Top Sauberkeit, Top Lage, Sehr leckeres Frühstück"
translated_text: "Top service, top cleanliness, top location, very tasty breakfast"

review_text: "Yeni açılmış bir otel. Genel anlamda iyiydi. Temizlik iyi. Tuvalet gideri kokuyordu. Mini buz dolabı çalışmıyordu, söyledik yine çalıştırmadılar. Kahvaltısı güzeldi. Otelin girişi ters taraftan yapılmış ve otoparkı yok. Personel güler yüzlü."
translated_text: "It is a newly opened hotel. It was generally good. Cleanliness was good. The toilet drain smelled. The mini refrigerator was not working, we told them but they did not make it work again. The breakfast was good. The entrance of the hotel is from the opposite side and there is no parking lot. The staff is friendly."

review_text: "Un hébergement calme très bien placer"
translated_text: “A quiet accommodation in a very good location”

review_text: "Çeşmemde soğuk su yoktu.. tuvaletinde küçük suyu çalışmıyordu bu ikisinin haricinde herşey çok güzeldi. otelin konumu ve dışarıya çıkış kapısı bence çok kötü kapııı ön tarafa alsalar daha iyi olurdu"
translated_text: "There was no cold water in my fountain. The small water in the toilet was not working. Apart from these two, everything was very good. I think the location of the hotel and the exit door are very bad. It would have been better if they had moved the door to the front."

review_text: "Yeni açılmış bir otel şehir merkezinde rahatlıkla tercih edebilirsiniz. Çalışanlar güler yüzlü ve yardımsever. Gece giriş yapmamıza rağmen gececi arkadaşlar bizi çok güzel karşıladı. Teşekkürler"
translated_text: "You can easily choose a newly opened hotel in the city center. The staff is friendly and helpful. Even though we checked in at night, our night friends welcomed us very well. Thank you"

review_text: "Resepsiyon ilgiliydi, otel temizdi, merkezde kalabileceğiniz güzel yerlerden biri"
translated_text: "The reception was helpful, the hotel was clean, it is one of the nice places to stay in the center"

review_text: "Temiz , yeni hotel, resepsiyonda gece karşılayan bey çok profesyonel teşekkür ederim hepinize"
translated_text: "Clean, new hotel, the gentleman who greeted us at the reception at night is very professional, thank you all."

review_text: "Temiz ve güvenli bir otel, 24 saat resepsiyon hizmeti vardır. Açık büfe lezzetli kahvaltı imkanı sunan bu otel şehir merkezine bir kaç adım mesafededir. Tavsiye ederim"
translated_text: "It is a clean and safe hotel, with 24-hour reception service. Offering a delicious open buffet breakfast, this hotel is a few steps away from the city center. I recommend it"

review_text: "Odalar ve hizmet güzeldi fakat geri kalan şeylerden memnun kalmadık özellikle yemek menüsü çok kısıtlı tek çeşit bir şey var onu yemek zorundasın"
translated_text: "The rooms and service were nice, but we were not satisfied with the rest, especially the food menu is very limited, there is only one kind of thing, you have to eat it."

review_text: "Otelin berbat ve korkunç bir iç dizaynı var. Ama otel olarak tüm hizmetleri oldukça yeterliydi. Özellikle kahvaltısından çok memnun kaldık, odalar da iyiydi."
translated_text: "The hotel has a terrible and terrible interior design. But as a hotel, all its services were quite adequate. We were especially pleased with the breakfast, and the rooms were also good."

review_text: "Otel gerçekten hem estetik yapısıyla hem sunduğu hizmetle mükemmeldi. Odalar temiz ve personel çok yardım sever ve iyiydi. Özellikle kahvaltıları çok güzel. Sadece merkezden biraz uzak arabanız varsa veya toplu taşıma kullanabilirsiniz önür türlüsü biraz eziyet oluyor."
translated_text: "The hotel was really excellent, both with its aesthetic structure and the service it offered. The rooms were clean and the staff was very helpful and good. Especially the breakfasts were very good. It is only a bit far from the center, if you have a car or you can use public transportation, it is a bit of a pain."

review_text: "Wir hatten ein 3 Personen Zimmer vor Monaten gebucht. Ungeplant hatte unser Flug Verspätung und wir sind erst um 4 Uhr in der Nacht im Hotel angekommen. Das Check-In verlief ohne Probleme und wir durften in unser Zimmer gehen. Was uns schockiert hat, es war nur ein Doppelbett im Zimmer. So steht die Frage wo die dritte Person schläft. Wir haben unten bei der Rezeption angerufen und sie darum gebeten, dass wir ein Bett benötigen, da wir das auch so gebucht haben. Wir waren sowieso schon von der ganzen Reise erschöpft und haben kraftlos noch über eine halbe Stunde im Zimmer gewartet, bis ein Klappbett organisiert wurde. Nach dem 3. Mal anrufen, ist dann ein junger Mann gekommen und hat das Bett gebracht. Das Bett war so unsicher, dass es jeden Moment zusammenklappen könnte. Zusätzlich hat er das Klappbett ohne Überzug, Decke und Kissen gebracht. Er hat das Bett in das Zimmer gebracht und ist schnell raus. Wir haben ihm nachgerufen, dass wir noch einen Bettüberzug und ein Kissen benötigen, er wollte uns jedoch nicht mehr zuhören und hat die Tür zugemacht. Aufgrund diesem Problem konnten wir erst um 5 ins Bett liegen. Wir haben das Problem bei der Rezeption am Morgen beschwert. Nun stand eine neue Dame dahinter. Sie meinte, dass die anderen Kollegen in diesem Moment wahrscheinlich nur das organisieren konnten. Was aber unerklärlich ist, da wir dieses Zimmer schon im Voraus gebucht haben. Wir haben dem Hotel 45 Minuten im Voraus informiert, dass wir auf dem Weg zu ihnen sind..."
translated_text: "We had booked a 3-person room months ago. Our flight was delayed unplanned and we only arrived at the hotel at 4 a.m. The check-in went without any problems and we were allowed to go to our room. What shocked us was that there was only a double bed in the room. So the question is where the third person sleeps. We called the reception downstairs and asked them that we needed a bed, since we had booked it that way. We were already exhausted from the whole trip and were still exhausted Waited in the room for over half an hour until a folding bed was organized. After the third call, a young man came and brought the bed. The bed was so unsafe that it could fold up at any moment. He brought the bed into the room and quickly went out 5 in bed. We complained about the problem to the reception. Now a new lady was behind it. She said that the other colleagues could probably only organize that, which is inexplicable since we had already booked this room 45 minutes in advance.

review_text: "Beklentimi karşıladı. Checkin yaptım (17:00) Duş aldım, yemeğe çıktım, uyudum (sessizdi), uyandım kahvaltıya gittim (ihtiyacımdan fazlaydı) ayrıldım(09:00). Yeterliydi"
translated_text: "It met my expectations. I checked in (17:00), took a shower, went out to dinner, slept (it was quiet), woke up, went to breakfast (it was more than I needed) and left (09:00). It was enough."

review_text: "Ich bin begeistert, alles perfekt"
translated_text: "I'm thrilled, everything is perfect"

review_text: "Les employés sont formidables et très serviable etM.fikrat chef cuisinier et tres professionnel et un bon cuisinier"
translated_text: "The employees are wonderful and very helpful and Mr. Fikrat chef and very professional and a good cook"

review_text: "Girdiğimizde özel oluşunu hissetmiştim. Her bir açıyı düşünmüşler. Güzel bir deneyimdi"
translated_text: "When we entered, I felt it was special. They thought of every angle. It was a nice experience."

review_text: "Bölge olarak ailelere cok uygun degil. Gceeleri kavga gürültü oluyor. Sonradan ogrendik ama semt olarak cok iyi biryer degil. Otel odalari fena degil, kahvalti orta seviyede."
translated_text: "As a region, it is not very suitable for families. There are fights and noise at night. We learned later, but it is not a very good neighborhood. The hotel rooms are not bad, the breakfast is average."

review_text: "Hotel cok iyi calisanlar mükemmel. Gece yarisi gittiğimiz halde bize Restaurantlarini actilar. Teşekkür ederiz. Bukadar misafirperver olduklari icin"
translated_text: "The hotel is very good, the staff are excellent. They opened their restaurant for us even though we went there at midnight. Thank you for being so hospitable."

review_text: "In unserem Zimmer roch es nach Rauch. Es wurde nicht mal geputzt. Im Jakuzzi drin fanden wir Haare, Schmutz und Dreck. Im Kühlschrank fanden wir noch eine Spritze. Mehrere Steckdosen im Zimmer waren ohne Funktion. Einfach schrecklich. Wir haben uns am nächsten Tag direkt ein neues Hotel gesucht und sind nach einer Nacht statt fünf Nächte raus. Natürlich gabs auch keine Entschädigung!"
translated_text: "It smelled of smoke in our room. It wasn't even cleaned. We found hair, dirt and grime in the jacuzzi. We found a syringe in the fridge. Several sockets in the room didn't work. Simply terrible. We looked for a new hotel the next day and left after one night instead of five. Of course there was no compensation either!"

review_text: "Sehr schöne und große Zimmer - Essenzauswahl könnte größer sein - Freundliches Personal"
translated_text: "Very nice and large rooms - Essence selection could be larger - Friendly staff"

review_text: "Struttura bellissima nuova e pulitissima"
translated_text: "Beautiful new and very clean structure"

review_text: "Vi fikk feil rom etter bestilling måtte vente 1 dag for å få et nytt rom. Resepsjonen beklagte feilen. Men vi fikk mindre dyne, vi var 4 og det var kunn 3 dyner. Dårlig engelsk, ventilasjonen på bade fungerte dårlig, mye støy når den starter. Men renholdere var flinke på jobben sin. Min vurdering for hotellet ligger mellom 3 og 4 stjerner."
translated_text: "We got the wrong room after booking and had to wait 1 day to get a new room. The reception apologized for the mistake. But we got a smaller duvet, there were 4 of us and there were only 3 duvets. Bad English, the ventilation in the bathroom didn't work well, a lot of noise when it starts. But the cleaners were good at their job. My rating for the hotel is between 3 and 4 stars."

review_text: "Veldig bra hotell midt i sentrum av antalya. Hyggelige personale og god frokost. Kommer til å være der hver gang vi skal til antalya."
translated_text: "Very good hotel right in the center of Antalya. Nice staff and good breakfast. Will be there every time we go to Antalya."

review_text: "Güzel lokasyon, iyi kahvaltı"
translated_text: "Nice location, good breakfast"

review_text: "Evinizdeymiş gibi rahat etmek istiyorsanız Mai İnci Hotelde konaklamalısınız. Tek kelineyle mükemmel üstü.Ortam, çalışanlar, hizmet ve dahası.En önemlisi de ÇALIŞANLARIN güler yüzleri ve hizmette yarışmaları, çok güzel ve anlayışlı insanlar…"
translated_text: "If you want to feel comfortable as if you were at home, you should stay at Mai İnci Hotel. Simply perfect. The environment, the employees, the service and more. Most importantly, the smiling faces of the EMPLOYEES and their competitiveness in service, very nice and understanding people..."

review_text: "Une adresse sure. Nous avons litteralement été traités comme des hotes de marque (ils nous ont trouvé et livré les meilleur kebab de notre vie, offert le café turc et le chocolat parce que ca leur faisait plaisir, changé notre chambre aveugle pour une chambre avec vue, et j'en passe...). Bref, l'adresse à ne pas rater quand vous passez à Antalya, à deux pas du centre historique."
translated_text: "A safe address. We were literally treated like distinguished guests (they found and delivered the best kebab of our lives, offered us Turkish coffee and chocolate because it made them happy, changed our blind room for a room with a view, and so on...). In short, the address not to be missed when you go to Antalya, a stone's throw from the historic center."

review_text: "4 gecelik konaklamamızda hiçbir sorunla karşılaşmadık. Çalışanlar her konuda yardımcı oldular. Konfor ve temizlik üst düzeydeydi. Kahvaltı çeşitlilik açısından yeterliydi. Hamam ve saunayı deneme fırsatımız olmadı."
translated_text: "We did not encounter any problems during our 4-night stay. The staff helped us in every way. Comfort and cleanliness were at a high level. The breakfast was sufficient in terms of variety. We did not have the opportunity to try the Turkish bath and sauna."

review_text: "Super fint hotel som vi havde 48 timer på, i forbindelse med arbejdet. Træls at hotellet kun havde vand i minibar og var løbet tør for Coca-Cola da vi ankom kl 02:00 om natten. Ellers mega hyggeligt hotel og meget centralt. Kommer helt sikkert igen."
translated_text: "Super nice hotel that we stayed at for 48 hours, in connection with work. Too bad the hotel only had water in the minibar and had run out of Coca-Cola when we arrived at 02:00 in the morning. Otherwise, super cozy hotel and very central. Will definitely come again."

review_text: "Personal sehr freundlich und bemüht. Zimmer hellhörig, Unterhaltungen von Balkon daneben oder darunter laut und deutlich hörbar. Von Schallschutzfenstern nichts bemerkt. Kühlschrank im Zimmer laut in der Nacht."
translated_text: "Staff very friendly and tried hard. Room noisy, conversations from the balcony next to it or below can be heard loudly and clearly. Nothing noticed from the soundproof windows. Fridge in the room loud at night."

review_text: "Zentral gelegen, wenngleich die Straße dreckig und nah an Müllcontainern war. Soweit alles ok, allerdings sind die Zimmer recht hellhörig. Unser Ausblick vom Balkon war eher mau. Essen und Personal gut"
translated_text: "Centrally located, although the street was dirty and close to garbage containers. So far everything was ok, but the rooms were quite noisy. Our view from the balcony was rather poor. Food and staff were good"

review_text: "Wir waren mit dem Hotel insgesamt sehr zufrieden. Sehr gepflegt und saubere Anlage. Das Personal war super freundlich und sehr hilfsbereit. Die Lage fanden wir auch sehr praktisch, einerseits die Nähe zur Altstadt und zum Hafen anderseits sehr nah zur Einkaufsmeile."
translated_text: "We were very satisfied with the hotel overall. Very well maintained and clean facility. The staff was super friendly and very helpful. We also found the location very practical, on the one hand it was close to the old town and the harbor and on the other hand it was very close to the shopping area."

review_text: "Cok yardimci ve kaliteli calisanlar, temizlik gayet iyi, kahvalti guzeldi."
translated_text: "Very helpful and qualified staff, cleanliness was very good, breakfast was good."

review_text: "Oda temizliği ve bakımı kötüydü. Her yerde kıl ve saç vardı. Housekeeping kaba ve yetersiz kalıyor. Oda kapısı kilitlenmiyordu. Kısacası beklentimizin çok altında kaldı puanını kesinlikle haketmiyor. Sadece konum olarak güzel bir yerde"
translated_text: "The cleanliness and maintenance of the room was bad. There was hair everywhere. Housekeeping was rude and inadequate. The room door did not lock. In short, it was far below our expectations. It definitely does not deserve its score. It is just in a good location."

review_text: "Das Zimmer lag im Keller, ohne Fenster ohne Tür schloss, laut und sehr kleines enges Zimmer"
translated_text: "The room was in the basement, no window, no door closed, noisy and very small, narrow room"

review_text: "Herşey çok güzeldi Herkes çok ilgili ve güleryüzlü Bölge içerisinde konfor ve düzeni sağlayan nadir işletmelerden biri. Tebrikler."
translated_text: "Everything was great. Everyone is very caring and friendly. It is one of the rare businesses that provide comfort and order in the region. Congratulations."

review_text: "Séjours tres agréable, hôtels magnifique, personnels très sympathique, rien a redire ."
translated_text: “Very pleasant stay, magnificent hotels, very friendly staff, nothing to complain about.”

review_text: "Hôtel bien situé dans la vieille ville (sauf pour les transferts de nuit). Bon accueil et personnel agréable. Wifi pas extra. Piscine pour se détendre."
translated_text: "Hotel well located in the old town (except for night transfers). Good welcome and pleasant staff. Wifi not great. Swimming pool to relax in."

review_text: "Fantastisk hotel med sentral beliggenhet i gamlebyen. God facilitet. Er nærmt havnen, privat strand , shopping og bazar. Er veldig fornøyde med personaler på resepsjon (hjelpsom og lett tilgjengelig særlig Umit.) Flott bassengområde Absolutt anbefales."
translated_text: "Fantastic hotel with a central location in the old town. Good facilities. Close to the harbour, private beach, shopping and bazaar. Very happy with staff at reception (helpful and easily accessible, especially Umit.) Great pool area Definitely recommended."

review_text: "Tout était parfait sauf la literie qui doit être changée et le frigidaire qui ne refroidissait pas. La position de l’hôtel est parfaite. Son architecture, la piscine, la cour, le jardin tout était de style. Nous avons eu une belle chambre qui donne sur la piscine d’un côté et sur la mer de l’autre (#519) Un merci spécial à Nihad et les personnes qui s’occupent du petit déjeuner. Je lui avais confié ma mère pour une matinée et tout le monde était au petit soin avec elle. Nous reviendrons InchAllah"
translated_text: "Everything was perfect except the bedding which had to be changed and the fridge which did not cool. The position of the hotel is perfect. Its architecture, the swimming pool, the courtyard, the garden everything was in style. We had a beautiful room which overlooks the swimming pool on one side and the sea on the other (#519) A special thank you to Nihad and the people who take care of breakfast. I had entrusted my mother to her for a morning and everyone took great care of her. We will come back Inshallah"

review_text: "Her şey güzeldi. Teşekkürler."
translated_text: "Everything was fine. Thank you."

review_text: "Muito bem localizado cafe da manhã muito bom, alguns lugares estava molhado ou pela piscina ou pelo ar condicionado, porem o atendimento da piscina e muito bom e as pizzas sao perfeitas, na parte dos vidro tinha um cheiro ruim mais tinha gatinhos muito fofos e bonitinhos,amei."
translated_text: "Very well located, very good breakfast, some places were wet either by the pool or by the air conditioning, however the service at the pool is very good and the pizzas are perfect, the glass part had a bad smell but there were very cute and cute kittens, I loved it."

review_text: "Karaalioglu parki girisinde kaleicinde eglence alisveris icinde denizin limanin dibinde ozel plaji var unlu mermerli plaji hem de sehir merkezinde havaalani heryer yakin ulasimi rahat ilgililer cok temiz sessiz sakin kahvaltisi cok iyi havuzu buyuk temiz calisanlar cok ilgili alakart restoranti var iceri disari oturma alanlari var cok rahat ettim 2.gelisim antalya merkezde kalinacak en guzel otel bence herkese tavsiye ederim otel calisanlarina cok tesekkurler."
translated_text: "At the entrance of Karaalioglu park, in the castle, for entertainment, shopping, there is a private beach at the bottom of the harbor, the famous marble beach and the airport in the city center, everywhere is close, transportation is easy, the people are very clean, quiet, the breakfast is very good, the pool is big and clean, the employees are very attentive, there is an a la carte restaurant, there are seating areas inside and out, I was very comfortable. 2.gelisim is the best place to stay in the center of Antalya "I think it's a nice hotel, I recommend it to everyone, thank you very much to the hotel staff."

review_text: "Otel herşeyiyle mükemmeldi.Çok iyi ağırlandık.Sorunsuz bir tatil için herkese tavsiye ediyorum"
translated_text: "The hotel was perfect in everything. We were hosted very well. I recommend it to everyone for a problem-free holiday"

review_text: "Bem localizado em Antalya Old Town proximo a restaurantes, lojas e pontis turisticos de interesse! Equipe amigável. Estacionamento com manobrista e carronho de golfe para nos transportar a pontos mais altos do bairro!"
translated_text: "Well located in Antalya Old Town close to restaurants, shops and tourist attractions! Friendly staff. Valet parking and golf cart to transport us to the highest points of the neighborhood!"

review_text: "Madrassene var veldig slite når jeg satt meg ned så satt jeg på plankene. maten var grei, bare syltetøy ok loff, og en liten omelett. Og en lite fjøl med noe ost.Det samme hver eneste dag, så jeg gikk og spiste frokost på hotell palermo. Kjempe fint og spise frokost 10 euro"
translated_text: "The mattresses were very tired when I sat down, so I sat on the planks. The food was decent, just jam, ok, and a small omelette. And a small bagel with some cheese. The same thing every single day, so I went and had breakfast at Hotel Palermo. Very nice and breakfast 10 euros"

review_text: "Son dakika konaklama oldu benim icin, ama dogru bir secim yaptigimi hemen anladim. Fevkalade"
translated_text: "It was a last minute stay for me, but I immediately knew I made the right choice. Fantastic"

review_text: "Yataklar konforlu degil. Gurultu nedeniyle sabah 7 sonrasi uyumak zor. Kahvalti vasat Bunlar disinda otelin konumu ve personel cok cok iyi."
translated_text: "The beds are not comfortable. It is difficult to sleep after 7 am due to the noise. The breakfast is mediocre. Apart from these, the location of the hotel and the staff are very good."

hotel_name: Old Town Point Hotel & Spa Antalya
review_text: "Das Hotel ist sehr zentral, das Personal immer hilfsbereit und zuvorkommend. Mein Zimmer war immer sauber & aufgeräumt, wenn ich zurück kam, danke hierfür an Fatma. 😊 Das Zimmer war super für den Preis und hatte alles was man braucht. Die Dusche ist groß und es kommt ein sehr guter Wasserstrahl raus. Die kostenlose Minibar hat gefehlt, aber es gab immerhin Wasser und Tee. Frühstück war auch super und für jeden war etwas dabei. Alles in einem, würde ich hier jederzeit wieder einchecken. 👍"
translated_text: "The hotel is very central, the staff was always helpful and accommodating. My room was always clean and tidy when I came back, thanks to Fatma for that. 😊 The room was great for the price and had everything you needed. The shower is large and has a very good jet of water. The free minibar was missing, but there was at least water and tea. Breakfast was also great and there was something for everyone. All in all, I would check in here again at any time. 👍"

hotel_name: Old Town Point Hotel & Spa Antalya
review_text: "Yeni İşletmesinde Ömer Kardeşime Başarılar dilerim Herşey çok iyi aile sıcaklığında bir otel ÖNDER beyede ayrı teşekkürler"
translated_text: "I wish success to my brother Ömer in his new business. Everything is very good. It is a hotel with family atmosphere. Special thanks to Mr. ÖNDER"

review_text: "Keine eigene Parkplätze! Wurde immer wenn ich darauf angesprochen habe mit gesagt das die Valet service haben, nur die sind dann auch um den block gefahren bis sie ein öffentliches Parkplatz gefunden haben!!! Sehr sehr enttäuscht!!!!!"
translated_text: "No private parking spaces! Whenever I asked about it, I was always told that they had valet service, but they then drove around the block until they found a public parking space!!! Very, very disappointed!!!!!"

hotel_name: Old Town Point Hotel & Spa Antalya
review_text: "Bana verilen oda in durumu bu sekilde idi. Bu tip odanin bence belirtilmesi gerekiyor. Odanin yarisi sutun tarafindan isgal edilmis. Sadece gec saatte girip sabah erken ucagim oldugu icin degistirme talebinde bulunamayacak kadar yorgundum. Klima 16 derecede butun gece calisti klima kumandasinda pil yoktu. Resepsyonu aramak icin telefonu kaldirdim telefon bozuk ve calismiyordu. Yorgunluktan hic bir sey ile ugrasamadim ve uyudum."
translated_text: "The condition of the room given to me was like this. I think this type of room needs to be specified. Half of the room was occupied by the column. I was too tired to ask for a change because I just checked in late and had an early flight in the morning. The air conditioner worked at 16 degrees all night and there was no battery in the air conditioner remote control. I picked up the phone to call the reception and the phone was broken and not working. I said nothing because of tiredness." I didn't bother and slept."

hotel_name: Old Town Point Hotel & Spa Antalya
review_text: "Vi kom kl 12 och fick rummet efter ca 5min. Rummet var rent och fräscht, det finns pool och frukost som ingår och sen kan man betala extra för massage och olika aktiviteter som personalen kan hjälpa till att boka. Personalen kan hjälpa till att hyra bil och parkering på gatan finns det ok av. Lite tråkigt är att om personer i rummen bredvid röker så känner man lukten av röken i badrummet. Och man hör när grannen diskuterar när man är i badrummet. Men i själva rummet tyst och skönt inte så mycket ljud från gatan (våning7 ) ingen plats att hänga blöta badkläder men helt ok iallafall"
translated_text: "We arrived at 12 noon and got the room after about 5 minutes. The room was clean and fresh, there is a pool and breakfast included and then you can pay extra for massages and various activities that the staff can help book. The staff can help rent a car and parking on the street is ok. A bit sad is that if people in the rooms next door smoke, you can smell the smoke in the bathroom. And you can hear the neighbor discussing when you are in the bathroom. But in the room itself, quiet and not nice so much noise from the street (floor 7), no place to hang wet swimwear, but absolutely ok anyway"

review_text: "Otele girdiğimizde asansörlerin orda bi lağım kokusu çarptı suratımıza. Odamız beklediğimizden küçüktü ve asla temiz değildi. Yerde başkasının çorabı vardı ve lavabo arkasında kullanılmış jilet başlığı vardı. Temizlik olarak berbattı. Çarşafta yanıktan oluşan delik vardı. Cidden insan utanır böyle bi hizmet sunmaya. Ama malesef ki daha bitmedi. En fiyaskosu ise duş. Bu duşu yapan iç mimar kör olmuş arkadaşlar. Duşakabinle klozet arasında hiçbir şey yok ne bi duvar ne bi cam ne bir perde. Duşa girdipinizde eşik yapılmamış 5 dk kalsanız bile tüm duş -evet tüm duş- su içinde kalıyor terlikleriniz yüzüyor böyle suda. Böyle bi iç dizayn yaparsanız tabi ki rutubet olur. Bizim odamızda çok rutubet yoktu ama duvarlar yine de çatlamış yer yer sararmıştı. Klozet kırık ve iyi temizlenmemişti. zaten oturamadık bile üzerine. Bir daha asla ama asla tercih etmem. Yeriniz iyi nası olsa müşteri geliyor diye de bu kadar boş verilmez. Hizmet sunuyorsunuz güya ayıp gerçekten. Sabahın köründe kaçarak çıktık otelden."
translated_text: "When we entered the hotel, we were hit by the smell of sewage right next to the elevators. Our room was smaller than we expected and it was never clean. There were someone else's socks on the floor and there was a used razor head behind the sink. The cleanliness was terrible. There was a hole in the sheet caused by burns. One would really be ashamed to offer such a service. But unfortunately, it is not over yet. The worst part is the shower. The interior designer who built this shower was blind, friends. There is nothing between the shower cabin and the toilet, nor is there a wall." There is no window or curtain. Even if you stay in the shower for 5 minutes, the entire shower - yes, the entire shower - stays in the water. If you design such an interior, of course there will be humidity. There was not much humidity in our room, but the walls were still cracked and yellowed in places. We couldn't even sit on it anyway. I would never prefer it again, even if you had a good place. "You're supposedly providing service, it's a shame. We ran out of the hotel early in the morning."

review_text: "Çift kişilik yatak istedim 2 tane tek kişilik yatağı birleştirip üstüne sünger koyup devam etmişler yatak açılıp durdu arası"
translated_text: "I asked for a double bed, they put two single beds together, put foam on top and kept opening the bed."

review_text: "odam çift kişilik olmasına rağmen 2 tane ayrı yatağı birleştirmişlerdi bu nedenle yataktan düşüp duruyorduk oda kaldığımız günler boyunca oda temizliği asla yapılmadı"
translated_text: "Although my room was a double room, they had put two separate beds together, so we kept falling off the bed. The room was never cleaned during the days we stayed."

review_text: "Hôtel de taille modeste donc calme. Une piscine de taille correcte pour se raffraichir. Propose des services de navettes pour se rendre sur des plages toutes payantes. Attention cette zone n'a aucun attrait culturel donc prévoir des moyens logistiques pour bouger à moins de se contenter de la piscine..."
translated_text: "Modest-sized hotel so quiet. A decent-sized swimming pool to cool off in. Offers shuttle services to get to beaches for which there is a charge. Be careful, this area has no cultural appeal so plan logistical means to get around unless you are satisfied with the swimming pool..."

review_text: "Nous avons séjourné 5 nuits à l’hôtel azuu. Nous sommes très satisfaits. L’hôtel a une très belle deco, les chambres sont spacieuses surtout la suite junior. La piscine reste propre et nettoyer régulièrement. L’hôtel se trouve à côté de toute commodité. Le personnel est adorable et au petit soin. Les chambres sont nettoyés tous les jours. La réception s’adapte à vos besoins. Le petit déjeuner est très copieux et délicieux, de qualité. N’hésitez pas à aller profiter du hammam et sauna vous ne regretterez pas. La masseuse incroyable ! En revanche, une musique zen et de l’encens dans l’espace zen serrait appréciable !"
translated_text: "We stayed 5 nights at the azuu hotel. We are very satisfied. The hotel has a very nice decor, the rooms are spacious, especially the junior suite. The swimming pool remains clean and cleaned regularly. The hotel is located close to all amenities. The staff is adorable and attentive. The rooms are cleaned every day. The reception adapts to your needs. The breakfast is very generous and delicious, of high quality. Don't hesitate to go and enjoy the hammam and sauna if you don't. You won't regret it. The incredible masseuse, on the other hand, Zen music and incense in the Zen space would be appreciated!

review_text: "Hersey çok güzel geçti ve mutlu oldum 👍"
translated_text: "Everything went very well and I was happy 👍"

review_text: "Çok temiz ve güzel konforluydu , bir gece konaklamalıydık ve bu otele seçtik , çok da rahat ettik."
translated_text: "It was very clean and nice and comfortable, we had to stay for one night and we chose this hotel, we were very comfortable."

review_text: "Harika personel tertemiz bir otel ayrıca plaj da çok güzel di Azu bundan sonra Antalya daki favori otelim keyifli kahvaltiyida unutmayalim"
translated_text: "Great staff, a spotless hotel and the beach is also very nice. Azu is my favorite hotel in Antalya from now on, let's not forget the delightful breakfast"

review_text: "Det var bra."
translated_text: "That was good."

review_text: "Vi bodde på ett annat hotell innan men bokade om för att komma närmare havet. Azuu var helt OK men deras personal var helt fantastiskt bra"
translated_text: "We stayed at another hotel before but rebooked to be closer to the sea. Azuu was perfectly OK but their staff were absolutely fantastic"

review_text: "Çok ilgili ve güzel"
translated_text: "Very caring and nice"

review_text: "Konum ve mekan çok güzel, temiz, nazik ve nezih bir ortam vardı teşekkürler"
translated_text: "The location and place were very nice, clean, kind and decent environment, thank you"

review_text: "Çift olarak kısa süre kaldık. Lara merkezde, sahile yürüme mesafesinde, plaja ise araçla 10-15 dakika mesafede. Uygun fiyatlı olduğu için tercih ettik. Spa kullandık ve masaj yaptırdık, tavsiye ederiz. Kahvaltıda çeşit çok fazla değil ama yeterli ölçüde. Anlaşmalı plaja ücretsiz servis var fakat farklı otellerden de yolcu aldığı için normalden daha uzun sürüyor. Odada dresuar üstünde ayna olsa ve banyoda daha büyük bir lavabo ve duş kısmında da şampuan koymak için askı olsa daha iyi olur. Genel olarak memnunuz. Konfor ve lüks değil ama iyi konum, uygun fiyat ve yeterli bir otel arayanlara tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "We stayed as a couple for a short time. It is in the center of Lara, within walking distance to the beach, and a 10-15 minute drive from the beach. We chose it because it was affordable. We used the spa and had a massage, we recommend it. The breakfast is not very diverse, but it is sufficient. There is a free shuttle service to the contracted beach, but it takes longer than usual because it picks up passengers from different hotels. It would be better if there was a mirror on the dresser in the room, a larger sink in the bathroom and a hanger in the shower area to put shampoo. In general We are satisfied. It is not comfort and luxury, but I would recommend it to those looking for a good location, affordable price and an adequate hotel."

review_text: "Çalışanlar oldukça kibar ve ilgililerdi. Özellikle kahvaltılarda salonda çalışan siyahi arkadaşın güler yüzü insanın içini açıyor. Kahvaltısını biraz eksik buldum daha çeşitli hale getirilebilir. Özellikle hamurişi ve kızartma ürünlerinin olmaması bizi üzdü. Olan ürünler (özellikle kekler) çok lezzetliydi. Temizlik konusunda kusur yoktu. Hergün odanıza gelip temizlik ister misiniz diye soruyorlar sağolsunlar ama bence kapıya gelmek yerine kapıya asılacak temizlik istiyorum kartları daha mantıklı olabilir. Hamam ve saunayı çift olarak kullanabiliyorsunuz. Havuzu da huzurlu ve sakin. Restoran bölümünü çok kullanmadık yemeğimizi dışarıdan söyledik. Sağolsunlar Yolculuğumuz gece olduğu için gün boyu bavulumuzu bırakmamıza olanak sağladılar. Lara plajı ve mermerli plajına tek otobüs ile ulaşmak mümkün."
translated_text: "The employees were very polite and attentive. Especially at breakfast, the smiling face of the black friend working in the lounge is heartwarming. I found the breakfast a bit lacking and it could be made more diverse. We were especially upset about the lack of pastries and fried products. The products that were available (especially the cakes) were very delicious. There was no fault in the cleanliness. They come to your room every day and ask if you want cleaning, thank you, but I think it would be more logical to hang the cleaning cards on the door instead of coming to the door. You can use the Turkish bath and sauna in pairs. The pool is also peaceful and quiet. The restaurant "We did not use the section much, we ordered our meal outside. Thank you, they allowed us to leave our luggage throughout the day since our trip was at night. It is possible to reach Lara beach and Mermerli beach with a single bus."

review_text: "Maalesef"

review_text: "Herşeyiyle mükemmeldi. Çalışanları otelin konumu kahvaltısı gibi tüm olanakları üst seviyedeydi. Teşekkür ederim."
translated_text: "Everything was perfect. All the facilities of the hotel, such as the staff, the location, the breakfast, were at the highest level. Thank you."

review_text: "Biz memnun kaldik,temiz bi otel"
translated_text: "We were satisfied, it is a clean hotel"

review_text: "Danke Mehmet für deine lieber Empfang, war total Nett bei Euch und ich komm sehr gerne wieder! Bis bald und danke noch für jeden Tipp. Ganz liebe grüsse aus Basel"
translated_text: "Thank you Mehmet for your lovely welcome, it was really nice with you and I would love to come back! See you soon and thank you for every tip. Kind regards from Basel"

review_text: "Kjempe fint hotell og god service. Frokosten var litt sånn bob bob. Et stort pluss ver at dem hadde nødagregat da strømmen gikk i området."
translated_text: "Very nice hotel and good service. The breakfast was a bit like bob bob. A big plus is that they had an emergency unit when the power went out in the area."

review_text: "Çok memnun kaldık bir sonraki ziyaretimizde mutlaka buraya geleceğiz herkese tavsiye ederim"
translated_text: "We were very pleased. We will definitely come here on our next visit. I recommend it to everyone."

review_text: "War sehr schwer"
translated_text: “It was very difficult”

review_text: "Petit déjeuner avec cadre sympathique. Personnel agréable. Gros gros bémol, le bruit horrible des restaurants et bars environnants jusqu'à 1h30 du matin, insupportable !"
translated_text: "Breakfast in a friendly setting. Pleasant staff. Big downside, the horrible noise from surrounding restaurants and bars until 1:30 a.m., unbearable!"

review_text: "Kaleiçi bir otel ve gece 12 ye kadar her gece otelin restaurantinda taverna tarzı canlı müzik var uyuyamazsiniz . Memnun kaldigimi söyleyemem ."
translated_text: "It's a hotel in Kaleiçi and there is tavern-style live music in the hotel restaurant every night until 12 at night, you can't sleep. I can't say I'm satisfied."

review_text: "Her zaman, uçuş öncesi tercih ettiğim tesis, kahvaltı dahil fiyatı ve serpme kahvaltı olması harika."
translated_text: "Always my preferred facility before the flight, it's great that the price includes breakfast and it has a mixed breakfast."

review_text: "Kahvaltı güzel. Sempatik bir yer."
translated_text: "Breakfast is good. It's a friendly place."

review_text: "Güzel ve huzurlu 2 gün geçirdik tüm otel çalışanlarına ve işletmecilerine sonsuz teşekkürler.."
translated_text: "We had a nice and peaceful 2 days. Endless thanks to all hotel staff and managers."

review_text: "Dans l’ensemble, nous avons été satisfaits de l’hôtel, mais surtout de la réception qui s’est montrée très accueillante et très sympathique. Mention spéciale pour Emrah qui a clairement changé notre voyage. Il nous a énormément aidés durant nos activités et a tout fait pour que nous passions de bonnes vacances à Antalya. Un grand merci à lui. J’enlève 1 étoile surtout pour la piscine, car il n’y a pas de quoi se poser (transats, etc.). Nous avons dû mettre nos serviettes sur des chaises du restaurant, ce qui n’est pas très pratique. La piscine est surtout décorative, car on peut se baigner uniquement de 14h à 18h, ce qui est très dommage, car c’est une des raisons pour lesquelles nous avions choisi cet hôtel. Autrement, c’est un hôtel avec un très bon rapport qualité-prix, et le personnel est très sympathique."
translated_text: "Overall, we were satisfied with the hotel, but especially with the reception which was very welcoming and very friendly. Special mention for Emrah who clearly changed our trip. He helped us enormously during our activities and did everything to ensure that we had a good holiday in Antalya. A big thank you to him. I take off 1 star especially for the swimming pool, because there is nothing to relax on (deckchairs, etc.). We had to put our towels on chairs in the restaurant, which is not very practical. The swimming pool is mainly decorative, because you can only swim from 2 p.m. to 6 p.m., which is a shame, because that is one of the reasons why we chose this hotel. Otherwise, it is a hotel with very good value for money, and the staff is very friendly.

review_text: "Otel genel hatlarıyla beklediğim gibiydi fakat odayı tutmadan önce hizmetleri sormayı unutmayın. Çünkü hizmetlerde şezlong ve çamaşırhane bulunuyor yazmalarına rağmen öyle bir imkanları bulunmuyordu."
translated_text: "The hotel was generally as I expected, but do not forget to ask about the services before you book the room. Because although it was written in the services that there were sunbeds and laundry, they did not have such facilities."

review_text: "La clima fonctionnait mal, le téléphone ne fonctionnait pas. J’ai signalé à la réception et rien a été fait. Mauvaise isolation acoustique. Le DJ passait les musiques « à côté » de mon lit. Un cauchemars…"
translated_text: "The air conditioning was malfunctioning, the telephone was not working. I reported it to reception and nothing was done. Poor sound insulation. The DJ played the music “next to” my bed. A nightmare..."

review_text: "Super emplacement directement dans la vieille ville. S’assurer de demander pour un stationnement si vous avez une voiture. Personnel super gentil et amicable. Chambre propre et nouvelle. La salle de bain est petite par contre."
translated_text: "Great location right in the old town. Make sure to ask for parking if you have a car. Super nice and friendly staff. Clean and new room. Bathroom is small though."

review_text: "Personalet var hjælpsomme."
translated_text: "The staff were helpful."

review_text: "Absolutt ingen trykk i dusjen, fikk ikke dusjet gjennom hele oppholdet. Ubeskrivelige dårlig vanntrykk. I dusjen var set en knapp man kunne dra ipp for å få vann til dusjhodet, desverret ar set ikke nokk trykk i dusjen for å få vannet opp, så man måtte sitte på gulvet å prøve å vaske seg med de dråpene man fikk ut fra kranen. I tillegg er ikke standarden like bra som bildene sier, noe slitt. Frokosten var bra noen dager, andre dager var hun som var ansvarlig mer opptatt av å se på mobilen. Det må dog nevnes at begge de to herrene i resepsjonen var veldig hyggelige og behjelpelige."
translated_text: "Absolutely no pressure in the shower, didn't get a shower during the whole stay. Indescribably bad water pressure. In the shower there was a button you could pull up to get water to the shower head, unfortunately there wasn't enough pressure in the shower to get the water up, so you had to sit on the floor and try to wash yourself with the drops you got from the tap. In addition, the standard is not as good as the pictures say, a bit tired. The breakfast was good some days, other days she was the one in charge more concerned with looking at the mobile phone. It must be mentioned, however, that both the two gentlemen at the reception were very nice and helpful."

review_text: "Das Hotel ist sehr klein aber ruhig und sauber. Das Zimmer ist echt klein wir mussten mit unseren Gepäck Tetris spielen (kein Schrank) Die Wasserleitung muss unbedingt verbessert werden. Das duschen war fast unmöglich und hat Ewigkeiten gedauert. Personal war Top!!"
translated_text: "The hotel is very small but quiet and clean. The room is really small we had to play Tetris with our luggage (no closet) The water pipe definitely needs to be improved. Showering was almost impossible and took ages. Staff was top!!"

review_text: "Beklentiye göre değişir fakat ilk gün biraz erken giriş yaptık ve bir kahvaltı tabağı ya da çay ikram etmek bu kadar maliyetli olmamalı değil mi? Girişler 14:00 de kahvaltı isterseniz bu gün ekstra yarın ücretsiz denildi. Oda aşırı küçük iki ayrı yatak istedik diye 1.40 lık yatağı ikiye bölmüşler yataktan düşmemek işin dümdüz yatmanız gerek o kadar küçük. 2. Gün kahvaltıya 11:05 de indik 11:00 de kahvaltı bitiyor uyarısı aldık mutfaktaki bayan sağ olsun yardımcı oldu ve ücretine dahil ettiğimiz kahvaltıyı hazırladı. Hazırlamasa da o kadar önemli değildi açıkçası bir gün öncesi ikram etmediklerini ben onlara ikram edebilirdim. Onun dışında konumu kale içi ulaşım çok kolay çarşı gezmek isteyen için ideal. Sahil için laraya geçtik ve bu gün başka bir otele geçtik odası beni çok daralttığı için."
translated_text: "It depends on expectations, but on the first day, we checked in a little early and offering a breakfast plate or tea shouldn't be this costly, right? Check-in was at 14:00. If you want breakfast, it was said to be extra today and free tomorrow. Since the room was too small, we wanted two separate beds, so they divided the 1.40 cm bed into two. It's so small that you have to lie flat to avoid falling out of bed. On the 2nd day, we went down to breakfast at 11:05 and received a warning from the kitchen that breakfast ends at 11:00." "Thanks to the lady, she helped me and prepared the breakfast, which was included in the price. Even if she didn't prepare it, it wasn't that important. Frankly, I could have served them what they didn't serve the day before. Apart from that, the location is very easy to reach within the castle. It is ideal for those who want to visit the market. We moved to Lara for the beach and moved to another hotel today because the room was too tight for me."

review_text: "Berbat"
translated_text: "Wretched"

review_text: "Alojamiento tranquilo. Con buen aarencion y vistas a la bahia"
translated_text: "Quiet accommodation. With good access and views of the bay"

review_text: "Ein wunderschönes kleines Hotel mit super Lage"
translated_text: “A beautiful little hotel with a great location”

review_text: "Das Hotel liegt in der Altstadt. Es ist interessant. Besonders gut gefallen hat mir, dass das Hotel einen Pool hat, in dem man sich an einem heißen Tag abkühlen kann."
translated_text: "The hotel is located in the old town. It's interesting. I particularly liked that the hotel has a pool where you can cool off on a hot day."

review_text: "Das Hotel und das Personal sind Klasse. Würde ich jederzeit weiterempfehlen."
translated_text: "The hotel and the staff are great. I would recommend it at any time."

review_text: "La struttura è molto bella in quanto l'antico splendore è mantenuto nel migliore dei modi... Direi che tutto è perfetto"
translated_text: "The structure is very beautiful as the ancient splendor is maintained in the best possible way... I would say that everything is perfect"

review_text: "Geçen yıl restaurant kısmına gelmiştik memnun kalmıştık, bu sene de yolumuz tekrar düşünce pansiyonda konakladık, konumu çok merkezi, oda çok temizdi,personel de güleryüzlüydü, gece de herhangi bir gürültü gelmedi,tekrar gelirsem ki gelirim yine burda seve seve kalırım💙"
translated_text: "Last year we came to the restaurant part and we were satisfied, this year we went again and stayed in the hostel. The location was very central, the room was very clean, the staff was friendly, there was no noise at night, if I come again, which I will, I will happily stay here again💙"

review_text: "Odalar güzel temizdi çarşaflar tertemizdi 2 yazdır severek gidiyoruz konumu zaten mükemmel"
translated_text: "The rooms were nice and clean, the sheets were spotless, we are going there for 2 summers with pleasure, the location is already perfect"

review_text: "Otel ahşap ağırlıklı olduğu için maalesef tahta kurusu vardı yataklarımızda .. kötü bir deneyimdi bizim için. Dilerim daha hijyen bir ortam sağlamak adına gerekli önlemleri alırlar."
translated_text: "Unfortunately, there were bedbugs in our beds as the hotel is mainly made of wood. It was a bad experience for us. I hope they take the necessary precautions to provide a more hygienic environment."

review_text: "Çok gürültülü"
translated_text: "Too loud"

review_text: "제 취향의 앤티크한 방을 잡을 수 있어서 좋았고, 직원들 모두가 친절히 제 요청사항을 들어주었습니다. 바다하고도 가까워서 야간에 주변 돌아다니기에도 좋았습니다."
translated_text: "It was nice to be able to get an antique room to my taste, and all the staff kindly listened to my requests. It was close to the sea, so it was great for walking around at night."

review_text: "Otel kaleiçinde, arabayla rezervasyon gösterilerek girilebiliyor, ancak park yeri yok. Alt katta restoran var, hareketli bir sokak, oda çok geniş ahşap oda, tarzı ve temizliği harika. ANCAK, yatak taş gibi, sanki yerde yatmışız gibi sertti, sabah çok yorgun uyandık, yolu bölüp gece dinlenmek için tutmuştuk, ama dinlemedik kötü oldu."
translated_text: "The hotel is in Kaleiçi, it can be entered by car by showing a reservation, but there is no parking place. There is a restaurant downstairs, it is on a lively street, the room is a very large wooden room, the style and cleanliness are great. BUT, the bed was hard as a stone, as if we had slept on the floor, we woke up very tired in the morning, we divided the road and took it to rest at night, but we did not listen, it was bad."

review_text: "Idéalement situé. Service impeccable. Personnel aimable."
translated_text: "Ideally located. Impeccable service. Friendly staff."

review_text: "Le séjour s'est globalement bien passé. Le personnel était agréable et l'hôtel bien situé. Cependant, notre chambre donnait sur la rue, ce qui nous a exposé à de nombreux bruits environnants, rendant l'expérience moins agréable."
translated_text: "The stay was generally good. The staff was pleasant and the hotel was well located. However, our room overlooked the street, which exposed us to a lot of surrounding noise, making the experience less pleasant."

review_text: "Personel çok güzel karşıladı bizi.Hepsi çok ilgili ve güleryüzlüydü. Oda sitenizde gördüğümüz fotoğraftaki ile aynı degildi açıkçası bu biraz hayal kırıklığı yarattı bizde.Personele buradan tekrar teşekkür ederiz . Kahvaltı da gayet iyiydi."
translated_text: "The staff welcomed us very well. They were all very attentive and friendly. The room was not the same as the one in the photo we saw on your website. Frankly, this was a bit disappointing for us. We would like to thank the staff again. The breakfast was also very good."

review_text: "Sevdiğimiz bir oteldi ve özel bir organizasyonumuz sonrası bilerek bu oteli seçmiştik ancak bir yanlışlık nedeniyle bizi başka bir otele yönlendirdiler ancak yönlendirdikleri otelin odası oldukça küçüktü ve etrafında çok gürültü vardı. Maalesef memnun kalamadık."
translated_text: "It was a hotel we liked and we deliberately chose this hotel after a special event, but due to a mistake, they directed us to another hotel, but the room of the hotel they directed us to was quite small and there was a lot of noise around it. Unfortunately, we were not satisfied."

review_text: "Konumu mükemmel heryere yakin ozellikle tranvaya yakin. Guvenli bir bolge. Odamizi hergun guler yuzle temizleyen nezehat hanimda cok iyi. Resepsiyondaki serhat beyde cok ilgiliydi."
translated_text: "The location is perfect, close to everywhere, especially the tram. It is a safe area. Ms. Nezehat, who cleaned our room every day with a smile, was very nice. Mr. Serhat at the reception was also very attentive."

review_text: "Oda son derece kullanışlı sabah kahvaltısı çok güzeldi personelin davranışı çok iyiydi"
translated_text: "The room was extremely useful, the breakfast was very nice and the behavior of the staff was very good"

review_text: "Çok güzeldi. Fiyat performans çok iyi. Personel ilgili. Otel sahibi de ilgili. Herkes güleryüzlü. Merkezi ve plaja yakın. Başarılı👍"
translated_text: "It was very nice. The price and performance are very good. The staff is attentive. The owner of the hotel is also attentive. Everyone is friendly. Close to the center and the beach. Successful👍"

review_text: "Fiyat performans açısından iyi sakin bir yer temiz güleryüzlü personel kahvaltı zayıf o da fiyat performans sonucu diyelim teşekkürler tekrar tercih edebilirim"
translated_text: "It's a good place in terms of price and performance, it's a quiet place, it's clean, it's friendly staff, the breakfast is poor, but let's say it's a result of price and performance, thank you, I may choose it again."

review_text: "ulaşığımızda odamız hazır değildi ve kısa bir süre bekledik ancak bu esnada kahve ikramları oldu. odamızda da sorun mevcut olduğu söylenip; upgrade ettiler. bize sundukları oda müthişti. çözümcül yaklaşımları nedeniyle alkışı hak ediyor işletme. kahvaltıları da oldukça iyiydi. kaleiçi geliyorsanız konum itibariyle de mutlaka tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "When we arrived, our room was not ready and we waited for a short time, but during this time, we were offered coffee. They were told that there was a problem in our room and they upgraded us. The room they offered us was amazing. The business deserves applause for their solution-oriented approach. Their breakfast was also very good. If you are coming to Kaleiçi, I would definitely recommend it due to its location."

review_text: "Konum olarak çok iyi bir yer. Çalışanların hepsi birbirinden tatlı. Çok memnun kaldık. Tekrar tercih ediceğimiz bir yer."
translated_text: "It is a very good place in terms of location. All the employees are sweet. We were very pleased. It is a place we would choose again."

review_text: "Otelin konumu cok iyiydi. Kaleicinde baska bir yere gidip takilma ihtiyaci duymadik.Otelin altinda yemek ve icecekleri ile keyifli zaman gecirdik. Pizzalari efsaneydi."
translated_text: "The location of the hotel was very good. We did not feel the need to go somewhere else to hang out in Kaleici. We had a pleasant time with food and drinks under the hotel. Their pizzas were legendary."

review_text: "Antalya'da Kaleiçi mevkiinde olmasına ve otelin araç parkı bulunmamasına rağmen bize otelcsahibi ve 2 çalışan personel elinden geldiğince destek olup çözüm yarattılar. Karşılama oldukça iyiydi. Odamız oldukça geniş tam bir aile odası ve tertemizdi. Banyo ve odadaki ekipmanlar herşey düşünülmüş, hiç bir eksik olmadığı gibi özen ve itina üst seviyedeydi. Çok teşekkürler tüm personele ve özellikle de odayı tertemiz yapan hanımefendinin emeğine sağlık. Tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle,"
translated_text: "Although it is located in Kaleiçi, Antalya, and the hotel does not have a car park, the hotel owner and the 2 staff members supported us as much as they could and created a solution. The welcome was very good. Our room was a very large family room and was spotlessly clean. Everything in the bathroom and the equipment in the room was considered, there was nothing missing, and the care and attention was at the highest level. Thank you very much to all the staff and especially the efforts of the lady who made the room spotless. Hope to see you again,"

review_text: "war leider nicht so schön"
translated_text: "Unfortunately it wasn't that nice"

review_text: "Ich blieb nur ein Tag. War in Ordnung. Nettes oersonal freundliche Mitarbeiter."
translated_text: "I only stayed for one day. It was fine. Nice staff and friendly staff."

review_text: "Bizi çok güzel karşıladılar her ne kadar arada su kesintisi elektrik kesintisi olsa da tabii ki bu durum onlara ait bir şey değil genel bir sıkıntı vardı. Bu durumu güler yüzleriyle çok güzel bir şekilde çözümlediler. Kahve ikramları için ayrıca çok teşekkür ederiz gerçekten çok anlayışlılar. Anlaşmalı beachler’i var larena beach’e gitmenizi tavsiye ederim çalışanları gerçekten çok ilgili ve cana yakınlar size her türlü konuda yardımcı olurlar. Sınırsız su ikramları ve bu ince davranışları da gözümüzden kaçmadı değil. Antalya’nın sıcak denizinden sonra havuz’a girip serinlemek gerçekten bize çok iyi geldi. Ayrıca wifi’nin mevcut olup klimanın sorunsuz çalışması bizi çok mutlu etti. En başta gelip gelmemek arasında kararsız kaldık fakat gidince hiç pişman olmadık. Bizi sürekli hoşgeldiniz tarzı yaklaşımlarla günümüzün nasıl geçtiğini sormaları çok hoşumuza gitti. Umarım çok yakın zamanda tekrar misafiriniz oluruz. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz. Burada konaklamak isteyen herkese tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "They welcomed us very well, even though there was a water outage and a power outage, of course, this was not their fault, it was a general problem. They resolved this situation very well with their smiling faces. We also thank them very much for the coffee offers, they are really understanding. I recommend you to go to Larena Beach, they have contracted beaches. Their employees are really very attentive and friendly, they will help you in all kinds of matters. We did not miss the unlimited water offerings and their kind behavior. Antalya is warm. It was really good for us to go to the pool and cool off after the sea. Also, we were very happy that the wifi was available and the air conditioning worked smoothly. We were undecided about whether to come at first, but we did not regret it at all. We really liked how they always welcomed us and asked us how our day was. I hope we will be your guest again very soon. Thank you very much for everything.

review_text: "Otel konum olarak iyi bir yerde, kaleiçinde park sorun olsa da otel yakın bir yerlere park edilmesi konusunda yardımcı oluyor, bu konuda sorun yaşamadık. Otel genel olarak iyi, odalar yeterli büyüklükte ve temizama biraz bakıma ihtiyacı var. Örnek olarak sararmış klozet kapağı gibi basit şeyler değiştirilebilir. Kahvaltı bizim için yeterliydi, her gün pişi, omlet, pankek gibi farklı sıcaklar çıkardılar. Genel olarak ailece memnun kaldık."
translated_text: "The hotel is in a good location, although parking is a problem in Kaleiçi, the hotel helps you park somewhere nearby, we did not have any problems in this regard. The hotel is generally good, the rooms are large enough and clean, but it needs some maintenance. For example, simple things such as a yellowed toilet seat can be changed. Breakfast was sufficient for us, they served different hot dishes such as bagel, omelet and pancakes every day. Generally, we were satisfied as a family."

review_text: "maalesef aldığı parayı hak etmeyen bir hotel. Evet yeri güzel. Merkezde. Heryere yakın bir konumda. Fotoğraflarda görünen temiz ve hijyen bir hoteldi. Gittiğimizde anladım ki eşyalar eskimiş, banyolarda küf var. Klimalar çalışmuyor ve eskimiş. Üstelik haber vermiştim uçağımız erken bir saatte inicek ve onlarda sorun olmayacağını oda boşsa verileceğini yazmıştı. Gittiğimizde maalesef çoluklarla dışarda kaldık ve başka bir hotele geçtik. Keşke önceden haber verilseydi. Havuz ve etrafı bakımsız. Kahvaltı ortalamada. Bir daha Antalya kaleiçine gelicem ama tabiki bu oteli tercih etmeyeceğim. Üzgünüm. Çalışanlar kibar ve yardımcı."
translated_text: "Unfortunately, it is a hotel that does not deserve the money it costs. Yes, the location is nice. It is in the center. It is close to everywhere. It was a clean and hygienic hotel as seen in the photos. When we went, I realized that the furniture was old and there was mold in the bathrooms. The air conditioners were not working and were old. Moreover, I had informed them that our flight would be landing at an early hour and they said that there would be no problem and that the room would be given if it was vacant. When we went, unfortunately, we were left out with the family and we moved to another hotel. I wish we had been informed in advance. The pool and its surroundings "It is poorly maintained. The breakfast is average. I will come to Antalya Kaleiçi again, but of course I will not choose this hotel. The staff is polite and helpful."

review_text: "Otel konum olarak çok iyi biz zaten konumundan dolayı tercih etmiştik otel çalışanları ilgili otel temiz ferah sakin 2 gece kaldığımız otelden memnun kaldık"
translated_text: "The hotel is very good in terms of location. We had already chosen it because of its location. The hotel staff were helpful. The hotel was clean, spacious and quiet. We were pleased with the hotel we stayed in for 2 nights."

review_text: "Sehr schönes, solides kleines Hotel, vermutlich von einer Familie geführt. In unmittelbarer Nähe zu den Anziehungspunkten mitten in Antalyas Altstadt gelegen. Pool im Innenhof ist für Familien mit Kindern interessant, die reiferen freuen sich an der Bar mit einfachen Getränken. Ausgiebiges Frühstück gibt's im schattigen Innenhof. Immer wieder gern."
translated_text: "Very nice, solid small hotel, probably run by a family. Located in the immediate vicinity of the attractions in the middle of Antalya's old town. Pool in the courtyard is interesting for families with children, the older ones enjoy simple drinks at the bar. There is an extensive breakfast in the shady courtyard. Always a pleasure."

review_text: "Sehr nette Chefin und ein super Personal. Saubere Zimmer. Würde gerne wiederkommen. Hat uns sehr gefallen."
translated_text: "Very nice boss and great staff. Clean rooms. Would like to come back. We really enjoyed it."

review_text: "“Rahat hissetmedik – tavsiye etmiyorum.” Otele önceden rezervasyon yapıp 2 günlük ödeme yaptık. Başta 3 gün kalmayı düşünüyorduk ama planımızı son anda değiştirmek zorunda kaldık ve 2. gün çıkmak istedik. Kalmayacağımız günün ücretini ödemek istemeyince, personelin tehditkâr tavırlarıyla karşılaştık. Bu yaklaşım bizi gerçekten rahatsız etti ve güvensiz hissettik. "If you want to have a pleasant holiday, I would definitely recommend you to choose another place."

The breakfast buffet was sufficient, comfort and cleanliness were very good. I came from Kemer for 2 days to rest my mind, but it is a place where you can have a good holiday even for a week, its location is right in Kaleiçi. As for the hotel staff, especially the waiters are young students and at the reception, they can sometimes get very good attention or sometimes if they are busy, there may be moments when they do not even look at your face, after all, this is a 5-star hotel." Even though they were working under that heat in today's conditions, I think the employees were very good, I was satisfied in every aspect, you are already on holiday, I would say don't worry about the little things, overall I felt 10/10, I would like to thank the hotel management, it will be my stop when I come to Kaleiçi from Kemer."

review_text: "Otel ambiyansı ve kahvaltı mükemmeldi. Antalyaya geldiğimde tekrar konaklamak isteyebileceğim bir yer"
translated_text: "The hotel ambience and breakfast were excellent. It is a place where I would like to stay again when I come to Antalya."

review_text: "Çok keyifliydi"

Empfehlenswert für einen Besuch der Altstadt."

The staff was very friendly, we got our breakfast (lunchbox) at five in the morning as our flight left early in the morning. Recommended for a visit to the old town."

review_text: "Genel olarak iyiydi her şeyi ile memnun kaldık"

review_text: "War hervorragend für ein Hotel in der Stadt und strand war nicht so weit 10min"

L’hôtel est bien placé et il y a beaucoup de restaurants et places de shopping autour. La chambre est très spacieuse, beau design Je recommande fortement Merci"
translated_text: "We had a great stay in this hotel, the staff was top notch, absolutely nothing to say, whether day or night! The hotel is well located and there are many restaurants and shopping places around. The room is very spacious, beautiful design I highly recommend Thank you"

review_text: "Fiyat performans açısından çok başarılıydı, temizlik konfor açısından da öyle. Kahvaltı ortalama bir açık büfeydi. Sadece duştaki su ile ilgili bir problem vardı musluğa dokunmamamıza rağmen suyun sıcaklığı sürekli değişiyordu. Bir daha kalmak isterim"
translated_text: "It was very successful in terms of price and performance, as well as in terms of cleanliness and comfort. The breakfast was an average open buffet. There was only a problem with the water in the shower, although we did not touch the tap, the temperature of the water was constantly changing. I would like to stay again."

review_text: "Sehr herzig empfangen. Frühstück ist großartig, authentisch, alles ist mit Liebe zubereitet.Sehr freundliche Chef und Personal. Kommen wieder gerne! Danke schön!"
translated_text: "A very warm welcome. Breakfast is great, authentic, everything is prepared with love. Very friendly boss and staff. We'll be back again! Thank you!"

review_text: "Bon hotel,bon personnel"
