review_text: "Vi var tre personer, en vuxen och två 16 åringar som bodde här en natt. Vi hade gärna stannat kvar fler nätter om vi inte redan hade bokat ett annat hotell sedan tidigare. Troligen ett hotell som ägs och drivs av en familj. Det var nämligen mycket familjärt. Vi fick bra service från start och fin frukost med färskpressad apelsin juice. Vårt rum var rent och stort. Litet och charmigt hotell med få gäster. Fanns alltid plats runt poolen. Gemensamma utrymmen även utomhus kyldes ner av stora AC-fläktar."
translated_text: "We were three people, an adult and two 16-year-olds who stayed here for one night. We would have liked to have stayed more nights if we hadn't already booked another hotel beforehand. Probably a hotel that is owned and run by a family. It was very family-like. We received good service from the start and a nice breakfast with freshly squeezed orange juice. Our room was clean and large. Small and charming hotel with few guests. There was always room around the pool. Common areas, even outdoors, were cooled by large AC fans."

review_text: "Fantastisk beliggenhet, rolig og hyggelig vertskap. God frokost"
translated_text: "Fantastic location, quiet and pleasant host. Good breakfast"

review_text: "Das Hotel Saye Koank liegt mitten in der wunderschönen historischen Altstadt von Antalya – perfekt, um die Stadt zu Fuß zu erkunden. Schon beim Check-in wurden wir herzlich empfangen. Das Personal war ausgesprochen freundlich, hilfsbereit und immer ansprechbar, egal ob es um Fragen zum Hotel oder um Tipps für die Umgebung ging. Besonders hilfreich waren die individuellen Empfehlungen für Ausflüge. Unser Zimmer war charmant eingerichtet, sauber und sehr gemütlich – mit liebevollen Details, die dem Ganzen eine persönliche Note verliehen. Der Service war ausgezeichnet*ä, vom Frühstück bis zur Reinigung. Wir haben uns jederzeit wohl und willkommen gefühlt und würden das Hotel uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen – ob für einen Städtetrip oder als Ausgangspunkt für die Erkundung der Region. Ein echtes Juwel in Antalya!"
translated_text: "The Hotel Saye Koank is located in the middle of the beautiful historic old town of Antalya - perfect for exploring the city on foot. We were warmly welcomed when we checked in. The staff was extremely friendly, helpful and always approachable, whether we had questions about the hotel or tips for the area. The individual recommendations for excursions were particularly helpful. Our room was charmingly furnished, clean and very comfortable - with loving details that gave the whole thing a personal touch. The service was excellent*ä, from breakfast to cleaning. We have We felt comfortable and welcome at all times and would recommend the hotel without reservation - whether for a city trip or as a starting point for exploring the region. A real gem in Antalya!"

review_text: "Tekin hizo que nuestra estancia fuera maravillosa, él y su familia nos ayudaron en todo lo que necesitamos, el hotel está en una zona con mucho encanto y cerca de La Mezquita Azul, Ayasofia, La Basílica Cisterna y otros puntos de interés. Nos como en casa!!!! Gracias por todo!!"
translated_text: "Tekin made our stay wonderful, he and his family helped us with everything we needed, the hotel is in a very charming area and close to The Blue Mosque, Ayasofia, The Basilica Cistern and other points of interest. We felt at home!!!! Thank you for everything!!"

review_text: "Arkadaşımla 2 gecelik Antalya seyahatimizde Kaleiçi bölgesinde yorumları da baz alarak Saye Konak Hoteli tercih ettik. Güleryüzlü, son derece ilgili personeli ve işletmecisine çok teşekkür ederiz. Kaleiçindeki merkezi konumu ve nispeten sakin bir bölgesinde olması konaklamamızı çok kolaylaştırdı. Özenle yapılmış restorasyonu ve tertemiz odaları ile bir dahaki seyahatimiz için yine tercih edeceğimiz bir otel oldu.."
translated_text: "During our 2-night trip to Antalya with my friend, we chose Saye Konak Hotel based on the comments in the Kaleiçi region. We would like to thank the friendly, extremely attentive staff and manager. Its central location in Kaleiçi and being in a relatively quiet area made our stay very easy. With its meticulous restoration and spotless rooms, it was a hotel we would choose again for our next trip."

review_text: "Es fehlt an sauberkeit insbesondere im bad die Betten waren nicht bequem die kissen Katastrophe Frühstück Standard täglich das gleiche"

review_text: "Sürekli gittiğim hotel mükemmel bir yer herkese tavsiye ederim"

There are almost no fruits or meats.It takes about 10 minutes to walk to the tourist center.The hotel's parking lot is nearby OTPARK, and the manager told me that I could stay at the Sky or Mail Hotel.

The breakfast can be improved under the diversity and freshness of Antalya. In general, it can be preferred, thanks to the staff on duty."

review_text: "Otel oldukça güzel ve temizdi. Çalışanlar güleryüzlü ve ilgiliydi. Oda konforlu sessiz ve dinlenmek için çok elverişliydi. Her şey için teşekkürler."

Although I do not know their names, I also thank the gentleman at the reception and the maid on our floor for their attention."

translated_text: "We were welcomed very well from the first entrance until our departure. The hotel was renovated and was clean and tidy. It is located very close to Falez park. The only problem was that the insulation on the walls was low and we could even hear normal conversations in the next room. I hope it will be fixed. Other than that, everything was good, we will stay again."

review_text: "Genel olarak memnun kaldık. Oda geniş ve temizdi. Oda renkleri iç açıcıydı. Personel yardımcı ve ilgiliydi. Öneri olarak camlara sineklik takılsa çok iyi olur."
translated_text: "We were generally satisfied. The room was spacious and clean. The room colors were pleasing. The staff was helpful and attentive. As a suggestion, it would be great if mosquito nets were installed on the windows."

During our stay, the price increased twice. The hotel "It is centrally located, but it is inevitable that the noise from the street will come to your room at night. On hotels.com where we booked, it also says that it is an adult hotel, which is why we chose the place, but there were also children in the hotel. Besides that, a real nice place."

translated_text: "The hotel is family friendly and the staff were very nice, cheerful and helpful. The hotel is in a central area, very easy to get around. We had a very nice experience. Recommended."

review_text: "Sehr gut und freundlich 👍"
translated_text: “Very good and friendly 👍”

review_text: "Çok güzel Kaleiçindeki gerçekten tarihine uygun çok hoş bir bina tek bir sıkıntısı var Kaleicinin tam göbeğinde olduğudan dolayı etrafındaki mekanlardan gelen sesler eğlenmeyi seviyorsanız tabii ki de o sizin için bir sıkıntı değil"
translated_text: "It's a very nice building in Kaleiçi, really appropriate to its history. There's only one problem, since it's right in the heart of Kaleici, the sounds coming from the places around it are loud. If you like to have fun, of course, that's not a problem for you."

review_text: "Zimmer grösse gut. Sehr ringhörig, Bett unbequem, das Wasser in der Dusche fliesst nicht richtig da alles verkalkt ist. Abflüsse sehr dreckig und alt!! Kein Lift vorhanden, aber den Gepäck bringen sie ins Zimmer. Einzig tolle, Lage und die Aussicht vom Balkon (Suite)"
translated_text: "The room is a good size. Very noisy, the bed is uncomfortable, the water in the shower doesn't flow properly because everything is calcified. Drains are very dirty and old!! There is no elevator, but they bring the luggage into the room. The only great thing is the location and the view from the balcony (suite)"

review_text: "Établissement très jolie et très propre à première vue. Nous avons beaucoup aimé la proximité des commerces et les rues piétonnes. Mais une fois arrivée dans la chambre nous avons pu remarquer l’état de la chambre sol sale, des moisissures dans la douche, évier pas propre, mur remplit de trace de saleté, lit loin d’être confortable et j’en passe .. pour le prix payé je trouve sa désolant"
translated_text: "Very pretty and very clean establishment at first glance. We really liked the proximity to the shops and the pedestrian streets. But once we arrived in the room we noticed the state of the room: dirty floor, mold in the shower, sink not clean, wall full of traces of dirt, bed far from comfortable and so on... for the price paid I find it distressing"

review_text: "Trotz der sehr zentrale Lage in der Altstadt, ist das Hotel und besonders der Pool-Bereiche ein Oase."
translated_text: "Despite the very central location in the old town, the hotel and especially the pool areas are an oasis."

review_text: "Tres bon séjour. Chambre nettoyé tous les jours sans exception. Personnel très sympathique et aux petits soins."
translated_text: "Very good stay. Room cleaned every day without exception. Very friendly and attentive staff."

review_text: "Ihana ja todella viihtyisä hotelli, viehättävä pihapiiri ja erittäin avulias ja ystävällinen henkilökunta. Huoneemme upgradettiin ja saimme vaivatta pidennettyä check-out aikaa. Jos tulen uudestaan tänne niin yövyn aivan varmasti uudestaan tässä hotellissa."
translated_text: "Wonderful and really cozy hotel, charming grounds and very helpful and friendly staff. Our room was upgraded and we were able to extend the check-out time easily. If I come here again, I will definitely stay at this hotel again."

review_text: "La habitación tenía el encanto de lo tradicional pero estaba en buen estado y era grande. El baño, sin embargo, era pequeño y antiguo. Los empleados son agradables y serviciales"
translated_text: "The room had traditional charm but was in good condition and large. The bathroom, however, was small and old. The employees are pleasant and helpful"

review_text: "Ons kamer was heel oud en bed was helemaal niet comfortabel"
translated_text: "Our room was very old and the bed was not comfortable at all"

review_text: "Biz üç kişilik bir odada konakladık.Eşim çocucuğum ve ben. Otele geç giriş yaptık gittiğimizde çocuğumuzun yatağı hazırlanmıştı . Odalar eski eşyalar eski fakat yatak inanılmaz rahattı eminim otelde çok daha güzel odalar vardır . Bizim kaldığımız oda da balkon yoktu fakat bahçe o kadar güzel ki bahçede ve havuzda zaman geçirdik çocuklu aileler için özellikle çok rahat bi otel . Sadece sigara kullananlar için balkonlu odaları seçmek daha konforlu olabilir. Kahvaltısı güzeldi hamurişi olan ürünler çeşitliydi fakat sıcaklara bi el atılmalı yumurtayı hiç beğenemedik . Otelin içinde üç farklı restaurant var biz Seraser restaurantta akşam yemeği yedik güzeldi çalışanlar çok ilgili ve kibarlar ambiyans çok güzeldi bahçedeki muz ağaçlarına bayıldım. Kahvaltıyıda seraser de yapıyosunuz oldukça keyifli ve yine burada da çalışanlar çok tatlılar . Otel çalışanları genel anlamda çok kibar ve yardımcılardı. Biz çok sevdik yine gitmeyi düşünüyoruz . Gidecek olanlar için oteli navigasyonla bulamıyosunuz biz inanılmaz zorlandık. Saat kulesini bulup oradan insanlara sorarak ilerlemenizi öneririm. Biz otelden akşam çıkıp gezip döneceğimizde bile bulamadık oteli labirent gibi bütün sokaklar dar ve iki araba yanyana geçemiyo tarihi bi bölge olduğu için bu şekilde . Ama biz yine gitsek yine Tuvana Hotel i seçeriz büyülü bi yer çok sevdik ♥️"
translated_text: "We stayed in a triple room. My wife, my child and I. We checked in late to the hotel. Our child's bed was already prepared when we arrived. The rooms have old furniture, but the bed was incredibly comfortable. I'm sure there are much nicer rooms in the hotel. The room we stayed in did not have a balcony, but the garden is so beautiful that we spent time in the garden and at the pool. It is a very comfortable hotel, especially for families with children. It may be more comfortable for smokers to choose rooms with a balcony. The breakfast was good, the pastries were diverse, but you should take care of the hot weather." We didn't like the eggs at all. There are three different restaurants inside the hotel. We had dinner at the Seraser restaurant. The staff were very friendly and polite. I loved the banana trees in the garden. You can also have breakfast at Seraser. The staff were very nice and helpful. We liked it very much. We are thinking of going there again. For those who are going to go, we had a hard time finding the hotel by asking people. I recommend it. Even when we left the hotel in the evening and came back, we couldn't find the hotel. All the streets are like a maze and two cars cannot pass each other because it is a historical area. But if we go again, we will choose Tuvana Hotel, it is a magical place. We loved it very much.

review_text: "Konum olarak merkezi bir konumda olduğu için erken uyumak isteyenler gürüntüden rahatsız olacaktır. Çevredeki publardan gelen müzikler ve sokaktaki insan gürültüleri yatak odanıza kadar ulaşıyor. Sessizlik arayanlara pek uygun değil bence. Onun dışında kahvaltı idare eder, yüksek bir kalite beklemeyin."
translated_text: "As the location is central, those who want to sleep early will be disturbed by the noise. The music from the surrounding pubs and the noise of people on the street reach your bedroom. I think it is not suitable for those looking for silence. Other than that, the breakfast is okay, do not expect a high quality."

review_text: "Gayet güzel iletişim ve yönlendirmelere sahip sunulan hizmet mükemmel tesekkür ederim."
translated_text: "Very good communication and guidance, excellent service, thank you."

review_text: "Herşey çok güzeldi teşekkür ederiz"
translated_text: "Everything was great, thank you"

review_text: "Gerek konum itibariyle gerekse hizmet anlamında beklentimizi karşıladı. Her şey çok güzeldi."
translated_text: "It met our expectations both in terms of location and service. Everything was great."

review_text: "Jätemysig hotell"
translated_text: "Very cozy hotel"

review_text: "Das Hotel ist wunderschön und toll gelegen. Wir haben uns hier rundum wohl gefühlt."
translated_text: "The hotel is beautiful and in a great location. We felt completely at home here."

review_text: "Wszystko było tak jak w opisie. Miła obsługa."
translated_text: "Everything was as described. Nice service."

review_text: "Nach anfänglichem Problem mit dem Zimmer haben wir ab der zweiten Nacht unser Wunschzimmer bekommen."
translated_text: "After an initial problem with the room, we got the room we wanted from the second night."

review_text: "Vi bodde längst uppe på andra våningen, längst borta från receptionen. Wi-Fi var väldigt ostabilt. Detta är dock nog det enda negativa vi kan säga om boendet. Personalen var helt otroligt trevliga och hjälpsamma. Byggnaden var i gammal stil, riktigt mysigt. Det kändes väldigt privat. Vi hade till ex egen balkong. Frukosten bjöd på mycket olika, både frukt och grönt, olika ägg, bröd, salt och sött. Flera olika traditionella turkiska rätter. Poolområdet var mindre men vi hade aldrig problem att hitta en plats. Ganska lugnt. Städning varje dag, vissa dagar kanske mer noggrant än andra, men en upplevelse av att personalen tar mycket hänsyn till när man är hemma eller inte. Riktigt trevligt område med små gator."
translated_text: "We stayed at the top of the second floor, furthest from the reception. The Wi-Fi was very unstable. However, this is probably the only negative thing we can say about the accommodation. The staff were incredibly nice and helpful. The building was in an old style, really cozy. It felt very private. We even had our own balcony. The breakfast offered a lot of variety, both fruit and vegetables, different eggs, bread, salt and sweet. Several different traditional Turkish dishes. The pool area was smaller but we had never a problem to find a place. Cleaning every day, maybe more thorough than others, but a very considerate experience when you are home or not. Really nice area with small streets."

review_text: "Frühstück war ok Zimmer roch muffig, sauber war es nıcht unbedingt. braucht im Bad viel reparaturen Lage vom Zimmer über der Küche roch extrem nach essen. Personal war nicht unbedingt freundlich. Nochmal würden wir da nicht hingehen."
translated_text: "Breakfast was ok. Room smelled musty, it wasn't really clean. The bathroom needs a lot of repairs. The location of the room above the kitchen smelled extremely like food. The staff wasn't necessarily friendly. We wouldn't go there again."

review_text: "Hotel incrível, com história em todos os comodos (tem mais de 300 anos), reformado, em bom estado. Piscina linda e limpa, com flores ao redor. Drinks deliciosos, apesar de acima do preço da região (compreensível pela exclusividade). Tem 3 restaurantes, todoa deliciosos. Café da manhã turco com variedade de queijos, azeitonas, tomates (apesar de não ser nosso estilo favorito - faz falta frutas, mais cereais, bolos)."
translated_text: "Incredible hotel, with history in every room (it's over 300 years old), renovated, in good condition. Beautiful and clean pool, with flowers around. Delicious drinks, although higher than the price in the region (understandable given the exclusivity). It has 3 restaurants, all delicious. Turkish breakfast with a variety of cheeses, olives, tomatoes (although it's not our favorite style - fruit is needed, more cereals, cakes)."

review_text: "Tuve una estadía agradable"
translated_text: "I had a pleasant stay"

review_text: "L'hôtel est tout simplement magnifique puisque il s'agit d'un ensemble d'anciennes maisons Ottomane. Il se situe dans le quartier historique du Kaleiçi donc l'endroit le plus sympa d'Antalya. Tout a été parfait: Les jardins, la piscine, le staff, l'accueil, le petit déjeuner, la chambre et le parking juste a côté. Cet endroit est une merveille j'espère revenir un jour !"
translated_text: "The hotel is simply magnificent since it is a group of old Ottoman houses. It is located in the historic Kaleiçi district, therefore the nicest place in Antalya. Everything was perfect: The gardens, the swimming pool, the staff, the reception, the breakfast, the room and the parking right next to it. This place is a marvel, I hope to come back one day!"

review_text: "Servicio de 10, muy amables y te reciben con una bebida de bienvenida que con el calor que hace en verano se agradece. Además, te ayudan a aparcar el coche. Hotel con mucho encanto ya que han respetado la arquitectura creando un atmósfera excelente. Desayuno excelente."
translated_text: "Service of 10, very friendly and they welcome you with a welcome drink which is appreciated with the heat in summer. In addition, they help you park your car. Hotel with a lot of charm since they have respected the architecture creating an excellent atmosphere. Excellent breakfast."

review_text: "Ottima posizione e hotel di carattere, confortevole."
translated_text: "Excellent location and hotel with character, comfortable."

review_text: "Parkplatz sollte angeschrieben werden, durch die Lage des Hotels wirkt es verwirrend. Hotel hat einen angenehmen Charme."
translated_text: "Parking should be noted, the location of the hotel makes it confusing. Hotel has a pleasant charm."

review_text: "Beau sejour"
translated_text: “Nice stay”

review_text: "Jättemysig hotell med Kaleiçis mysigaste gata. Jättetrevlig personal och bra service. Det tråkiga var att air conditioner hade bara ett läge med fullt ös, så det blev väldigt kallt på nätterna. Fjärrkontrollen till tvn var urfunktion."
translated_text: "Very cozy hotel with Kaleiçi's coziest street. Very nice staff and good service. The sad thing was that the air conditioner only had one mode with full blast, so it got very cold at night. The remote control for the TV was out of order."

review_text: "Oda ve otelin bina olarak durumu iyiydi ancak iyileştirmeler yapılabilir. Otel genelinde klimalar çok eski iyileştirme yapılabilir. Oda dışında otel içerisinde serin hava hissedilmiyordu çünkü klimaları çalıştırmıyorlardı. Genel olarak konaklamadan çok memnun ayrıldık. Otelin restoranı da ortam olarak çok şıktı. Otelin Kaleiçinde olup otoparkının olması başlı başına bir tercih sebebi. Fakat otopark kapısı otomatiğe döndürülebilir. Her oda anahtarına bir adet otopark anahtarı verilebilirzd"
translated_text: "The condition of the room and the hotel as a building was good, but improvements can be made. The air conditioners throughout the hotel are very old. The cool air in the hotel could not be felt outside the room, because they did not operate the air conditioners. In general, we were very satisfied with the stay. The hotel's restaurant was also very stylish in terms of ambiance. The fact that the hotel is in Kaleiçi and has a parking lot is a reason for preference. However, the parking lot door can be turned into automatic. Each room key could be given a car park key."

review_text: "Havde dejligt ophold, med en perfekt beliggenhed , tæt på alt hvad man har behov for. Rigtig god service og imødekommende personale."
translated_text: "Had a lovely stay, in a perfect location, close to everything you need. Really good service and welcoming staff."

review_text: "Die Unterkunft hat viel Charme. Unser Zimmer war ausreichend groß und hatte einen schchönen Balkon. Das Schwimmbad ist ebenfalls ausreichend groß und gut gepflegt. Der Garten mit der Beleuchtung, den Pflanzen und bewußt ausgewählten Dekorationen einfach wunderschön. Frühstücksbuffet völlig ausreichend. Das Hotel ist sehr zu empfehlen."
translated_text: "The accommodation has a lot of charm. Our room was big enough and had a nice balcony. The swimming pool is also big enough and well maintained. The garden with the lighting, the plants and carefully selected decorations is simply beautiful. The breakfast buffet was completely sufficient. The hotel is highly recommended."

review_text: "Harika bir yer, sanki eski zamanlarda seyahat ediyormuşsunuz gibi. Odamizda balkon yoktu fakat katımizda balkon vardı, hiç sorun değildi. Yazacak birsey bulamıyorum, hersey mükemmel ötesi"
translated_text: "It's a wonderful place, it's like you're traveling in old times. Our room didn't have a balcony, but there was a balcony on our floor, so it wasn't a problem at all. I can't find anything to write about, everything is beyond perfect."

review_text: "Muy agradable el hotel, el personal amable y buen desayuno En cuanto a los cuartos le falta un poco de renovacion. Excelente lugar"
translated_text: "Very nice hotel, friendly staff and good breakfast. As for the rooms, they need a little renovation. Excellent place"

review_text: "Jederzeit gerne wieder."
translated_text: “I’d be happy to come again at any time.”

review_text: "Camere molto piccole e alquanto rumorose. Ottima la pulizia. Personale molto gentile, a parte il portiere che mi ha fatto il check-out che non voleva accettare lo scambio tra la bottiglia di vino omaggio, valore superiore ai 15€, e le consumazioni da 2€ da me fatte dal frigobar. Quando ha capito che avrei regalato la bottiglia al tassista ha accettato lo scambio. Colazione caotica e sbilanciata sul salato."
translated_text: "Very small and somewhat noisy rooms. Excellent cleanliness. Very friendly staff, apart from the concierge who checked me out who didn't want to accept the exchange between the free bottle of wine, worth more than €15, and the €2 drinks I made from the minibar. When he realized that I would give the bottle to the taxi driver he accepted the exchange. Chaotic and unbalanced breakfast on the savory side."

review_text: "det sødeste personale! også på de tilknyttede restauranter."
translated_text: "the nicest staff! also at the affiliated restaurants."

review_text: "L'hotel non e' facile da trovare e va raggiunto a piedi. Non ho visto cartelli o insegne. Le stanze sono buone , la TV pur accendendosi non sembrava ricevere alcun canale. Ottima colazione."
translated_text: "The hotel is not easy to find and must be reached on foot. I didn't see any signs or signs. The rooms are good, even though the TV was turned on it didn't seem to receive any channels. Excellent breakfast."

review_text: "zu jeder Zeit erreichbar, super service"
translated_text: “Available at any time, great service”

review_text: "Odalar kucuk olmasina ragmen, sadece yatmaya gittigimiz icin yeterli idi. Calisanlar guler yuzlu ve yardimci idiler. Konumu cok iyi."
translated_text: "Although the rooms were small, they were enough for us just going to bed. The staff were friendly and helpful. The location is very good."

review_text: "Oda genel olarak güzeldi, otelin genel kısmında biz 1 gece konakladığımız için fazla vakit geçirmedik. ancak havuz çok bulanıktı o hayal kırıklığı oldu. Ortam olarak güzel bir ortamı var. kale içinde olmasına rağmen gece ses sorunu yaşamadık."
translated_text: "The room was generally nice, we did not spend much time in the general part of the hotel since we stayed for 1 night. However, the pool was very cloudy and that was a disappointment. It has a nice environment. Even though we were in the castle, we did not experience any noise problems at night."

review_text: "Super Zentral. Würde es wieder buchen."
translated_text: "Great central. Would book it again."

review_text: "Hotellet behöver rustas upp då det är väldigt slitet tex trasiga galgar, slitna sittdynor. Städningen även där kan behövas se över då det var dammigt på vissa saker och fläckar på papperskorgen."
translated_text: "The hotel needs to be refurbished as it is very worn, for example broken hangers, worn seat cushions. The cleaning there may also need to be revised as there was dust on some things and stains on the trash can."

review_text: "Nous y avons passé 3 nuits pour visiter le centre D’Antalya. Tout est proche, la piscine est franchement la bienvenue en fin de journée de visite. Petit déjeuner top, chambre confortable et propre, personnel charmant et au petit soin! Je recommande vivement ce petit hôtel plein de charme au cœur de la vieille ville !"
translated_text: "We spent 3 nights there to visit the center of Antalya. Everything is close, the swimming pool is definitely welcome at the end of the day's visit. Top breakfast, comfortable and clean room, charming and caring staff! I highly recommend this charming little hotel in the heart of the old town!"

review_text: "Ok hotell. Jeg var der bare en natt. Rask innsjekking Hyggelig personal. Men det var ikke særlig rent"
translated_text: "Okay hotel. I was there only one night. Quick check-in. Nice staff. But it was not very clean"

review_text: "Vi är en familj som består av 5 persone, 2 barn på 2 respektive 10 år samt en 18 åring. Då vi landade sen på kvällen i Antalya valde vi att övernatta här innan vi åker vidare till Alanya. Rummens storlek var helt ok med två sovrum och kök. Problemet med sovrummet var att det inte var anpassad för att sova i. Kanske för att vila lite och få egen tid. Detta eftersom det fanns takfönster som var rakt ovanför sängarna utan persienner eller mörkläggningsgardiner som gör rummet mörk och lämplig för sömn. Kl 5 på morgonen får du soloen rakt i ansiktet och du kan inte undvika det hur än du virider dig i sängen. Så sömn får du hoppa över i dessa två sovrum på takvåningen. Rummen var inte så rena och döda kackerlackor var det inte brist på under sängarna som lockade vår nästan 3 åriga dotter. Gällande servicen kan jag börja med att taxin som vi beställde från hotellets reseption innan vårt resa kom aldrig. Vi landade ca 21:10 och var ute från flygplatsen kl 22:00 och letade efter taxin som ej var där. Med små trötta barn kan man bara tänka sig situationen. Till sist lyckades reseptipnen hitta ny chaufför som kom kl 23:30. Fick alltså vänta 1,5 timmar där. Framme vid reseptionen vid incheckningen frågade vi efter en affär för att köpa vatten men svaret blev tydligt att det fanns vatten på rummet och det är gratis och ingår i priset. Va bra tänkte vi men efter utcheckningen fick vi notan på att varje flaska kostade minst 50 lira. Vatten kostade 5 lira max utanför hotellet."
translated_text: "We are a family consisting of 5 people, 2 children aged 2 and 10 respectively and an 18-year-old. When we landed late in the evening in Antalya, we chose to spend the night here before going on to Alanya. The size of the rooms was quite ok with two bedrooms and a kitchen. The problem with the bedroom was that it was not adapted to sleep in. Maybe to rest a little and have some time. This is because there were skylights that were directly above the beds without blinds or blackout curtains make the room dark and suitable for sleep. At 5 in the morning you can't avoid it no matter how you lie in bed. The rooms were not so clean and there was no shortage of cockroaches that attracted our almost 3-year-old daughter. I can start with the fact that the taxi we ordered from the hotel reception never arrived 21:10 and was looking for the taxi that wasn't there. You can only imagine the situation. Finally, we had to wait 1.5 hours at the reception to buy water and it was included in the price after check-out we got the bill that each bottle cost at least 50 lira. Water cost 5 lira max outside the hotel."

review_text: "Accès a la plage direct inexistant faut marché 5 minute et l'entrée a la plage est payante 500 TL par personnes de l'attente pour avoir un transat car pas de place pour mettre ta serviettes, la piscine n'est pas a l'hôtel elle se trouve dans un autre hôtel à côté 3minute mais bien sur ce n'est pas marquer dans la description de l'hôtel, on nous a envoyé un mail 2 semaines avant notre séjour pour nous en informer. Pas du tout calme il se trouve dans un endroits entourée de bar et de boîtes de nuit. Le personnel est adorables, on a demandé à changer de chambre car était trop petite et c'est pas celle qu'on a choisie lors de la réservation et ca étaient fait, le petit-déjeuner est tres bon."
translated_text: "Direct access to the beach does not exist, you have to walk 5 minutes and the entrance to the beach costs 500 TL per person for the wait to get a deckchair because there is no place to put your towels, the swimming pool is not at the hotel it is located in another hotel next door 3 minutes but of course it is not noted in the description of the hotel, we were sent an email 2 weeks before our stay to inform us of this. Not at all calm it is located in a quiet place Surrounded by bars and nightclubs, the staff are lovely, we asked to change rooms because it was too small and it was not the one we chose when booking and it was done, the breakfast is very good."

review_text: "Bel Hotel . E il Propietario molto Gentile e anche lo Staff. Lo consiglio."
translated_text: "Nice hotel. The owner is very kind and the staff too. I recommend it."

review_text: "Super hotel personelle très serviable je suggère cette hôtel."
translated_text: “Great hotel, very helpful staff, I suggest this hotel.”

review_text: "Fantastisk opphold med en ypperlig service. Her vil vi igjen for en så billig overnatting. Koselig"
translated_text: "Fantastic stay with an excellent service. We would like to stay here again for such a cheap accommodation. Cozy"

review_text: "Tatilimizin ilk durağı olarak tuttuğumuz odadan memnun kalmadık."
translated_text: "We were not satisfied with the room we booked as the first stop of our holiday."

review_text: "Mükemmel ötesi bir otel her konuda gönül rahatlıgıyla gidilebilinir"
translated_text: "An excellent hotel, you can visit it with peace of mind in every respect"

review_text: "Si vous allez à Antalya, vous devez absolument vous arrêter dans cet hôtel. En effet, le personnel (donc le manager y compris) se font un réel plaisir de vous servir et de répondre à tous vos souhaits. Ils sont très très gentils, serviables et très généreux. Ça fait vraiment chaud au cœur... Je recommande les yeux fermés avec tout mon amour"
translated_text: "If you go to Antalya, you absolutely must stop at this hotel. Indeed, the staff (including the manager) are really happy to serve you and respond to all your wishes. They are very, very kind, helpful and very generous. It really warms my heart... I recommend with my eyes closed with all my love"

review_text: "Helt greit enkelt hotel. Bra beliggenhet. Super vennlig personale. Bor her gjerne igjen"
translated_text: "Perfectly simple hotel. Good location. Super friendly staff. Would love to stay here again"

review_text: "Charmant petit hôtel dans le cœur de la vieille ville d'Antalya. La piscine est très agréable et calme, l'équipe est souriante et professionnelle. Les chambres sont un peu vieillissantes mais confortables."
translated_text: "Charming little hotel in the heart of the old town of Antalya. The swimming pool is very pleasant and quiet, the team is smiling and professional. The rooms are a little dated but comfortable."

review_text: "Es war ein super schöner Aufenthalt, sehr freundliches u zuvorkommendes Personal :) schönes, sauberes Zimmer und gute Lage!! Guter Pool 🏊‍♀️ Wirklich zu empfehlen. Vielen Dank!"
translated_text: "It was a really nice stay, very friendly and accommodating staff :) nice, clean room and good location!! Good pool 🏊‍♀️ Really recommended. Thank you very much!"

review_text: "Daha önce de konaklamıştım bu otelde. Plaja yakın. Kahvaltısı güzel. Oteli kesinlikle öneririm. İç dizaynı, odalar vs fiyat performans oteli. Hamamı varmış hiç kullanmadım. Havuz küçük ama keyifli. Yetişkin oteli olması da harika."
translated_text: "I have stayed at this hotel before. It is close to the beach. The breakfast is good. I would definitely recommend the hotel. Its interior design, rooms, etc., it is a price-performance hotel. It has a Turkish bath, I have never used it. The pool is small but enjoyable. It is also great that it is an adult hotel."

review_text: "Bon hôtel de classe moyenne supérieure. Tres bon buffet petit-déjeuner, varié. A 5 mn à pied de la plage de petits cailloux mais les chaises longues/parasol sont payants à la mer."
translated_text: "Good upper-middle class hotel. Very good breakfast buffet, varied. 5 minutes walk from the small pebble beach but you have to pay for sun loungers/parasols at the seaside."

review_text: "Excelente experiência! Quarto amplo, limpo, ótimo chuveiro. Ótimo café da manhã, funcionários muito atenciosos. Jantamis tb uma noite, pratos muito bem servidos e saborosos! Para ser perfeito só precisava ser mais perto do centro histórico e se atentarem à não trocar toalhas banho tds dias. Mas voltaria com certeza!"
translated_text: "Excellent experience! Large, clean room, great shower. Great breakfast, very attentive staff. Dinners also one night, very well served and tasty dishes! To be perfect, it just needed to be closer to the historic center and pay attention not to change bath towels every day. But I would definitely come back!"

review_text: "Flott opohold, men kun en heis på hele hotellet. Ble derfor en del venting om du da ikke valgte trappa."
translated_text: "Great stay, but only one lift in the whole hotel. There was therefore quite a wait if you didn't choose the stairs."

review_text: "Güzel bir otel tavsiye ederim"
translated_text: "A nice hotel, I recommend it"

review_text: "Bu otelde gecen sene de bir kez kalmistim. Gecen sene rezervasyonum suit ve deniz manzarali oda iken bu sene 3 kisilik biri balkonlu 2 oda tuttuk. Gecen yil da oldugu gibi temizlik kahvalti Konyaaltinda bir planlamaniz var ise konumu gayet yeterli. Fakat bu yil 3 kisilik olarak tuttugumuz odalarin aslinda 1 adet cift kisilik yatak ile sunuldugunu odaya cikinca anladik. Balkon dedikleri alanlarda ise bir kisi ancak ayakta durabilir. Ek yatak talep etsek odada yatak koyulabilecek yer bile yoktu. Bu yuzden iki yanindaki otelden bir oda daha tutmak zorunda kaldik. Rezervasyon yapilirken dikkat edilmeli. Restaurant calisanlari temizlik gorevlileri gayet sicak kanli iyi niyetli sevimli insanlar. Recepsiyondaki arkadaslardan gecen yil da cok hoslanmamistim bu yil da tutumlari biraz rahatsiz edici geldi."
translated_text: "I stayed at this hotel once last year. While my reservation last year was for a suite and a sea view room, this year we booked 2 rooms for 3 people, one of which has a balcony. If you have plans for cleaning and breakfast in Konyaalti, as last year, the location is quite adequate. However, this year, when we got to the room, we realized that the rooms we booked for 3 people were actually offered with 1 double bed. What they said was a balcony." In these areas, only one person can stand. Even if we requested an additional bed, there was no place to put a bed in the room. That's why we had to take another room from the hotel next to it. You should be careful when making a reservation. The restaurant staff and cleaning staff are very friendly and well-intentioned people. I didn't like the reception staff very much last year, but this year I found them a bit disturbing."

review_text: "Rent, rett ved stranda , frokosten var topp"
translated_text: "Clean, right by the beach, the breakfast was top"

review_text: "Otel konum olarak çok iyi çalışanlar ilgili ve güleryüzlü gönül rahatlığıyla kalabileceğiniz bir mekan"
translated_text: "The hotel is very well located, the staff are friendly and helpful, it is a place where you can stay with peace of mind."

review_text: "Alles ok"
translated_text: "Everything okay"

review_text: "Biz sadece 3 gün kaldık zamanımızın kısalığından dolayı, ama en az yedi gün kalmaya değer bir otel"
translated_text: "We only stayed for 3 days due to our short time, but it is a hotel worth staying at least seven days."

review_text: "처음 방문을 열었을때 담배연기 냄새로 찌들어 있어서 체인지 요청을 할려다가 그냥 넘어감. 2박을 했는데 담배 찌든 냄새는 계속됨. 특별한 환기가 필요하다고 생각됨.다른조건은 만족 특히 1층엔 한국음식점이 있어서 좋았슴."
translated_text: "When I first opened the door, it was smelt of cigarette smoke, so I tried to request a change, but passed on it. I stayed for 2 nights, but the cigarette smell continued. I thought special ventilation was needed. Other conditions were satisfactory. It was especially nice that there was a Korean restaurant on the first floor."

review_text: "Le service était bon et le personnel toujours souriant mais il faut que l'hôtel pense à changer les matelas. Aussi, les tarifs des consommations au niveau de la piscine peuvent changer d'un jour à l'autre."
translated_text: "The service was good and the staff were always smiling but the hotel needs to think about changing the mattresses. Also, the prices for drinks at the swimming pool can change from one day to the next."

review_text: "Her sey mükemmeldi. Ucreti uygun, kalite yüksek. Bu ücüncü kalisim. yer buldugum sürece devamli bu otelde kalicam"
translated_text: "Everything was perfect. The price is affordable, the quality is high. This is my third stay. I will stay at this hotel as long as I find a place."

review_text: "Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à l’hôtel Atici à Antalya. L’établissement est plein de charme, très calme et idéalement situé, en plein cœur de la vieille ville, à quelques secondes seulement de la porte d’Hadrien. La chambre était agréable, avec un balcon donnant sur la cour intérieure, ce qui ajoutait encore au charme du lieu. L’hôtel est proche de toutes les commodités, parfaitement desservi par les transports en commun (bus, tramway), et à proximité des plages publiques, qui sont magnifiques. Nous avons vraiment adoré notre séjour et recommandons cet hôtel sans hésiter !"
translated_text: "We had an excellent stay at the Atici Hotel in Antalya. The establishment is full of charm, very quiet and ideally located, in the heart of the old town, just a few seconds from Hadrian's Gate. The room was pleasant, with a balcony overlooking the interior courtyard, which further added to the charm of the place. The hotel is close to all amenities, perfectly served by public transport (bus, tram), and close to the public beaches, which are magnificent. We really enjoyed loved our stay and would definitely recommend this hotel!”

review_text: "Standart bir otel beklentiniz fazla olmasın kalınabilir elemanlar güler yüzlü yardımcı oldular duş ve alanlar kötü duzeltilmesi lazım gecelik kalınabilir bir hotel"
translated_text: "Don't expect too much from a standard hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful. The showers and areas are bad. They need to be fixed. It's a hotel where you can stay overnight."

review_text: "Keyifli bir konaklamaydı, işletmecileri çok tatlılar. Tekrar gideceğim."
translated_text: "It was a pleasant stay, the owners are very sweet. I will go again."

review_text: "Très bon séjour, très bien accueilli à l’accueil surtout par M. Cengiz qui vous sera expliqué où aller comment aller et faire les meilleurs activités."
translated_text: "Very good stay, very well received at reception especially by Mr. Cengiz who will explain to you where to go how to go and do the best activities."

review_text: "Otel deneyimimiz gerçekten çok güzeldi. Odalar temiz ve rahat, ortam huzurlu. Özellikle Cengiz Bey’in ilgisi ve misafirperverliği için ayrıca teşekkür ederiz. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye."
translated_text: "Our hotel experience was really nice. The rooms were clean and comfortable, the environment was peaceful. We would especially like to thank Cengiz Bey for his interest and hospitality. Recommended with peace of mind."

review_text: "Her şey çok güzeldi. Tertemiz ve ilgili. Bayıldık, bi sonraki seyahati iple çekiyoruz."
translated_text: "Everything was very nice. Clean and attentive. We loved it, we are looking forward to the next trip."

review_text: "Antalya’daki konaklamamız boyunca her anından keyif aldığımız harika bir deneyim yaşadık. Özellikle Cengiz Bey’e en içten teşekkürlerimizi iletmek istiyoruz. Otele adım attığımız andan itibaren bizi adeta kendi ailesinden biri gibi görerek ağırladı. Güler yüzü, hoş sohbeti, düşünceli ikramları ve misafirperverliğiyle tatilimize bambaşka bir anlam kattı. Kahvaltılar ise ayrı bir güzeldi — Cengiz Bey’in eşine ayrıca teşekkür etmek isteriz. Ev yapımı lezzetler, hijyenik sunum ve sıcak bir ev ortamı hissi, güne harika başlamamızı sağladı. Her şey özenle hazırlanmış ve lezzetliydi. Ayrılırken bile içtenlikle bizi uğurlamaları, bu güzel insanların samimiyetini bir kez daha gösterdi. Böyle içten, kaliteli ve huzurlu bir konaklama deneyimi yaşamak isteyen herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz. Cengiz Bey ve eşine tekrar teşekkür ederiz, en kısa zamanda tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle!"
translated_text: "We had a wonderful experience during our stay in Antalya, where we enjoyed every moment. We would especially like to express our sincere gratitude to Mr. Cengiz. From the moment we stepped into the hotel, he welcomed us as if we were one of his own family. He added a whole new meaning to our holiday with his smiling face, pleasant conversation, thoughtful treats and hospitality. The breakfasts were also wonderful - we would also like to thank Cengiz Bey's wife. Home-made delicacies, hygienic presentation and the feeling of a warm home environment added to our day. It got us off to a great start. Everything was carefully prepared and delicious. Even when we were leaving, their sincere farewell showed once again the sincerity of these beautiful people. We would like to thank Mr. Cengiz and his wife again, with all our heart, to anyone who wants to have such a sincere, quality and peaceful accommodation experience. We hope to see you again soon!”

review_text: "Odalar biraz küçük, balkon da yok ama temiz bir işletme. Görevli arkadaş son derece nazik ve yardımcı"
translated_text: "The rooms are a little small, there is no balcony, but it is a clean property. The staff is extremely kind and helpful."

review_text: "Odalar temiz, yatak ve yastık vs kaliteli. Lokasyon güzel. Görevli personel yardımsever"
translated_text: "The rooms are clean, the beds and pillows etc. are of good quality. The location is nice. The staff is helpful"

review_text: "Mükemmel bir konaklama deneyimi yaşattığı için özellikle Cengiz Bey’e çok teşekkür ederiz."
translated_text: "We would especially like to thank Mr. Cengiz for providing a perfect accommodation experience."

review_text: "Mükemmeldi temiz ve çok ilgiliydi herkes"

review_text: "Det var en rigtig god service og et meget komfortabelt ophold. Personalet, især Efa, var meget venlige og hjælpsomme. Jeg har overnattet der to nætter, og alt fungerede godt. Det eneste lille minus var, at der ikke var døgnrengøring."
translated_text: "It was a really good service and a very comfortable stay. The staff, especially Efa, were very friendly and helpful. I stayed there for two nights and everything worked well. The only small minus was that there was no 24-hour cleaning service."

review_text: "Le séjour était presque parfait et le cadre est vraiment magnifique"
translated_text: “The stay was almost perfect and the setting is truly magnificent”

review_text: "Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis war in Ordnung. Allerdings fanden wir die Zimmer recht klein, was den Aufenthalt etwas eingeschränkt hat. Besonders störend war die Hellhörigkeit – die Wände sind so dünn, dass man sämtliche Geräusche aus den Nachbarzimmern mitbekommt. Selbst das Betreten der Dusche im Nebenzimmer war deutlich hörbar. Für lärmempfindliche Gäste eher nicht zu empfehlen."
translated_text: "Value for money was okay. However, we found the rooms to be quite small, which limited our stay somewhat. The lack of soundproofing was particularly annoying - the walls are so thin that you can hear all the noises from the neighboring rooms. Even entering the shower in the next room was clearly audible. Not recommended for noise-sensitive guests."

review_text: "Plus: bra personal,bra läge, Trevlig frukost. Minus: otrolig lyhört, man hör ljud från rumen brevid,tv ljud,dusch och toalett,pratade.."
translated_text: "Plus: good staff, good location, nice breakfast. Minus: incredibly responsive, you can hear sounds from the room next door, TV sound, shower and toilet, talked.."

review_text: "Her şey çök iyiydi rahat konforlu bir tatil geçirdim Cengiz bey Efe bey herseyle ilgilendiler herkese tavsiye ederim odalar rahattı kahvaltı ler lezzetliydi"
translated_text: "Everything was fine, I had a comfortable holiday. Mr. Cengiz and Mr. Efe took care of everything. I recommend it to everyone. The rooms were comfortable and the breakfast was delicious."

review_text: "Çalışanlar çok güleryüzlüydü, odalar güzel temizdi, bir istek ya da ihtiyaç olduğunda hemen yardımcı oldular, güzel bir konaklamaydı."
translated_text: "The staff was very friendly, the rooms were very clean, they helped us immediately when there was a request or need, it was a nice stay."

review_text: "Çalışanlar gayet ilgili"
translated_text: "Employees are very attentive"

review_text: "Fiyat performans ve konum olarak çok iyi oda kahvaltı mevcuttu"
translated_text: "The bed and breakfast was very good in terms of price, performance and location"

review_text: "En üst katta oda verildi ilk başta çok sıcaktı ve klima yetersizdi."
translated_text: "We were given a room on the top floor, it was very hot at first and the air conditioning was inadequate."

review_text: "Gayet temiz , yeri kolay ,yatak rahat ve kahvaltı tatmin ediciydi Tavsiye ederim"
translated_text: "It was very clean, the location was easy, the bed was comfortable and the breakfast was satisfactory. I recommend it"

review_text: "Yeni tadilat yapilmis bir otel. Giris katinda guzel dekore edilmis bistro var biraz ama pahali. Kahve 120.-TL Konumu guzel. Odalarin tasarimi cok kötü. Duş aldim ve bütün oda su icerisinde kaldi. Lavaboda el yikarken heryer islaniyor çünkü lavabo odanin ortasinda ve çok küçük. Odalarin büyüklüğü normal. Tasarlayan mimar fonksiyonel olmasindan ziyade goresellige onem vermiş ve saçma bir plan ortaya çıkmış. Kahvalti almayin. Çünkü peynir-yumurta-zeytin haricinde birsey yok. O paraya disarida cok daha guzel kahvalti yapabilirsiniz."
translated_text: "It is a newly renovated hotel. There is a beautifully decorated bistro on the ground floor, but it is a little expensive. Coffee is 120.-TL. The location is good. The design of the rooms is very bad. I took a shower and the whole room was flooded with water. When I wash my hands in the sink, everything gets wet because the sink is in the middle of the room and it is very small. The size of the rooms is normal. The architect who designed it is more about relativity rather than being functional." He gave importance to it and came up with a ridiculous plan: "Don't buy breakfast, because there is nothing but cheese, eggs and olives. You can have a much better breakfast outside for that money."

review_text: "Logement d’exception dans la vieille ville d’Antalya. Chambre typique, propre et bien équipée. Le beau jardin est un vrai plus. Proche de toutes commodités (restaurants, bars, magasins, transports…). Le personnel est très accueillant et arrangeant. Une adresse ne pas manquer !"
translated_text: "Exceptional accommodation in the old town of Antalya. Typical room, clean and well equipped. The beautiful garden is a real plus. Close to all amenities (restaurants, bars, shops, transport, etc.). The staff is very welcoming and accommodating. An address not to be missed!"

review_text: "Bu zamana kadar kaldığım en tatlı ve huzurlu otel olabilir. Otantik konseptli bir otel. Çok güzel bir bahçesi var, her şey özenle hazırlanmış. Otel çalışanlarının hepsi çok güleryüzlü, ilgili ve kibarlar. Odamız geniş, çok konforlu ve temizdi. Konumu da çok iyi, direkt Old Town bölgesinin içinde yer alıyor. Tekrar gelirsem kesinlikle burada konaklarım."
translated_text: "It may be the sweetest and most peaceful hotel I have ever stayed in. It is a hotel with an authentic concept. It has a very beautiful garden, everything is carefully prepared. All the hotel staff are very friendly, attentive and polite. Our room was large, very comfortable and clean. The location is also very good, it is directly in the Old Town area. If I come again, I will definitely stay here."

review_text: "Très bon séjour dans cet hôtel rempli de charme. Nous y avons séjourné une dizaine de jour et nous n'avons pas été déçu. Gros plus sur le petit déjeuner où vous y trouverez des produits locaux, frais, et variés. Le cadre est très agréable et nous n'entendions que très très rarement du bruit depuisnos chambre malgré un quartier animé de restaurant et concerts. Je recommande vivement cet hôtel charmant et très bien placé"
translated_text: "Very good stay in this charming hotel. We stayed there for around ten days and we were not disappointed. Big plus on the breakfast where you will find local, fresh and varied products. The setting is very pleasant and we very rarely heard noise from our rooms despite a lively area of ​​restaurants and concerts. I highly recommend this charming and very well located hotel"

review_text: "Es ist ein Hotel den ich immer wieder besuchen würde Personal sehr nett und höflich Rezeption ist immer besetzt und hilfsbereit Die Küche ist sehr gut aber nur für eine Woche danach könnte man auch draußen essen Frühstück super Zum Flughafen dauert es ca. 30 Minuten Aber wenn man mehr von der Umgebung sehen möchte dann nur mit Taxi Zum Strand Gehweg ca. 3 min Es ist empfehlenswert"
translated_text: "It is a hotel that I would visit again and again. The staff is very nice and polite. The reception is always staffed and helpful. The kitchen is very good but only for a week after that you could also eat outside. Breakfast is great. It takes about 30 minutes to get to the airport. But if you want to see more of the area you can only take a taxi. The walk to the beach is about 3 minutes. It is recommended."

review_text: "Fiyat-performans dengesi açısından çok uygun. Resepsiyondaki görevli oldukça ilgiliydi. Otopark sorunu yok. Konumu çok iyi. Konyaaltı Plajına yürüme mesafesinde. Açık büfe kahvaltısı oldukça iyiydi. Beğenmediğim tek şey restoran kısmında sipariş ettiğim hamburgerdi. Benim damak zevkime hiç uygun değildi."
translated_text: "It is very affordable in terms of price-performance balance. The receptionist was very attentive. There is no parking problem. The location is very good. Walking distance to Konyaaltı Beach. The open buffet breakfast was quite good. The only thing I did not like was the hamburger I ordered in the restaurant section. It was not to my taste at all."

review_text: "Rent och fint. Underbara hjälpsamma personal. Fantastiskt frukost bufe. Vi valde middag också det var lika gott. Nära havet också."
translated_text: "Clean and nice. Wonderful helpful staff. Fantastic breakfast buffet. We also chose dinner and it was just as good. Close to the sea too."

review_text: "Sehr nette Mitarbeiter. Wir hatten ein Upgrade für Zimmer mit Meeresblick erhalten. Das Frühstück war vielfältig. Man hat uns morgens ein Frühstück zum mitnehmen gegeben, weil unser Flug sehr früh war. Leider wurde dabei Brot vergessen. Ist aber halb so schlimm :)"
translated_text: "Very nice staff. We were upgraded to a room with a sea view. The breakfast was varied. We were given a breakfast to take away in the morning because our flight was very early. Unfortunately, bread was forgotten. But it's not that bad :)"

review_text: "Denize çok yakın, temiz, rahat, personel güler yüzlü ve ilgili. Kahvaltısı da gayet çeşitli, kaliteli ve lezzetli. Otoparkı var. Daha ne olsun, tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "Very close to the sea, clean, comfortable, friendly and attentive staff. The breakfast is very diverse, high quality and delicious. It has a parking lot. What else can you ask for? I recommend it."

review_text: "Güler yüzlü çalışan arkadaşlar teşekkür ederim"

review_text: "Le personnel de la réception pas trop sympathique, pas agréable, par contre personnel du restaurant la véranda est très professionnel et sympathique merci oué leurs gentillesses et professionnalisme."
translated_text: “The reception staff not too friendly, not pleasant, on the other hand the restaurant staff at the veranda are very professional and friendly, thank you for their kindness and professionalism.”

translated_text: "The quality of the food was very good. The hotel was very clean and the staff were very friendly and attentive. I highly recommend it."

review_text: "Un très bon séjour. Personnels accueillant, souriant, disponibles. La chambre confortable. Les draps et les serviettes changées tous les jours...Un peu d informations sur la ville et les possibles visites auraient été bien…"
translated_text: "A very good stay. Welcoming, smiling, available staff. The comfortable room. The sheets and towels changed every day...A little information on the city and possible visits would have been nice..."

review_text: "Unfreundlicher Personal beim Empfang und bei der Abreise; Klima im Zimmer ist eingeschränkt und braucht 1 Stunde bis es den Zimmer kühlt; Die Fotos im Netz sind nicht genau dem entsprechend was dort zu sehen ist; Teppiche sind kaputt; Alles insgesamt = nicht Empfehlenswert."
translated_text: "Unfriendly staff at reception and upon departure; air conditioning in the room is limited and takes an hour to cool down the room; the photos on the internet are not exactly what you see there; carpets are broken; everything overall = not recommended."
