review_text: "Otelden çok memnun kaldım. Arabayla gelmedim ama bir otoparkı da varmış. Resepsiyondan Hafize hanım çok yardımcı oldu."
translated_text: "I was very pleased with the hotel. I did not come by car, but it also had a parking lot. Ms. Hafize from the reception was very helpful."

review_text: "La ubicación del hotel está en el centro de Antalya. Ali en la recepción nos recibió muy amablemente y nos dio una bonita habitación. Mi consejo es"
translated_text: "The location of the hotel is in the center of Antalya. Ali at the reception welcomed us very kindly and gave us a nice room. My advice is"

review_text: "Odalar temizdi fakat lobi çok basıktı ve kahvaltı biraz daha geliştirilebilir. Onun dışında personel çok güleryüzlüydü resepsiyonda ki Ali beye ayrıca teşekkür ederiz"
translated_text: "The rooms were clean, but the lobby was very small and the breakfast could be improved a little more. Apart from that, the staff was very friendly. We also thank Mr. Ali at the reception."

review_text: "Daha öncedende bi gece konaklamıştım. Tavsiye ederim. Başta resepsiyonda ki Ali bey olmak üzere tüm personel çok sıcakkanlı ve yardımsever. Odalar temiz ve rahat. Konum olarak markantalya ve Kaleiçi gibi yerlere yürüme mesafesi"
translated_text: "I stayed there for one night before. I recommend it. All the staff, especially Mr. Ali at the reception, are very friendly and helpful. The rooms are clean and comfortable. The location is within walking distance to places such as Markantalya and Kaleiçi."

review_text: "On a bien aimé notre séjour à l’hôtel ! Surtout l’accueil de afize était excellent! A l’écoute toujours la pour trouver une solution. La propreté est bien rien à dire. Seul petit bémol il n’y a pas de piscine mais sinon rien a dire"
translated_text: "We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel! Above all, the welcome from Afize was excellent! Always attentive to find a solution. The cleanliness is nothing to say. The only downside is that there is no swimming pool but otherwise nothing to say"

review_text: "Oda çok sıcaktı. Klima çok kötü çalışıyordu. Klima çalışsa bile sıcaklık yaklaşık 30 dereceydi. Resepsiyon odayı değiştirmeyi reddetti ve hiçbir şekilde yardımcı olmadı."
translated_text: "The room was very hot. The air conditioner was working very poorly. Even if the air conditioner was working, the temperature was about 30 degrees. The reception refused to change the room and did not help in any way."

review_text: "Yatak berbat.Kahvaltıda hijyen hiç yok.Personel çok eğitimsiz ve ilgisiz.Yönetim sıkıntısı var.Memnun kalmadık."
translated_text: "The bed is terrible. There is no hygiene at the breakfast. The staff is very uneducated and indifferent. There is a management problem. We are not satisfied."

review_text: "Wir haben hier einen Abend nach einem späten Flug übernachtet. Sehr schnell erreichbar vom Flughafen aus, Check-in lief um 01:30 ohne Probleme, obwohl hier bis 00:00 angegeben wurde. Mietwagen wurde aucu durch das Personal kostenlos geparkt. Das Frühstück war zu unserem Überraschen auch sehr umfangreich. Alles in allem sehr reibungslos verlaufen, danke dafür. - Kleine Abzüge: Das Bett war sehr sehr hart, länger als eine Nacht könnte ich da wahrscheinlich drauf nicht schlafen. Die „obligatorischen“ Hotel-Pantoffeln habe ich vermisst und es war noch etwas Staub auf dem Boden hier und ds. Bett und Wäsche waren sauber. - Als Zwischenstopp würde ich hier immer wieder her kommen. Auf wiedersehen :)"
translated_text: "We stayed here one evening after a late flight. Very easy to reach from the airport, check-in was at 1:30 a.m. without any problems, even though it was stated until 12:00 a.m. The staff also parked the rental car for free. To our surprise, the breakfast was also very extensive. All in all, it went very smoothly, thank you for that. - Small deductions: The bed was very, very hard, I probably couldn't sleep on it for more than one night. The "obligatory" I missed hotel slippers and there was still some dust on the floor here and there. Bed and linen were clean. - I would come here again and again as a stopover. Goodbye :)"

review_text: "Wir waren 3 nächte in dieser unterkunft als 4 köpfige familie. Die möbel sind veraltet der kühlschrank hat gestunken... es tut mir leid aber ich würde diese unterkunft nicht wieder buchen. Die inhaber sind tierfreunde und das war das einzige was ich geschätzt habe :-)"
translated_text: "We stayed in this accommodation for 3 nights as a family of 4. The furniture is outdated, the fridge smelled... I'm sorry but I wouldn't book this accommodation again. The owners are animal lovers and that was the only thing I appreciated :-)"

review_text: "3 gece ailemle birlikte kaldık. Bence bir aparta göre harikaydı.temizlik gayet güzeldi. Hele fiyatına göre oldukça mükemmeldi."
translated_text: "We stayed with my family for 3 nights. I think it was great for an apartment. The cleanliness was very good. Especially for the price, it was perfect."

review_text: "투어가 아침 일찍 출발이여서 가방 보관이 제일 필요했는데 감사하게도 가방 보관해주셔서 바로 투어갈수 있었습니다 시설도 깔끔하고 정말 좋았습니다 다음에 안탈리아 방문시 또 머물도 싶네여 ㅎㅎ"
translated_text: "Because the tour departed early in the morning, I needed to store my bag the most, but thankfully they stored my bag so I was able to go on the tour right away. The facilities were clean and really nice. I want to stay again next time I visit Antalya haha."

review_text: "Oda temiz ve kullanışlıydı. konaklamadan memnun kaldık"
translated_text: "The room was clean and convenient. We were pleased with the stay"

review_text: "Otel genel olarak iyiydi, temizlik de dahil olmak üzere kayda değer bir sorun yaşamadık, otelin konumu arabası olanlar için iyi sayılabilir, özellikle otel elemanları güler yüzlü ve sıcaktı."
translated_text: "The hotel was generally good, we did not have any significant problems, including cleaning, the location of the hotel can be considered good for those with a car, especially the hotel staff were friendly and warm."

review_text: "Çok temiz bir otel antalya içinde ilk defa bu kadar temiz otel gördüm. Ailemle huzur içinde kaldık. Çalışanları çok anlayışlı ve güleryüzlü. Tüm arkadaşlarıma yakın çevreme tavsiye ediyorum"
translated_text: "It is a very clean hotel. This is the first time I have seen such a clean hotel in Antalya. We stayed in peace with my family. The staff is very understanding and friendly. I recommend it to all my friends and relatives."

review_text: "Otele ilk giriş anımızdan çıkışa kadar her türlü konuda çok yardımcı oldular.Odalar yeterli büyüklükte ,mutfak gereçleri yeterli, klimalar oldukça iyiydi.Temizlik istediğiniz zaman yapılıyor. Havlular ve çarşaflar temizdi.Çok güler yüzlü ve her saat ulaşabileceğiniz personellere sahip.Konum olarak tüm olanaklara sahip bir bölgede.Biz karpuzkaldıran askeri kampı kullandık. Arabayla 3 dk içerisinde ulaşılıyor. Otel de oldukça güvenliydi.Tüm personele ve Almila Hanıma tekrar teşekkürler."
translated_text: "They were very helpful in every aspect, from the moment we first entered the hotel until we left. The rooms were large enough, the kitchenware was sufficient, the air conditioning was quite good. Cleaning is done whenever you want. Towels and sheets were clean. The staff is very friendly and you can reach them at any time. The location is in an area with all the amenities. We used the Karpuzkaldıran military camp. It can be reached within 3 minutes by car. The hotel was also very safe. I would like to thank all the staff and Ms. Almila again." Thank you."

review_text: "Merkezdeki en iyi apart otel, temiz, ilgili, saygılı yetkililer🙏"
translated_text: "The best apart hotel in the center, clean, caring and respectful officials🙏"

review_text: "Güzel bir kısa konaklama oldu, odadaki televizyon 65 inch, yataklar temiz, eksik bir şey yok. Keyifli oldu. Resepsiyondaki hanım nazik ve ilgiliydi. Çocuklar da çok sevdi. Klima düzgün çalışıyor, panjurlar motorlu kolay açılıp kapanıyor. Tek önerim lavabo kenarı ahşap üstünde bir kaç kabarma olmuş, onun üzerine güzel koyu renkli bir cam kestirin. Teşekkürler."
translated_text: "It was a nice short stay, the television in the room is 65 inch, the beds are clean, there is nothing missing. It was enjoyable. The lady at the reception was kind and attentive. The children loved it too. The air conditioner works well, the blinds are motorized and open and close easily. My only suggestion is that there are a few blisters on the wooden side of the sink, have a nice dark glass cut over it. Thank you."

review_text: "It was great to have room in Suits hotel. You have everything around to visit nearby.The reception Aymila and Oğuzhan was very helpful to the guests with everything. So thankful 😌"
translated_text: "It was great to have room in Suits hotel. You have everything around to visit nearby.The reception Aymila and Oğuzhan was very helpful to the guests with everything. So thankful 😌"

review_text: "Harika bir deneyim , her şey için teşekkürler."
translated_text: "A great experience, thank you for everything."

review_text: "Güzel bir konaklama. Geç giriş yapmama rağmen sorunsuz odama yerleştim ve sabah ayrıldım"
translated_text: "It was a nice stay. Even though I checked in late, I settled into my room without any problems and left in the morning."

review_text: "Fiyatı uygun, konumu iyi, temiz bir aile oteli. Her gelişimizde tercih edeceğiz."
translated_text: "Affordable, well-located, clean family hotel. We will choose it every time we come."

review_text: "Geç check-in yaptım fakat herhangi bir sorun yaşamadım. Yiğit Bey öncesinde tüm bilgilendirmeleri yapmıştı zaten. Traditional Room gerçekten tavsiye edebileceğim bir oda. Oda çok geniş, taş ev konsepti çok güzeldi ve aynı fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Negatif olarak söyleyebileceğim pek bir şey yok, belki ses yalıtımı biraz daha iyi olabilir ama benim için bir problem yaratmadı."
translated_text: "I checked in late but I did not have any problems. Mr. Yiğit had already given all the information beforehand. Traditional Room is a room that I can really recommend. The room was very spacious, the stone house concept was very nice and it was just like in the photos. There is not much I can say negatively, maybe the sound insulation could be a little better, but it did not create a problem for me."

review_text: "Otele giriş yapmamız çok zor oldu. Dış kapı şifresi bize söylenmemişti. Geç geleceğimizi belirtmiştik oysaki. İçeriden çıkam misafirler sayesinde girebildik yoksa kapıda 2 saat bekleyecektik. Telefonlarına ulaşamadık, 2 saate yakın bir süre sonrasında açtılar. Bunun dışında otelin kendisi gayet güzel temiz konumu da kaleiçinin hemen karşı sokağı gayet iyi."
translated_text: "It was very difficult for us to enter the hotel. We were not told the password for the outer door. However, we had stated that we would arrive late. We were able to enter thanks to the guests coming out of the house, otherwise we would have waited at the door for 2 hours. We could not reach their phone numbers, but they answered after almost 2 hours. Apart from that, the hotel itself is very nice and clean, and its location, right across the street from Kaleiçi, is very good."

review_text: "Öncelikle işletme sahibi yiğit bey'e konaklama sürecindeki ilgi ve alakası için teşekkür ediyorum. Konaklama sürecinde hiçbir sorun yaşamadık aile olarak eşim ve çocuğum ile kaldık.Nevresimler değiştirilmiş ve temizdi. Banyo,tuvalet ve lavabo temizdi. Konum olarak merkezi ve ulaşım kolay. Sadece park sorunu var onun içinde 200 metre arkasında belediyenin katlı otoparkı mevcut orası park için uygun ancak malumunuz üzere park ücreti var. Konaklama yapacak olanlar gönül rahatlığı ile değerlendirebilir."
translated_text: "First of all, I would like to thank the owner of the business, Mr. Yiğit, for his interest and concern during the accommodation process. We did not have any problems during the accommodation process, we stayed with my wife and child as a family. The linens were changed and clean. The bathroom, toilet and sink were clean. The location is central and easy to reach. The only problem is parking, there is a multi-storey car park of the municipality 200 meters behind it. It is suitable for parking, but as you know, there is a parking fee. Those who will stay can use it with peace of mind."

review_text: "Nous n'avons passé qu'une nuit, mais la chambre était hyper confort et conforme au photo. Très bien placé dans le centre d'antalya dans une rue calme."
translated_text: "We only spent one night, but the room was super comfortable and consistent with the photo. Very well located in the center of Antalya in a quiet street."

review_text: "Yeri merkezi, odalar güzel, temiz."
translated_text: "Location is central, rooms are nice, clean."

review_text: "Gastvrouw en gastheer waren erg vriendelijk! Ontbijt en overig eten was werkelijk top! Goede service en alles vers en met liefde bereid! Ook de prijzen waren erg schappelijk. Zeker een aanrader."
translated_text: "Hostess and hosts were very friendly! Breakfast and other food were really great! Good service and everything fresh and prepared with love! The prices were also very reasonable. Definitely recommended."

review_text: "Harika bir oteldi , herkesin en az bi kere o otantik odalarda deneyim yaşaması gerekiyor."
translated_text: "It was a great hotel, everyone should experience those authentic rooms at least once."

review_text: "Öncelikle elif hanıma çok teşekkür ederiz, mükemmel kahvaltıları ile güne herzaman iyi başlamanıza vesile oluyor. Hilal hanım da olmak üzere herkese çok teşekkür ederiz çok güzel bir yer 2. Gidişimiz ve sürekli gitmeyi düşünüyoruz."
translated_text: "First of all, we would like to thank Ms. Elif, she always helps you start the day well with her excellent breakfasts. Thank you very much to everyone, including Ms. Hilal. It is a very nice place. It is our second visit and we plan to go again."

review_text: "Otelin lokasyonu çok iyi arabamızı park etmemize çok yardımcı oldular bu bakımdan çok mutlu olduk. Otelin 101 nolu odasında konakladık, bu oda diğerlerine göre biraz daha ucuzdu, Oda bodrum kattaydı rutubetli ve biraz da küf kokusu vardı bu bakımdan bunun dışındaki odalarda konaklamanızı tavsiye ederiz"
translated_text: "The location of the hotel is very good, they helped us park our car, we were very happy in this regard. We stayed in room 101 of the hotel, this room was a little cheaper than the others. The room was on the basement floor, it was damp and had a slightly musty smell, so we recommend you to stay in rooms other than this one."

review_text: "Die zentrale Lage ist super und das Personal ist sehr freundlich. Unser Zimmer war großzügig und die Betten sehr bequem."
translated_text: "The central location is great and the staff is very friendly. Our room was spacious and the beds were very comfortable."

review_text: "loistava sijainti keskellä kaupunki lähellä vanhaa kaupunkia, viihtyisä kaunis vanha hotelli, hyvin nukuttu yö, ei liikenteen meteliä"
translated_text: "great location in the middle of the city near the old town, cozy beautiful old hotel, a good night's sleep, no traffic noise"

review_text: "Struttura moderna, personale cortese, pulizia nella norma. Deludente la colazione, tutt'altro che internazionale e caffè della macchinetta pessimo. in generale comunque un' esperienza positiva."
translated_text: "Modern structure, courteous staff, normal cleanliness. Disappointing breakfast, far from international and terrible coffee from the machine. Overall, however, a positive experience."

review_text: "Hôtel propre, personnels accueillant et serviable, proche de l’aéroport."
translated_text: "Clean hotel, friendly and helpful staff, close to the airport."

review_text: "On était en famille c’était super, on voulait se reposer avant notre vol Tardif centre commercial à 3 mn de marche"
translated_text: “We were with family, it was great, we wanted to rest before our late flight, shopping center 3 minutes walk away”

review_text: "Hôtel très pratique à 5mn à pied de l’arrêt du tram Yenigöl, qui est connecté à l’aéroport et au centre-ville."
translated_text: "Very convenient hotel 5 minutes walk from the Yenigöl tram stop, which is connected to the airport and the city center."

review_text: "Als Flughafenhotel auf jeden Fall ok.... Taxi zum Flughafen 10 € und jederzeit verfügbar....."
translated_text: "Definitely ok as an airport hotel... Taxi to the airport €10 and available at any time..."

review_text: "Allting var bra, förutom sängkläder som luktade jättemycket rök."
translated_text: "Everything was fine, except for the bedding which smelled like a lot of smoke."

review_text: "unterer Mittelmaß"
translated_text: "below average"

review_text: "Bence olabildiğince temiz konforlu bir aile oteli"
translated_text: "I think it is a family hotel that is as clean and comfortable as possible"

review_text: "il y a beaucoup de bruit à cause de la route."
translated_text: “There is a lot of noise from the road.”

review_text: "Super Unterkunft"
translated_text: “Great accommodation”

review_text: "Schone hotel voor een goede prijs"
translated_text: "Clean hotel for a good price"

review_text: "Otel gayet güzel ve personeli ilgili. İş amaçlı konaklama yaptım memnun kaldım."
translated_text: "The hotel is very nice and the staff is friendly. I stayed for business purposes and was satisfied."

review_text: "Zimmer sind sehr klein. In unserem ersten zimmer hat die Klimaanlage nicht funktioniert."
translated_text: "Rooms are very small. The air conditioning didn't work in our first room."

review_text: "Très bon accueil et hôtel bien situé à proximité du tram pour un accès rapide dans la vieille ville. Chambre propre et bien équipée et excellent petit déjeuner. Le parking gratuit couvert est très appréciable.
translated_text: "Very warm welcome and hotel well located near the tram for quick access to the old town. Clean and well-equipped room and excellent breakfast. The free covered parking is very nice.

review_text: "Det var faktiskt hotell i Antalya, personalen var jätte hjälpsam och hade respekt, rummet var rent och fint."
translated_text: "It was actually a hotel in Antalya, the staff was very helpful and respectful, the room was clean and nice."

review_text: "Nous avons réservé une chambre famille, nous aurions apprécié savoir en avance que la fenetre de la chambre des enfants donnait a l interieur de l hotel...dans la salle petit dej/restaurant! Resultat: musique chaque matin et chaque soir... pas etonnant que nous ayons ete accueilli rideaux fermes le premier soir! Mais pour toutes les autres chambres, l emplacement de l hotel est ideal et les chambres correctes. Personnel du petit déjeuner pourrait être plus avenant..."
translated_text: "We booked a family room, we would have appreciated knowing in advance that the window of the children's room looked inside the hotel...into the breakfast room/restaurant! Result: music every morning and every evening...no wonder we were greeted with closed curtains the first evening! But for all the other rooms, the location of the hotel is ideal and the rooms correct. Breakfast staff could be more helpful..."

review_text: "Yoldan geliyorsunuz otelde karşılama görevlisi yok.Valizleri yorgun argın odamıza çocuklar ile beraber çıkardık.Oda kartı verdiler odaya girdik ki başkalarının eşyaları var.Resepsiyona indiğimde dolu odayı verdiğinden haberi yok.Zaten resepsiyonda 1 kişi vardı.Başka görevli yok dendi.Yeni oda kartı odayı açmıyor.Kapı bozuk.1gün sonra denizden geldik kapı yine açılmıyor.Neymiş telefonla yan yana geldiği için magnetiği bozulmuş.İşin yoksa defalarca in çık."
translated_text: "You are coming from the road, there is no receptionist at the hotel. We took our luggage to our room together with the children, tired. They gave us a room card, we entered the room and there were other people's belongings. When I went down to the reception, they had no idea that they had given me a full room. There was already one person at the reception. I was told that there was no other attendant. The new room card does not open the room. The door is broken. We came back from the sea after 1 day, and the door does not open again. What's the matter, because it was next to the phone, its magnet is broken. If you have no business, go down several times."

review_text: "Auf jedenfall sind die suıtes mıt den grossen Terassen ganz oben der hammer"
translated_text: "In any case, the suites with the large terraces at the top are awesome"

review_text: "Bel hôtel, très propre, bon service. Par contre, il faut prévoir un moyen de transport, dans notre cas, nous avions loué une voiture, donc nous n’avons eu aucun problème. Merci beaucoup!"
translated_text: "Nice hotel, very clean, good service. However, you have to provide means of transport, in our case we had rented a car, so we had no problem. Thank you very much!"

review_text: "Gayet güzeldi çalışanlar güler yüzlü istediğimiz her şeyi yaptılar.Sadece oda temizlipini çok beğenmedim ama genel olarak temiz.Yemeklerin porsiyonları büyük ve lezzetliydi"
translated_text: "It was very nice, the staff were friendly and did everything we wanted. I just didn't like the cleanliness of the room, but it was generally clean. The portions of the food were large and delicious."

review_text: "Bahce odasini secmistik fotograflarda daha buyuk gozukuyordu fakat oda bize biraz kucuk geldi, o acidan asiri konforlu degildi fakat temizligi, sakinligi acisindan guzeldi. Kahvaltisi az cesitliydi fakat lezzetliydi. Fakat odalarin icerisine banyolardan ve camlardan cok fazla ses gecirimi oluyordu. Bu konuda bir iyilestirme yapilabilir ama genel olarak ortalama-guzel bir deneyimdi."
translated_text: "We chose the garden room, it looked bigger in the photos, but the room seemed a little small to us, so it wasn't overly comfortable, but it was nice in terms of cleanliness and tranquility. The breakfast had little variety but was delicious. However, there was a lot of sound transmitting into the rooms from the bathrooms and windows. An improvement can be made in this regard, but overall it was an average-good experience."

review_text: "War sehr gut.danke"
translated_text: "It was very good, thank you"

review_text: "Snyggt designat hotell med mycket trevlig och hjälpsam personal. Belysningen rent allmänt och i rummen kunde vara bättre. Skulle önska bättre städning av alla utrymmen. Det är inte ett hotell för den ljudkänsliga då det är extremt dåligt isolerat och alla ljud går igenom väggarna."
translated_text: "Nicely designed hotel with very nice and helpful staff. The lighting in general and in the rooms could be better. Would like better cleaning of all areas. It is not a hotel for the sound sensitive as it is extremely poorly insulated and all sound goes through the walls."

review_text: "heel gemakkelijk, tramstation naar de binnenstad om de hoek. je krijgt een brochure voor leuke activiteiten in de buurt en voor de rest een erg fijne vakantie gehad."
translated_text: "very easy, tram station to the city center around the corner. you get a brochure for fun activities in the area and otherwise had a very nice holiday."

review_text: "Nicht wie angepriesen! Die Zimmer sind definitiv nicht schallisoliert. Es hörte sich an, als würde ich versuchen, die ganze Nacht bei geschlossenem Fenster mitten auf einer belebten Hauptstraße zu schlafen. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass ich mit meinen Nachbarn nebenan im Bett lag, als sie anfingen los zu legen. Die Wände, Türen und Fenster müssen aus Pappe sein. Das Hotel sieht auf den Bildern besser und sauberer aus, als es in Wirklichkeit ist. Haare und Staub so weit das Auge reicht. Die Lage ist sehr zentral und wenn der Preis keinen Luxus versprechen würde, wäre es vielleicht ausreichend und akzeptabel, um nachts ein paar Stunden zu crashen. Die Straßenbahn ist praktisch vor der Tür, Taxis sind in max. 2 Minuten da, wenn man sie ruft und vieles ist auch zu Fuß gut erreichbar. Vorsicht am Morgen.. selbst wenn man das "Bitte nicht stören"-Schild an die Tür hängt, kann man sicher sein, dass es jeden Tag ignoriert wird und das Reinigungspersonal einfach die Tür aufschließt. Der Garten ist ganz nett, aber ziemlich klein. Das einzig Positive sind ein paar Mitarbeiter, die sehr hilfsbereit waren. Zu viele No-Gos und zu viele bessere Hotels in Antalya, um wiederzukommen."
translated_text: "Not as advertised! The rooms are definitely not soundproof. It sounded like I was trying to sleep all night with the windows closed in the middle of a busy main street. I felt like I was in bed with my neighbors next door when they started getting started. The walls, doors and windows must be made of cardboard. The hotel looks better and cleaner in the pictures than it is in reality. Hair and dust as far as the eye can see. The location is very central and if the Price doesn't promise luxury, it would perhaps be sufficient and acceptable to crash for a few hours at night. The tram is practically in front of the door, taxis are there in max. 2 minutes if you call them and many things are easily accessible on foot. Be careful in the morning. Even if you hang the "Do not disturb" sign on the door, you can be sure that it will be ignored every day and the cleaning staff will simply unlock the door few staff who were very helpful. Too many no-gos and too many better hotels in Antalya to come back."

review_text: "3 gün tatil için konakladık. İki çocuklu olduğumuz için oda küçük geldi, hemen yardımcı oldular. Geçtiğimiz Oda gayet geniş, ferah ve temizdi, duşu, soğutması çok iyiydi. Kahvaltı gayet iyi ama kahvaltıda çalışan ekip harika ötesiydi. Hepsi oldukça sempatik, güler yüzlü ve ilgiliydi. Hiçbirini ayırt etmeden teşekkür ederim. Hergün kahvaltıda sıcak ve soğuk seçenekleri mevcuttu. Otel konum olarak da harika bir yerde. Kendi kapalı otoparkı mevcut. Tekrar ziyeret etmek de tereddüt yaşamayacağım bir yer oldu. Herkese iyi tatiller."
translated_text: "We stayed for 3 days on holiday. Since we had two children, the room was small, but they helped us immediately. The room we stayed in was very large, spacious and clean, the shower and cooling were very good. The breakfast was very good, but the team working at the breakfast was beyond wonderful. They were all very sympathetic, friendly and attentive. Thank you without making a distinction. There were hot and cold options for breakfast every day. The hotel is also in a great location. It has its own indoor parking lot. It was a place I would not hesitate to visit again. Have a nice holiday everyone."

review_text: "Otel gayet guzel ve temizdi tek sikayetci oldugumuz taraf araba seslerini cok fazla iceri aliyor odalar onun haricinde bir sikayetimiz yok …"
translated_text: "The hotel was very nice and clean. Our only complaint is that the rooms let in too much car noise. Apart from that, we have no complaints..."

review_text: "Leider sehr hellhörig; ansonsten wunderschönes Hotel - wie auf den Bildern."
translated_text: "Unfortunately very noisy; otherwise beautiful hotel - as in the pictures."

review_text: "Fiyata göre hizmet çok iyiydi. Kahvaltısı güzeldi. Personel ilgiliydi. Müdür bizimle ilgilendi Konum çok merkezi değil ama çok da uzak değil Oda konforu, otelin iç tasarımı vs. Cok iyiydi. Yüksek tavan odalar ferahdı"
translated_text: "The service was very good for the price. The breakfast was good. The staff was attentive. The manager took care of us. The location is not very central, but not too far. Room comfort, interior design of the hotel, etc. were very good. The high ceiling rooms were spacious."

review_text: "Sehr gut"
translated_text: "Very good"

review_text: "Sehr schönes, sauberes Hotel zwischen Flughafen und Busbahnhof. Das Personal ist sehr freundlich."
translated_text: "Very nice, clean hotel between the airport and the bus station. The staff is very friendly."

review_text: "Kahvaltı hariç her şey güzeldi.Teşekkürler 🙏"
translated_text: "Everything was good except the breakfast. Thank you 🙏"

review_text: "Detta hotell ligger mitt i centrum, men är mer ett trestjärnigt än ett fyrstjärnigt hotell. Rummen väldigt små. Ett fyrstärnigt hotell ska inte ha pappersmuggar vid frukostserveringen, utan det ska vara riktiga glas och koppar. Personalen var dock väldigt service inriktade och trevliga"
translated_text: "This hotel is located right in the center, but is more of a three-star than a four-star hotel. The rooms are very small. A four-star hotel should not have paper cups at the breakfast service, but real glasses and cups. However, the staff were very service-oriented and pleasant"

review_text: "Temizliğinden kahvaltısına denize yakınlığına her şey gayet iyiydi. Tek sıkıntı banyosunun kapı dizaynı :) boşluklu kapatma sistemi olduğu için dışardan içerisi gözükebiliyor. O da onemlı bir sıkıntı değil tabi, konaklayacak olanlara tavsıye edılır."
translated_text: "Everything was fine, from cleanliness to breakfast to proximity to the sea. The only problem is the door design of the bathroom :) since it has a gap closure system, the inside can be seen from the outside. This is not a significant problem either, it is recommended for those who will stay."

review_text: "Bra rum, nära till centrum. Frukosten var inte alls bra, det saknades. Glas , skålar, skedar., salt varje dag, man var tvungen och fråga. Det var ofräscht på borden. Mycket folk, för lite plats, det fanns ingen som regelbundet plockade bort från borden från tidigare gäster eller torkade borden, tog ett bra tag innan det togs bort och man fick ett fräscht ledigt bord att sitta vid. Begränsat utbud. Samma varje dag. Brödet var inte färskt och det låg bara massa småbitar kvar i korgen. Uppskattar att det fanns en pool, dock kunde poolområdet städas lite och göras mysigare. Det var inte så mysigt att ligga där o sola. Det är sol endast på förmiddagen fram till ca kl 14. Sedan hamnar poolområdet i skuggan. Rummen var ok. Lite lampor som inte fungerade och handdukar byttes för en person och inte för alla. Ingen. Golvhandduk lämnades efter att de tagit den som fanns. Det var en person som var trevlig och hälsade och det var han i receptionen vid utcheckning, annars var det svårt att få ett hej. Man visste knappt om det var personal eller gäster på hotellet då de inte riktigt framgick. Annars bra hotell för kortare vistelser. Det utgjorde sitt syfte och sängen var helt ok lagom mjuk/hård. Kan absolut bo där igen för att få ett hotell nära till stan med pool och frukost. Bussarna går regelbundet utanför hotellet. Kattungarna"
translated_text: "Good room, close to the center. The breakfast was not good at all, it was missing. Glass, bowls, spoons., salt every day, you had to ask. It was not fresh on the tables. Too many people, too little space, there was no one who regularly removed from the tables from previous guests or dried the tables, took a long time before it was removed and you got a fresh free table to sit at. Limited supply. Same every day. The bread was not fresh and it was lying bara massa småbitar kvar i korgen. Uppskattar att det fanns en pool, dock kunde poolområdet städas lite och göras mysigare. Det var inte så mysigt att ligga där o sola. Det är sol endast på förmiddagen fram till ca kl 14. Sedan hamnar poolområdet i skuggan. Rummen var ok. Lite lampor som inte fungerade och handdukar byttes för en person och inte för alla. Ingen. Golvhandduk lämnades efter att de tagit den som fanns. Det var en person som var trevlig and he was at the reception, otherwise it was hard to say hello. It was a good hotel for short stays. Can definitely stay there again with a pool and breakfast.

review_text: "Sejour parfait dans chalbre d'angle avec balcon. Chambre spacieuse. Proche du centre à pieds mais dans un quartier moins touristique. Restaurants à proximité. Facilité de stationnement au pied de l'immeuble. Accueil chaleureux. Petite piscine. Adresse à recommander. Prix très satisfaisant pour les prestations."
translated_text: "Perfect stay in a corner room with balcony. Spacious room. Close to the center on foot but in a less touristy area. Restaurants nearby. Easy parking at the foot of the building. Warm welcome. Small swimming pool. Address to recommend. Very satisfactory price for the services."

review_text: "Personalen på hotellet var vänliga och bemötte oss på ett trevligt sätt. Tyvärr var städningen en stor besvikelse. Under de tio nätter vi bodde där blev rummet aldrig ordentligt städat. Ingen kom och bytte sängkläder en enda gång, och badrummet rengjordes inte alls under hela vistelsen. Det samlades smuts, och det kändes ofräscht att bo där så länge utan någon form av rengöring. Det drog tyvärr ner hela upplevelsen, och vi kände oss inte bekväma. Jag är därför inte alls nöjd och hade förväntat mig en högre standard, särskilt när det gäller hygien och renlighet."
translated_text: "The staff at the hotel were friendly and treated us in a nice way. Unfortunately, the cleaning was a big disappointment. During the ten nights we stayed there, the room was never properly cleaned. No one came to change the bed linen once, and the bathroom was not cleaned at all during the whole stay. Dirt accumulated, and it felt unrefreshing to stay there for so long without any kind of cleaning. It unfortunately dragged down the whole experience, and we did not feel comfortable. So I am not at all satisfied and had expected a higher standards, especially in terms of hygiene and cleanliness."

review_text: "Guzel bakimli güler yüzlü persenel güzel kahvalti daha ne olsun"
translated_text: "Nicely well-groomed, friendly staff, good breakfast, what more could you ask for?"

review_text: "Odada sigara kokusu vardı."
translated_text: "There was a cigarette smell in the room."

review_text: "İki ayrı oda tutarak girdiğimiz otelde beş kişi konakladık. Odanın birinde buzdolabı çalışmıyordu sorun iletince hemen ilgilenip odamızı değiştirdiler. Çalışanlar gayet ilgili kahvaltı gerçekten çok güzel ve çeşitli taze. Klimalar çok eski ama çalışır durumda. Odalarda çöp kovası da olmalı bir de kıyafet asmak için askı olmalı."
translated_text: "We stayed at the hotel as five people, where we entered by renting two separate rooms. The refrigerator in one of the rooms was not working. When we reported the problem, they immediately took care of us and changed our room. The staff is very helpful, the breakfast is really nice and the variety is fresh. The air conditioners are very old but in working order. The rooms should also have a trash can and a hanger to hang clothes."

review_text: "Ich hatte einen wirklich tollen Aufenthalt! Die Mitarbeiter waren unglaublich freundlich und hilfsbereit – vom Empfang bis zur Küche. Besonders das Personal beim Frühstück war super herzlich und aufmerksam. Das ganze Hotel war sehr sauber, und das Frühstück war ein echtes Highlight: große Auswahl, abwechslungsreich und lecker – da ist für jeden etwas dabei! Einziger kleiner Kritikpunkt: Die Fenster müssen geschlossen bleiben, sonst wird es draußen leider etwas zu laut. Aber das ist wirklich das einzige Manko. Ich werde dieses Hotel auf jeden Fall wieder buchen und kann es wärmstens empfehlen!"
translated_text: "I had a really great stay! The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful - from reception to the kitchen. The staff at breakfast in particular were super warm and attentive. The whole hotel was very clean, and the breakfast was a real highlight: large selection, varied and delicious - there is something for everyone! The only small point of criticism: the windows have to remain closed, otherwise it gets a bit too noisy outside. But that is really the only drawback. I will definitely book this hotel again and can highly recommend it!"

review_text: "Reception 🛎️ e servizi professionali"
translated_text: "Reception 🛎️ and professional services"

review_text: "Hotelli hyvällä paikalla josta lyhyt matka rantaan ja satamaan ym.Henkilökunta erittäin ystävällisiä ja mukavia.Aamupala erittäin runsas, joten kaikille löytyy varmasti syötävää ja juotavaa, niin lapsille kuin aikuisillekkin.Ainoana miinuksena on huoneiden kunto.Huoneissa on kokolattiamatot ja meidän huoneen matto oli kamala ja likainen.Myös seinät kaipaisivat vähän kunnostusta.Huoneiden kunnosta huolimatta jos menen vielä Antalyaan varaan huoneeni tästä hotellista."
translated_text: "The hotel is in a good location, a short walk to the beach and harbor etc. The staff is very friendly and nice. The breakfast is very plentiful, so there is definitely something to eat and drink for everyone, both children and adults. The only downside is the condition of the rooms. The rooms have carpets and the carpet in our room was terrible and dirty. The walls also need a little renovation. Despite the condition of the rooms, if I go to Antalya again, I will book my room here from the hotel."

review_text: "Vi hadde et fint opphold på Antroyal, men noen ting trakk opplevelsen ned for vår del, bl.a. at det luktet mugg på badet og at vi fikk for lite toalettpapir. Sengene var harde og det var ikke lystette gardiner, men det er vel mer en smakssak. I tillegg sto TVn på hele tiden under frokosten."
translated_text: "We had a nice stay at Antroyal, but a few things dragged the experience down for us, including the smell of mold in the bathroom and the fact that we were given too little toilet paper. The beds were hard and there were no light-proof curtains, but that's probably more a matter of taste. In addition, the TV was on all the time during breakfast."

review_text: "Zeer vriendelijk personeel, ontbijt was prima. Badkamer beetje verouderd."

review_text: "Det var mycket bra, uppmärksamheten på turisten var mycket bra. den perfekta rengöringen Läget för den gamla staden och stranden är mycket bra. Frukosten mycket bra. Jag rekommenderar detta hotell. :)"

hotel_name: Akra V - Access to Akra Antalya
review_text: "Akra otelde daha önce konaklamama rağmen Akra V otelde ilk defa konakladım. Çalışanların ilgi ve alakaları müthişti. Akra profesyonelliği buraya da sirayet etmiş. Antalya’da konaklayacağım tek adres burası. Her şey için teşekkür ederim."
translated_text: "Although I have stayed at Akra hotel before, it was my first time staying at Akra V hotel. The interest and concern of the employees was amazing. Akra professionalism has spread here as well. This is the only place I will stay in Antalya. Thank you for everything."

hotel_name: Akra V - Access to Akra Antalya
review_text: "Fantastisk område, tæt på strand og mange gode café restauranter. Familie venligt. Fitness og spa er godt. Fantastisk morgenmad. Venlige, smilende og hjælpsomme medarbejder Vi opholdte os i 3 dage, og fik en høj grad af service. Det kunne mærkes, at personalet er kompetent og går op i at gæsternes ophold bliver til en god og uforglemmelige oplevelse. Jeg vil bestemt komme igen, for at nyde maden, og faciliteterne og den gode service. Tak til alle Akra V, som tog kærligt og gavmild af os, og en ekstra tak til Merve. Vi blev mødt med et stort varmt smil hvergang vi mødte hende."
translated_text: "Fantastic area, close to the beach and many good café restaurants. Family friendly. Fitness and spa are good. Great breakfast. Friendly, smiling and helpful staff. We stayed for 3 days and received a high level of service. You could feel that the staff is competent and cares about the guests' stay being a good and unforgettable experience. I will definitely come again, to enjoy the food, and the facilities and the good service. Thank you to all Akra V, who took lovingly and generously from us, and an extra thank you to Merve. We were greeted with a big warm smile every time we met her."

review_text: "Zimmer sauber und geräumig , Personal sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, Wasserkocher im Zimmer mit Kaffee und Tee, im Badezimmer Shaving Kit, Kamm, Wattepads, Zahnbürste mit Zahnpasta. Large TV. Breakfast in the Hotel Akra opposite (***** everything your heart desires; one of the best breakfast buffets I've ever had) and 25 m pool also in the hotel on the other side of the street accessible via a footbridge"

hotel_name: Akra V - Access to Akra Antalya
review_text: "Lyxigt hotell som till hösten ska renovera alla rum, vilket behövs. Utöver de fint och modernt hotell men många pooler. Vi blev glatt överraksade med en uppgraderade till de 5 stjärninga hotellet brevid. Rekommenderas varmt"
translated_text: "Luxury hotel which in the autumn will renovate all rooms, which is needed. In addition to the nice and modern hotel but many pools. We were pleasantly surprised with an upgraded to the 5-star hotel next door. Highly recommended"

hotel_name: Akra V - Access to Akra Antalya
review_text: "Fantastiskt hotell rekommenderar verkligen, framöver blir det bara detta hotell. Har aldrig varit så utvilad på en semester/ En som besöker Antalya minst två gånger per år."

translated_text: "Everything was very good, thank you very much especially to the friends working in the beach department"

hotel_name: Akra V - Access to Akra Antalya
review_text: "Leider habe ich nicht das Hotel bekommen , was ich bei ihnen laut Bilder und Reklame gebucht habe. Die Bilder waren vom gegenüber liegenden Hotel was auch zu der Gesellschaft gehört. Dieses war aber nicht beschrieben bei der Buchung das es nicht dieses Akra Hotel ist sondern das gegenüber. Auch nach einigen Gesprächen mit den Angestellten und Rezeption das wir auch bereit sind die Differenz zu zahlen ohne Anerkennung einer Schuld damit wir in diesem Hotel bleiben was auch geworben wurde , wurde uns nicht weiter geholfen. Der service dazu war sehr schlecht und nicht zu empfehlen. Hier wurden auch Buchungen von Zimmer mehrfach gemacht wo es sowieso schon Ärger an der Rezeption gab. Mir wurde gesagt das die Leitung nichts damit zu tun hat und nur Expedia dafür verantwortlich ist , und Expedia die Bilder dazu auch in ihrer Werbung eigenständig gemacht hat. Ich solle mich an sie wenden. Der Preis der Unterkunft war der gleiche welches ich bezahlt habe eigentlich mit dem Aufenthalt für die in Expedia gezeigten Bilder und Hotel. Ich buche immer über Sie habe schon viele Hotel gebucht und nächste Woche wieder eine Buchung in Afrika für mich und meine Mitarbeiter. Ich buche diese Hotels jetzt direkt da mir hier auch nicht geholfen wurde wie damals in Kusadasi. Dort musste ich auch alles selber klären. Wir haben nicht einmal eine Entschuldigung bekommen. Wobei das personal anscheinend nichts dafür kann. Ich habe auch keine Antwort von ihnen beo"
translated_text: "Unfortunately I didn't get the hotel that I booked with them according to the pictures and advertisements. The pictures were of the hotel opposite which also belongs to the company. However, this was not described when I booked - it is not this Akra Hotel but the one opposite. Even after a few conversations with the employees and reception that we are willing to pay the difference without acknowledging any debt so that we can stay in this hotel, which was also advertised, we were not helped any further. The service was very poor and not recommended. Bookings were also made here of rooms where there was already trouble at the reception. I was told that the management had nothing to do with it and that Expedia was solely responsible for it, and that Expedia had also taken the pictures in their advertising. The price of the accommodation was the same as what I actually paid for the stay for the pictures and hotel shown in Expedia. I have already booked a lot of hotels for myself and my employees directly because I didn't get any help here like I did back in Kusadasi. We didn't even get an apology, although I didn't get any response from them either.

review_text: "Självla läget där hotellen låg var mycket bra läge. Bra pool sen var det bara en trappa ner från poolen ner till en privat strand. AC lät mycket och de gick inte sova, flygplanen åkte exakt ovanför hotellet och de störde en hel del med sömnen också. Det värsta med hotellet var att man inte fick handla utifrån och hämta in i hotellet. Det kunde vara vad som helst , mat , dricka , m.m… MAX 2 dagar ska man vara på denna hotellen inte mer."
translated_text: "The location where the hotel was located was very good location. Good pool then it was just one step down from the pool down to a private beach. The AC made a lot of noise and they couldn't sleep, the airplanes flew right above the hotel and they disturbed a lot of sleep as well. The worst thing about the hotel was that you couldn't shop from outside and bring it into the hotel. It could be anything, food, drink, etc... MAX 2 days you should stay at this hotel no more."

review_text: "Très belle vu Restaurant très chèr Vieille chambre Lit n est pas confortable de tt Mais a l ensemble un charmant hôtel"
translated_text: “Very nice view Very expensive restaurant Old room Bed is not comfortable at all But overall a charming hotel”

review_text: "Fantastisk udsigt og god wifi. Støj fra fly der fløj lige over hotellet hver 3.-5. minut De kunne ikke finde min reservation og ville se bevis, så noget tyder på de ikke har haft den i systemet"
translated_text: "Fantastic view and good wifi. Noise from planes flying right over the hotel every 3-5 minutes. They couldn't find my reservation and wanted to see proof, so something suggests they didn't have it in the system"

review_text: "Otel konum olarak çok güzel.Otel ile aynı konumda yeni açılmış la vera restoran ve beach mükemmel.Çok keyifli bir yer ancak ıdalar ve otel çok eski ve bakımsız .Kahvaltı kötü..Tüm bunlara rağmen oteli sadece uyumak için kullanıp La vera da zaman geçirnek çok güzel 👍👍"
translated_text: "The hotel is very good in terms of location. The newly opened La Vera restaurant and the beach are perfect in the same location as the hotel. It is a very pleasant place, but the islands and the hotel are very old and neglected. The breakfast is bad. Despite all this, it is very nice to use the hotel only to sleep and spend time in La Vera 👍👍"

review_text: "Manzarası mükemmeldi. Yapı biraz yaşlı fakat temizlik ve hizmet ile bu eksiklik göz ardı edilebilir. Çalışanlar güler yüzlü ve çalışkan. Havuz ve denizi çok güzel."
translated_text: "The view was excellent. The building is a bit old, but with cleanliness and service, this deficiency can be ignored. The employees are friendly and hardworking. The pool and the sea are very beautiful."

review_text: "Fin pool, vacker utsikt och bra säng. Dock slitet rum som inte kändes helt rent heller. Hög musik från baren till efter klockan 12 på natten vilket gjorde att öronproppar behövdes, även pga ljud från AC:n och minibaren. Stranden var stängd pga renovering vilket inte hade förmedlats innan vistelsen och det pågick byggen på båda sidor av hotellet, det var därmed inte så rofyllt under dagarna och inte heller på kvällen iom musik från baren. Bott på hotellet under lågsäsong förut och då var det såklart lugnare och bättre i mitt tycke. Bra läge på hotellet nära parken och bra frukost som även en vegan kan bli mätt på iom grönsaker, bröd, frukt och olika sorters sylt."
translated_text: "Nice pool, beautiful view and good bed. However, worn-out room that didn't feel completely clean either. Loud music from the bar until after 12 o'clock at night, which meant that earplugs were needed, also because of the noise from the AC and the minibar. The beach was closed due to renovation, which had not been communicated before the stay and there was construction going on on both sides of the hotel, so it wasn't so peaceful during the day and not even in the evening with music from the bar. Stayed at the hotel during low season before and then it was of course calmer and better in my opinion. I hope I don't praise it so much and increase the prices, because I will visit again :)"

The room was clean, with comfortable beds and a cooking set. The pool was small but clean and cool. The interior was very nice. Everything is pleasing to the eye. The service of the staff was excellent. They welcomed us warmly, completed the transaction quickly, gave recommendations. Many thanks for their hospitality! This is a gem of Konyaalti."

review_text: "Notre sejour était parfait !! Rien à redire! Première fois de ma vie que je n'ai rien à redire sur la propreté d'un hôtel. L'équipement etait parfait, décoré avec goût. The equipment was perfect, tastefully decorated. We felt like we were at home. The swimming pool is clean and the entire property is very well maintained. The staff is incredibly kind. Perfect stay!!! Too bad there was no longer availability because we would have liked to stay there every holiday"

review_text: "Våran vistelse var underbar. Hotell personalen är jätte snälla och hjälpsamma. Det är mycket rent och fräscht. Det ligger på ett lugnt område med matbutiker nära till. Kommer definitivt komma tillbaka rekommenderar starkt!"

review_text: "Oteli merkezi konumu, şehir içinde deniz imkanı ve marka grubu olduğu için standartları dolayısıyla her geldiğimde tercih ediyorum. Kahvaltısı da gayet yeterli. translated_text: "I prefer the hotel every time I come because of its central location, sea access in the city and the standards of the brand group. The breakfast is also quite sufficient. Personally, I like to spend time in hotel lobbies, but this is not a very hotel concept building and it has a bit of a cold atmosphere. I also think they should get rid of the curtains in the bathrooms. A nice shower cabin is a must. Other than that, business and travel are fine together."

review_text: "Yataklar kötü, yastıklar facia.Bir otele yakışmayacak derecede konforsuz. Orta sınıf bir otelde bile daha konforlu elyaf dolgun yastıklar olur ne yazık ki bu konuda çok özensizsiniz. Even in a middle-class hotel, there are more comfortable fiber-filled pillows, unfortunately you are very careless in this regard. The bathroom is old rather than retro-looking. Also, the water in the minibar had been turned on before, maybe there was tap water in it. In summary, there are many situations that do not suit the name of The Marmara in Antalya the Marmara!"

review_text: "Antalya merkez için konumu çok güzel her yere yakın ister kaleiçine gidin ister güzel restorantlara. Ayrıca kendine ait sahilin olması şahane"
translated_text: "The location is very good for Antalya center, close to everything, whether you go to Kaleiçi or nice restaurants. Also, it's great to have its own beach."

review_text: "Arkadaşımın tavsiyesi üzerine otelde bulundum fakat tam anlamıyla rezil bir odayla başladık , karşılıklı pembe duvarlar ve tepesindeki boyanmamış alçı ile karşı karşıya kalarak odaya giriş yaptık, odanın camlarının ince olmasından dolayı gece uyurken her saat başı gürültüye uyandık , sabah 5 te çöp arabasının sesine de uyandık . translated_text: "I stayed at the hotel upon the recommendation of my friend, but we started with a completely disgraceful room. We entered the room facing pink walls facing each other and the unpainted plaster on top. Due to the thin windows of the room, we woke up to noise every hour while we were sleeping, and we woke up to the sound of the garbage truck at 5 in the morning. While checking out, we asked the people in front of us whether there was consumption from the mini bar, and received the answer that it was not done. We sent the guest away, even though we said we did not use the mini bar for 10 minutes." They made us wait at the reception. All the staff were friendly, but the hotel in general was very bad. I will definitely not choose it next time."

translated_text: "The seaside sun lounger is not comfortable. When the door in the next room is closed, the headboard shakes and wakes you up. The mini bar is sometimes very noisy and sometimes works normally. Room 1807"

review_text: "Ich bin sonst immer im Akra Hotel, welches optisch und vom Service sowie dem gastronomischen Angebot viel besser ist. Ich hatte Meerblick gebucht und hatte alle 2 Stunden nur Meerblick weil das Gebäude sich gedreht hat. Beim Frühstück gibt es nur Filterkaffee. Cappuccino nur auf Anfragen und dann für 3,50 € aus einem Automaten. Das Frühstück hatte auch kein tolles Angebot. Das Essen am Abend ist überteuert und das Geld nicht wert. Zu dem wird bei jeder Rechnung eine Service Gebühr raufgeschlagen zwischen 2-3 €. Das ist schon frech und der Service ist nicht mal besonders. Ich würde diese Hotel nie wieder buchen und auch nicht empfehlen."
translated_text: "Otherwise I always stay at the Akra Hotel, which is much better visually and in terms of service and the gastronomic offer. I had booked a sea view and only had a sea view every 2 hours because the building was rotating. At breakfast there is only filter coffee. Cappuccino only on request and then for €3.50 from a machine. The breakfast didn't have a great offer either. The food in the evening is overpriced and not worth the money. A service fee is added to every bill 2-3 €. That's rude and the service isn't even special. I would never book this hotel again and wouldn't recommend it."

review_text: "Gayet keyifli güzel bir otel. Deniz manzaralı odadaki manzara harikaydı. Hizmet iyi, yemek kalitesi düşük."

review_text: "Das Hotel bietet ein gutes Frühstück 🍳 an, aber leider keine natürlichen Getränke. Es steht nur gezuckerter und übersüsster Kirsch Saft da, pures Gift ☠️, bei der minibar sieht es noch schlimmer aus. Zucker Zucker Zucker!!! Grauenhaft und nicht zeitgemäss"

"I'm generally unhappy with their lack of care. I croak very often. I hope it gets better."
