review_text: "Personnel très sympa et accueillant"
translated_text: “Very friendly and welcoming staff”

review_text: "Ucuz ve sehir ici konaklama icin uygun"
translated_text: "Cheap and suitable for urban accommodation"

review_text: "Hotel was nice but there isn't very much to see and do surrounding it. It is directly under the flight path with planes coming in every few minutes which can be very loud. Hotel restaurant and pool area is nice."
translated_text: "Hotel was nice but there isn't very much to see and do surrounding it. It is directly under the flight path with planes coming in every few minutes which can be very loud. Hotel restaurant and pool area is nice."

review_text: "Çalışanlar cok iyiydi hep yardım etmeye çalışıyorlar bişey olursa. Ayrıca birkaç dili konuşuyorlar. Odalar tertemizdi, her hangi bir sıkıntı çıkmadı Tek bir yemek kötüydü: her şey yağlı, seçeneklerin az olduğunu düşünüyorum"
translated_text: "The staff was very good, they always try to help if anything happens. They also speak several languages. The rooms were clean, there were no problems. Only one meal was bad: everything was greasy, I think the options were few."

review_text: "8 haziran pazar günü otel için hotels den randevu olusturduk ve aksam saatlerinde yerleşmek için gittik.bize ek bir bina dan zemin katta bir oda gösterdiler odaya girmemizle cıkmamız bir oldu. Oda kücücük penceresi tavana yakın konumda ve çok kötü sigara kokuyordu eşim astım hastası resepsiyon da ki hamfendiye o da da kalamayacağımızı bize baska bir oda vermesini istedik ek ücret talep ederek ana bina da bize 10. Katta bir oda verdi sevinerek gittik fakst ne görelim oda berbat derece de gider kokusu kokuyor perdeler leke banyo kirli .kahvaltıya gelirsek cok zayıf .kesinlikle tavsiye etmiyorum bu oteli.sadece recepsiyonda bulunan hanfendiye çözüm ürettiği için teşekkürler"
translated_text: "We made an appointment at the hotel on Sunday, June 8th, and went there in the evening to settle in. They showed us a room on the ground floor in an additional building. Once we got into the room, we had to leave. The room had a tiny window close to the ceiling and it smelled very bad of cigarettes. My wife is an asthmatic. We asked the lady at the reception to give us another room, saying that we could not stay there. We asked for an additional fee and she gave us a room on the 10th floor in the main building. We were happy to go there. Fax what?" Let's see, the room smells terrible, the curtains are stained, the bathroom is dirty. As for the breakfast, it is very poor. I definitely do not recommend this hotel. I just thank the lady at the reception for providing a solution."

review_text: "Hôtel sympathique avec une piscine et un spa. La chambre est spacieuse. Mais quelques défauts le petit-déjeuner n'était pas à notre goût, peu de choix et certaines choses sont payantes, le petit-déjeuner à partir de 8h c'est un peu tard je trouve. La chose qui m'a le plus choquée c'est le ménage dans les chambres, il est à peine fait on nous change les serviettes et nous donne des bouteilles d'eau. Le toilette et le lavabo sont nettoyés et voilà leur ménage. L'aspirateur et la serpillière sont très rarement passés. À la fin de notre séjour notre chambre était pleines de poussières. Nous avions aussi une odeur horrible dans la salle de bain, nous l'avons signalé mais notre problème n'a pas été résolu."
translated_text: "Nice hotel with a swimming pool and a spa. The room is spacious. But a few faults the breakfast was not to our taste, little choice and some things have to be paid for, breakfast from 8 a.m. is a little late in my opinion. The thing that shocked me the most was the cleaning in the rooms, it was barely done, the towels were changed and we were given bottles of water. The toilet and the sink were cleaned and that was their cleaning. The vacuum cleaner and "The floor was mopped very rarely. At the end of our stay our room was full of dust. We also had a horrible smell in the bathroom, we reported it but our problem was not resolved."

review_text: "Alt katta bir oda verildi ve ağır rutubet kokuyordu hiç memnun kalmadım"
translated_text: "I was given a room downstairs and it smelled strongly of humidity. I was not happy at all."

review_text: "Det var meget ubehageligt at opholde sig på hotellet er placeret lige ved lufthavnens landingsbane så flymaskiner flyver præcis lige over hotellet og larmer så sindsygt meget at man ikke kan sove om natten. Derudover var morgenmaden slet ikke som en 5 stjernet hotel og var ikke appetitligt."
translated_text: "It was very unpleasant to stay at the hotel, which is located right next to the airport's runway, so airplanes fly directly over the hotel and make so much noise that you can't sleep at night. In addition, the breakfast was not at all like a 5-star hotel and was not appetizing."

review_text: "Hotel ist sehr sauber modern eingerichtet und hat einen tollen Spa Bereich. Infrastruktur ist super Bushaltestelle in der Nähe und Flughafen, man muss wissen das die Flieger direkt über dem Hotel im Landeanflug sind, ist schön anzusehen aber sehe laut uns hat es nicht gestört. Der Pool ist sauber und schön. Kritikpunkte sind dass die Liegen am Pool nahezu alle beschädigt sind und man diese nicht verstellen kann, leider ziehen sich diese Art von Defekten (alte Handtücher im Bad, Toilettendeckel sind billig, Batterien in der Fernbedienung sind leer) durch, sodass ich nicht eine 5 Sterne Bewertung geben kann. Aber wenn man nicht so pingelig ist, ein absolut tolles Hotel."
translated_text: "The hotel is very clean, modernly furnished and has a great spa area. Infrastructure is great, bus stop nearby and airport, you have to know that the planes are approaching directly over the hotel, it's nice to look at but according to us it didn't bother us. The pool is clean and nice. Criticisms are that the loungers at the pool are almost all damaged and you can't adjust them, unfortunately these types of defects (old towels in the bathroom, toilet lids are cheap, batteries in the remote control are empty) are common, so I "I can't give it a 5 star rating. But if you're not that fussy, it's an absolutely great hotel."

review_text: "Está muy muy bien la habitación"
translated_text: "The room is very very good"

review_text: "Kahvaltıda biten yiyecekleri söylemeden getirmiyorlar ve genelde birçoğu bitmiş oluyor, otel havalimanı yakınında olduğu için özellikle akşamları uçakların sesi çok fazla rahatsız edici oluyor. Sabah resepsiyonda kalan arkadaşlar çok ilgisiz, otelin anlaşmalí olduğu plaja gitmek istedik ve bizi bir saatten fazla beklettiler, bu durumdan rahatsızlık duyduğumuzu söylediğimizde ise "biz ne yapabiliriz isterseniz gitmeyin" tarzında bir yaklaşım sergilediler. Odalar oldukça genişti ama koltuklar aşırı kirli. Üzerine çarşaf serip oturabildik ancak."
translated_text: "They don't bring the food that is finished for breakfast without telling them, and usually most of it is finished. Since the hotel is near the airport, the noise of the planes is very disturbing, especially in the evening. The friends staying at the reception in the morning are very indifferent. We wanted to go to the beach that the hotel has a contract with, and they made us wait for more than an hour. When we said that we were uncomfortable with this situation, they showed an approach of "do not go, whatever we can do". The rooms were quite spacious, but the seats were extremely dirty. We could only spread sheets on them and sit down."

review_text: "Kahvaltı biraz zayıf onun dışında her şey mükemmel"
translated_text: "Breakfast is a little weak, other than that, everything is perfect"

review_text: "On nous a donné une autre chambre que prévu. Elle était située dans un bâtiment annexe, sans balcon et vue sur des vieilles choses. A proximité de notre piete des sacs plastic trainaient toute la journée. 24 h sur 24 h vous avez des avions qui passent juste au-dessus de votre tête, donc pour dormir c'est pénible."
translated_text: "We were given another room than expected. It was located in an annex building, without a balcony and a view of old things. Near our piete plastic bags were lying around all day. 24 hours a day you have planes passing right over your head, so it's difficult to sleep."

review_text: "Otel gayet güzel ve nezihti. Temizlik açısından gayet iyiydi. Odamız standart oda olduğu için biraz küçüktü. Herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Hava alanı yakın olduğu için uçak sesleri vardı ama rahatsız olmadık."
translated_text: "The hotel was very nice and decent. It was very good in terms of cleanliness. Our room was a little small because it was a standard room. We did not have any problems. Since the airport was close, there were airplane noises, but we were not disturbed."

review_text: "Værste frokost hotellet jeg har vært på. Lite variasjoner og jeg måtte mase på at de skal fylle på ting som var tomt. Bestiller du basicrom blir du sendt til en annen bygning. Hadde en gang problem med lys på kvelden og de mente det var får seint å komme opp å hjelpe meg, Så jeg måtte gå ned selv til resepsjonen for å hente dem."
translated_text: "Worst hotel breakfast I've been to. Little variety and I had to nag them to refill things that were empty. If you book a basic room, you'll be sent to another building. I once had a problem with the lights in the evening and they thought it was too late to come up to help me, so I had to go down to reception myself to get them."

review_text: "We zouden eigenlijk ergens anders verblijven , toen we daar aankwamen was het zeer vies en toen hebben wij dit hotel gevonden! Het is een geweldige hotel met de beste service, ze helpen je graag met alles wat je vraagt en geven je tips! Tot volgend jaar dan komen we zeker weer!"
translated_text: "We were actually going to stay somewhere else, when we got there it was very dirty and then we found this hotel! It is a great hotel with the best service, they are happy to help you with everything you ask and give you tips! See you next year, we will definitely come again!"

review_text: "Kahvaltı çeşitliliği ve lezzeti iyileşitirilmeli"
translated_text: "Breakfast variety and taste should be improved"

review_text: "Otel temizliği iyiydi odanın genişliği iyiydi fakat hizmet diye bir şey yok otel bölgesin üstünde sürekli uçak indiği için uyuyamıyorsunuz odaya buyrun 7. Kat çıkın… Valiz için yardım yok kız arkadaşım taşıdı valizi. Kahvaltı vasat berbat sadece simit yiyebildim. Şahsen önermiyorum"
translated_text: "The cleanliness of the hotel was good, the size of the room was good, but there is no such thing as service. You cannot sleep because planes are constantly landing above the hotel area. Go to the room, go to the 7th floor... There is no help with the luggage, my girlfriend carried the suitcase. The breakfast was mediocre and terrible. I could only eat a bagel. I personally do not recommend it."

review_text: "전반적으로 만족하는 호텔입니다. 시설, 주변 관광지 접근성, 조식은 만족하는 포인트입니다."
translated_text: "Overall, this is a satisfactory hotel. Facilities, accessibility to nearby tourist attractions, and breakfast are the points of satisfaction."

review_text: "직원들 친절해요 사우나 시설이 좋아요"
translated_text: “The staff is friendly and the sauna facilities are good.”

review_text: "Alles gut"
translated_text: "It's all ok"

review_text: "Temiz ve güzel bir oteldi. Fiyat performans olarak oldukça başarılı. Kahvaltısını beğendim."
translated_text: "It was a clean and nice hotel. It was very successful in terms of price and performance. I liked the breakfast."

review_text: "Alt var perfect. Litt dårlig solforhol i basseng området. Fikk et rom med veldig mye støy fra utenfor bygget, maskin støy selv om rommene skal være lydisolerte. Ellers prisgunstig og bra hotell. Anbefales."
translated_text: "Everything was perfect. Slightly bad sun conditions in the pool area. Got a room with a lot of noise from outside the building, machine noise even though the rooms are supposed to be soundproofed. Otherwise good value and good hotel. Recommended."

review_text: "Selve hotellet og værelserne var fine MEN Ringe/ingen services fra personalet, ingen rengøring trods vi bede om det samt total ringe morgenmad. Vi måtte flytte til andet hotel efter 4 dages ophold vil aldrig aldrig anbefalede dette hotel til nogle."
translated_text: "The hotel itself and the rooms were fine BUT Poor/no services from the staff, no cleaning despite us asking for it and a total poor breakfast. We had to move to another hotel after a 4 day stay and will never ever recommend this hotel to anyone."

review_text: "Biz çok beğendik merkezi konumda temiz ve kahvaltısı 10 numara"
translated_text: "We liked it very much, it is centrally located, clean and the breakfast is top 10."

review_text: "Gece saatlerinde otele varmamıza rağmen bizi o saatte bile çok iyi karşıladılar. Yine gece saatlerinde fazladan bir yastık istediğimizde 5 dk da getirdiler. Temizlik çok üst düzeydeydi. En ufak ayrıntıya kadar düşünmüşlerdi. Diş fırçası ve macun bile vardı :) çoğu bu tarz otellerde bunu bulmak imkansız. Kahvaltısı da 5 yıldızlı otelden çok farklı değildi. Bunu okuyanlar otel çalışanı olduğumuzu düşünebilir ama kesinlikle tek gün kalmış bir aileyiz."
translated_text: "Even though we arrived at the hotel at night, they welcomed us very well even at that hour. Again, when we asked for an extra pillow at night, they brought it to us within 5 minutes. The cleanliness was at a very high level. They had thought of every little detail. There was even a toothbrush and paste :), which is impossible to find in most hotels of this type. The breakfast was not much different from a 5-star hotel. Those who read this may think that we are hotel employees, but we are definitely a family who stayed for a single day."

review_text: "Un excellent magnifique hôtel, que ça soit le service l’accueille a été chaleureux et souriant. Nos demandes a été bien traitée à la seconde. Une suite climatisée très confortable, les meubles propre et confortable. Super propre rien a dire à cet hôtel la piscine propre à la bonne température, la terrasse reposante. TRÈS SINCÈREMENT CET HÔTEL MÉRITERAI UN 5 ÉTOILE, Ils nous proposer une croisière en bateau qu on a pris, la prise en charge et la promenade baignade luxueux Je reviendrai les yeux fermée. Merci merci et encore merci"
translated_text: "An excellent, magnificent hotel, whether the service, the welcome was warm and smiling. Our requests were well handled at the second. A very comfortable air-conditioned suite, the furniture clean and comfortable. Super clean, nothing to say about this hotel, the clean swimming pool at the right temperature, the relaxing terrace. VERY SINCERELY THIS HOTEL WOULD DESERVE A 5 STAR, They offered us a boat cruise that we took, the pick-up and the luxurious swimming walk I will return my eyes closed Thank you thank you and thank you again.

review_text: "Magnifique hôtel, très propre, le personnel est très agréable. Je recommande à 100 %."
translated_text: “Beautiful hotel, very clean, the staff is very pleasant. I recommend 100%.”

review_text: "Her şey çok güzel idi, yepyeni bir otel, çalışanlar çok yardımcı oldu Tavsiye ederim"
translated_text: "Everything was very nice, it is a brand new hotel, the staff was very helpful. I recommend it"

review_text: "Het was een prima ervaring, de kamers werden netjes opgeruimd en schoongemaakt elke dag alleen had de jacuzzi wel ook schoongemaakt mogen worden. Het is een ‘12+ hotel’ maar er waren wel kinderen onder de 12 in het hotel & zwembad. Het personeel was vriendelijk en gastvrij en de schoonmaaksters waren erg lief."
translated_text: "It was a great experience, the rooms were neatly tidied and cleaned every day, but the jacuzzi could have been cleaned as well. It is a '12+ hotel' but there were children under 12 in the hotel & swimming pool. The staff was friendly and hospitable and the cleaning ladies were very sweet."

review_text: "Hayatımda gittiğim en muhteşem otellerden birisi. Kusursuz hizmet kalitesi. Muhteşem konforlu oda. Jakuzi felan filan yani lüx bir deneyim. Çok yukarı bir şey kelimelerle anlatamam size."
translated_text: "One of the most magnificent hotels I have ever been to in my life. Perfect service quality. Magnificently comfortable room. Jacuzzi and all, so it's a luxurious experience. I can't describe it in words."

review_text: "Odalar süslemeler çok güzeldi, temizdi, özellikle jakuziye bayıldık zaten. Bahçeli ve teraslı odada birer gün kaldık, ikisinin de yeri ayrıydı, kahvaltımızı terasta yaptık. Kahvaltısı gayet güzeldi fazlasıyla yeterliydi. İlhan beye ayrıca çok teşekkür ederiz, çok ilgili ve güler yüzlüydü."
translated_text: "The rooms were very well decorated and clean, we especially loved the jacuzzi. We stayed in the garden room and the terrace room for one day, both of them had separate rooms, we had our breakfast on the terrace. The breakfast was very good and more than enough. We would also like to thank Mr. İlhan, he was very attentive and friendly."

review_text: "1 gecelik kaldım kral dairesini tutmamıza rağmen sıcak su arızalıydı gece oda değişikliği yapmak zorunda kaldık odalar temiz ve güzeldi ama sıcak suyun olmayışı kötü bir durum çalışanlar ilgiliydi ama daireye girmeden önce kontrol edilmesi gereken bir durumdu"
translated_text: "I stayed for 1 night, even though we booked the king suite, the hot water was faulty. We had to change rooms at night. The rooms were clean and nice, but the lack of hot water was a bad situation. The staff were attentive, but it was a situation that should be checked before entering the flat."

review_text: "Güleryüzlü ve ilgili personele sahip,sakin ve butik otel konseptinde bir konaklama gecirdik. Ucak sesleri dısında hersey güzeldi. Plajından ve ucretsiz spa dan faydalanmak harikaydı. Odalardaki buzdolabı cok kucuk ve yeterince sogutmuyordu. Genel olarak memnun ayrildik."
translated_text: "We had a quiet stay in a boutique hotel concept with friendly and attentive staff. Everything was nice except for the plane noises. It was great to benefit from the beach and free spa. The refrigerator in the rooms was too small and did not cool enough. In general, we were satisfied."

review_text: "Yorumlara aldanarak gittik arkadaşlar. Direkt özetle sizlere yardımcı olmak istiyorum. Temizlik kötü, sigara izmaritleri vardı. Yerler pis. Temizliği yapan abla havlumuzu alıp yerine yenisini koymuyor, yorganı alıp götürüyor. Tuvalet pecetesini bile yenilemiyor öyle düşünün. Diş macunu, fırçası yok. Parasına değmeyecek bir mekan. İlk başta karşılayanlar güler yüzlüydü onun dışında artı bir şeyi yok. Konaklamayı planlayan sizlere yardımcı olsun diye yorum yaptım."
translated_text: "Friends, we went there deceived by the comments. I want to help you in a direct summary. The cleaning is bad, there were cigarette butts. The floors are dirty. The sister who does the cleaning takes our towels and does not replace them with a new one, takes away the duvet. Think about it, she does not even replace the toilet napkins. There is no toothpaste or brush. It is not worth the money. The people who welcomed us at first were friendly, but apart from that, there is nothing positive. I commented to help you who are planning to stay."

review_text: "Vi tjekke ind kort før midnat. Det var intet problem. Vi blev tjekket ind og vist op på værelset og fik alt forklaret på engelsk. Værelset var rent og levede op til billederne. Der var en ekstra seng og det var helt okay."
translated_text: "We checked in shortly before midnight. It was no problem. We were checked in and shown to the room and had everything explained in English. The room was clean and lived up to the pictures. There was an extra bed and it was perfectly fine."

review_text: "Antalya merkez de kalıba bilecek en güzel otel ailemle kaldık çok memnun ayrıldık otel ok çok temiz ve güzel personel çok güler yüzlü kahvaltı harika resepsiyonda ki Arkadaşlar çok yardımcı oldular çok teşekkür ederiz"
translated_text: "The best hotel to stay in Antalya center, we stayed with my family, we left very satisfied. The hotel is ok, very clean and nice staff, very friendly breakfast, wonderful. The friends at the reception were very helpful, thank you very much"

review_text: "Kaldığımız 4 Gün boyunca personel ve otel sahibi tarafından çok güzel ağırlandık. Teşekkürler"
translated_text: "We were welcomed very well by the staff and the hotel owner during our 4-day stay. Thank you"

review_text: "Tutto nell insieme brava la Donna delle Colazioni"
translated_text: "All in all, the Breakfast Woman is good"

review_text: "J'ai aimé l'emplacement"
translated_text: “I liked the location”

review_text: "Otel kaleiçinde merkezi bir lokasyonda. Otopark müthiş bir sorun kesinlikle. Omun haricinde odaya ilk girdiğimizde yatakta saç ve kıllar vardı. Temizlik maalesef vasat. Cenaze nedeniyle konaklamamızı 1 gece erken bitirmek zorunda kaldık. Otel kalmayacağımız günün ücreti ödemeyeceğini belirtti. Sonuç olarak farklı yerleri değerlendirin, burayı değil."
translated_text: "The hotel is in a central location in Kaleiçi. Parking is definitely a problem. Apart from that, when we first entered the room, there were hairs and hairs on the bed. Unfortunately, the cleaning is mediocre. We had to end our stay 1 night early due to the funeral. The hotel stated that it would not pay for the day we would not stay. As a result, consider different places, not this one."

review_text: "Alles super! Super sauber! Freundliches Personal und netter Empfang."
translated_text: "Everything was great! Super clean! Friendly staff and nice reception."

review_text: "Hôtel sympathique et très bien positionné proche de la vieille ville ! Super séjour merci au personnel très professionnel !"
translated_text: “Friendly and very well positioned hotel close to the old town! Great stay thanks to the very professional staff!”

review_text: "Det var en hotell med fantastiskt läge. Promenadavstånd till centrum, restauranger, berömda Old Town (Kaleiçi), klocktornet, vackra Mermerli som ger en unik känsla att bada i havet med historisk borg runtomkring, Trots detta är det ändå i ett hörn att man hör inte folkvimlet och festandet. Fin frukostbuffé och fantastiskt trevlig personal som hjälper till så fort det behövs. Man känner sig trygg då många som jobbar är familjemedlemmar och receptionen som bemannas tror dygnet runt eller till största delen av dygnet. Rekommenderar detta hotellet och kommer själv tillbaka om jag ska resa till Antalya igen."
translated_text: "It was a hotel with a fantastic location. Walking distance to the center, restaurants, famous Old Town (Kaleiçi), the clock tower, beautiful Mermerli which gives a unique feeling to bathe in the sea with a historic castle all around. Despite this, it is still in a corner that you don't hear the crowd and the partying. Nice breakfast buffet and fantastically friendly staff who help as soon as needed. You feel safe as many of the staff are family members and the reception is staffed around the clock or most of the day. Recommend this hotel and will come back myself if I will travel to Antalya again."

review_text: "Jeg var virkelig glad for rengøring, og medarbejderne var virkelig søde især Zuhal Aysegül og housekeeperen Emine og alle andre der arbejdede derhenne. Den lå midt i centrum alt var ved siden af hotellet taxa tøj musik resturanter. Rengøring var hverdag og meget hjælpsomme og især Hassan. Deres morgenmad er meget god. Selvom der ikke var pool, var stranden 5 min væk gående. Jeg anbefaler virkelig Golden Lux!!"
translated_text: "I was really happy with the cleaning, and the employees were really nice, especially Zuhal Aysegül and the housekeeper Emine and everyone else who worked there. It was in the middle of the center, everything was next to the hotel, taxi, clothes, music, restaurants. Cleaning was everyday and very helpful, and especially Hassan. Their breakfast is very good. Although there was no pool, the beach was 5 minutes away on foot. I really recommend Golden Lux!!"

review_text: "Nette kamers, schoon maar her en der wat mankementen. Vriendelijk personeel, centrale ligging"
translated_text: "Nice rooms, clean but some defects here and there. Friendly staff, central location"

review_text: "Trevligt personal.. är behjälpliga. Hotel är i bra skick ...städning varje dag. Hotellet ligger mitt i gammla staden. Nära flygplatser ca 20 minuter. Det som var mindre bra är att personalen inte kunde bra engelska ..det kan de jobba mer på. De kan bara turkiska. Bra turkiskt frukost."
translated_text: "Nice staff.. are helpful. Hotel is in good condition ... cleaning every day. The hotel is in the middle of the old town. Close to airports about 20 minutes. What was less good is that the staff did not know English well .. they can work more on that. They only know Turkish. Good Turkish breakfast."

review_text: "Kesinlikle tavsiye etmiyorum"
translated_text: "I definitely do not recommend it"

review_text: "Das Hotel ist etwas älter, jedoch hält man es sehr sauber und man merkt, dass das hotel etwas besonderes ist. Zimmer schön mit coolen direkten Meerblick. Coole Poolanlage, fitness sehr gut. Wellness hervorragend, habe 2 Massagen gehabt weil die Masseurin ganze arbeit geleistet hat."
translated_text: "The hotel is a bit older, but they keep it very clean and you can tell that the hotel is something special. Nice rooms with cool direct sea views. Cool pool area, fitness very good. Wellness excellent, I had 2 massages because the masseuse did a great job."

review_text: "Ligging is heerlijk. Het aquapark en zee is op paar minuten loopafstand. Het ligt dicht bij restaurants en een heerlijk looppark. Er is in en rondom het hotel niet veel lawaai, juist heerlijk rustig. Hygiëne staat hoog in het vaandel. Heb echt een heerlijke vakantie gehad."
translated_text: "The location is wonderful. The aqua park and the sea are a few minutes' walk away. It is close to restaurants and a wonderful running park. There is not much noise in and around the hotel, it is wonderfully quiet. Hygiene is of paramount importance. I really had a wonderful holiday."

review_text: "Нам очень понравился отель, белый номер выглядит чисто и ново. Большой балкон с кроватью."
translated_text: "We really liked the hotel, the white room looks clean and new. Large balcony with a bed."

review_text: "Impeccable"
translated_text: "Impeccable"

review_text: "Herşeyi ile harika bir oteldi. Dolu dolu 4 gün 3 gece geçirdik. Çocuğum için Aquapark seçeneğinin oluşuda ayrı bir mutluluk verdi tabi. Tekrardan tercih edebileceğim bir otel. Tavsiye ederim. Yalnızca tek eksik tarafı akşam yemeğinden içecekler ücretliydi. Bunun dışında eksik birşeyi yoktu. Birde saat 16-17 sularında çay ve atıştırmalık ikramları olmuş olsaydı süper olurdu."
translated_text: "It was a great hotel with everything. We spent 4 days and 3 nights to the fullest. Of course, having the Aquapark option for my child gave me a special happiness. It is a hotel that I can choose again. I recommend it. The only downside was that drinks from dinner were paid. Other than that, there was nothing missing. It would have been great if they had offered tea and snacks at around 16-17 o'clock."

review_text: "Certains Personnels de la piscine désagréable , crème solaire vendu sur place en magasin au -2 est de très mauvaise qualité malgré 2400tl pour 3 différents crèmes"
translated_text: "Some unpleasant pool staff, sun cream sold on site in store at -2 is of very poor quality despite 2400tl for 3 different creams"

review_text: "Godt!"

review_text: "Uçak saatimiz sebebiyle hotele sabah erken saatte geldik. Odalarımıza erken check-in yapabilmemiz bizi çok memnun etti. Personel güleryüzlü. Hotel içi yemek ve içecek fiyatları normal, lezzetleri iyi. Tekrar yolumuz düşerse konaklamak isteriz."
translated_text: "We arrived at the hotel early in the morning due to our flight time. We were very pleased to be able to check in to our rooms early. The staff is friendly. In-house food and drink prices are normal and the taste is good. If we come back again, we would like to stay."

review_text: "Bastante confortável, ótimas refeições, quartos amplos, academia acima da média. Localização privilegiada próximo a restaurantes e praia."
translated_text: "Very comfortable, great meals, large rooms, above average gym. Privileged location close to restaurants and beach."

review_text: "Bel endroit qui donne directement sur la plage à Konyaaltı à l’ouest du centre ville d’Antalya direction Kemer"
translated_text: "Beautiful place which overlooks the beach in Konyaaltı to the west of Antalya city center towards Kemer"

review_text: "Güzel ve temiz bir otel, lokasyonu mükemmel. Yemekler kaliteli ve leziz. Aquapark ve plaj imkanı güzel. Tekrar tercih ederim."
translated_text: "A nice and clean hotel, the location is perfect. The food is high quality and delicious. The aquapark and beach facilities are nice. I would choose it again."

review_text: "Konyaaltina yakınlığı aile dostu oluşu kids club ve oyun havuzu olması ayrıca sabah ve akşam menüleri gerçekten çok güzeldi."
translated_text: "Its proximity to Konyaaltina, being family friendly, having a kids club and a game pool, and the morning and evening menus were really nice."

review_text: "Mükemmel tek kelimeyle"
translated_text: "In one word, perfect"

review_text: "Her yıl ailece gidiyoruz. Otelin mimarisi, restoranı, havuzu yemekleri, özetle herşeyi harika /yarım pansiyon konsepte göre akşam yemeği ve kahvaltı mükemmel. Bunu çok az otel sağlar eminolun. Çok yüksek memnuniyetle tavsiye ederiz. Kids club daki sarışın hanımefendi de çok ilgili ve başarılı bir çalışan. Fiyatlar biraz daha iyi olursa daha uzun konaklama yapabilsek, tek kusuru bu diyebilirim. ☺️ özellikle bizim gibi müdavim misafirlere ☺️"
translated_text: "We go every year as a family. The hotel's architecture, restaurant, pool, food, in short, everything is great / dinner and breakfast are excellent according to the half-board concept. Rest assured, very few hotels provide this. We recommend it with great satisfaction. The blonde lady at the kids club is also a very attentive and successful employee. If the prices were a little better, we could stay longer, I can say that this is the only flaw. ☺️ especially for regular guests like us ☺️"

review_text: "Wunderbares Essen, alles bestens, einfach till!"
translated_text: "Wonderful food, everything is great, just great!"

review_text: "Mükemmel bir Otel"
translated_text: "An excellent hotel"

review_text: "Herşey mükemmeldi"
translated_text: "Everything was perfect"

review_text: "Konaklama güzeldi temiz ve konforlu kat çalışanları gayet güleryüzlülerdi fakat o kadar para veriyorsun havuz başında çay kahve bile ücrete tabi anlamış değilim kaç para tutacak bir şey de bu kadar büyük bir otelde bence herşeyi ekstra para olarak görmek hoş değil."
translated_text: "The accommodation was nice, it was clean and comfortable, the floor staff were very friendly, but you pay so much money, even tea and coffee by the pool is subject to a fee, I don't understand how much something will cost, and in such a big hotel, I think it is not nice to see everything as extra money."

review_text: "Das interessante am Hotel ist zunächst das Konzept - es ist alles in Weiß gehalten mit oranger und roter Beleuchtung. Wenn die Tür vom Taxi aufgeht wirkt es aufgrund der komplett weiß gekleideten Belegschaft fast wie ein Sanatorium. Ist mal was anderes und das Konzept wird im ganzen Hotel durchgezogen. Die Zimmer ist entsprechend stylisch und doch gemütlich. Highlight war die große Matratze auf dem Balkon, wo man sehr gemütlich liegen konnte. Bequemes Bett, schneller 24/7-Zimmerservice zu vernünftigen Preisen. Viele Maßnahmen zur Reduzierung des Wasserverbrauchs (freiwillig). Großer (langer) Pool mit schöner Bar, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten im Hotel. Aquarium, Strand und Aqualand je 5 min zu Fuß entfernt. Das Frühstück war fantastisch! Werde gerne wiederkommen!"
translated_text: "First of all, the interesting thing about the hotel is the concept - it's all in white with orange and red lighting. When the door of the taxi opens, it almost looks like a sanatorium because of the staff all dressed in white. It's something different and the concept is carried through throughout the entire hotel. The rooms are correspondingly stylish and yet cozy. The highlight was the large mattress on the balcony, where you could lie very comfortably. Comfortable bed, fast 24/7 room service at reasonable prices. Many measures to reduce water consumption (optional). Large (long) pool with a nice bar, shopping in the hotel. Aquarium, beach and Aqualand are each a 5-minute walk away. I would love to come back!

review_text: "temizlik idare eder, daha da iyi olabilirdi."
translated_text: "Cleaning is ok, could be better."

review_text: "Artık yaşlanmış bir otel ama hala zevkle kalınabilir"
translated_text: "It is an old hotel, but you can still stay there with pleasure"

review_text: "Ailecek kaldık, çok memnun kaldık. Evet biraz eskimiş ama kaliteli bir ortam var. Kahvaltı da keyifliydi. Güzel bir deneyim oldu, teşekkür ederiz"
translated_text: "We stayed as a family, we were very pleased. Yes, it is a bit old, but it has a quality atmosphere. The breakfast was also enjoyable. It was a nice experience, thank you."

review_text: "- Ne mérite pas 5étoiles, - Beaucoup d’usures et de défauts dans la chambre, - Hotel qui a besoin d’un renouvellement, - Au prix de la nuit, boisson en extra au dîner un peu abusé. - Accès Gratuit à Aqualand Super, - Personnel Au Petit Soin, - Ptit Dèj’ / Dîner Très Grand choix Bon et Variés, - Parcontre les Desserts Vraiment pas Top, - Rapport Qualité/Prix trop Élevé."
translated_text: "- Does not deserve 5 stars, - Lots of wear and tear and defects in the room, - Hotel in need of renewal, - At the price of the night, extra drink at dinner a little excessive. - Free access to Aqualand Super, - Very attentive staff, - Breakfast / Dinner Very large choice, Good and varied, - Check out the desserts Really not great, - Value for money too high."

review_text: "Das perfekte Hotel mit allem was dazugehört.Tolker Service,tolles Zimmer,tolles Restaurant und natürlich der Strand 👍👍👍"
translated_text: "The perfect hotel with everything that goes with it. Great service, great room, great restaurant and of course the beach 👍👍👍"

review_text: "Fantastisk hotel! God mad, fremragende service og søde personale. Her vil vi gerne komme igen."
translated_text: "Fantastic hotel! Good food, excellent service and nice staff. We would like to come here again."

review_text: "Waren jetzt dann schon zum 3. mal hier. Wieder sehr zufrieden! Was uns aber sehr stark gestört hat, dass wir um 04.00 auschecken mussten, da unser Flug sehr früh war. 4 Koffer und ein Kinderwagen musste ich alleine von der Reception bis zum Taxi selber tragen. 2 Mitarbeiter haben nur zugeschaut! Die waren anscheinend im Schlafmodus und haben es genossen, dass ihr Vorgesetzter schlafen war. Ausser diesem Vorfall waren wir rundum zufrieden."
translated_text: "We were here for the third time now. Again very satisfied! What really bothered us was that we had to check out at 4 a.m. because our flight was very early. I had to carry 4 suitcases and a stroller from reception to the taxi myself. 2 employees just watched! They were apparently in sleep mode and enjoyed the fact that their supervisor was asleep. Other than this incident, we were completely satisfied."

review_text: "Absolument parfait !!!"
translated_text: “Absolutely perfect!!!”

review_text: "Der Pool hat mir gefallen sowie der liegen Abteil an der Kalypso Beach Bar am Meer. Das Hotel ist zentral und an einem guten Ort. Veranstaltungen auf der Wiese sind schön jedoch in der Halle nicht, dort dröhnt der Bass hoch bis in den Körper im Schlaf. Die Connection Zwischentür ist sehr schlecht gemacht, Geruch und Geräusche sehr stark vom Zimmernachbar. Ich würde das Hotel wieder besuchen und empfehlen"
translated_text: "I liked the pool and the lounge area at the Kalypso Beach Bar by the sea. The hotel is central and in a good location. Events on the lawn are nice, but not in the hall, where the bass booms right up to your body while you sleep. The connection between the door is very poorly made, the smell and noises are very strong from the room next door. I would visit the hotel again and recommend it."

review_text: "Otel biraz eskimiş ancak herşey olması gerektiği gibi, beklentileri karşılıyor."
translated_text: "The hotel is a little old, but everything is as it should be and meets expectations."

review_text: "Meget fint hotel som ligger tæt på strande. Helt hvidt indvendigt og på værelset, med 6 store discokugler i midten at hotellet, som dog først kommer til sin ret, når lyset bliver tændt. Dejlig morgenmad."
translated_text: "Very nice hotel located close to beaches. Completely white inside and in the room, with 6 large disco balls in the middle of the hotel, which only come into their own when the lights are switched on. Lovely breakfast."

review_text: "Konum olarak çok iyi yerde. Kahvaltı çeşitli ve taze oldukça güzeldi.Odalarin temizliği güzel şekilde yapılmıştı.Otelin olumsuz gördüğüm tek yönü odamız aşırı derecede küçüktü hareket alanı yok ve eşyalar için dolap çok az.Onun dışında otel oldukça güzel ve sorunsuzdu.Konyaaltinda kalmak isteyenler hiç düşünmeden tercih edebilirler."
translated_text: "It is in a very good location. The breakfast was varied and fresh. The rooms were cleaned well. The only negative aspect of the hotel that I see is that our room was extremely small, there is no space for movement and there are very few closets for your belongings. Other than that, the hotel was very nice and trouble-free. Those who want to stay in Konyaalti can choose it without hesitation."

review_text: "Biz ucuz olduğu kahvalisi ve havuz u olduğu için yer ayirttik. Havuz hariç öteki olanaklardan yararlandik"
translated_text: "We booked a room because it was cheap and had a pool. We took advantage of other facilities except the pool."

review_text: "Çok güzel bir otel. Ortamı, temizliği, hizmetleri mükemmel. Güleryüzlü,sicak samimi bir personel ve yöneticileri var.Bir dahaki tatilimizde tercihimizde ilk otel olacak .Hizmetleriniz ve samimiyetiniz için cok teşekkürler"
translated_text: "It is a very nice hotel. Its environment, cleanliness and services are excellent. It has friendly, warm and sincere staff and managers. It will be the first hotel we choose for our next holiday. Thank you very much for your services and sincerity."

review_text: "Situado a un ligero paseo a la playa y a los autobuses que llevan a la ciudad. 4 restaurantes a un par de metros de la puerta. No se nos ha presentado ningún problema molesto. Empleados excepcionales. Buen desayuno bufé, mas bien estilo turco, también con mermeladas y cereales para niños. Café, té y agua, que además puedes tomar fuera de la hora del desayuno. Habitación como se describe en las fotos, limpia, con balcón, el nuestro casi mas grande que la propia habitación! botellas diarias de agua, gel y champú. Limpieza diaria. Buen estado. Lo único que hemos echado de menos es una cortina en la ducha para que no se mojase todo el suelo del baño al ducharse, y alguna percha mas. Empezamos reservando 5 días en este hotel con intención de movernos después a otra zona y finalmente nos hemos quedado 6 días mas wn el mismo. Calidad-precio, muy bueno."
translated_text: "Located a short walk to the beach and the buses that take you to the city. 4 restaurants a couple of meters from the door. We have not had any annoying problems. Exceptional employees. Good buffet breakfast, rather Turkish style, also with jams and cereals for children. Coffee, tea and water, which you can also drink outside of breakfast time. Room as described in the photos, clean, with a balcony, ours almost bigger than the room itself! Daily bottles of water, gel and Shampoo. Daily cleaning. Good condition. The only thing we missed was a curtain in the shower so that the entire bathroom floor wouldn't get wet when showering, and some more clothes hanger. We started booking 5 days in this hotel with the intention of moving to another area and finally we stayed 6 more days with the same price.

review_text: "Tertemiz kusursuz bş otel"
translated_text: "Immaculate, perfect hotel"

review_text: "Gayet iyiydi herşey."
translated_text: "Everything was fine."

review_text: "Güler yüzlü personel, Odalar yeterince rahat, lokasyonu güzel. Sahile 10 dk. Kahvaltı yeterli bana kalırsa, fakat saati uzatmaları lazım ya da sabah erken kalkıp 08:30' kadar kahvaltı yapanların tercih etmesi gerekir. Temizlik kısmını biraz daha detaylı yapmalarını öneririm. Balkon gibi önemsiz noktalar olsa da orada görülenler banyo veya yatak gibi asıl noktaları sorgulamaya neden olur"
translated_text: "Friendly staff, rooms are comfortable enough, location is good. 10 minutes to the beach. Breakfast is sufficient in my opinion, but they should extend the hours or those who wake up early in the morning and have breakfast until 08:30 should prefer it. I suggest they do the cleaning part in a little more detail. Even though there are unimportant points such as the balcony, what is seen there will cause people to question the main points such as the bathroom or the bed."

review_text: "Dejligt lille hotel med charme. Ulempen er der er meget lydt og badebassin trængte til nyt vand, da der var meget klor i det Morgenmad var ikke specielt god. Lækre værelser"
translated_text: "Nice little hotel with charm. The downside is that it is very noisy and the swimming pool needed new water as there was a lot of chlorine in it. Breakfast was not particularly good. Nice rooms"

review_text: "Özellikle çalışanların davranışları ve destekleri üst düzeydi. Diğer unsurlar, anlatılan ve beklenilenlere eş değerdi."
translated_text: "Especially the behavior and support of the employees were at a high level. Other elements were equivalent to what was described and expected."

review_text: "Çok ama çok memnun kaldık. Güleryüzlü personel, yenilenmiş ve tertemiz odalar, kahvaltı olması ve odanın her gün temizlenmesi bir apart otel olması dolayisiyla kendimizi evimizde hissettik. Teşekkürler Ella."
translated_text: "We were very, very pleased. We felt at home with the friendly staff, the renovated and spotlessly clean rooms, the breakfast available and the room being cleaned every day, as it is an aparthotel. Thank you Ella."

review_text: "Veldig god verdi for pengene. Kjempebra service, og et rolig strøk ved hotellet. Anbefaler virkelig. Litt lite frokost bare, men ellers var det perfekt"
translated_text: "Very good value for money. Great service, and a quiet area by the hotel. Really recommend. Only a little small breakfast, but otherwise it was perfect"

review_text: "Notre séjour dure 6 nuits , je suis très satisfaite parce qu'il y a tout ce qu'il me faut : la piscine , le petit déjeuner , le bon personnel, bonne emplacement, le confort, calme, la sortie touristique, ... Mes enfants sont ravis d'ici car elles se sentent comme chez nous. Elles ont dormi très bien. Bonne continuation"
translated_text: "Our stay lasts 6 nights, I am very satisfied because there is everything I need: the swimming pool, the breakfast, the good staff, good location, the comfort, calm, the tourist outing, ... My children are delighted here because they feel at home. They slept very well. Good luck"

review_text: "Väldigt fin ny hotell. Det bästa av allt va Kamal som jobbade i receptionen. Väldig fin bemötande och han va hjälpsam samt väldig trevlig. Han hjälpte till med allt. Rekommenderar stark. Tack ännu en gång för allt Kamal. :)"
translated_text: "Very nice new hotel. The best of all was Kamal who worked at the reception. Very nice treatment and he was helpful and very nice. He helped with everything. Strongly recommend. Thanks again for everything Kamal. :)"

review_text: "Bästa hotellet jag har varit på. Mycket fint och bra bemötande av personalen speciellt av Kemal abe. Han var så snäll, lugn och mycket hjälpsam. Kemal var väldigt ödmjuk och jordnära person. Om jag åker tillbaka till Antalya kommer jag absolut att besöka detta hotell igen. Det bjöds på en enkel och god frukost på morgonen. Det fanns alltid te och kaffe på receptionen för gästerna. Även kallt vatten fanns hela tiden. Jätte rent och lyxigt hotell som jag rekommenderar starkt. En fin pool finns också för en liten avkoppling. Bästa hotellet i Antalya ❤️❤️❤️ Varma kramar till bästa Kemal❤️❤️❤️"
translated_text: "The best hotel I have been to. Very nice and good treatment by the staff especially by Kemal abe. He was so kind, calm and very helpful. Kemal was very humble and down to earth person. If I go back to Antalya I will definitely visit this hotel again. There was a simple and good breakfast in the morning. There was always tea and coffee at the reception for the guests. Even cold water was available all the time. Very clean and luxurious hotel which I highly recommend. A nice pool is also available for a little relaxation. Best hotel in Antalya ❤️❤️❤️ Warm hugs to the best Kemal❤️❤️❤️"

review_text: "Perfekt trevligt personal som en familj😊"
translated_text: "Perfectly nice staff like a family😊"

review_text: "Genel olarak çok memnun kaldık. Konum olarak güzel. Temizlik de bir kez problem yaşadık onun haricinde hersey çok güzeldi."
translated_text: "Overall, we were very pleased. The location is nice. We had a problem with the cleaning once, but other than that, everything was great."

review_text: "Perge otelde yer kalmadığı için sadece 50 m uzaklıktakiş bu otelde konakladık. Perge otelin restoranını ve beach'ini kullandık. Her şey mükemmeldi. Görevli tüm personele, özellikle Lanthe restaurant şefine teşekkürü bir borç bilirim."
translated_text: "Since there was no room left at the Perge hotel, we stayed at this hotel, which is only 50 meters away. We used the restaurant and beach of the Perge hotel. Everything was perfect. I would like to thank all the staff, especially the chef of Lanthe restaurant."

review_text: "So wie beschrieben, waren nicht im Hauptgebäude. Ruhig gelegen, personal sehr aufmerksam. Lob an den Kellner im Haupthaus aus Ulm. Wir waren sehr zufrieden und das Essen super lecker."
translated_text: "As described, we were not in the main building. Quietly located, staff very attentive. Praise to the waiter in the main building from Ulm. We were very satisfied and the food was delicious."

review_text: "Otel çok güzel ve keyifli her şey orada, plajda en ince ayrıntısına kadar düşünülmüş. Kahvaltı çok lezzetliydi. Herkes çok güler yüzlü. Kesinlikle değerlendirilmeli."
translated_text: "The hotel is very nice and pleasant, everything is there, on the beach, thought to the smallest detail. The breakfast was very delicious. Everyone was very friendly. It should definitely be evaluated."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "-1’inci katta bir oda verildi. Odanın sözde bir balkonu var. Sabah uyandığımızda perdeyi açtığımda 2 ilaçlama firması personeli bizim balkonda olan yapay çimi kaldırıp rögar kapağını açtılar. Afederseniz dışkı dolu lağımın içine ve etrafına ilaçlama yaptılar. Balkona çıktığınızda da yapay yeşil çimler bu lağım kapağı ve etrafında ıslaktı. Bu ıslaklık klima sularından da birikiyor. Balkona çıkan direkt bir kapı yok zaten, pencereden bacak atarak balkona iniyorsunuz. Yatak nevresimlerinde saç telleri vardı. Banyoda yerde ölü hamam böceği vardı. Kahvaltıda kullanılan süt bim markası zaten kaliteyi ordan biçin. Kullanılan kahvaltılık ürünleri de hiç beğenmedik. Meyve suyu diye toz içecek konulmuş gerçekten komikti. Sadece personel hizmeti kötü değildi, ellerinden geleni yapıyorlar. Kalan her şey kötüydü."
translated_text: "-I was given a room on the 1st floor. The room supposedly has a balcony. When we woke up in the morning, when I opened the curtain, 2 disinfection company personnel removed the artificial grass on our balcony and opened the manhole cover. Excuse me, they sprayed in and around the sewer full of feces. When you went to the balcony, the artificial green grass was wet around this sewer cover and around it. This wetness also accumulates from the air conditioner water. There is no direct door to the balcony anyway, you go down to the balcony by stepping your legs through the window. Bed. "There were strands of hair on the bed linen. There were dead cockroaches on the floor in the bathroom. The brand of milk used for breakfast was bad. We didn't like the breakfast products at all. It was really funny that there was a powdered drink called fruit juice. Not only was the staff service bad, they did their best."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Fint hotell for enkel opphold. Jeg var der med familien fra onsdag til mandag-fordi det ble opplevd som sentralt. Trikk går rett utenfor og old bazaar er på gåavstand. Men fortsatt 20-25 min til Strand med bil. Frokostbuffeten var helt ok, helt ok mat, kunne vært litt bedre. Føler bildene samsvarer ikke helt med det du kommer til basseng og uteområde. Det er ekstrakostnader som strykejern. Men ellers renslig hotell med hyggelig personale."
translated_text: "Nice hotel for a simple stay. I was there with the family from Wednesday to Monday - because it felt central. The tram goes right outside and the old bazaar is within walking distance. But still 20-25 minutes to the beach by car. The breakfast buffet was quite ok, quite ok food, could have been a little better. I feel the pictures do not quite match what you get to the pool and outdoor area. There are extra costs such as an iron. But otherwise a clean hotel with pleasant staff."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Ailemle rahat bir konaklama güzel bir gece geçirdim."
translated_text: "I had a comfortable stay and a nice night with my family."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "J'ai passé 5 nuits dans cette hôtel et j'en suis ravie. Les personnels est vraiment au top, l'hébergement est proche de tout et facilement accessible même en transport. J'ai apprécié mon séjour seul petit bémol le petit déjeuner qui je trouve manque de variété, beaucoup de nourriture salé et je préfère le sucré mais dans l'ensemble mon séjour dans cet hôtel était vraiment très bien"
translated_text: "I spent 5 nights in this hotel and I am delighted. The staff is really top notch, the accommodation is close to everything and easily accessible even by transport. I enjoyed my stay only small downside the breakfast which I find lacks variety, a lot of salty food and I prefer sweet but overall my stay in this hotel was really very good"

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Het is goed ontbijtbuffet rijkelijk Allen budcet accementatie wc en bad gezamenlijk gebruik dat is minder verder is goed bevalen"
translated_text: "It is a good breakfast buffet, plentiful, all budget, toilet and bath, shared use, which is less, otherwise it was well liked"

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Personal war freundlich und nett. Leider die Fenster im Zimmern sind nicht dicht und hört man, was draußen alles abläuft. Wer keine Probleme mit Lärm hat, kann bestimmt gut schlafen. Past mehr für junge Leute, die viel auf Party stehen."
translated_text: "Staff was friendly and nice. Unfortunately, the windows in the rooms are not tight and you can hear what's going on outside. If you don't have problems with noise, you can definitely sleep well. Better for young people who like to party a lot."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Herkese tavsiye edebilecegim bir hotel, hotel yeni oldugu icin eksikleri var, ama bunu bir kusur olarak gormedim.. gercekten personale ilgilenme superdi.."
translated_text: "It is a hotel that I can recommend to everyone. Since the hotel is new, it has some shortcomings, but I did not see this as a flaw. The personal attention was really great.."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Otel çok temiz ve konforluydu. Konumu da iyiydi. Genel olarak memnun kaldık tavsiye ediyorum."
translated_text: "The hotel was very clean and comfortable. The location was also good. Overall, we were satisfied. I recommend it."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Çok güzeldi herşey tertemiz gayet uygun fiyatlı ve harika bir oteldi"
translated_text: "It was very nice, everything was spotless, very affordable and it was a great hotel"

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Das Hotel ist wirklich sehr sauber und modern eingerichtet. Wie auf den Bildern. Personal freundlich. Hat uns sehr gut gefallen."
translated_text: "The hotel is really very clean and modernly furnished. As in the pictures. Staff friendly. We really liked it."

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Empfehlenswert"
translated_text: "Recommended"

hotel_name: Wolf Of The City Hotel & Spa
review_text: "Her bir personel çok iyi ve yardımseverdi. Aralarındaki uyum güzeldi. Odalar çok konforlu ve size rahat bir dinlenme alanı sunuyor. Check- in saatinden önce gelmeme rağmen hiçbir sorun yaşamadım. Keyifli bir süreç geçirdim. Konumundan bahsetmeme gerek bile yok. Mutlaka değerlendirmelisiniz."
translated_text: "Every staff member was very good and helpful. The harmony between them was good. The rooms are very comfortable and offer you a comfortable resting area. Even though I arrived before the check-in time, I had no problems. I had a pleasant process. Not to mention the location. You should definitely evaluate it."

review_text: "Bu kadar merkezi bir bölgede bu kadar sessiz ve konforlu bir otel olmasına şaşırdım.Konumu çok iyi.Temizlik çok iyi.Çalışanlar çok ilgili ve güleryüzlü.Kahvaltı yeterli.Kesinlikle tekrar tercih edicem.Teşekkür ediyorum."
translated_text: "I was surprised that it was such a quiet and comfortable hotel in such a central area. The location is very good. The cleanliness is very good. The employees are very attentive and friendly. The breakfast is sufficient. I will definitely choose it again. Thank you."

review_text: "Ich war nur eine Nacht dort und habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt. Das Zimmer war sauber und bequem, das Hotel liegt in einer ruhigen Gegend und alles ist fußläufig erreichbar. Besonders gut gefallen haben mir das Frühstück und die freundliche Atmosphäre. Es gibt sogar einen kleinen Pool. Ein Ausblick hätte schön gewesen, aber das ist nicht weiter schlimm. Insgesamt sehr empfehlenswert. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen."
translated_text: "I was only there for one night and felt very comfortable. The room was clean and comfortable, the hotel is in a quiet area and everything is within walking distance. I particularly liked the breakfast and the friendly atmosphere. There is even a small pool. A view would have been nice, but that's not a big deal. Overall, highly recommended. I would come back at any time."

review_text: "Personelleri empati kurmak konusunda işletme sahibi kadar bilgisinin olması müşteri memnuniyeti konusunda vasat düzeyde fotoğrafları güncel değil iskele başka otele ait ve paralı çalışanların işi sahipleneceği memnuniyeti maddi manevi işletme sahibi tarafından sağlanmadığı için, çözüm odaklı olması adına benim bilgi deneyimimle orta yolu bulmak için fazlaca dil döktüm değer mi derseniz bu otel için değmez ki bunu aklı başında herkes farkeder. Üzgünüm açıkçası ekmek kazanmak icin bu kadar ticari düşünmemek gerektiğini isterdim"
translated_text: "The staff is as knowledgeable as the business owner about empathy and customer satisfaction. Their photos are not up to date. The pier belongs to another hotel and since the satisfaction that the paid employees will take over the job is not provided by the owner financially and morally, I spent a lot of time trying to find a middle ground with my knowledge and experience in order to be solution-oriented. If you ask if it is worth it, it is not worth it for this hotel, which everyone in their right mind would realize. I'm sorry, frankly, I wish I didn't have to think so commercially to earn a living."

review_text: "Værelserne var beskidte, blev ikke ordentlig rengjort . Håndklæder og sengesæt blev ikke udskiftet under opholdet . Meget ringe morgenmad. Eneste positive var deres pool som var god til børn."
translated_text: "The rooms were dirty, not properly cleaned. Towels and bedding were not changed during the stay. Very poor breakfast. The only positive was their pool which was good for children."

review_text: "Çok teşekkür ederiz. Hizmetleriniz çok mükemmel. Resepsiyon, restoran, ve temizlik elemanı hizmetleri profesyonel."
translated_text: "Thank you very much. Your services are excellent. Reception, restaurant, and cleaning staff services are professional."

review_text: "Ren fin bra service stort sortiment frukost"
translated_text: "Clean, nice, good service, large selection of breakfast"

review_text: "Çalışanlar cana yakın ,güler yüzlü,fiyatına göre iyi bir hotel"
translated_text: "The staff is friendly, smiling, it's a good hotel for the price."

review_text: "Het was een heel fijn hotel. Er werd elke dag schoongemaakt. Het eten was zeer gevarieerd en heerlijk. Chef Mithat was erg attent. Het was op loopafstand van veel bezienswaardigheden. Ik kan dit hotel iedereen aanbevelen."
translated_text: "It was a very nice hotel. Cleaning was done every day. The food was very varied and delicious. Chef Mithat was very attentive. It was within walking distance of many sights. I can recommend this hotel to everyone."

review_text: "Kötü bir yer"
translated_text: "Bad place"

review_text: "Leuke hotel dichtbij strand en stad"
translated_text: "Nice hotel close to beach and city"

review_text: "Wir fanden das Buffet mittelmäßig. Fü Familien gut geeignet. Personal sehr nett. Zum Strand ca 20 min Fußweg. 3x am Tag fährt ein Transfer hin und zurück."
translated_text: "We found the buffet mediocre. Good for families. Staff very nice. It's about a 20 minute walk to the beach. There is a transfer there and back 3 times a day."

review_text: "Sehr angenehmes kleines „Familienhotel“. Es ist ruhig, sehr angenehm. Essen ist reichhaltig und abwechslungsreich und gut. Personal ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Gerne wieder."
translated_text: "Very pleasant little family hotel". It's quiet, very pleasant. Food is rich and varied and good. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Gladly again."

review_text: "Nettes freundliches Personal und nah am Strand."
translated_text: "Nice friendly staff and close to the beach."

review_text: "Dejligt rent og gode faciliteter"
translated_text: "Nicely clean and good facilities"

review_text: "Hotel top! Lage Top! wir hatten kein frühstück nur zum übernachten und fürs Pool gebucht! Die Lage war besser als erwartet. Mitten in der Stadt. Bazar zu fuss erreichbar, Strand zu fuss erreichbar, die Clubs, Pubs und Bars und Kaleici welche bekannt ist für das Nachtleben auch zu fuss erreichbar. haben Kein taxi benötigt. taxi in antalya soll auch wohl sehr teuer sein, nicht vergleichbar mit istanbul."
translated_text: "Hotel top! Location top! We didn't book breakfast just to stay overnight and for the pool! The location was better than expected. Right in the middle of the city. Bazar within walking distance, beach within walking distance, the clubs, pubs and bars and Kaleici, which is known for its nightlife, also within walking distance. No taxi needed. Taxi in Antalya is also said to be very expensive, not comparable to Istanbul."

review_text: "Den dårligst hotel nogensinde har vi oplevet. Dårligt morgenmad meget støj og uvenligt personale."
translated_text: "The worst hotel we have ever experienced. Bad breakfast, lots of noise and unfriendly staff."

review_text: "조용한위치 도보로 올드타운 접근성이 좋다 친절한 서비스도 최고"
translated_text: "Quiet location, easy access to the old town on foot, friendly service is the best"

review_text: "주차 가능 (주차가 필요하면 미리 호텔에 연락바람) 깔끔하고 에어컨 빵빵 수압 굿 위치 굿 카라알리올루 바로 옆에 있음 방도 캐리어 2개 필 공간 있고 좋음 직원도 너무 친절하고 조식은 한상차림"
translated_text: "Parking available (if you need parking, please contact the hotel in advance). Clean, good air conditioning, good water pressure, good location. Right next to Karaaliolu. The room was good and had space for 2 suitcases. The staff was very friendly and the breakfast was well prepared."

review_text: "Nous avons passé une nuit là bas est c’était tout simplement fantastique. La propreté des lieux, l’amabilité du personnelle, le petit déjeuner (buffet), la piscine tout étaient incroyable. J’y reviendrais les yeux fermés. Un grand merci :)"
translated_text: "We spent one night there and it was simply fantastic. The cleanliness of the place, the friendliness of the staff, the breakfast (buffet), the swimming pool were all incredible. I would come back with my eyes closed. Many thanks :)"

review_text: "Magnifique comme hôtel"
translated_text: “Magnificent as a hotel”

review_text: "Otelin yeri son derece iyi hemen önünden tramvaya binilerek şehir merkezine 5 dakikada ulaşılıyor odaları çok büyük çok rahat manzarası çok güzel kahvaltısı son derece yeterli hepsini öğrenmesi çalışanlar son derece güler yüzlü ve yardımcı biz içeri girer girmez çekimimizi yaptıktan sonra çay kahve ikram etmek istediler kabul ettik keyifli güler yüzlü bir servis aldık Akşam odamıza çıkarken soğuk su ikram ettiler sularıımızı yanımıza aldık keyifli bir akşam geçirdik çok teşekkür ederiz"
translated_text: "The location of the hotel is extremely good. You can reach the city center in 5 minutes by taking the tram right in front of it. The rooms are very big and very comfortable. The view is very nice. The breakfast is extremely sufficient. The staff are very friendly and helpful. They wanted to offer us tea and coffee as soon as we entered, after we took our photo. We accepted it. We received a pleasant and friendly service. They offered us cold water when we went to our room in the evening. We took our water with us. We had a pleasant evening. Thank you very much."

review_text: "Antalya için oldukça merkezi ve her yere ulaşımı kolay bir yerde.Otelin temizliği mükemmel.Ayrıca kahvaltıyı da çok beğendim .Tüm çalışanlara teşekkürler"
translated_text: "It is very central for Antalya and easy to reach everywhere. The cleanliness of the hotel is excellent. I also liked the breakfast very much. Thank you to all the staff."

review_text: "편안하게 묶다 왔습니다."
translated_text: “I came bundled up comfortably.”

review_text: "Albergo vecchio, poco curato in zona limitrofa al centro raggiungibile a piedi, ma abbastanza lontano. In camera la pulizia è scarsa, le lenzuola sporche che mi sono fatta cambiare subito, e il bagno è vecchio. La parziale vista mare è un piccolissimo spicchio e per il resto si vede il parcheggio! Anche la colazione non è un granché. Prezzo ingiustificato."
translated_text: "Old, poorly maintained hotel in an area close to the center reachable on foot, but quite far away. In the room the cleanliness is poor, the sheets dirty which I had changed immediately, and the bathroom is old. The partial sea view is a very small segment and for the rest you can see the parking lot! Even the breakfast isn't that great. Unjustified price."

review_text: "Hôtel vraiment parfait rien n’a redire !"
translated_text: “Really perfect hotel, nothing to complain about!”

review_text: "Personnel accueillant et répondant à plusieurs de nos besoins, petit déjeuner complet pour le prix et cadre agréable"
translated_text: “Welcoming staff who met many of our needs, full breakfast for the price and pleasant surroundings”

review_text: "Otel temizdi , kahvaltı çeşidi ve kalitesi gayet yeterliydi. Kendine ait otopark olması ve lokasyonu bize çok uygundu. Kesinlikle her gelmemde kalabileceğim bir otel teşekkür ederim otel yönetimine"
translated_text: "The hotel was clean, the breakfast variety and quality was quite sufficient. It had its own parking lot and the location was very convenient for us. It is definitely a hotel where I can stay every time I come, thank you to the hotel management."

review_text: "Slidt og dårligt vedligeholdt. Poolen blev ikke rengjort i de 14 dage vi boede der. Der lå skrald og visne blade i bedene. Morgenmaden var frygtelig og frugten rådden, så vi spiste ude hver dag. A la carte restauranten var ikke åben overhovedet! Der blev kun fejet og vasket gulv på midten af værelset, ikke fyldt op af toiletpapir eller kaffe. Sæbe kommer i genfyldte beholdere, så vi købte vores egen. De øvrige gæster var helt uden manerer, råben, skrigen og boldspil i poolområdet og gjorde at man ikke havde lyst til at opholde sig på hotellets område. Det eneste gode ved dette hotel var at personalet var søde og hjælpsomme."
translated_text: "Torn and poorly maintained. The pool was not cleaned in the 14 days we stayed there. There was rubbish and withered leaves in the beds. The breakfast was terrible and the fruit rotten, so we ate out every day. The a la carte restaurant was not open at all! Only the floor in the middle of the room was swept and washed, not topped up with toilet paper or coffee. Soap comes in refillable containers, so we bought our own. The other guests were completely without manners, shouting, screaming and ball games in the pool area and made you not want to stay in the hotel area. The only good thing about this hotel was that the staff were nice and helpful."

review_text: "Équipement trop vieux"
translated_text: “Equipment too old”

review_text: "Mindre bra"
translated_text: "Less Good"

review_text: "Gayet güzel bir geceydi resepsiyondaki arkadaş çok yardımcı oldu gayet ilgiliydi oda temiz ve konforluydu sabah kahvaltı çeşidi fazla ve lezzeyliydi bence gayet güzel bir oteldi tavsiye edetim tekrardan gelicem"
translated_text: "It was a very nice night. The friend at the reception was very helpful and attentive. The room was clean and comfortable. The breakfast in the morning had a lot of variety and was delicious. I think it was a very nice hotel. I recommend it. I will come again."

review_text: "Hôtel satisfaisant au vu du prix."
translated_text: “Satisfying hotel considering the price.”

review_text: "War ok"
translated_text: "It was ok"

review_text: "Das Personal war uns immer eine Unterstützung. Sehr nett und hilfsbereit."
translated_text: "The staff was always helpful to us. Very nice and helpful."

review_text: "Perfetto per soggiornare una sola notte ad Antalya. Subito fuori dal centro storico che si raggiunge comodamente a piedi così come l’antico porto romano.Il museo Archeologico si raggiunge sia a piedi che in soli 5 minuti di taxi (traffico permettendo). Personale gentilissimo e disponibile, camera spaziosa e dotata di tutti i comfort."
translated_text: "Perfect for staying just one night in Antalya. Just outside the historic center which can be easily reached on foot as well as the ancient Roman port. The Archaeological museum can be reached either on foot or in just 5 minutes by taxi (traffic permitting). Very kind and helpful staff, spacious room equipped with all comforts."

review_text: "Gut"
translated_text: "Gut"

review_text: "Très bon accueil par le gérant de l’hôtel. Du personnel présent à toute heure pour vous renseigner. Le parking est très pratique si vous arrivez en voiture. Petit déjeuner au dernier étage avec une belle vue. La chambre était très propre."
translated_text: "Very warm welcome by the hotel manager. Staff present at all hours to provide information. Parking is very convenient if you arrive by car. Breakfast on the top floor with a beautiful view. The room was very clean."

review_text: "Çok hijyenik olmasa da idare edilebilecek seviyedeydi"
translated_text: "Although it was not very hygienic, it was manageable"

review_text: "Alles"
translated_text: "Everything"

review_text: "Gut"
translated_text: "Gut"

review_text: "Tertemiz şirin özellikle konyaaltı sahile çok yakın çalışan personel ilgili kibar ve otel hakkında gereken bilgileri sormadan paylaştı misafirperverliklerinden dolayı teşekkür ediyorum."
translated_text: "I would like to thank the staff, who are immaculately clean and very close to the Konyaalti beach, for their hospitality, they were polite and shared the necessary information about the hotel without asking."

review_text: "Jeden Tag, das gleiche Frühstück und Zimmer Service war nicht in Ordnung"
translated_text: "Every day, same breakfast and room service was not ok"

review_text: "Jättefin och härlig hotell"
translated_text: "Wonderful and lovely hotel"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Personelin güler yüzlülüğü ,, odaların temizliği kahvaltı vs herşey çok güzeldi …"
translated_text: "The friendliness of the staff, the cleanliness of the rooms, the breakfast etc., everything was great..."

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Her anlamda çok memnun kaldık. Çalışanların hepsi güler yüzlü ve ilgili fakat hijyen konusunu gerçekten arşa çıkarmışlar. Herkesin emeğine sağlık."
translated_text: "We were very pleased in every sense. All the employees are friendly and attentive, but they have really taken the hygiene issue to the fore. Thank you for everyone's efforts."

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Resepsiyon personeli kaba davrandı ve misafirlere yardımcı olmadı. Odam hazır değildi (uçuşum erken indiği için bunun farkındayım) fakat bana sadece valizimi bırakma izni verdiler ve 4 saat boyunca koltukta oturmamı söylediler; havuz veya plajı kullanmama izin vermediler. Ayrıca bar personeli çok yetersizdi, basit bir içecek (vodka Red Bull) bile hazırlayamadılar. Ancak Deniz ve Bushra her sorumda bana yardımcı oldular, çok güler yüzlü ve profesyoneldiler. Birçok misafir de aynı şekilde onların ne kadar iyi çalıştığını söylüyor. İkisine özellikle teşekkür ederim"
translated_text: "The reception staff were rude and unhelpful to guests. My room wasn't ready (I'm aware of this because my flight landed early) but they only allowed me to leave my luggage and told me to sit on the sofa for 4 hours; they didn't let me use the pool or the beach. Also the bar staff was very incompetent, they couldn't even prepare a simple drink (vodka Red Bull). But Deniz and Bushra helped me with every question, they were very friendly and professional. Many guests also say how well they work." I would like to thank both of them especially"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Super hôtel adult only . Propreté / calme et détente . L’accès à la crique est exceptionnel. Petit bémol pour les chambres sans balcon et un peu petites .. et pas assez de transats. Je vous le recommande quand même ! Super séjour pour nous dans un bon quartier !"
translated_text: "Great adult only hotel. Clean / calm and relaxing. Access to the cove is exceptional. Small downside for the rooms without balcony and a little small.. and not enough deckchairs. I still recommend it! Great stay for us in a good area!"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "L'hotel gode di spiaggia privata che abbiamo particolarmente apprezzato. La stanza che abbiamo prenotato era un po piccola ma gradevole. Non siamo invece soddisfatti del ristorante e della colazione per mancanza di qualità del cibo. Abbiamo da ridire sulla pulizia delle parti esterne, visto che puliscono tutto con la canna dell'acqua, abbiamo avuto un incidente perché ci hanno lavato le scarpe mentre stavamo cenando. É comodo il servizio di parcheggio con parcheggiatore (si lasciano le chiavi dell'auto)"
translated_text: "The hotel has a private beach which we particularly appreciated. The room we booked was a little small but pleasant. However, we were not satisfied with the restaurant and the breakfast due to the lack of quality of the food. We have to complain about the cleanliness of the external parts, since they clean everything with the hose, we had an accident because they washed our shoes while we were having dinner. The valet parking service is convenient (you leave the car keys)"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Alles war super"
translated_text: “Everything was great”

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Alles was perfect, grote dank aan de organisatie"
translated_text: "Everything was perfect, big thanks to the organization"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Sakinlik konfor arayanlar icin ideal bir yer. Mukemmel dinlenmis hiss ettim. Tai masajina bayildim. Plaj ve havuzda guzel vakit gecirdim. Acik bufe kahvaltida cok lezzetliydi hersey. Odamin manzarasi harikaydi fakat camlarin tam acilmiyor olmasi biraz üzdu. Cunki odada garip hafif bir koku oluyor oda tam havalanmiyor sanki,rahatsiz edici bir koku degil ama yine de belirtmek istedim.Belki bir cozum bulunur. Personelin emegini degerlendirmege puan yetmez. Sicagin altinda garsonluk hizmeti veren arkadaslarimiza daha serin giyecek temin edilirse guzel olur. Kafa Dinlemek ayni zamanda denizin keyfini cikarmak isteyen herkese tavsiye ederim"
translated_text: "It is an ideal place for those looking for tranquility and comfort. I felt perfectly rested. I loved the Thai massage. I had a great time at the beach and the pool. Everything was delicious at the open buffet. The view from my room was great, but the fact that the windows did not open completely made me a little sad. Because there is a strange, slight smell in the room, as if the room is not fully ventilated, it is not a disturbing smell, but I wanted to point it out anyway. Maybe there is a solution. "There are not enough points to evaluate the effort of the staff. It would be nice if cooler clothes were provided to our friends who work as waiters in the heat. I recommend it to everyone who wants to relax and enjoy the sea."

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Keyifle 2 gün geçirdik Herşey güzeldi"
translated_text: "We had a pleasant 2 days. Everything was good."

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Sehr freundliches Personal an allen Stellen, ein gepflegtes Hotel, sauber und zuvorkommend und ebenso die Gäste. Die Ruhe - bedingt durch die Tatsache, dass es ein Erwachsenenhotel ist - ist wunderbar! Ich habe mich wohl gefühlt und komme sicher bei Gelegenheit wieder. Der Zugang zum Meer war wunderbar und es wurde auf Sicherheit geachtet. Ich habe es geliebt direkt am/über dem Meer Zeit verbringen zu können. Auch die Möglichkeit direkt Getränke und Essen zur Liege zu bestellen, war wunderbar. Hätte ich hier einen Tipp, würde ich komfortablere Liegen mit Auflagen empfehlen, die aktuell vorhandenen sind okay, jedoch kein gehobenes Niveau. Was etwas ungewöhnlich ist, ist das gar keine Getränke ins Hotel mitgebracht werden dürfen. Ich verstehe die Vorgabe bei alkoholischen Getränken und Softdrinks, jedoch nicht bei Wasser. Wasser ist ein menschliches Grundbedürfnis und sollte daher immer in ausreichender Menge mit sich geführt werden dürfen. Hier sollte die Einschränkung überdacht werden."
translated_text: "Very friendly staff everywhere, a well-kept hotel, clean and accommodating and so are the guests. The peace and quiet - due to the fact that it is an adults-only hotel - is wonderful! I felt comfortable and will definitely come back when the opportunity arises. The access to the sea was wonderful and safety was taken into account. I loved being able to spend time directly on/above the sea. The possibility of ordering drinks and food directly to the lounger was also wonderful. If I had a tip, I would recommend more comfortable loungers with cushions, The ones currently available are okay, but not of a high standard. What is somewhat unusual is that you are not allowed to bring any drinks into the hotel. I understand the requirement for alcoholic drinks and soft drinks, but not for water. Water is a basic human need and should therefore always be allowed to be brought with you in sufficient quantities.

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Nous sommes aller la bas pour nos 1 ans de mariage ils nous on fait une très belle surprise Le personnel est très gentil La chambre, le ménage impeccable Merci pour tout Je recommande à 100%"
translated_text: “We went there for our 1st wedding anniversary, they gave us a very nice surprise The staff is very nice The room, the cleaning is impeccable Thank you for everything I recommend 100%”

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Vi har haft en fantastisk tur og ophold. Vi kommer helt sikkert tilbage!"
translated_text: "We had a great trip and stay. We will definitely be back!"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Das einzig nette Personal war das Reinigungspersonal. Under Badezimmer hat zeitweise nach Kanalisation gerochen. Das Sonnendeck war sehr schön sowie das geräumige Hotelzimmer."
translated_text: "The only nice staff was the cleaning staff. The bathroom smelled like sewage at times. The sun deck was very nice as was the spacious hotel room."
