review_text: "Odalarda balkon olmaması Antalya’da sıkıntı oluyor onun haricinde iyi oteldi"
translated_text: "Not having a balcony in the rooms is a problem in Antalya, other than that it was a good hotel"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Güzeldi"
translated_text: "It was nice"

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Çok temiz, nezih ve huzurlu bir otel. Konumu da çok iyi. Memnun kaldık, tekrar konaklamayı da düşünüyoruz."
translated_text: "It is a very clean, decent and peaceful hotel. Its location is also very good. We were satisfied and we are considering staying again."

hotel_name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Antalya Lara - Yetişkinlere Özel (+18)
review_text: "Nous avons passé un superbe séjour dans cet hôtel L’hôtel est propre et le personnel est vraiment très gentil. Cet hôtel est très bien situé La salle de sport est superbe avec du matériel nouvelle Generation. Le spa est aussi très bien et tarif abordable Le restaurant japonais. Quant à lui est vraiment délicieux et je le recommande. Vivement Cet hôtel a aussi un coucher de soleil magnifique."
translated_text: "We had a superb stay in this hotel. The hotel is clean and the staff are really very nice. This hotel is very well located. The gym is superb with new generation equipment. The spa is also very good and affordable. The Japanese restaurant is really delicious and I recommend it. Highly This hotel also has a magnificent sunset."

review_text: "Très bel accueil et personnel très agréable. Petite piscine assez sympa. Repas très variés."
translated_text: "Very warm welcome and very pleasant staff. Quite a nice little swimming pool. Very varied meals."

review_text: "Det var en otrolig vy från balkongen med havsutsikt! Hotellet låg väldigt nära stranden dessutom, och det var ju toppen. Sängen var skön och städningen var okej. Den närmaste strandklubben var dock den sjavigaste av all de närmaste, så man fick gå en kort promenad till nästa, som var fin! Frukosten var inte mycket att hurra för tyvärr."
translated_text: "It was an incredible view from the balcony with a sea view! The hotel was also very close to the beach, and that was great. The bed was comfortable and the cleaning was okay. However, the nearest beach club was the shadiest of all the nearest ones, so you had to walk a short distance to the next one, which was nice! The breakfast was not much to cheer about, unfortunately."

review_text: "Otel temiz hissiyatı vermiyor, konum olarak iyi hepsi bu"
translated_text: "The hotel does not feel clean, the location is good, that's all"

review_text: "Leider Zimmer viel zu klein, wie auf den Bildern zu sehen war. Haare in der Dusche und im Bett ."
translated_text: "Unfortunately, the room was much too small, as shown in the pictures. Hair in the shower and in the bed."

review_text: "Herşey orta.."
translated_text: "Everything is average.."

review_text: "Beste Lage, sehr nettes und hilfsbereites Personal, gerne wieder."
translated_text: "Best location, very nice and helpful staff, gladly again."

review_text: "Odalar temiz değil.Personel mutsuz.kahvaltısı kötü"
translated_text: "Rooms are not clean. Staff is unhappy. Breakfast is bad"

review_text: "Mükkemmel di otel çalışanlar hep nazik kibar kişiler biz erken geldigimiz halde bize giriş için yardımcı oldular tavsiye ederim antalyada kalabilceginiz en iyi otellereden biri"
translated_text: "It was perfect, the hotel staff were always kind and polite, they helped us check in even though we arrived early, I recommend it, it is one of the best hotels you can stay in Antalya."

review_text: "J’ai séjourné dans un hôtel classé 3 étoiles et demie, bien situé en plein centre-ville, à deux pas de la mer, ce qui est un vrai point positif pour les promenades ou l’accès aux plages. En revanche, j’ai été assez déçu par le confort de la literie. Les lits sont loin d’être adaptés si vous avez des problèmes de dos : j’ai eu du mal à dormir correctement durant mon séjour. Je m’interroge un peu sur la classification de l’établissement, car certains aspects ne semblent pas correspondre au niveau attendu pour un hôtel de ce standing. Le petit déjeuner était correct, mais sans plus. Je n’en attendais pas grand-chose, et cela s’est confirmé : pas de vraie surprise ni de grande variété. En résumé, l’emplacement est excellent, mais il y a des améliorations à faire sur le confort et la qualité des services proposés."
translated_text: "I stayed in a hotel rated 3 and a half stars, well located in the city center, a stone's throw from the sea, which is a real positive point for walks or access to the beaches. On the other hand, I was quite disappointed by the comfort of the bedding. The beds are far from suitable if you have back problems: I had difficulty sleeping properly during my stay. I wonder a little about the classification of the establishment, because certain aspects do not seem to correspond at the level expected for a hotel of this standard. The breakfast was ok, but nothing more, I wasn't expecting much, and that was confirmed: no real surprise or great variety. In summary, the location is excellent, but there are improvements to be made in terms of comfort and the quality of the services offered.

review_text: "Очень уютный отель, прекрасный сервис, чистые номера,ежедневная уборка, большой выбор блюд на завтраке.Спасибо!"
translated_text: "Very cozy hotel, excellent service, clean rooms, daily cleaning, large selection of dishes at breakfast. Thank you!"

review_text: "Bra läge, fin restaurang o så. Super trevlig personal! Men rummen va inte så jätte rena och städningen va sådär.. annars prisvärt, precis vid stranden."
translated_text: "Good location, nice restaurant and so on. Super nice staff! But the rooms weren't very clean and the cleaning was so-so.. otherwise good value, right by the beach."

review_text: "Hôtel bien situé.! La chambre propre mais il faut avoir une chambre vue mer sinon c’est un appartement de 20m2. Le petit déjeuner au dessous de notre attente. J’avais sélectionné pour une personne (faute de moi ) Ils m’ont demandé 50€ ( la carotte ) Mais on a négocié à 20€ :)"
translated_text: "Hotel in a good location.! The room is clean but you have to have a room with a sea view otherwise it's a 20m2 apartment. The breakfast was below our expectations. I had selected for one person (my fault) They asked me 50€ (the carrot) But we negotiated for 20€ :)"

review_text: "Konum olarak çok güzel. Oda geniş, çalışanlar ilgili. Duş ufak, kahvaltı daha zengin olabilir. Antalya' nın meşhur reçelleri olmalıydı."
translated_text: "The location is very good. The room is spacious, the staff is friendly. The shower is small, the breakfast could be richer. It should have been Antalya's famous jams."

review_text: "alles gut"
translated_text: "it's all ok"

review_text: "All Inclusive ist hier ein Fremdwort - war krank, 150€ für einen Inkompetenten Arzt + Getränke aufs Zimmer kostet extra (auch wenn man krank ist) - finde das gehört sich nicht"
translated_text: "All inclusive is a foreign word here - I was sick, €150 for an incompetent doctor + drinks in the room cost extra (even if you're sick) - I don't think that's appropriate"

review_text: "Har hatt en god opplevelse. God mat og hyggelig personale"
translated_text: "Had a good experience. Good food and nice staff"

review_text: "Alt var fantastisk men manglet litt på hygiene"
translated_text: "Everything was fantastic but lacked a bit of hygiene"

review_text: "Sehr leckeres Essen!"
translated_text: "Very tasty food!"

review_text: "Je souhaite vous faire part du pire séjour de ma vie…. Votre Hôtel ne mérite à peine 2 étoiles …c’est scandaleux de facturer autant … Comment est ce que vous pouvez afficher de tels prix ?!?! J’aurais honte à votre place… Un buffet avec des plats pleins d’eau sans aucun goût ..,aucun transat de disponible il faut se réveiller à 5 heure du matin pour avoir un transat. Je vous souhaite une belle fermeture et je n’aimerais vraiment pas être à la place des prochains vacanciers… J’ai déjà séjourner à l’hôtel Liberty et à l’Hotel Concorde …ce sont des établissements incroyable Vous devriez prendre exemple sur eux Je ne reviendrais jamais dans votre hôtel Mention spéciale à la dame asiatique qui m’a encaissé 110 euros en espèces sans aucune facture et surtout son accueil très froid pas du tout aimable …"
translated_text: "I would like to tell you about the worst stay of my life.... Your Hotel barely deserves 2 stars... it's scandalous to charge so much... How can you display such prices?!?! I would be ashamed in your place... A buffet with dishes full of water without any taste..., no deckchair available you have to wake up at 5 a.m. to get a deckchair. I wish you a nice closing and I really wouldn't like to be in the place of the next ones vacationers… I have already stayed at the Liberty Hotel and the Hotel Concorde… they are incredible establishments You should take an example from them I would never return to your hotel Special mention to the Asian lady who collected 110 euros in cash from me without any invoice and above all her very cold welcome, not at all friendly…”

review_text: "Godt"
translated_text: "Well"

review_text: "Barkeeper top sehr nette Mitarbeiter…aber was das andere an geht wie zum Beispiel Handtücher wechseln usw. Schrecklich richtig unfreundlich also gehe da nicht wieder hin"
translated_text: "Bartender top, very nice employees...but when it comes to other things like changing towels etc. Terrible really unfriendly so won't go there again"

review_text: "Genel olarak gayet memnun kaldık. Tüm çalışanların nezaketi ve güleryüzü ozellikle vurgulanmayı hak ediyor."
translated_text: "Overall, we were very satisfied. The kindness and friendliness of all employees deserves special emphasis."

review_text: "Bien mais les chambre devrait être un peut plus propre !"
translated_text: “Good but the rooms should be a little cleaner!”

review_text: "Alles war perfekt"
translated_text: "Everything was perfect"

review_text: "Çok berbat bir oteldi. Koğuş gibi bir odada aile olarak kaldık. Odada sadece yatağa yatıp kalktık. Odada hiç vakit geçirmedik. Çünkü küçücük bir odaya dört tane tek kişilik yatak sıkıştırmaya çalışmışlar. Çöpe atılacak paranız varsa kalabilirsiniz. Banyoda elektrikli ısıtıcıyla çok az akan suyla duş almaya çalışıyorsunuz."
translated_text: "It was a very terrible hotel. We stayed as a family in a room like a ward. We only slept in the room and woke up. We did not spend any time in the room. Because they tried to squeeze four single beds into a tiny room. If you have money to throw away, you can stay. You try to take a shower with an electric heater in the bathroom with very little running water."

review_text: "Uzun süre araç kullandıktan sonra uyumak için kaldım. Yan odada konaklayan insanların fısıltılı konuşmaları bile duyuluyordu. Sesten etkilenen biri değilim, ama çok gürültülü . Bir de yanıltıcı sayıda yıldızı var, 5 te 5 alabilecek bir yer degil. Resepsiyonda ki arkadaş çok kibar."
translated_text: "I stayed to sleep after driving for a long time. Even the whispered conversations of the people staying in the next room could be heard. I am not someone who is affected by sound, but it is very loud. Also, it has a misleading number of stars, it is not a place that can get 5 out of 5. The friend at the reception is very polite."

review_text: "Standort Industrie plus kein buffet Frühstück Ein Tag gab kein Wasser sogar in ganzen Hotel ."
translated_text: "Industrial location plus no buffet breakfast. One day there was no water even in the entire hotel."

review_text: "Odanın duşluğu bozuktu, banyoda duşakabin yoktu."
translated_text: "The shower in the room was broken, there was no shower cabin in the bathroom."

review_text: "Romu kaikki oli rikki WC.suihku.lauari"
translated_text: "Rubbish everything was broken toilet.shower.laurair"

review_text: "Ukala bir resepsiyon gorevlisi bayan z1 denilen kotu bir oda duvar hethalde kartondan yan odaki hetsey bize yansidi kapi kilitlenmiyor havlu bir tane tv kagidi sonra asla bu paranin yeri degil brnim acimdan berbat tavsiye etmiyorum baskasini bilmem"
translated_text: "A cocky receptionist lady, a bad room called Z1, the wall is made of cardboard, the hetsey in the next room was reflected back at us, the door does not lock, there is only one towel, there is a TV paper, after all, this is not the place for the money, it is terrible from my perspective, I do not recommend it, I do not know anyone else."

review_text: "Mukava asiakaspalvelu ja oikein hyvä huone. Suihkussa vähän huono vedenpaine mutta muuten ei mitään moittimista ja huonekin oli oikein siisti!"
translated_text: "Nice customer service and a really good room. A little bad water pressure in the shower, but otherwise nothing to complain about and the room was really clean!"

review_text: "Sehr freundliche mitarbeiter, Ahmet abi hat uns immer geholfen..unsere check in war am mitternacht 12uhr, alles ohne probleme super vorbereitet"
translated_text: "Very friendly staff, Ahmet Abi always helped us...our check-in was at midnight at 12 p.m., everything was well prepared without any problems"

review_text: "Güleryüzle karşılandığımız çok tatlı bir işletmeydi. Evcil hayvanımızla gittik ve hiç sorun çıkarmadılar. Sadece kahvaltısının daha iyi olabileceğini düşünüyorum. Genel olarak Fiyat performans açısından oldukça iyi."
translated_text: "It was a very sweet establishment where we were greeted with a smile. We went with our pet and they did not cause any problems. I just think the breakfast could be better. In general, it is quite good in terms of price and performance."

review_text: "Otel çok temizdi ve herkes çok ilgili ve kibardı. Bulunduğu yer sessiz ve sakin. Memnun kaldık."
translated_text: "The hotel was very clean and everyone was very attentive and polite. The location is quiet and calm. We were satisfied."

review_text: "Küçük bir aile oteli, odalar temiz, güleryüzlü, ilgili herkes, 6 gece kaldık, memnun olarak ayrıldık. Konum olarak konya altına, kale içine 15 dk araç ile. Sakin konumda. Kahvaltıda çeşit az ama yeterli. Antalyayı dolaşmak için ideal otel."
translated_text: "It's a small family hotel, the rooms are clean, friendly, everyone involved is friendly, we stayed for 6 nights, we left satisfied. The location is under Konya, 15 minutes by car from the castle. It's in a quiet location. The variety at breakfast is limited but sufficient. It's the ideal hotel to travel around Antalya."

review_text: "Vi tyckte hotellet var fint och rent, den låg vid en gata där det inte fanns mycket ljud och bilar så det var tyst på natten. Det enda jag blev irriterad på var att när jag försökte sova vid 23.45 tiden så var det någon manlig röst som hördes väldigt högt, någon gäst troligen som pratade antingen utanför hotellet eller ovanför oss så det var väldigt svårt att somna."
translated_text: "We thought the hotel was nice and clean, it was on a street where there wasn't much noise and cars so it was quiet at night. The only thing that annoyed me was that when I tried to sleep at 11.45pm, there was some male voice that was heard very loudly, some guest probably talking either outside the hotel or above us so it was very difficult to fall asleep."

review_text: "Kahvaltisi eskisi gibi degil idi. Daha cok degisik olabilirdi. Kahvalti disinda hotelde bir eksiklik yok. Temiz ve guzel . Bu 3. Kalisim ve tekrar gelebilirim."
translated_text: "The breakfast was not the same as before. It could have been more different. Apart from the breakfast, there is nothing missing in the hotel. It is clean and nice. This is my 3rd stay and I may come again."

review_text: "Ficamos apenas uma noite para pegar um voo na manha seguinte."
translated_text: "We only stayed one night to catch a flight the next morning."

review_text: "Aile odasında 3 kişi kaldık. Rezervasyon 3 kişilik yapılmasına rağmen 2 kişi diye ısrar edildi. 3 kişi için de kimlik verilmesine rağmen. Klima bir değişik çalışıyor doğru düzgün serinleyemedik. Banyoda giderde saç vardı. Bir gece kaldık ama önermem."
translated_text: "We stayed in the family room for 3 people. Although the reservation was made for 3 people, they insisted that it was for 2 people. Even though IDs were given for all 3 people. The air conditioner was working differently and we could not cool off properly. There was hair in the bathroom drain. We stayed for one night, but I do not recommend it."

review_text: "Guleryuzlu ekip, temiz odalar. Kahvaltı yeterliydi, ozel park yeri olması cok iyi. Jimnastik sampiyonası icin spor salonuna yakınlık avantaj. Tekrar sampiyona oldugunda kesinlikle bakacagım hotel olacak. Cok tesekkurler"
translated_text: "Friendly team, clean rooms. Breakfast was sufficient, it is very good to have a private parking space. Proximity to the gym is an advantage for the gymnastics championship. When the championship is held again, it will definitely be the hotel I will look at. Thank you very much."

review_text: "Beş Yildiz 10 numara . Her şey olmasi gerektigi gibiydi. Tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "Five Stars, number 10. Everything was as it should be. I recommend it."

review_text: "Hôtel propre et confortable dans l'ensemble. En revanche isolation à revoir, on entend tous se qui se passe dans les chambres d'à côté. Parking gratuit appréciable mais pas très grand (places limitées) ni facile d'accès. Centre historique accessible à pied en 20-30min. PDJ inclus correcte mais sans grand choix. Climatisation et frigo se coupent lorsque vous n'êtes pas dans la chambre car fonctionnent avec la clef, dommage surtout lorsqu'il fait 42°c dehors !"
translated_text: "Clean and comfortable hotel overall. On the other hand, insulation needs to be reviewed, we can all hear what is happening in the rooms next door. Free parking is appreciable but not very large (limited spaces) nor easy to access. Historic center accessible on foot in 20-30 minutes. Breakfast included OK but without much choice. Air conditioning and fridge turn off when you are not in the room because they work with the key, a shame especially when it's 42°C outside!"

review_text: "Für diese Preis hier vier Nächte hätte abisschen mehr drauf liegen das Geld und bin direkt am Strand"
translated_text: "For this price, four nights here would have a little more money and I'm right on the beach"

review_text: "Temiz, sıcakkanlı görevlilerin olduğu butik küçük bir otel, kahvalti doyurucu, araba için otopark olmasa da otel önünde çok fazla boşluk oluyor , çarşaflar ve odalar temiz. Havuz yeterli yaklaşık 160 boyunda. Sadece yastıklar yüksek ve rahat değil, başka seçenek de yok, arabayla gelenler yanında getirebilir. onun dışında memnun kaldık önerilir. Fiyat performans 8/10"
translated_text: "It's a small boutique hotel that is clean and has friendly staff. The breakfast is satisfying. Even though there is no parking lot for the car, there is plenty of space in front of the hotel. The sheets and rooms are clean. The pool is adequate, approximately 160 meters long. Only the pillows are high and comfortable, there is no other option, those who come by car can bring it with them. Apart from that, we were satisfied. Price-performance is 8/10."

review_text: "Virkelig sød og hjælpsom personale især Mehmet generelt alle personer var meget hjælpsom og imødekommende"
translated_text: "Really nice and helpful staff especially Mehmet in general all people were very helpful and welcoming"

review_text: "Ailelerin tercih edilmesi gereken tek yer olabilir ilgilenmeleri olsun temizlik konfor çok güzeldi ve rahattı sayelerinde çok mutlu bi tatil geçirdik teşekkür ediyoruz"
translated_text: "It may be the only place to be preferred by families. Their attention to detail, cleanliness and comfort was very nice and comfortable. Thanks to them, we had a very happy holiday. Thank you."

review_text: "3 gece kaldık. Sanirim aile işletiyor. Çok sıcak kanlı insanlar. Memnun kaldık, tavsiye ederim. Tuncelili arkadaşa selamlar."
translated_text: "We stayed for 3 nights. I think it is run by a family. They are very friendly people. We were satisfied, I recommend it. Greetings to a friend from Tunceli."

review_text: "방디컨션이 좋않지니습다."
translated_text: “The room condition is not good.”

review_text: "Réponds à mes attentes."
translated_text: “Meet my expectations.”

review_text: "À quelque pas de la plage de Konyaaltı .Personnel au top"
translated_text: “A few steps from Konyaaltı beach. Top staff”

review_text: "Hiç tavsiye etmiyorum şimdiye kadar konakladığım en iğrenç oteldi başka odanın klima motor bizim balkondaydı klimalar eski ve çok gürültü yapıyor"
translated_text: "I do not recommend it at all. It was the most disgusting hotel I have ever stayed in. The air conditioning motor of another room was on our balcony. The air conditioners are old and make a lot of noise."

review_text: "Calisanlar cok guler yuzlu ve yardimci, kat gorevlilerinden resepsiyona kadar tum calisanlar samimi bir sekilde cabaliyorlar. Temizligi acisindan hicbir sorun yasamadim, otel biraz eski ama. 1990 lardan bir tarz hala korunuyor gibi. Odalardaki her sey kaliteli kullanisli iyi markalardan urunler fakat eskiler. Sanirim tekrar tercih etmem ama birkac gunlugune kalmakta da hicbir sorun yok."
translated_text: "The staff is very friendly and helpful, all the employees, from the housekeeping staff to the reception, work in a sincere manner. I had no problems with its cleanliness, the hotel is a bit old, but it seems like it is still preserving a style from the 1990s. Everything in the rooms is of high quality, useful products from good brands, but they are old. I think I would not choose it again, but there is no problem in staying for a few days."

review_text: "Hotel avec rapport qualité-prix imbattable"
translated_text: “Hotel with unbeatable value for money”

review_text: "Alles ok"
translated_text: "Everything okay"

review_text: "War alles gut:)"
translated_text: "Everything was good :)"

review_text: "İdare eder"
translated_text: "It will do"

review_text: "Ein preiswertes hotel. Bereits zwei Aufenthalte dort gehabt, bei beiden nichts anzuwenden. Zimmer sind sauber und ausreichend ausgestattet mit Föhn, Kühlschrank, Wasser und Wasserkocher. Wenn man Glück hat bekommt man ein größeres Zimmer mit einem Balkon mit Blick aufs Meer, ansonsten gibt's kleinere Zimmer mit einem seitlichem Blick ohne Balkon. Frühstück nichts besonders aber vollkommen ausreichend. Der Pool war immer leer.."
translated_text: "An inexpensive hotel. I've already stayed there twice, but nothing to use in both. Rooms are clean and adequately equipped with a hairdryer, fridge, water and kettle. If you're lucky you'll get a larger room with a balcony overlooking the sea, otherwise there are smaller rooms with a side view without a balcony. Breakfast nothing special but perfectly adequate. The pool was always empty.."

review_text: "Bra budgethotell. Trevlig personal och perfekt läge. Rent och rummet städades var dag. Normal frukost för ett hotell i Turkiet. Det enda jag har att anmärka på är att Internetuppkopplingen var usel."
translated_text: "Good budget hotel. Nice staff and perfect location. Clean and the room was cleaned every day. Normal breakfast for a hotel in Turkey. The only thing I have to complain about is that the Internet connection was lousy."

review_text: "Schreckliches Hotel seit 30 Jahren fast nichts investiert Nur zum Schlafen ok"
translated_text: "Terrible hotel, almost nothing invested in 30 years. Only ok for sleeping"

review_text: "Ich möchte Leute, die einen Aufenthalt in diesem Hotel reserviert haben, warnen: Das Hotel organisiert einen Taxitransport vom Flughafen zum Hotel für eine Hin- und Rückfahrt für 25 Euro pro Strecke. Seien Sie vorsichtig mit dem Transportfahrer, er akzeptiert den Betrag von 25 Euro nicht verlangt 30 Euro, abgesehen davon, dass er ein aggressiver Mensch ist und nicht beim Tragen einer Tasche hilft. Ich empfehle Ihnen, sich selbst ein Taxi zu organisieren, es kostet ungefähr 250 Lira in Euro, es wären also 8 bis 9 Euro. Das Zimmer im Hotel Olbia war sehr klein, alt und roch extrem nach Zigaretten, für Familien mit Kindern nicht zu empfehlen, Herr Ahmet bot mir ein Apartment an der Seite des Hotels an, es war sehr schön, groß, sauber, aber ich musste 210 Euro erhöhen. Das Frühstück war sehr einfach, es gab keine verschiedenen Brotsorten, aber köstliche Wassermelone."
translated_text: "I would like to warn people who have reserved a stay in this hotel: the hotel organizes taxi transport from the airport to the hotel for a round trip for 25 euros each way. Be careful with the transport driver, he accepts the amount of 25 euros and does not ask for 30 euros, in addition to being an aggressive person and not helping to carry a bag. I recommend you organize a taxi yourself, it costs about 250 lira in euros, so it would be 8 to 9 euros. This Room in Hotel Olbia was very small, old and smelled extremely of cigarettes, not recommended for families with children, Mr. Ahmet offered me an apartment on the side of the hotel, it was very nice, big, clean, but I had to pay 210 euros. Breakfast was very simple, there were no different types of bread, but delicious watermelon."

review_text: "Gut"
translated_text: "Gut"

review_text: "İş seyahatinde bir gece kaldım. Konum itibari ile çok iyi. personel ilgiliydi. Küçük olsa da bir havuzu vardı, denize gitmeye üşenenler için iyi bir alternatif."
translated_text: "I stayed for one night on a business trip. The location is very good. The staff was friendly. Although it was small, it had a pool, a good alternative for those who are too lazy to go to the sea."

review_text: "Odalar apart ev konforunda. Bir mutfakta olması gereken herşey var. ( Kettle, filtre kahve makinesi, ocak, büyük buzdolabı, tabak çanak, hatta tencere tava, her türlü bardak). Tv ler akıllı tv. Ben netflix ve prime hesabımı açtım. Dinlendiğimiz zamanlarda film izledik. Banyoda çamaşır makinesi bile var. Personel ilgili ve güleryüzlü. Odalar tertemiz, pırıl pırı. Balkonu var. Küçük bir havuzu var. Biz Denizi kullandık genelde. Deniz 300 m uzaklıkta. Otel odalarında konfor bulamayan. Daha çok ev tadında bir tatil yapmak isteyenler için tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "The rooms have the comfort of an apart house. There is everything a kitchen should have (kettle, filter coffee machine, stove, large refrigerator, crockery, even pots and pans, all kinds of glasses). The TVs are smart TVs. I opened my Netflix and Prime account. We watched movies when we rested. There is even a washing machine in the bathroom. The staff is attentive and friendly. The rooms are spotless, sparkling clean. It has a balcony. It has a small pool. We usually used the sea. The sea is 300 m away. "I recommend it for those who cannot find the comfort of hotel rooms and want to have a more home-like holiday."

review_text: "Hotel ziet er goed uit kamers zijn schoon en modern minpunt van de kamer is dat de wasmachine en droger niet tegelijk werkte. Locatie is perfect je zit 5 min lopen van Konyalti beach. Personeel helaas iets minder er werdt gelijk een opmerking gemaakt toen we zijden dat we turks waren dat we niet echt turks zijn omdat we uit europa komen"
translated_text: "Hotel looks good, rooms are clean and modern. The downside of the room is that the washing machine and dryer did not work at the same time. Location is perfect, you are a 5-minute walk from Konyalti beach. Staff unfortunately a little less, a comment was immediately made when we said that we were Turkish that we are not really Turkish because we come from Europe"

review_text: "Çok samimi sıcak bir ortam . Çalışanlar cana yakın . Kesinlikle bir dha gideceğim 😊"
translated_text: "It is a very friendly and warm environment. The employees are friendly. I will definitely go again 😊"

review_text: "Vi var familj med 3barn. Väldigt rena rum och bra bemötande av personalen."
translated_text: "We were a family with 3 children. Very clean rooms and good treatment by the staff."

review_text: "Yeni eşyalar, temiz oda ve banyo, yeterli mutfak, yeni klimalar. Yatak odasında jakuzi mükemmeldi."
translated_text: "New furnishings, clean room and bathroom, adequate kitchen, new air conditioners. Jacuzzi in the bedroom was perfect."

review_text: "Otel cok guzel odalar temiz ve konforlu. Kendimizi evimizde hissettik. Odamizda hersey eksiksizdi ve yeni temizdi. Cok memnun kaldik birdaha antalyaya gelirsen tercih edecegim tek yer. Personel ilgili hepsine tesekkur ederim."
translated_text: "The hotel is very nice, the rooms are clean and comfortable. We felt at home. Everything in our room was complete and new. We were very pleased. If you come to Antalya again, it is the only place I will choose. I would like to thank all the staff."

review_text: "Bra standard og god service. Kort vei til Flyplassen. Hyggelig beliggenhet med stor park ved sjøen."
translated_text: "Good standard and good service. Short distance to the Airport. Pleasant location with a large park by the sea."

review_text: "Sehr Kinderfreundlich uns als Familie hats hier sehr gefallen sehr gute Personal☆☆☆☆☆"
translated_text: "Very child-friendly, we as a family really liked it here, very good staff☆☆☆☆☆"

review_text: "Duşakabinin bir camı olmadığından her yer ıslandı. Odaya havlu bırakılmamış. Plaj otele 6km uzaklıkta"
translated_text: "The shower cabin did not have a glass, so everything got wet. No towels were left in the room. The beach is 6 km away from the hotel."

review_text: "Gayet temiz ve konforlu kahvaltısı yeterli."
translated_text: "Very clean and comfortable, breakfast is sufficient."

review_text: "Odaları çok dardı,sürekli müşterilere aynı kahvaltı çeşitleri veriyorlar hatta 1 gün önceden kalan yiyecekleri ertesi gün tekrar verdiler ve yiyecekler bozulmaya yüz tutmuştu,hamamdan faydalanmak istiyorsun ama söyledikleri saatler tutmuyor mesela hamam kapanış saati 22:00 ama 21:00'da kapatıyorlar hiç kimseye tavsiye etmem gelmeyin"
translated_text: "The rooms were very narrow, they always serve the same breakfast types to the customers, they even gave the leftover food from the day before again the next day and the food was about to spoil. You want to use the bath, but the hours they say do not keep, for example, the closing time of the bath is 22:00, but they close at 21:00. I do not recommend it to anyone, do not come."

review_text: "Foi somente uma noite, mas agradável. Quarto limpo( apesar do cheiro a cigarro), camas confortáveis, a piscina era gostosa, apesar de coberta. De modo geral, salvou por uma parte nossas férias na Turquia, que se mostrou uma desilusão."
translated_text: "It was only one night, but pleasant. Clean room (despite the smell of cigarettes), comfortable beds, the pool was nice, despite being covered. Overall, it saved our holiday in Turkey, which turned out to be a disappointment."

review_text: "Güzel bi oteldi ailemle 2 gece kaldım gayet güler yüzlü çalışanları vardı lakin annemle yukarı çıkmak için merdiven sorduğum beyfendi sert bi tavır takındı ve asansör orda dedi garipti"
translated_text: "It was a nice hotel, I stayed with my family for 2 nights, it had very friendly staff, but the gentleman I asked about the stairs to go up with my mother had a harsh attitude and said the elevator was there, which was strange."

review_text: "Sehr sehr schmutzig"
translated_text: "Very very dirty"

review_text: "Yataklar berbat temizlik kötü kahvaltı berbat"
translated_text: "Beds are terrible, cleaning is bad, breakfast is terrible"

review_text: "Alles super"
translated_text: “Come on great”

review_text: "İlgili , temiz , konforlu idi. Her şey olması gerektiği gibi."
translated_text: "It was professional, clean and comfortable. Everything is as it should be."

review_text: "An sich alles klassisch aber das schlimmste war, dass ich ein Zimmer bekommen habe, wo geraucht wurde. Als nicht Raucher ein no go. Bei meiner Beschwerde musste ich fast diskutieren, dass ich ein Recht auf ein nicht Raucher Zimmer habe. Ich bin dann auf einem Zimmer zugeteilt, wo es weniger nach Rauch stank. Auch der SPA Bereich stank nach rauch. Ich gehe davon aus, dass überall in dem Hotel geraucht wurde und das normal angesehen wird. Bad!"
translated_text: "Everything was classic in itself, but the worst thing was that I was given a room where there was smoking. As a non-smoker, that was a no go. When I complained, I almost had to argue that I had the right to a non-smoking room. I was then assigned to a room where it smelled less of smoke. The SPA area also smelled of smoke. I assume that there was smoking everywhere in the hotel and that is considered normal. Bathroom!"

review_text: "Das Lupo Libero Hotel liegt sehr zentral in der Nähe des Mark Antaly Shopping Centers und ist in 2 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar, ebenso der Old Bazar. Der Konyaalti Strand ist mit der historischen Tram in ca. 20 Minuten entspannt erreichbar, da sich Bus und Tram-Stationen ebenfalls in der Nähe befinden. Zum Hotel selbst kann ich das sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Personal loben, das jederzeit Auskunft auf Fragen gibt. Die Zimmer entsprechen genau den Fotos der Internet-Präsentation und sind sauber, es wird jeden Tag gereinigt und die Handtücher werden gewechselt. Einziges Minus, denn es gibt kaum Möglichkeiten die Handtücher im Bad aufzuhängen und auch im Zimmer sind diese sehr begrenzt. Das Frühstück ist sehr reichhaltig und abwechslungsreich und man steht sicher nicht hungrig auf. Alles in allem war es ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt und ich kann dieses Hotel auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen."
translated_text: "The Lupo Libero Hotel is very centrally located near the Mark Antaly Shopping Center and can be reached in 2 minutes on foot, as can the Old Bazar. The Konyaalti Beach can be easily reached with the historic tram in about 20 minutes, as bus and tram stations are also nearby. Regarding the hotel itself, I can praise the very friendly and helpful staff, who are always available to answer questions. The rooms correspond exactly to the photos on the internet presentation and are clean, it is cleaned every day Cleaned and the towels are changed. The only negative is that there are hardly any options to hang the towels in the bathroom and there are also very few of them in the room. The breakfast is very rich and varied and you definitely won't get up hungry. All in all, it was a very pleasant stay and I can definitely recommend this hotel."

review_text: "Leider bietet das Hotel gute und sehr schlechte Zimmer im Keller an. Mir wurde ein solches Zimmer angeboten. Es riecht feucht, es gibt kein Fenster im Zimmer. Nur ein kleines Fenster hoch oben unter der Decke. Dieses Zimmer ist nicht für Allergiker geeignet. Bitte entfernen Sie diese Option. Am zweiten Tag hat mir eine sehr freundliche Dame an der Rezeption ein anderes Zimmer angeboten. Ein sehr gutes Zimmer mit Fenster."
translated_text: "Unfortunately the hotel offers good and very bad rooms in the basement. I was offered a room like this. It smells damp, there is no window in the room. Only a small window high up under the ceiling. This room is not suitable for allergy sufferers. Please remove this option. On the second day a very friendly lady at the reception offered me another room. A very good room with a window."

review_text: "War im im Großen und Ganzen gut"
translated_text: "Overall it was good"

review_text: "La estancia bien.. el hotel es correcto y calidad precio es buena.. la atencion de los chicos de recepción es muy buena, amables y siempre dispuestos, la unica chica que atiende es prepotente maleducada y siempre le molestan las consultas de los clientes.. muy borde"
translated_text: "The stay was good... the hotel is correct and quality-price is good... the attention of the guys at the reception is very good, friendly and always ready, the only girl who serves is arrogant, rude and is always bothered by customer queries... very rude"

review_text: "ara sokak arasında bir yer. resepsiyona koydukları personel yeni işe girmiş. ne söylesen sorayım diyor. Oda havasız. ağır bir koku var . camı açsanız dışardan başka koku var. banyo küçük. duş başlığı bozuk. terlik yok. her şeyi tek tek istiyeceksin. Tek iyi tarafı merkeze yakın olması. Ama iyi araştırırsan aynı paraya daha iyiler vardı. tavsiye etmem"
translated_text: "It's somewhere in a side street. The staff they put at the reception has just started working. They ask me whatever you want. The room is stuffy. There is a strong smell. If you open the window, there is another smell from outside. The bathroom is small. The shower head is broken. There are no slippers. You will want everything one by one. The only good thing is that it is close to the center. But if you search carefully, there are better ones for the same price. I would not recommend it."

review_text: "Sehr freundliches Personal gute saubere Zimmer nur in der nähe des Fahrstuhls nachts hört man diesen"
translated_text: "Very friendly staff, good clean rooms, you can only hear it near the elevator at night"

review_text: "Einige Zimmer hatten einen komischen Geruch. Ansonsten ist das Hotel ok."
translated_text: "Some rooms had a strange smell. Otherwise the hotel was ok."

review_text: "Tatilimizde otelden genel olarak çok memnun kaldık. Otel oldukça temizdi ve çalışanlar hem güler yüzlü hem de samimiydi. Karşılamada Uğur Bey’in misafirperverliği bizi çok mutlu etti, kat görevlisi Ayten Hanım ise son derece kibar ve nazikti. Her gün odamız düzenli olarak temizlendi ve çarşaflar değiştirildi, bu detay bizim için çok önemliydi. Alakart restoranın yemekleri gerçekten lezzetliydi. Kahvaltı da yeterli çeşitliliğe sahipti ve doyurucuydu. Keyifli ve huzurlu bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık, teşekkür ederiz."
translated_text: "We were generally very pleased with the hotel during our holiday. The hotel was very clean and the staff were friendly and sincere. We were very happy with Mr. Uğur's hospitality in the welcome, and Ms. Ayten, the housekeeper, was extremely polite and courteous. Our room was cleaned regularly and the sheets were changed every day, this detail was very important to us. The food of the à la carte restaurant was really delicious. The breakfast had sufficient variety and was satisfying. We had a pleasant and peaceful accommodation experience, thank you."

review_text: "Odalar temiz,güzel ve özenli döşenmiş, konyaaltı merkeze ve plajlara çok yakın, gelmek isteyenlere tavsiye edilir."
translated_text: "The rooms are clean, beautifully and carefully furnished, very close to Konyaaltı center and beaches, recommended to those who want to come."

review_text: "1 günlük haftasonu tatili için geldik. Odalar temizdi. Kahvaltı lezzetliydi."
translated_text: "We came for a 1-day weekend holiday. The rooms were clean. The breakfast was delicious."

review_text: "Harika bir yer"
translated_text: "Great place"

review_text: "Odamıza istediğimiz havlular biraz kirliydi onun dışında bir sıkıntımız yoktu, kahvaltı bol çeşitli"
translated_text: "The towels we asked for in our room were a little dirty, other than that we had no problems, the breakfast was plentiful and varied"

review_text: "Das Personal war ziemlich unfreundlich..absolutes no go! Wir haben fast unseren Flug verpasst, weil wir trotz vorheriger Absprache und Bestätigung eines Transfers plötzlich morgens um 4 Uhr kein Fahrzeug hatten. Der Rezeptionist war dann noch so dreist und hat dem zuständigen Taxi-Unternehmen mitgeteilt kein Fahrzeug zu schicken. Wir waren als Familie unterwegs und anstatt uns zu helfen, hat man uns alles noch erschwert, trotz eines Fehlers ihrerseits. Deshalb absolut nicht zu empfehlen!"
translated_text: "The staff was pretty unfriendly...absolute no go! We almost missed our flight because, despite prior arrangement and confirmation of a transfer, we suddenly didn't have a vehicle at 4 a.m. The receptionist was so bold and told the responsible taxi company not to send a vehicle. We were traveling as a family and instead of helping us, they made everything even more difficult for us, despite a mistake on their part. Therefore, absolutely not recommended!"

review_text: "Gerçekten müşteri iletişimi ve ilişkileri çok güzel. Odalar temiz ve konforlu. Sürekli aaa bunda düşünmüşler dediğim detaylarla karşılaştım. Havuzu bir butik otel için ideal boyutlara sahip. Bence olması gereken 1- Keşke televizyonlarda Netflix-Disney veya YouTube uygulamalarını açabilseydik. 2-Akşam yemeğini otelde yemek isterdim fakat biraz tuzlu geldi."
translated_text: "Customer communication and relations are really good. The rooms are clean and comfortable. I constantly come across details that make me think they have thought of this. The pool has ideal dimensions for a boutique hotel. I think it should be 1- I wish we could open Netflix-Disney or YouTube applications on the televisions. 2- I would like to have dinner at the hotel, but it was a little salty."

review_text: "Undvik! Riktigt dålig skick med små gamla rum, dålig service och obekväm säng. Verkligen inte rent och luktade väldigt illa. Är inte alls likt bilderna. Vi fick byta hotell"
translated_text: "Avoid! Really bad condition with small old rooms, bad service and uncomfortable bed. Really not clean and smelled very bad. Not at all like the pictures. We had to change hotels"

review_text: "Frühstück von 5/3 Sterne Restaurant heiß keine Klimaanlage die Sachen sind nicht gekühlt Auswahl wenig aber okay Reinigung super. Rezeption die jungs unten super der ältere Herr unfreundlich und desinteressiert von seinem Job. Die Lage ist super."
translated_text: "Breakfast from 5/3 star restaurant hot no air conditioning the things are not cooled selection little but okay cleaning great. Reception the guys downstairs great the older gentleman unfriendly and disinterested in his job. The location is great."

review_text: "Birincisi görseller ile gerçek arasında çok fark vardı lütfen görselleri detaylı ve düzgün verin...yataklar çok rahatsız akşam her bir bölgeden klima dış ünite sesi gelmekte camlar kapalıyken ...kahvaltısı iyiydi ama kahvaltı yaptığımıź alan 40 dereceydi yani konya altı plajına yakın olması haricinde hiçbir özelliği yok bunu söylerken normal şartlar bile yok düşünün camın biri otopark ve çöplüge bakıyor digeri duvara aciliyor bukadar. Aldıgı parayı gerçekten haketmiyor"
translated_text: "First of all, there was a big difference between the visuals and the reality, please provide the visuals in detail and accurately... The beds are very uncomfortable. In the evening, the sound of the air conditioner and external unit can be heard from every area when the windows are closed... The breakfast was good, but the area where I had breakfast was 40 degrees, so it has no special features other than being close to Konyaaltı beach. While I say this, there are not even normal conditions. Imagine that one of the windows is facing the parking lot and garbage dump, the other one opens to the wall. He really does not deserve the money he gets."

review_text: "Excelente ubicación, limpio. Personal amable"
translated_text: "Excellent location, clean. Friendly staff"

review_text: "Yorumlarla pek alakalı durum göremedim. Otel çalışanları güler yüzlü ve ilgili. Ama bunun dışında yorumlarda bahsedilen sadece konumu doğru olan. Öncelikle lobiden odalara çıkmak için geçtiğiniz koridora mutfak kapıları açılıyor. Çok pis bir koku var ıslaklık rutubetle karışık bir koku. Kahvaltı mevzusu zaten fiyasko. Otelin alt katındaki ciğerciyle birleşik bir salon var. Sabah kahvaltınızı yaptığınız yerde öğleden itibaren ciğercinin müşterilerine ait. Kahvaltı deseniz ilk gün maydonozun üstünde sinekler geziniyordu. Tabaklarda çıkmaz lekeler var. Çatal bıçaklar aynı şekilde kirli olanlar vardı. Otelin lobi koridorunda olan koku açık büfeden de geliyor. Kokudan dolayı mide bulantısıyla tabağıma birkaç bir şey de alsam yiyemedim. Kaldığım oda 1.kattı balkon dedikleri yere koydunları masa ve sandalye bile zor sığmıştı. Balkon seviyesi odadan üstteydi. Akşam balkon kapısı açık bıramadım çünkü alt kattaki ciğerciğinin üst koruması direkt balkonuma bağlıydı. Çok güvensiz bir ortam yani. Oda çok kullanışsızdı. Ayna ile yatak arasında yürüyecek kadar alan bile yoktu. Odada tv yoktu. Tek iyi şey klimasıydı. Yarım manzaralı diye tutmuştum ama yan cephe olmasına rağmen manzara sadece duvarlardı. O lobiden her odaya çıkıştaki kokuyu unutamıyorum .2 günlüğüne 8.900 tl ödedim ama değmez bu paraya çok daha iyi oteller var bölgede. Kahvaltısı inanılmaz kötü. Hijyen asla yok."
translated_text: "I couldn't see anything related to the comments. The hotel staff are friendly and attentive. But other than that, the only thing mentioned in the comments is the correct location. First of all, the kitchen doors open to the corridor you pass through to get to the rooms from the lobby. There is a very bad smell, a smell mixed with wetness. The breakfast issue is already a fiasco. There is a lounge combined with the liver restaurant on the ground floor of the hotel. The place where you have your breakfast in the morning belongs to the customers of the liver restaurant from the afternoon. If you talk about breakfast, the first day there were flies crawling on the parsley. There were dirty stains on the plates. The smell in the lobby corridor of the hotel was also coming from the open buffet. I couldn't even eat a few things on my plate because of the smell. The room I stayed in was on the first floor, and even the table and chair they put on the balcony were at the top level. I couldn't leave the balcony door open in the evening because the upper protection of the lung on the lower floor was directly connected to my balcony. The room was very unusable. There wasn't even enough space to walk between the mirror and the bed. The only good thing was the air conditioning. Even though it was on the side, the view was only on the walls. I paid 8,900 TL for 2 days, but there are much better hotels in the region. The breakfast is incredibly bad."

review_text: "Güzel manzaraya sahipti"
translated_text: "It had a beautiful view"

review_text: "Konum konyaaltında çok kalabalık bayram olması sebebi ile yoğundu"
translated_text: "The location was very crowded in Konyaaltı due to the holiday."

review_text: "Vraiment un bel hôtel, propre, avec des réceptionnistes sympa et à l’écoute, un très bel emplacement en face de la mer de Konyalti, une vue très magique, à côté de restaurants et cafés, 20 mètres à pied de la plage."
translated_text: "Really a nice hotel, clean, with friendly and attentive receptionists, a very beautiful location in front of the Konyalti sea, a very magical view, next to restaurants and cafes, 20 meters walk from the beach."

review_text: "Sehr schönen Aussicht aber die Zimmern sind für 2 Personen sehr klein und der Fernseher Funktion teilweise."
translated_text: "Very nice view but the rooms are very small for 2 people and the TV doesn't work at all."

review_text: "Au départ nous avons prévu être au même étage, mais malheureusement ce n'était pas le cas. Pour le reste l'accueil au top, et le séjour était bien agréable."
translated_text: "Initially we planned to be on the same floor, but unfortunately that was not the case. Otherwise the welcome was top notch, and the stay was very pleasant."

review_text: "Das Zimmer war schmutzig, Bettwäsche wurde nicht gewechselt. Handtücher voll von Flecken!!, Außerdem die Personal waren unfreundlich leider!"
translated_text: "The room was dirty, bed linen wasn't changed. Towels were full of stains!!, and the staff were unfriendly unfortunately!"

review_text: "Otel gayet iyiydi fakat otopark yanıltıyor.Çünkü otoparka otelde kalanlar dışında da herkes parkedebiliyor ve neredeyse hep dolu."
translated_text: "The hotel was very good, but the parking lot is misleading. Because everyone except those staying at the hotel can park in the car park and it is almost always full."

review_text: "Odamız temiz ve konforluydu. Her gün temizlik yapıldı. Kahvaltı iyi diyebilirim. Halk plaji hemen önünde. (İsterseniz yaninda ücretli plajda mevcut) Şehir merkezine otobüs ile gidebiliyorsun. Biz temizligi ve konumu olarak memnun kaldık. Teşekkürler."
translated_text: "Our room was clean and comfortable. It was cleaned every day. I can say that the breakfast was good. It is right in front of the public beach. (There is a paid beach next to it if you want) You can go to the city center by bus. We were satisfied with its cleanliness and location. Thank you."

review_text: "Guter Standort"
translated_text: "Good location"

review_text: "Çok memnun kaldık genel olarak, otel temizdi kahvaltı çok güzeldi, çalışanların hepsi çok efendilerde, sadece temizlik konusunda eksikler var çarşaflar hiç değiştirilmedi. Ayrıca koridorda halı olmasa daha güzel olurdu."
translated_text: "We were very pleased in general, the hotel was clean, the breakfast was very nice, all the employees were very polite, the only thing missing was the cleanliness, the sheets were never changed. Also, it would have been better if there was no carpet in the corridor."

review_text: "Es war schon alles sehr gut. Am anfang war ich entteuscht aber nächste Tag hat sich alles geändert. War sehr nette service, hilfreiche mitarbeiter sehr gute Lage. Ich bin mit allem sehr sehr zufrieden…"
translated_text: "Everything was very good. At the beginning I was disappointed but the next day everything changed. The service was very nice, helpful staff, very good location. I am very, very satisfied with everything..."

review_text: "Ein sehr schönes und sauberes Hotel. Nettes Personal, nah am Strand und der Pool war auch toll! Jeden Tag wurde unser Bett frisch bezogen, alles wurde sauber gemacht. Sehr nettes Personal! Leider hat uns das Frühstück nicht so geschmeckt. Sonst war alles perfekt."
translated_text: "A very nice and clean hotel. Nice staff, close to the beach and the pool was great too! Our bed was freshly made every day, everything was cleaned. Very nice staff! Unfortunately we didn't like the breakfast that much. Otherwise everything was perfect."

review_text: "Meget tæt på stranden ."
translated_text: "Very close to the beach."

review_text: "Ich werde nochmals kommen wenn ich wieder in dem ungebung bin"
translated_text: "I'll come again when I'm in that area again"

review_text: "Una sobredosis de humo de cigarrillo te recibe al entrar al lobby del hotel (costumbre turca de fumar y fumar en cualquier lado). Creímos que eran huéspedes que estaban en el lobby pero al poco tiempo nos dimos cuenta que eran los administradores y su familia (otra costumbre turca, la familia del administrador vive o utiliza las instalaciones como si viviera en el lugar). La habitación es normal pero por ejemplo la heladera estaba sucia y no funcionaba. El baño tenía hongos. Lo peor empezó al otro día cuando fuimos al desayuno que pagamos aparte… 3 fetas de fiambre, una ensalada de papas, algunos huevos (viejos), y jugos en botellas apretadas de plastico que se toma en viejos vasos de ..plástico… más algunas manzanas. Perdimos los 4 desayunos más porque era lo mismo. Cuando quisimos consultar por la heladera nos encontramos con una pareja durmiendo en el sillón. Cada vez que bajamos esa mañana. Y así todos los días el sillón del lobby lleno de gente (la familia de administradores) que estaban comiendo fumando y durmiendo… tampoco hicieron el servicio de limpieza ningún día, ni nos cambiaron las toallas, papel, sábanas. Ni sacaron la basura. Pésimo servicio. Y lo peor que dan la impresión de no importarles nada. A veces son hasta 7 u 8 personas ahí pasando el día y me pregunto si no podrían manejar mejor el hotel. Skjønner at dette er et billig hotell, men at renhold skal være på plass, men det var det ikke."
translated_text: "Bad cleaning. Some of our rooms had blood stains, remnants of condoms and other things. It was simply bad cleaning. They took several days and fussing from our side before they cleaned the rooms. The toilet was broken, was simply not attached to the floor. The shower head was broken. I understand that this is a cheap hotel, but that cleaning should be in place, but it wasn't."

review_text: "Merkezi konumda fiyatına göre mükemmel güler yüzlü"
translated_text: "Centrally located, excellent and friendly for the price"

review_text: "Rummen är nyrenoverade men saker är en touch ifrån att falla isär. Dem är ej strikta med att man ej får röka i rummet, vårt rum luktade rök överallt, hela familjen fick illamående, lukten försvann aldrig. Rekommenderar att du stannar här max 2 nätter. Dem skyllde på att kaffet var slut när flera gäster klagade, det finns flera affärer i närheten, man kan lösa kaffe på 10 minuter. Annars väldigt centralt, nära till MarkAntalya, restauranger och andra affärer. Dem har installerat ljussensor i badrummet, det släcks varje 15 sekunder, jag fick gå ut ur duschen och vifta med handen hela tiden annars blev det kolsvart. Min väns rum hade väldigt dålig belysning, det var nästan mörkt i rummet. Frukosten är helt ok."
translated_text: "The rooms are newly renovated but things are a touch away from falling apart. They are not strict about no smoking in the room, our room smelled of smoke everywhere, the whole family felt nauseous, the smell never went away. Recommend you stay here for a maximum of 2 nights. They blamed that the coffee was out when several guests complained, there are several shops nearby, you can get coffee in 10 minutes. Otherwise very central, close to MarkAntalya, restaurants and others shops. They have installed a light sensor in the bathroom, it goes off every 15 seconds, I had to get out of the shower and wave my hand the whole time. My friend's room had very bad lighting, it was almost dark in the room."

review_text: "Hotellet uppnår inte kriterierna för fyrstjärnigt hotell då det var så äckliga rum med ofräscha badrum. Däremot var personalen trevliga och hjälpsamma."
translated_text: "The hotel does not meet the criteria for a four-star hotel as there were such disgusting rooms with stale bathrooms. However, the staff were nice and helpful."

review_text: "Ortalama temizlige sahip oda. Konforunda sikinti yok ama klimalar temizlenmemis ve bogaz enfeksiyonu geçirdik. Bir gün daha kalamadik hastalandigimiz icin"
translated_text: "The room was averagely clean. There was no problem in its comfort, but the air conditioners were not cleaned and we had a throat infection. We couldn't stay another day because we got sick."

review_text: "Hotelpersoneel was weg behulpzaam"
translated_text: "Hotel staff was extremely helpful"

review_text: "Konum olarak merkezi bir yerde tramvay önünden geçiyor otobüs de çok yakınında yürüme mesafesinde çoğu yere bu açıdan güzeldi fakat günlük temizliği yok resepsiyon ilgisiz odalarda fotoğraflardaki gibi büyük değil kutu gibi yan odayla birlikte kaldık sanki her konuşulan duyuluyordu"
translated_text: "The location is central, the tram is in front of it, the bus is very close, walking distance to most places, it was nice in this respect, but there is no daily cleaning, the reception is irrelevant, the rooms are not as big as in the photos, we stayed with the room next door, which was like a box, it was as if every conversation could be heard."

review_text: "otelin 4 yıldızlı olarak geçtiğine emin miyiz ? otelde kettle bile yoktu berbat kokuyordu ve asla temiz değildi bir daha geldiğimde burada asla kalmam…"
translated_text: "Are we sure that the hotel is a 4-star hotel? There wasn't even a kettle in the hotel, it smelled awful and was never clean. I will never stay here again when I come back..."

review_text: "L'accueil de l'hôtel est le seul endroit correct. A l'arrivée, nous aurions dis que notre chambre n'avait même pas été nettoyé. Les lits étaient fait mais ce n'était pas propre, la poubelle de la salle de bain n'avait pas été vidé et la douche pas nettoyée, il y avait encore un shampoing utilisé. La femme de chambre de passe pas sauf si vous faites la demande à l'accueil. Un cafard mort est resté 2 jours devant l'ascenseur sans même que quelqu'un le retire !!! Je suis vraiment très déçu de cet hôtel car j'adore la ville d'Antalya. Juste une chose de bien c'est l'emplacement, vous descendez de l'hôtel et tout est à votre portée."
translated_text: "The hotel reception is the only correct place. On arrival, we would have said that our room had not even been cleaned. The beds were made but it was not clean, the trash in the bathroom had not been emptied and the shower was not cleaned, there was still used shampoo. The maid does not come through unless you ask reception. A dead cockroach remained for 2 days in front of the elevator without anyone even checking it. withdraw!!! I'm really very disappointed with this hotel because I love the city of Antalya Just one good thing is the location, you get off the hotel and everything is within your reach."

review_text: "照片很漂亮， 但现实很失望， 房间很小有异味、窗户很小而且不通风， 卫生间很小水压力不大，洗澡是不可能， 没有热水只有常温水， 空调吹的有异味，床单没换，房间里没有电话没有开水器。不包含早餐，提供早餐另外收费一人一百里拉儿童也一样，不提供任何旅游信息， 我是在网上预定而付了全款所以咬着牙住了两天。。。 强烈不推荐！ 不要怪我没说"
translated_text: "The photos are beautiful, but the reality is very disappointing. The room is very small and smelly. The windows are small and not ventilated. The bathroom is very small and the water pressure is not high. It is impossible to take a shower. There is no hot water, only room temperature water. The air conditioner blows a strange smell. The sheets have not been changed. There is no phone or water boiler in the room. Breakfast is not included. Breakfast is provided for an additional 100 lire per person. Children are the same. No travel information is provided. I booked online and paid the full price, so I stayed there for two days... Strongly not recommended! Don't blame me for not saying anything."

review_text: "Otelin, çevre dostu işletme anlayışı ve temizlik konusunda ki hassasiyetinden dolayı çok memnun kaldık. Kahvaltı çeşit bakımından çok zengin olmasada seçilen gıda markası bizimde her zaman tercih ettiğimiz marka olması sebebiyle çok memnun kaldık. Oda tertemiz ve iç dizaynı diğer oteller tarafından örnek olabilecek düzeydeydi. Biz bir akşam kaldık. Yeniden gitmek için şimdiden bahane arıyoruz. Her detayı ince düşünülen otelin işletmecilerine teşekkür ederiz."
translated_text: "We were very pleased with the hotel's environmentally friendly business approach and its sensitivity to cleanliness. Although the breakfast was not very rich in variety, we were very pleased because the food brand chosen was the brand we always preferred. The room was spotless and its interior design was exemplary for other hotels. We stayed for one evening. We are already looking for an excuse to go again. We would like to thank the managers of the hotel, whose every detail was carefully considered."

review_text: "Kahvaltı zayıftı fakat odadan memnun kaldık"
translated_text: "Breakfast was poor but we were satisfied with the room"

review_text: "Tarihi Hadrian kapısına 2 dk yürüme mesafesinde kaleiçinde kalmak isteyenler tercih edebilirler içi temiz ve bakımlı kahvaltısını denemedik."
translated_text: "Those who want to stay in Kaleiçi, a 2-minute walk from the historical Hadrian's Gate, can choose it. The interior is clean and well-kept. We did not try the breakfast."

review_text: "Positiv: Lage, Service, Rezeption ist sehr hilfsbereit (auch über die eigentlichen Aufgaben hinaus) und sehr zuverlässig, klein aber relativ fein (Family Room 408), Kühlschrank wird täglich mit Wasser aufgefüllt, Kaffebar Nespresso, Bettenkomfort. Verbesserungswürdig: Klimaanlage kühlt nicht den gesamten Raum gleichmäßig, Bad ist viel zu klein und ein paar Kleiderhaken wären gut (Room 408), Aufzug sehr klein für Familie und Gepäck, Kissen könnten bequemer, weicher und kleiner sein (subjektiv). Etwas Obst zum Continental-Frühstück wäre gut."
translated_text: "Positive: Location, service, reception is very helpful (even beyond the actual tasks) and very reliable, small but relatively nice (Family Room 408), refrigerator is refilled with water every day, Nespresso coffee bar, bed comfort. Needs improvement: Air conditioning does not cool the entire room evenly, bathroom is far too small and a few coat hooks would be good (Room 408), elevator very small for family and luggage, pillows could be more comfortable, softer and smaller (subjective). Some fruit with the continental breakfast would be good."

review_text: "Wir hatten einen großartigen Aufenthalt! Das Hotel liegt sehr zentral alle Geschäfte, Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind bequem zu Fuß erreichbar. Alles war super: sehr freundlicher Service, saubere Zimmer und eine angenehme Atmosphäre. Besonders toll war, dass wir trotz unseres sehr frühen Abflugs ein liebevoll vorbereitetes Frühstück zum Mitnehmen bekommen haben mit frischen Sachen vom Bäcker. Eine wirklich aufmerksame Geste, die unseren Aufenthalt perfekt abgerundet hat. Vielen Dank, wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!"
translated_text: "We had a great stay! The hotel is very centrally located, all shops, restaurants and sights are within easy walking distance. Everything was great: very friendly service, clean rooms and a pleasant atmosphere. What was particularly great was that, despite our very early departure, we received a lovingly prepared breakfast to go with fresh things from the bakery. A really attentive gesture that rounded off our stay perfectly. Thank you very much, we'll be happy to come back!"

review_text: "Otelin konumu çok iyi. Yemek ve vakit geçirmek için bir çok seçeneğe yakın. Otoparkı yok fakat çok yakında otopark seçenekleri mevcut. Kahvaltı zayıf ama vaadedilenden farklı değil. Benim kaldığım odanın klima performansı iyi değildi. Odalarda değerli eşyalarınızı saklayabileceğiniz küçük bir kasa mevcut. Genel olarak 4.8/5"
translated_text: "The location of the hotel is very good. It is close to many options for eating and spending time. It does not have a parking lot, but there are parking options very close by. The breakfast is weak but not different from what was promised. The air conditioning performance of the room I stayed in was not good. There is a small safe in the rooms where you can store your valuables. Overall 4.8/5"

review_text: "Rien a dire. Rapport qualité prix imbattable ! Propre et proche de tout ."
translated_text: "Nothing to say. Unbeatable value for money! Clean and close to everything."

review_text: "Çalışanlar gayet güler yüzlüydü. Temizlik yeterli seviyedeydi. Kahvaltı biraz daha doyurucu olabilirdi ancak yeterliydi gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilirsiniz. Otelin tek sıkıntısı otopark çevrede otopark ücretleri yüksek en uygun yer şehir tiyatrolarının otoparkıydı tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "The staff was very friendly. The cleanliness was adequate. The breakfast could have been a little more satisfying, but it was enough and you can stay with peace of mind. The only problem with the hotel is parking. The parking fees in the surrounding area are high, and the most suitable place is the parking lot of the city theaters. I recommend it."

review_text: "Il y a pas mal de restaurants a proximité de l’hôtel. Les Taxi c’est pas ce qui manque aussi. Le personnel de l’hôtel est à l’écoute. Je recommande cette hôtel sans hésitation. Nous sommes venus en famille et tout s’est bien passer. Ont reviendras ♥️"
translated_text: "There are quite a few restaurants near the hotel. Taxis are also not lacking. The hotel staff is attentive. I recommend this hotel without hesitation. We came as a family and everything went well. We will come back ♥️"

review_text: "Şehir merkezinde, ulaşım çok kolay, personel ilgili, odalar yeni restore edilmiş fiyat performans dengeli bir otel"
translated_text: "It's in the city center, transportation is very easy, the staff is friendly, the rooms are newly renovated, it's a price-performance balanced hotel."

review_text: "Çok iyiydi."
translated_text: "It was very good."

review_text: "Die Lage ist Hervorragend, mitten im Zentrum. Auch die Zimmer sind bequem und ausreichend für einen Wochenendtrip. Die Mitarbeiter sind sehr nett. Kann ich sehr empfehlen!"
translated_text: "The location is excellent, right in the center. The rooms are also comfortable and sufficient for a weekend trip. The staff are very nice. I can highly recommend it!"

review_text: "Tolles Hotel mit Top Lage !"
translated_text: "Great hotel with a great location!"

review_text: "Calişanlar cok güler yüzlüydü ve konum olarak heryere yakin olmasi güzeldi :-) odalar temizdi ve teras bölümü keyifliydi... biz memnun kaldik tessekürler"
translated_text: "The staff was very friendly and it was nice to be close to everything :-) the rooms were clean and the terrace area was enjoyable... we were satisfied, thank you"

review_text: "Konumu çok güzel merkezi yerde. Birçok seyahat yapan biri olarak belirtmeliyim ki otelin içi çok güzel dizayn edilmiş ve herşey düşünülmüş içerisi ferah oda büyük lavabo banyo ayrı eşyalar için ayrı bölme bornoz terlik temizlik kitleri kesinlikle harika. Kahvaltı sadece yeterli değil onun sebebi de mutfak olmaması ama o zamanda bu fiyat yüksek olmalı yani kesinlikle harika biz çok beğendik personel de güleryüzlü."
translated_text: "The location is very good, in a central place. As someone who has traveled a lot, I must say that the interior of the hotel is very well designed and everything has been thought of. It is spacious, large sink, bathroom, separate compartment for separate belongings, bathrobes, slippers, cleaning kits. It is absolutely wonderful. The breakfast is not only sufficient, the reason for this is that there is no kitchen, but at that time, this price must be high, so it is absolutely wonderful, we liked it very much, and the staff is friendly."

review_text: "Ottimo hotel solo se viaggi a piedi. Altrimenti sei fregato come noi. Servizio discreto ma nessuno ti aiuta. Tutti i comfort eccetto finestre"
translated_text: "Excellent hotel only if you travel on foot. Otherwise you are screwed like us. Decent service but no one helps you. All the comforts except windows"

review_text: "Très belles expériences en famille dans cette établissement rien à dire, proche de tout Personnelles très gentille et agréable, Je conseille vivement"
translated_text: “Very nice family experiences in this establishment, nothing to say, close to everything Very kind and pleasant staff, I highly recommend”

review_text: "Placeret fantastisk til et byophold."
translated_text: "Great location for a city stay."

review_text: "Top Lage. Preis Leistung in Ordnung. Zimmer renoviert und modern. Nachteil ist sehr hellhörig."
translated_text: "Great location. Good value for money. Rooms renovated and modern. The downside is very noisy."

review_text: "Otopark yok teras denilen yer çok sıcak ve balkon falan yok konum çok karışık"
translated_text: "There is no parking, the place called terrace is very hot and there is no balcony, the location is very complicated"

review_text: "War gut"
translated_text: "Was good"

review_text: "+++ Propre Confortable En plein centre - - - Le petit déjeuner"
translated_text: "+++ Clean Comfortable Right in the center - - - Breakfast"

review_text: "otel in otoparkı olmadığı gibi önüne yanaşamıyorsunuz uzak bir mesafede aracınızdan yada taksi den inip bavullarınızla yürümeniz gerekiyor. diğer konularda birşey söyleyemem zaten konaklamadık vazgeçtik paramızda yandı."
translated_text: "The hotel does not have a parking lot and you cannot approach the front of it. It is a long distance away and you have to get out of your car or taxi and walk with your luggage. I cannot say anything about other issues. We did not stay anyway, we gave up and lost our money."

review_text: "小さな玄関とロビーに比べ部屋は広々使いやすかったです。ベッドに前の人の歯ブラシがあったり、シャワーの水捌けが悪いなどはありましたが、立地とコスパの面で概ね満足です！ 何より朝ごはんに部屋まで持ってきてくれた焼き立てクロワッサンは最高においしかったです。"
translated_text: "Compared to the small entrance and lobby, the room was spacious and easy to use. There was the previous person's toothbrush on the bed, and the water in the shower was poor, but overall I was satisfied with the location and value for money! Best of all, the freshly baked croissants brought to my room for breakfast were delicious."

review_text: "Er alt i alt veldig fornøyd. Vi hadde et lang opphold med min lille sønn. Bpde betjeningen og renholdet var utmerket. Vi anbefaler stedet på det sterkeste. Kort avstand til butikker og shoppingsenter."
translated_text: "All in all very satisfied. We had a long stay with my little son. Bpde service and cleanliness were excellent. We strongly recommend the place. Short distance to shops and shopping centre."

review_text: "Il est bruyant avec des clients qui ne respecte rien , le petit déjeuner toujours il faut le commander faut pas s attendre a un truc de fou 1 croissant et 1 boule de pain confiture nutella, l emplacement est idéal loin de la plage par contre"
translated_text: "It's noisy with customers who don't respect anything, breakfast you always have to order it, don't expect something crazy 1 croissant and 1 ball of bread with Nutella jam, the location is ideal far from the beach on the other hand"

review_text: "In het algemeen in goeie ervaring gehad maar er is maar 1 lift waar je met 3 personen er in kan en bij drukte lang wachten en een iriterende afvoer en of vocht geur in de badkamer, ontbijt wordt van buiten besteld en kom in een zakje (met reservering) en zit croissant en wat confituur,honing en boter wat ik gezien hebt nooit besteld kwa ligging ideaal"
translated_text: "In general I had a good experience, but there is only 1 elevator where you can get in with 3 people and when it is busy there is a long wait and an irritating drain and/or damp smell in the bathroom. Breakfast is ordered from outside and comes in a bag (with reservation) and contains croissant and some jam, honey and butter. What I saw never ordered. Location is ideal."

review_text: "Rimelig og god beliggenhet . Var veldedig varmt inne i hotellet. Frokost ikke så bra utvalg."
translated_text: "Reasonable and good location. It was mercifully warm inside the hotel. Breakfast not such a good selection."

review_text: "Odalar çok küçük fakat 2 kişiye yetiyor. Ama odalarda cam olmaması yüzünden duvarların üstünüze üstünüze geliyormuş gibi. Kahvaltı kesinlikle yetersiz bi kruvasan ve mini ekmek veriyorlar avucunuzun içi kadar, yanlarında reçel tereyağı vs. var. Eğer kahvaltı düzenlenirse ve odalara en azından bir şekilde Günışığı giren bir şey eklenebilirse güzel olur. Onun dışında gördüğüm 5 6 çalışanın 1 tanesi hariç hepsi çok suratsız ve ilgisizdi"
translated_text: "The rooms are very small, but they are enough for 2 people. But since there is no glass in the rooms, it feels like the walls are closing in on you. The breakfast is absolutely inadequate. They only serve a croissant and mini bread, the size of the palm of your hand, with jam, butter, etc. It would be nice if the breakfast could be arranged and something could be added to the rooms, at least in some way, allowing sunlight to enter. Apart from that, all of the 5 or 6 employees I saw, except 1, were very sullen and uninterested."

review_text: "İlgili güzel bir oteldi. Temiz ve düzgündü. Kahvaltıda verilen kuruvasan efsaneydi. Birtek domates, salatalık, yumurta eksikti. Genel olarak çok iyi bir otel diyebilirim."
translated_text: "It was a nice hotel. It was clean and neat. The croissant served at breakfast was legendary. Only tomatoes, cucumbers and eggs were missing. Overall, I can say that it is a very good hotel."

review_text: "Centralt läge med väldigt bra och snabb service. Rena och rimliga rum. - Ej egna parkeringar och smal hiss."
translated_text: "Central location with very good and fast service. Clean and reasonable rooms. - No private parking and narrow lift."

review_text: "Personal war sehr hilfsbereit und angaggiert."
translated_text: "Staff was very helpful and engaging."

review_text: "Tam fiyat performans oteli. Konumu cok iyi kaleicine yurume mesafesi, havaalanina giden tramwaya yurume mesafesi. Temizlik ve hizmet profesyoneldi. Penceresiz odalari cok havasiz, uyumak mumkun degil. Normal odalarindan tercih edin."
translated_text: "Full price performance hotel. The location is very good, walking distance to the goalkeeper, walking distance to the tram to the airport. Cleaning and service were professional. Windowless rooms are very stuffy, it is not possible to sleep. Choose normal rooms."

review_text: "Enorm behulpzaam personeel, heerlijke douche met goede straal, goede bedden en schoonmaak. Ligging is echt leuk je loopt zo de winkelstraatjes v de oude stad in en goede koffietent om de hoek. Drogist en apotheek op 25 meter, ook fijn. Echt een prima plek!"
translated_text: "Very helpful staff, wonderful shower with a good jet, good beds and cleaning. Location is really nice, you can walk straight into the shopping streets of the old town and a good coffee shop around the corner. Drugstore and pharmacy 25 meters away, also nice. A really great place!"

review_text: "Schoon en simpel hotel, wij komen met gezin zeker nog een keer terug. Helaas geen koelkast in de driepersoonskamer, wel te doen in de zomer hoor en anders mag je alles in de koelkast bij receptie achterlaten. Helaas geen schoonmaak of nieuwe handdoeken gekregen tweede nacht waarbij we zelf om nieuwe handdoeken konden vragen. Wifi heel erg goed."
translated_text: "Clean and simple hotel, we will definitely come back with the family. Unfortunately no refrigerator in the triple room, which is doable in the summer, otherwise you can leave everything in the refrigerator at reception. Unfortunately, no cleaning or new towels were provided on the second night, but we could ask for new towels ourselves. Wifi is very good."

review_text: "Buena situación para conocer Antalya"
translated_text: "Good location to get to know Antalya"

review_text: "Daha önce de kalmıştım. Yeri Antalya'nın kalbinde. Doğrudan şehir merkezinde. Konfor veya başka bir beklentiniz olmasın. Gidip uyumalık sadece."
translated_text: "I've stayed there before. The place is in the heart of Antalya. Directly in the city center. Don't expect comfort or anything else. Just go and sleep."

review_text: "El alojamiento se encuentra en el centro, muy cerca de todo a pie. Las habitaciones estaban muy limpias. El recepcionista, muy majo. Estuvimos charlando un par de horas y me ha indicado lugares para visitar. No pude despedirme. Gracias por todo 🤗"
translated_text: "The accommodation is located in the center, very close to everything on foot. The rooms were very clean. The receptionist was very nice. We chatted for a couple of hours and he told me places to visit. I couldn't say goodbye. Thank you for everything 🤗"

review_text: "Bir iki gecelik, iş-gezi için mükemmel. Sadece geceyi geçirmek için temiz-merkezî bir yer arıyorsanız harika. Oda küçük fakat temiz, klima-televizyon gayet iyi çalışıyor."
translated_text: "Perfect for a night or two, business or travel. If you're just looking for a clean, central place to spend the night, it's great. The room is small but clean, the air conditioning and television work very well."

review_text: "Väldigt smutsigt, bra service oftast."
translated_text: "Very dirty, good service most of the time."

review_text: "Todella rauhallinen hotelli, uima-altaalla sai joka päivä olla rauhassa. Kävelymatkan päässä rannasta, rauhallinen sijainti. Ravintoloita ja kauppoja lähellä."
translated_text: "Really quiet hotel, you could relax at the pool every day. Walking distance from the beach, quiet location. Restaurants and shops nearby."

review_text: "otel plaja yakın ekran resmi koyup plajla alakası olmaması hazirçi iyiydi yanlız fiyatı etrafındakilerine göre pahalı"
translated_text: "The fact that the hotel had a screenshot showing that it was close to the beach and had nothing to do with the beach was good, but the price was expensive compared to others around it."

review_text: "Kötü bir deneyim değildi ferah,temiz bir otel konumu gayet iyiydi"
translated_text: "It wasn't a bad experience, it was a spacious, clean hotel, the location was very good"

review_text: "Görsellere bakıp tuttuk ama çok pişman olduk. Yataklar hiç rahat değil. Eski yataklar var. Yatakda döndükçe ses çıkıyor. Kalvaltı hiç güzel değildi. Çay için plastik bardak koymuşlar. Hiç bir şekilde tavsiye etmem"
translated_text: "We looked at the pictures, but we regretted it very much. The beds are not comfortable at all. There are old beds. When you turn around in the bed, you make noise. The breakfast was not good at all. They put plastic cups for tea. I would not recommend it at all."

review_text: "Resepsiyondaki beyefendi aynı zamanda işletmecisi çok ilgili ve kibardı. İsminden dolayı otel beklentisi ile gitmiştim. Bir otel değil ama çok kaliteli bir pansiyon diyebilirim. Oda kahvaltı konakladım, hijyen, sıcak su iyiydi. Kahvaltıda da karnım doydu. Havuzu var, temizdi ama girmedim. Antalya’ya gelmişken denize gittim. Plaja yürüyerek 8-10 dakika mesafede. Komple yenilenmiş bu sezon, tavsiye ederim."
translated_text: "The gentleman at the reception, as well as the owner, was very attentive and polite. I went with the expectation of a hotel because of its name. It is not a hotel, but I can say that it is a very high-quality hostel. I stayed in bed and breakfast, the hygiene and hot water were good. I was satisfied at breakfast. The room was no different Expected, not cleaned. Apparently the room service came because we got new water bottles, but nothing else was touched. review_text: "Mükemmel bir otel deneyimi kendinizi evinizde gibi hissedebilirsiniz. Sakin ve sessiz bir otel. Gerek otel sahibi gerek çalışanlar olsun mükemmel insanlar. Temizlik on numara. translated_text: "An excellent hotel experience, you can feel like you are at home. It is a calm and quiet hotel. Both the hotel owner and the staff are excellent people. Cleanliness is top notch. When you enter the room, you can directly feel the cleanliness of the bathroom and the smell of clean sheets. It is in a very central point in terms of location. If you want to feel like you have a home in Konyaalti, this place should definitely be your first choice."

review_text: "Oteli tercih edecekler hiç şüphe etmesin . Civardaki en temiz, nezih otellerden birisi. Otel yeni bahçe ve oturma alanları çok güzel , odalar konforlu , kahvaltı güzel, havuzu var, denize çok yakın ve çalışanlar her konuda yardımcı oluyorlar . Ben 4 gün kalacaktım , 6 güne uzattım :)"
