review_text: "Tesadüfen bulduğumuz çok memnun kaldığımız bir otel oldu. Temizliği, konumu ile kesinlikle tekrar gelmeyi hak ediyor. Sahipleri ve çalışanları çok güleryüzlü. Her şey için teşekkürler."
translated_text: "We found this hotel by chance and were very pleased with it. It definitely deserves to come again with its cleanliness and location. The owners and staff are very friendly. Thank you for everything."

review_text: "Wir sind Ende Juni dieses Jahr zwei Tage in dem Hotel geblieben und hatten zwei Zimmer gebucht. Die Mitarbeiter waren freundlich, die Räume waren sauber und die Ausstattungen waren auch sehr gut. Wir hatten einen Safe, einen kleinen Kühlschrank sowie einen Balkon. Einziges Manko war, dass in einem der Zimmer die Lüftungsanlage sowie die Klimaanlage recht laut gewesen sind. In dem anderen Zimmer gab es dieses Problem nicht. Zudem gibt es keinen Aufzug. Auch ein spätes Check in ist möglich. Da wir sehr spät erst in Antalya angekommen sind, haben wir um 2/3 Uhr Nachts eingecheckt. Zimmerreinigung gab es in diesen zwei Tagen nicht, was kein Problem für uns war. Allerdings weiß ich nicht, wie es bei längeren Aufenthalten geregelt wird. Erfreulich war, dass das Hotel und insbesondere die Zimmer, Handtücher, Laken etc. alle wirklich sehr sauber waren. Parken vor der Tür war nie ein Problem. Frühstück war auch ok für mich, wenn auch die Auswahl überschaubar war. Mit dem Auto war die Lage sehr gut. Wir waren in wenigen Minuten beim Konyaalti Beach. Fußläufig sind Turkcell und kleinere Supermärkte verfügbar. Mit dem Auto ist man in wenigen Minuten bei Migros. Alles in allem war ich zufrieden mit unserem Aufenthalt in dem Hotel und kann es weiterempfehlen."
translated_text: "We stayed in the hotel for two days at the end of June this year and booked two rooms. The staff were friendly, the rooms were clean and the facilities were also very good. We had a safe, a small refrigerator and a balcony. The only drawback was that the ventilation system and air conditioning in one of the rooms were quite loud. This problem didn't exist in the other room. There is also no elevator. A late check-in is also possible. Since we arrived in Antalya very late, we changed Checked in at 2/3 a.m. There was no room cleaning for these two days, which wasn't a problem for us. However, I don't know how it is handled for longer stays. It was pleasing that the hotel and especially the rooms, towels, sheets, etc. were never a problem. Breakfast was also ok for me, although the selection was manageable. The location was very good in a few minutes. Turkcell and smaller supermarkets are within walking distance. Migros is just a few minutes away by car. All in all, I was satisfied with our stay in the hotel and can recommend it."

review_text: "Tolles kleines sauberes Hotel mit sehr netten Mitarbeitern .Frühstücksbuffet völlig ausreichend immer wieder mit etwas Abwechslung im Angebot. Wir kommen gerne wieder uns hat es dort sehr gut gefallen."
translated_text: "Great small, clean hotel with very nice staff. Breakfast buffet was completely sufficient, always with some variety on offer. We would be happy to come back and we really enjoyed it there."

review_text: "Je suis profondément surprise par le décalage entre les photos promotionnelles ve la réalité. L’accueil manquait de chaleur, ve la propreté laissait franchement à désirer. Nous étions trois dans une chambre minuscule, un gros doute sur la taille de la chambre, une chaleur étouffante qui a rendu le séjour pénible. La climatisation il faut l'activer un temps avant l'arrivée du client. 🔹 À notre arrivée, avec 1h de retard ve la chambre n’était pas préparée, un manque de professionnalizm flagrant. Deux petites bouteilles d’eau pour trois personnes ? Deux serviettes pour deux ? Cela démontre un souci évident d’organisation. On etait trois !!! 🍽️ Le petit déjeuner, censé être inclus, était un autre point noir : les bouteilles de jus ve de lait étaient vides, le buffet semblait composé de restes, ve notre table n’était ni dressée, ni propre. Manger dans ces conditions est inacceptable pour un établissement hôtelier. 👉 Un conseil constructif : le jeune homme en charge sur place semble compétent ve professional – laissez-le piloter l’hôtel, il pourrait réellement en améliorer la gestion ve l’image."
translated_text: "I am deeply surprised by the discrepancy between the promotional photos and reality. The reception lacked warmth, and the cleanliness frankly left something to be desired. There were three of us in a tiny room, a big doubt about the size of the room, a stifling heat which made the stay painful. The air conditioning had to be activated for a while before the guest's arrival. 🔹 On our arrival, 1 hour late, the room was not prepared, a lack of professionalism Two small bottles of water for three people? Two towels for two? This shows an obvious organizational concern!!! 🍽️ Breakfast, supposed to be included, was another downside: the bottles of juice and milk were empty, the buffet seemed to be made up of leftovers, and our table was neither set nor clean. place seems competent and professional – let him manage the hotel, he could really improve its management and image."

translated_text: "We were generally satisfied. Cleanliness and breakfast were adequate. We had a hot water problem on the first day. But the problem was solved the next day."

review_text: "Vil komme igen, god beliggenhed. Hotellets beliggenhed er super og er tæt på alt. Vi har haft et godt ophold. Værelset var stort med garderobeskab og køleskabet. Personalet var flinke, venlige, søde og hjælpsomme. Vi har næsten kun overnattede der, da vi skulle andet om dagen. De få gange vi spiste der, var maden virkelig god og smagte pragtfuldt. Tjenerne var også super gode. Det eneste vi synes mindre godt om var, personalet (unge mennesker) ved baren. De var lidt langsomme og glemte noget af bestillingen. Vi ville komme derhen igen, en anden gang."
translated_text: "Would come again, good location. The location of the hotel is great and is close to everything. We had a good stay. The room was big with a wardrobe and a fridge. The staff were nice, friendly, sweet and helpful. We almost only stayed there overnight as we had other things to do during the day. The few times we ate there, the food was really good and tasted wonderful. The waiters were also super good. The only thing we didn't like was the staff (young people) at the bar. They were a bit slow and forgetful some of the order. We would go there again, another time."

review_text: "War ganz okay, angezeigte Mängel wurden sofort behoben"
translated_text: "It was okay, any defects that were reported were corrected immediately"

review_text: "Alles gut"
translated_text: "It's all ok"

review_text: "Schönes Hotel in einer guten Lage Das Hotel ist sehr gut gelegen und man kann eine schöne Zeit verbringen, vor allem für einen Kurztrip und in der Nähe vom Strand."
translated_text: "Nice hotel in a good location The hotel is very well located and you can have a nice time, especially for a short trip and close to the beach."

review_text: "Frokosten var en stor skuffelse, renhold på rommene var halvveis men ansatter var veldig hyggelig."
translated_text: "The breakfast was a big disappointment, the cleaning of the rooms was half way but the staff were very nice."

review_text: "Çalışan personel profesyonel teşekkürler"
translated_text: "The staff is professional, thank you"

review_text: "Kahve makinesi bozuk, kahvaltı yetersizdi. Oda kapısı kırıktı."
translated_text: "The coffee machine was broken, the breakfast was inadequate. The room door was broken."

review_text: "Schoonheid en de kamer meisjes zijn Goed en aardig. ONTBIJT IS goed Zweembad is schoon... Niet goed in de Nacht hardmuziek en Lawaai in het Restaurant voor het hotel tot 2 uur in de Nacht."
translated_text: "Beauty and the room girls are Good and nice. BREAKFAST IS good Swimming pool is clean... Not good in the Night loud music and Noise in the Restaurant in front of the hotel until 2 o'clock in the Night."

review_text: "Sahile yakınlığı havuzun büyüklüğü ve temizliğini beğendim. Oda büyüklüğü biraz yetersizdi. Kahvaltı yeterliydi. Tekrar kalmayı isterim"
translated_text: "I liked the proximity to the beach, the size of the pool and its cleanliness. The room size was a bit inadequate. The breakfast was sufficient. I would like to stay again"

review_text: "Super séjour! J’ai séjourné à Anatalya pendant une semaine. L’emplacement est vraiment idéal, à 3mins porte à porte de la plage. Super équipe, très aimable et serviable. Un gros plus serait de mettre en place les petites pancartes à la porte pour signaler la présence dans la chambre, et d’améliorer l’isolation en terme de bruit, mais ça ne m’a pas perturbée plus que ça."
translated_text: "Great stay! I stayed at Anatalya for a week. The location is really ideal, 3 minutes door to door from the beach. Great team, very friendly and helpful. A big plus would be to put up the little signs at the door to indicate the presence in the room, and to improve the insulation in terms of noise, but it didn't bother me that much."

review_text: "Séjour agréable hotel très bien situé proche de toutes commodités et de la plage . Je le recommande qualité prix excellent."
translated_text: “Pleasant stay in a very well located hotel close to all amenities and the beach. I recommend excellent value for money.”

review_text: "Wir waren 3 nächte in dieser unterkunft als 4 köpfige familie. Die möbel sind veraltet der kühlschrank hat gestunken... es tut mir leid aber ich würde diese unterkunft nicht wieder buchen. Die inhaber sind tierfreunde und das war das einzige was ich geschätzt habe :-)"
translated_text: "We stayed in this accommodation for 3 nights as a family of 4. The furniture is outdated, the fridge smelled... I'm sorry but I wouldn't book this accommodation again. The owners are animal lovers and that was the only thing I appreciated :-)"

review_text: "3 gece ailemle birlikte kaldık. Bence bir aparta göre harikaydı.temizlik gayet güzeldi. Hele fiyatına göre oldukça mükemmeldi."
translated_text: "We stayed with my family for 3 nights. I think it was great for an apartment. The cleanliness was very good. Especially for the price, it was perfect."

review_text: "투어가 아침 일찍 출발이여서 가방 보관이 제일 필요했는데 감사하게도 가방 보관해주셔서 바로 투어갈수 있었습니다 시설도 깔끔하고 정말 좋았습니다 다음에 안탈리아 방문시 또 머물도 싶네여 ㅎㅎ"
translated_text: "Because the tour departed early in the morning, I needed to store my bag the most, but thankfully they stored my bag so I was able to go on the tour right away. The facilities were clean and really nice. I want to stay again next time I visit Antalya haha."

review_text: "Oda temiz ve kullanışlıydı. konaklamadan memnun kaldık"
translated_text: "The room was clean and convenient. We were pleased with the stay"

review_text: "Otel genel olarak iyiydi, temizlik de dahil olmak üzere kayda değer bir sorun yaşamadık, otelin konumu arabası olanlar için iyi sayılabilir, özellikle otel elemanları güler yüzlü ve sıcaktı."
translated_text: "The hotel was generally good, we did not have any significant problems, including cleaning, the location of the hotel can be considered good for those with a car, especially the hotel staff were friendly and warm."

review_text: "Mükemmel Çok temiz bir otel antalya içinde ilk defa bu kadar temiz otel gördüm. Ailemle huzur içinde kaldık. Çalışanları çok anlayışlı ve güleryüzlü. Tüm arkadaşlarıma yakın çevreme tavsiye ediyorum"
translated_text: "Excellent, very clean hotel. This is the first time I have seen such a clean hotel in Antalya. We stayed in peace with my family. The staff is very understanding and friendly. I recommend it to all my friends and close circle."

review_text: "Otele ilk giriş anımızdan çıkışa kadar her türlü konuda çok yardımcı oldular.Odalar yeterli büyüklükte ,mutfak gereçleri yeterli, klimalar oldukça iyiydi.Temizlik istediğiniz zaman yapılıyor. Havlular ve çarşaflar temizdi.Çok güler yüzlü ve her saat ulaşabileceğiniz personellere sahip.Konum olarak tüm olanaklara sahip bir bölgede.Biz karpuzkaldıran askeri kampı kullandık. Arabayla 3 dk içerisinde ulaşılıyor. Otel de oldukça güvenliydi.Tüm personele ve Almila Hanıma tekrar teşekkürler."
translated_text: "They were very helpful in every aspect, from the moment we first entered the hotel until we left. The rooms were large enough, the kitchenware was sufficient, the air conditioning was quite good. Cleaning is done whenever you want. Towels and sheets were clean. The staff is very friendly and you can reach them at any time. The location is in an area with all the amenities. We used the Karpuzkaldıran military camp. It can be reached within 3 minutes by car. The hotel was also very safe. I would like to thank all the staff and Ms. Almila again." Thank you."

review_text: "Mü-kem-mel Merkezdeki en iyi apart otel, temiz, ilgili, saygılı yetkililer🙏"
translated_text: "Perfect, the best apart hotel in the centre, clean, caring, respectful officials🙏"

review_text: "Keyifli kısa konaklama Güzel bir kısa konaklama oldu, odadaki televizyon 65 inch, yataklar temiz, eksik bir şey yok. Keyifli oldu. Resepsiyondaki hanım nazik ve ilgiliydi. Çocuklar da çok sevdi. Klima düzgün çalışıyor, panjurlar motorlu kolay açılıp kapanıyor. Tek önerim lavabo kenarı ahşap üstünde bir kaç kabarma olmuş, onun üzerine güzel koyu renkli bir cam kestirin. Teşekkürler."
translated_text: "An enjoyable short stay. It was a nice short stay, the television in the room is 65 inch, the beds are clean, there is nothing missing. It was enjoyable. The lady at the reception was kind and attentive. The children loved it too. The air conditioner works well, the blinds are motorized and open and close easily. My only suggestion is that there are a few blisters on the wooden side of the sink, have a nice dark colored glass cut over it. Thank you."

review_text: "Harika bir deneyim , her şey için teşekkürler."
translated_text: "A great experience, thank you for everything."

review_text: "Hotelzimmer war schrecklich und keine aufzug unhigjenij"

review_text: "Tutto ok apparte rumore esterno"
translated_text: "Everything ok apart from external noise"

review_text: "Des avions passent toutes les quatre heures et l’hôtel n’ai pas insonorisé beaucoup de bruits dommages car le personnel est très sympathique"
translated_text: "Planes pass every four hours and the hotel has not soundproofed a lot of damage because the staff is very friendly"

review_text: "Hôtel confortable repas correct les employés sont serviables Par contre le boss a élevé la voix contre les employés devant nous il a même donné un coup de pied dans une chaise Quel dommage d’avoir un boss qui ne sait pas se contrôler devant les clients En résumé l’hôtel est bien placé et le Club de plage est bien Les excursions achetées à l’hôtel étaient à la hauteur de la description faite par la dame du bureau d’accueil Serveurs cuisiniers manager sont des gens professionnels Vous ne serez pas déçus qualité prix au rendez-vous !!"
translated_text: "Comfortable hotel, decent food, the employees are helpful. On the other hand, the boss raised his voice against the employees in front of us, he even kicked a chair. What a shame to have a boss who doesn't know how to control himself in front of customers. In summary, the hotel is well located and the Beach Club is good. The excursions purchased at the hotel lived up to the description given by the lady at the reception desk. Waiters, cooks and managers are professional people. You will not be disappointed, value for money!!"

review_text: "Ravie de mon sejour 8 jours très bon rapport qualité prix en demi pension buffet au petit déjeuner buffet au dîner excursions au départ de l hôtel pour Cappadoce et Pamukkale avec hôtesse accueil hôtel chambre petite mais climatisée avec terrasse"
translated_text: "Delighted with my 8-day stay, very good value for money, half board breakfast buffet, dinner buffet, excursions from the hotel to Cappadocia and Pamukkale with hostess, hotel reception, small but air-conditioned room with terrace"

review_text: "Reception är inte bra dålig bemötande av personalen som är på receptionen annars restaurangen helt okej med trevliga personal och även städpersonalen var mycket maten inte speciellt sådär bra"
translated_text: "Reception is not good, bad treatment by the staff at the reception, otherwise the restaurant is perfectly fine with nice staff and also the cleaning staff, the food was not particularly that good"

review_text: "Helt greit. Bra med tanke på pris, begrenset på alt annet"
translated_text: "Perfectly fine. Good in terms of price, limited in everything else"

review_text: "hayatımda konakladığım en kötü mekandı sokakta yatsam daha temiz ve özenli bir oda olurdu çok rezalet bi otel buraya para vereceğinize paranızı çöpe atın daha iyi"
translated_text: "It was the worst place I've ever stayed in my life. If I were to sleep on the street, I would have a cleaner and more attentive room. It's a terrible hotel. Better throw your money away instead of paying here."

review_text: "Çok kötü"
translated_text: "Too bad"

translated_text: "Very dirty rooms are small"

review_text: "Otele gittiğimizde duşların ve lavaboların odanın dışında olduğunu söylediler bu uygulamada Yazmıyordu mağduriyet yaşadık duşlu ve lavabolu odalar için ek ücret talep edildi maalesef verdik hotels.com'dan yapılan rezervasyonlarda sıkıntı yaşadıklarını aktardılar ama sonuç olarak Mağdur olan bizdik"
translated_text: "When we went to the hotel, they said that the showers and sinks were outside the room. This was not written on the application. We suffered a problem. An additional fee was requested for rooms with showers and sinks. Unfortunately, we gave it to them. They told us that they had problems with the reservations made on hotels.com, but as a result, we were the victims."

review_text: "Hijyen alakası olmayan otel Temizlik açısından Fotoğraflardaki gibi bir otel değil çöp pis bir otelde bu konuda hiçbir şey yapmadılar iş için seyahat edildi ama pişman olduk"
translated_text: "The hotel has nothing to do with hygiene. In terms of cleanliness, it is not a hotel like the photos, it is a garbage and dirty hotel. They did nothing about it. We traveled for business, but we regretted it."

review_text: "Otel hiç rahat değil. Para iadesi olmadığı için mecburen kaldık. Odalar çok temiz değil. Yatak rahat değil. Banyosu çok küçük."
translated_text: "The hotel is not comfortable at all. We had to stay because there was no refund. The rooms are not very clean. The bed is not comfortable. The bathroom is very small."

review_text: "Ulaşım kolay şehir merkezinde her yere yürüme mesafesi olduğu için her saat ihtiyaçlarınızı karşılayabilirsiniz tek sıkıntı hijyen ve banyo tesisatı"
translated_text: "Transportation is easy, it is within walking distance to everywhere in the city center, you can meet your needs at any time, the only problem is hygiene and bathroom facilities."

review_text: "Utmärkt. Rekommenderar varmt."
translated_text: "Excellent. Highly recommend."

review_text: "Wij zijn zeer tevreden over deze accommodatie, netjes, schoon,vriendelijk,gezellig, handig en kwaliteit en prijs verhouding is super. Volgende keer weer zeker deze hotel."
translated_text: "We are very satisfied with this accommodation, neat, clean, friendly, cozy, convenient and the quality and price ratio is great. Next time we will definitely stay at this hotel."

review_text: "Otopark var sandik ilana gore ama yokdu. Odada iki kisi kaldigimiz halde bize bir oda kart verdiler ve bu nedenle Antalyayi rahat gezemedik. Ikinci kart isteyince vermediler. Odamizda hapis olduk. Ilk defa bir hotel de kaldim ki iki kisi basina bir oda karti. YAZIK! Boyle cimrilik yapilmasin artik!"
translated_text: "We thought there was parking, according to the advertisement, but there wasn't. They gave us a room card even though there were two people staying in the room, and therefore we couldn't travel around Antalya comfortably. When I asked for a second card, they didn't give it to us. We were imprisoned in our room. It was the first time I stayed in a hotel and got a room card for two people. A Pity! Such stinginess should not be done anymore!"

review_text: "Ilgili calisanlar, temiz fiyat-performans sehir oteli. Tavsiye edilir."
translated_text: "Careful staff, clean price-performance city hotel. Recommended."

review_text: "Kesinlikle uzak durun. Amatör bir şekilde yönetilen bir otel. Ciddi sıkıntılı. Odalarda koku var. Müşteri iletişimi rezalet."
translated_text: "Definitely stay away. It's an amateurly managed hotel. It's seriously problematic. There's a smell in the rooms. Customer communication is a disgrace."

review_text: "Sauberes Hotel. Sehr zentrale Lage. Die Qualität des Frühstückbuffets sollte verbessert werden! Weniger aber dafür bessere Qualität!"
translated_text: "Clean hotel. Very central location. The quality of the breakfast buffet should be improved! Less but better quality!"

review_text: "İki günlüğüne Antalya tatiline geldik. Odalar gayet temiz ve rahat. Banyo temiz,havlular temiz, sıcak su ve duşta sıkıntı yok. Klima iyi soğutuyor. Kahvaltı açık büfe ve sıcak çeşitleri de soğuk çeşidi kadar fazla. Menemen, küçük kuruvasan, haşlama yumurta, börek,mantar patlıcan kızartma vb çeşitler var. Otelin tek sıkıntısı bence mutfak katındaki koku ve bu kokunun sabah odalara çıkması. Kahvaltı yaparken üstümüz yağ kokmuş vaziyette ayrıldık o biraz kötü bir durum oldu. Onun dışında otel konumu 15 dk yürüme mesafesiyle kaleiçi çarşıya yakın sadece etrafı çok tekin durmuyor. Araba ile geldiyseniz park yeri sorun olmayacaktır."
translated_text: "We came for a two-day holiday in Antalya. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. The bathroom is clean, the towels are clean, there is no problem with hot water and shower. The air conditioner cools well. The breakfast is an open buffet and the hot varieties are as numerous as the cold ones. There are menemen, small croissants, boiled eggs, pastries, fried mushrooms, eggplants, etc. I think the only problem with the hotel is the smell on the kitchen floor and this smell coming to the rooms in the morning. We left while having breakfast, smelling of oil." It was a bit of a bad situation. Apart from that, the location of the hotel is close to the Kaleiçi bazaar, 15 minutes away. However, if you come by car, parking will not be a problem."

review_text: "Het is een nieuw accomodatie, vriendelijk personeel, heel schoon,goed ontbijt,volgende keer als we weer naar antalya gaan! weten wij waar wij moeten boeken."
translated_text: "It is a new accommodation, friendly staff, very clean, good breakfast, next time we go to Antalya! we know where to book."

review_text: "Aile oteli tavsiyemdir"
translated_text: "Family hotel is my recommendation"

review_text: "Schönes Hotel"
translated_text: "Nice hotel"

review_text: "Temizdi,güleryüzlü çalışanlar ayrıca ocakbaşındaki yemekler çok güzeldi, memnun kaldık,"
translated_text: "It was clean, the staff were friendly and the food at the fireside was very nice, we were satisfied,"

review_text: "Wir waren sehr zufrieden"
translated_text: “We were very satisfied”

review_text: "Otel yeni ve cok temizdi. Odalari genis kahvalti cesitleri cok ve guzeldi. Personel cok ilgili ve guler yuzlu. Tekrar tercih edecegim bir otel"
translated_text: "The hotel was new and very clean. The rooms were large and the breakfast options were very nice. The staff was very attentive and friendly. It is a hotel I would choose again."

review_text: "Bir gece konakladık. Ailecek güvenli kalınacak yer"
translated_text: "We stayed for one night. A safe place to stay as a family"

review_text: "Normal standartta orta temizlik vardı ,kahvaltı fena değildi .odalarda oturmak için ekstra koltuk olabilirdi ,çalışanlar Güleryüzlü idi.Genel olarak 3 yıldız veriyorum"
translated_text: "The cleanliness was moderate to normal standards, the breakfast was not bad. There could be extra seats in the rooms, the employees were friendly. Overall, I give it 3 stars."

review_text: "Nette kamer. Ontbijt was redelijk, niet veel keuze.. Jammer dat er in de buurt niet zoveel restaurants zijn."
translated_text: "Nice room. Breakfast was reasonable, not much choice... Too bad there aren't many restaurants in the area."

review_text: "Fomos em Julho e o calor muito intenso. Ar condicionado do quarto só funciona com o cartão de acesso e demora muito para refrescar. A geladeira do quarto estava quebrada e pedi 2 vezes para que arrumassem e nunca ninguém apareceu."
translated_text: "We went in July and the heat was very intense. The air conditioning in the room only works with the access card and it takes a long time to cool down. The refrigerator in the room was broken and I asked them to fix it twice and no one ever came."

review_text: "Das einzige was gut war, ist die nähe zum Flughafen"
translated_text: "The only thing that was good was the proximity to the airport"

review_text: "Mooi hotel, ontbijt voor de prijs mocht wel beter. Ontbijt was met openingstijd nog niet klaar ik moest om brood vragen en weinig keuze. Ontvangst bij de receptie was heel koud en zo niet vriendelijk wat niet past bij het hotel. Ik heb niks gemerkt van mijn VIP. Ze zeiden dat expedia reclame wilde maken wat ik heel apart vond omdat bij andere hotels mijn VIP keurig werd geaccepteerd."
translated_text: "Nice hotel, breakfast could have been better for the price. Breakfast was not ready at opening time, I had to ask for bread and there was little choice. Reception at the reception was very cold and not friendly, which does not suit the hotel. I didn't notice anything about my VIP. They said that Expedia wanted to advertise, which I thought was very strange because at other hotels my VIP was neatly accepted."

review_text: "Kahvaltı salonu ve açık büfenin yetersiz olduğunu düşünüyorum..ancak personel süper.. ilgili..yardımsever teşekkürler"
translated_text: "I think the breakfast room and open buffet are inadequate..but the staff is super..attentive..helpful, thank you"

review_text: "Jeg oppriktig anbefaler dette hotellet til alle som skal være i Antalya eller bare har lyst på en behagelig ferie. Det er flere kjøpesenter i nærheten, mange restauranter i området og beliggenheten er rolig og fantastisk. Frokosten var herlig, de ansatte var tilstede og ordnet. Dette må være et av de beste hotellene i Tyrkia for en rimelig penge. Omgivelsene var magisk. Bildene er realistiske, det er små kattepuser på området som er veldig søte, alt var så herlig. Virkelig all cred til personalet, eieren og alle som smiler for å få det til å gå rundt."
translated_text: "I sincerely recommend this hotel to anyone who will be in Antalya or just want a comfortable holiday. There are several malls nearby, many restaurants in the area and the location is quiet and wonderful. The breakfast was wonderful, the staff were present and organized. This has to be one of the best hotels in Turkey for a reasonable price. The surroundings were magical. The pictures are realistic, there are little kittens in the area that are very cute, everything was so lovely. Really all credit to the staff, the owner and everyone who smiles to make it go around."

review_text: "Meget Dårlig morgenmad med lidt valg muligheder blev ikke ryddet af på bordet fra tidligere gæster"
translated_text: "Very bad breakfast with few choices, the table was not cleared from previous guests"

review_text: "Çok güzel bir otel manzarası havuzu odası gerçekten konfor ve kalite oranı çok yüksek. Açık büfeside gayet kaliteli taze ve çeşit çeşit. Sadece havuzun yanında ağaçlar olduğu için havuza ağaçtan yaprak ve dallar düşüyor. Havuzun daha sık temizlenmesi gerek çok rahatsız edici değil ama bu konuda eksik gördüm."
translated_text: "The hotel has a very nice view, the pool room has a really high comfort and quality ratio. The open buffet is also very high quality, fresh and diverse. Only because there are trees next to the pool, leaves and branches from the trees fall into the pool. The pool needs to be cleaned more often, it is not very disturbing, but I found it lacking in this regard."

review_text: "Banyoda yerde kıl vardı iyi temizlenmemiş bir önceki gelişimde temizliğini çok beğenmiştim bu yüzden tercih etmiştim ama yanılttı beni kahvaltıda daha özenli olabilir"
translated_text: "There was hair on the floor of the bathroom, it was not cleaned well. I liked the cleanliness of the place in my previous visit, that's why I chose it, but it misled me. He could have been more attentive at breakfast."

review_text: "Sehr saubere und schöne Anlage in der Nähe des Flughafens Antalya. Gastronomie mangelhaft: total überforderte Bedienung, Essen war ok. Für Restaurant nicht zu empfehlen, für Überbachtung hingegen sehr."
translated_text: "Very clean and nice facility near Antalya airport. Gastronomy poor: totally overwhelmed service, food was ok. Not recommended for a restaurant, but highly recommended for overnight stays."

review_text: "Rent och fint. Tyst , bra frukost, trevlig personal"
translated_text: "Clean and nice. Quiet, good breakfast, nice staff"

review_text: "Sehr gutes und sauberes Hotel. Ich kann es jederzeit empfehlen."
translated_text: "Very good and clean hotel. I can recommend it at any time."

review_text: "Buzdolabı yoktu. Klima hiç soğutmadı sıcaktan uyuyamadık. Kaldığım en kötü otel"
translated_text: "There was no refrigerator. The air conditioner did not cool at all, we could not sleep because of the heat. The worst hotel I have ever stayed in."

review_text: "Antalya da kalınabilecek en barbât yer diyebilirim rahatlıkla, Havuz 8 de kapanıyor dediler gece 3 te içip içip havuza giriyolar, bağırıyorlar vs otel yönetimi asla gidip uyarmadı. 3 gece de rahat uyuyamadık uykumuz sürekli bölündü diğer müşterilerimde rahatsız olduğu belliydi.Otelin restauranta akşam yemeği için gittik Tahminen otel müdürü olan sarışın 30-40lı yaşlardaki kadın bağırarak “Bunlar yeni geldi sipariş alın” diyor yanındakilere , şaka gibi ama gerçek.Üslupları berbat , güler yüz 0 , Zorla işe gelmiş gibi bir hava var. Dolayısıyla burada kalmadan önce 2 değil 3 defa düşünün derim."
translated_text: "I can easily say that it is the worst place to stay in Antalya. They said the pool closes at 8 a.m., they drink and enter the pool at 3 a.m., they shout, etc. The hotel management never went and warned them. We couldn't sleep well for 3 nights, our sleep was constantly interrupted, and it was obvious that my other customers were disturbed. We went to the hotel restaurant for dinner. The blonde woman, aged 30-40, who is probably the hotel manager, shouted, "These have just arrived, take orders," she said to the people next to her, like a joke, but It's real. Their style is terrible, there is zero smiling face, there is an atmosphere of being forced to work, so I suggest you think twice, not 3 times before staying here."

review_text: "Tout était plus que parfait Sauf le réceptionniste de ce matin qui a été désagréable et expéditif. Il a répondu à mes questions sommairement et avec dédain."
translated_text: "Everything was more than perfect Except the receptionist this morning who was unpleasant and expeditious. He answered my questions summarily and with disdain."

review_text: "Tout est conforme aux photos Propre, calme, idéal pour familles Restaurant/bar a dispo Prix chez aeroport"

review_text: "Arkadaşımla kaldım mükemmel bir yer. Çok temiz ve nezih bir mekan. Personeller güler yüzlü ve çok ilgili. Açık büfe kahvaltısı harika. Gideceğin yerlere kolay ulaşımı var. Birdaha ki tatilimde tekrar kalacağım tek yer."
translated_text: "I stayed with my friend. It's a perfect place. It's a very clean and decent place. The staff is friendly and very attentive. The open buffet breakfast is great. It has easy access to the places you want to go. It's the only place I will stay again on my next holiday."

review_text: "Otele girişimiz ve çıkışımız sırasında bir kişi de valizlerinize yardımcı olalım diyen olamadı. Kapılar çok sert çarpıyor . Bayram sonrası giriş yapmıştık , havuz kenarındaki sehpaların üstü dünden kalma tepeleme doluydu . translated_text: "During our check-in and check-out of the hotel, not one person asked us to help you with your luggage. The doors slam very hard. We checked in after the Eid, and the coffee tables by the pool were full of yesterday's leftovers. You are looking for staff in the square to order by the pool. The area around the pool is full of flower petals falling from the trees. You cannot plant deciduous trees by the pool. I wish you had consulted a landscaper. There is no interest at all. Are you there? "It is not clear whether you are there or not. Walking distance to shopping malls"

review_text: "Alles war super!"
translated_text: "Everything was great!"

review_text: "Otel mükemmeldi, oda olsun bahçe ve havuz başı kahvaltı ve yemekleri, çalışanlar güler yüzlü ve yardımcılardı. Sadece odada tv’de sorun vardı ve çözülemedi. Yaşadığım tek aksilik buydu 10/10 bir otel."
translated_text: "The hotel was perfect, the room, the garden and the poolside breakfast and meals, the staff were friendly and helpful. There was only a problem with the TV in the room and it could not be solved. This was the only misfortune I experienced. 10/10 hotel."

review_text: "Gerçek bir tatil ve dinleme imkani sunan sessiz sakin bir konaklama gerçekleştirdik, mükemmeldi :)"
translated_text: "We had a quiet stay that offered a real holiday and the opportunity to relax, it was perfect :)"

review_text: "Aile ortamı huzurlu sakin kafa dinlenecek bir yer temizlik çalışanları çok güleryüzlüydü gülümser hanım başta olmak üzere tavsiye edilir"
translated_text: "Family atmosphere, peaceful, quiet place to rest, cleaning staff were very friendly, especially the smiling lady, it is recommended"

review_text: "Hotel charmant, propre, très bien entretenu et très calme ! La chambre etait belle, nettoyée et rangée chaque jour, bonne literie on y dort bien ! Cependant, accueil et service catastrophique ! Arrivés en famille à 1h du matin en famille, le receptionniste etait seul, à moitié endormi et personne pour nous aider avec nos valises ni même nous accompagner à la chambre. D'une facon générale, le personnel est incroyablement antipathique, pas un sourire, pas un bonjour, pas un merci, vous les derangez même quand vous leur demander quelque chose, surtout les 2 jeunes filles qui s'occupent du snack et du petit dejeuné, elles se permettent des reflexion et s'énervent parce que vous demandez des renseignements sur la carte ("bismillahi rahmani rahim nous a-t-elle dit sans savoir que javais compris la signification de sa reflxion car je parle arabe), pourtant Dieu sait à quel point nous sommes une famille respectueuse et souriante mais quand en retour on vous rend cette tete désagreable....elles s'attireront des ennuies ou nuieront à la reputation de l'hôtel si elles continuent ainsi. Devant l'hôtel il y a une pancarte où il est ecrit "EMA SMILES" le personnel et surtout ces deux filles devraient l'appliquer à elles-mêmes. Un receptionniste et dame de menage etaient eux plutot souriant et agreable."
translated_text: "Charming hotel, clean, very well maintained and very quiet! The room was beautiful, cleaned and tidied every day, good bedding, we slept well there! However, the welcome and service were catastrophic! Arrived as a family at 1 a.m., the receptionist was alone, half asleep and no one to help us with our suitcases or even accompany us to the room. Generally speaking, the staff is incredibly unfriendly, not a smile, not a hello, not a thank you, you bother even when you ask them something, especially the 2 young girls who take care of the snack and the breakfast, they indulge in reflections and get angry because you ask for information on the menu ("bismillahi rahmani rahim she told us without knowing that I had understood the meaning of her reflection because I speak Arabic), yet God knows to what extent we are a respectful and smiling family but when in return we give you back this head unpleasant....they will get into trouble or harm the reputation of the hotel if they continue like this. In front of the hotel there is a sign that says "EMA SMILES" the staff and especially these two girls should apply it to themselves. A receptionist and cleaning lady were rather smiling and pleasant."

review_text: "Als Familie übernachtet. Wir waren sehr begeistert als wir die Anlage betreten haben. Parkmöglichkeiten im Hof (sicher) der Check in ging reibungslos und wurden sehr nett und höflich empfangen. Unser ZIMMER war sauber die Klimaanlage hat sehr gut Funktioniert. Der Pool war schön und sauber. Das Frühstück war lecker. Ein Pluspunkt war das man zu Fuß (700 Meter)zu Mall of ANTALYA erreichen konnte."
translated_text: "Stayed overnight as a family. We were very excited when we entered the complex. There was parking in the courtyard (safe), the check-in went smoothly and we were greeted very nicely and politely. Our ROOM was clean, the air conditioning worked very well. The pool was nice and clean. The breakfast was delicious. A plus point was that you could walk (700 meters) to the Mall of ANTALYA."

review_text: "Ailecek konakladık.Yeni bir hotel, temiz.Kullanılan malzemeler kaliteli.Yemyeşil bahçesi ve ağaçların gölgesinde güzel bir havuzu var.Keyifli bir tatildi."
translated_text: "We stayed as a family. It's a new hotel, clean. The materials used are of high quality. It has a lush garden and a beautiful pool in the shade of the trees. It was an enjoyable holiday."

review_text: "Todella siisti hotelli. Pieni ja rauhallinen. Lähellä lentokenttää. Ei merenrantas, mutta pieni, puhdas, miellyttävä uima-allas"
translated_text: "Really neat hotel. Small and quiet. Close to the airport. Not the beach, but a small, clean, pleasant swimming pool"

review_text: "Hotel très correcte pour le prix. Ça reste un hôtel europeanisé comme dans toutes les régions balnéaires. Accueil qui ne ressemble pas à un Accueil turc..dommage."
translated_text: "Very decent hotel for the price. It remains a Europeanized hotel like in all seaside regions. A welcome that does not resemble a Turkish welcome... too bad."

review_text: "Kleines ruhiges, sauberes Hotel. Das Personal war sehr nett. Ich hätte 5 Sterne gegeben, wäre der Müll aus unserem Zimmer früher entfernt worden. (Erst nach drei Tagen) Auch neue Handtücher. Und mitten beim Duschen war das Shampoo leer. TV hatte keine Kanäle gespeichert. Diese Kleinigkeiten gaben 1 Stern Abzug. Aber schön ruhig. Pool war groß genug zum schwimmen. Frühstück war super. Sehr nettes Personal. Alles in allem empfehlenswertes Hotel. Wir würden wieder kommen."
translated_text: "Small, quiet, clean hotel. The staff was very nice. I would have given 5 stars if the trash had been removed from our room earlier. (Only after three days). Also new towels. And in the middle of the shower the shampoo was empty. TV had no channels saved. These little things deducted 1 star. But nice and quiet. Pool was big enough for swimming. Breakfast was great. Very nice staff. All in all, recommendable hotel. We would come back."

review_text: "Es hat nur eins gefehlt für badetücher zum trocken in zimmer sonst ist alles."
translated_text: "Only one thing was missing for bath towels to dry in the room, otherwise that's all."

review_text: "Güzel bir konaklama oldu, çalışanlar gayet ilgili ve güleryüzlü."
translated_text: "It was a nice stay, the staff were very attentive and friendly."

review_text: "Antalyayı dolaşıp gezmek amaçlı tuttuğumuz otel.Otel yenilenmiş sahipleri çok ilgili.Parasına göre temiz ve ferah otel kahvaltı güzel. Tşk Hakan bey ve ailesi."
translated_text: "We rented the hotel to travel around Antalya. The hotel has been renovated and the owners are very attentive. It is clean and spacious for the price, the breakfast is good. Thank you Mr. Hakan and his family."

review_text: "Temiz ve konforlu bir otel. Kahvaltı çeşitliliği yeterli ve güzeldi. Memnun kaldık teşekkür ederiz"
translated_text: "It is a clean and comfortable hotel. The breakfast variety was sufficient and good. We were satisfied, thank you."

review_text: "Konaklama yeri çölde bir vaha gibi. Kendinizi Italya'da gibi hissediyorsunuz. Konforlu ve temiz. Kahvaltısı güzel. Çok keyifli bir otel. Bir iki ufak negatif noktaya deginmek istiyorum kendilerini geliştirmek isterlerse diye. Yeni bir mekan olmasına ragmen TV lerde sorun var. Kanal değiştirmek pek mümkün olmuyor. Buna bir çözüm bulmadılar. Bu tarz bir otelde insan daha güleryüzlü ve yardımsever bir resepsiyon bekliyor. Fakat asıl başka bir işleri varmış da ek iş olarak size bakıyorlarmış gibi. Yanı sıra bu tarz bir otel Yetişkin oteli konseptinde olsa ciyak ciyak havuz kullanan çocuklar olmadan ortama uygun daha huzurlu bir tatil geçirilebilir. Daha iyiye odaklanirlarsa 100 puanlık bir otel haline gelir."
translated_text: "The accommodation is like an oasis in the desert. You feel like you are in Italy. It is comfortable and clean. The breakfast is good. It is a very pleasant hotel. I would like to mention a few negative points in case they want to improve themselves. Even though it is a new place, there are problems with the TVs. It is not possible to change the channel. They did not find a solution to this. In this type of hotel, one expects a more friendly and helpful reception. However, it is as if they actually have another job and are looking after you as an additional job. Besides, this type of hotel "Even if it was an adult hotel concept, you could have a more peaceful holiday without the squealing kids using the pool. If they focus on the better, it will become a 100-point hotel."

review_text: "Güler yüzlü personeli,temizliği ve konforu bence kesinlikle gelip görülmeye değer…"
translated_text: "I think its friendly staff, cleanliness and comfort are definitely worth coming and seeing..."

review_text: "İki günlük bir tatili için sectigimiz ve çok ama çok memnun kaldığımız bir otel odaları ve havuzu oldukça temiz kahvaltısı çok güzel tavsiye edeceğimiz bir otel"
translated_text: "We chose the hotel for a two-day holiday and were very pleased with it. The rooms and pool are very clean, the breakfast is very nice, it is a hotel we would recommend."

review_text: "Çok güzel çok temiz kahvaltısı açık büfe ve güzel biz memnun kaldık."
translated_text: "Very nice, very clean, breakfast is open buffet and nice, we were satisfied."

review_text: "地點位置很好，房間也很舒服，環境更是漂亮，好停車，門口都有管理員，安全有保障，離機場很近，距離住的地方的十多分鐘步行距離內就有兩間賣場，如果晚一點玩回來還可以找吃的（我是比較推薦Deepo)，櫃檯人員很友善，會盡力解決問題"
translated_text: "地點位置很好，房間也很舒服，環境更是漂亮，好停車，門口都有管理員，安全有保障，離機場很近，距離住的地方的十多分鐘步行距離內就有兩間賣場，如果晚一點玩回來還可以找吃的（我是比較推薦Deepo)，櫃檯人員很友善，會盡力解決問題"

review_text: "Bu fiyata bu lokayonda kalmak gayet iyiydi.Kahvaltı gayet güzeldi.Nazik,ulaşılabilir bir pansiyon.Oda çok küçüktü,minik de olsa duş için bir sabun olabilirdi ama bu fiyata gene de çok iyi.Klima ve tv ve buzdolabı vardı ve çalışıyordu."

The room was very small, there could have been a soap for the shower, even if it was tiny, but it was still very good for this price. There was air conditioning, a TV and a refrigerator and it was working."

review_text: "Gayet konforlu, her odada klima var, kahvalti iyi, personel guler yuzlu ve yardimci, ve lokasyon mükkemmel heryer yurume mesafesi."
translated_text: "It is very comfortable, every room has air conditioning, the breakfast is good, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the location is perfect, walking distance to everywhere."

review_text: "einfache preiswerte Unterkunft in fantastischer Lage mit freundlich familiären Ambiente. Zimmer war klein aber mit eigenem Bad."

Very clean room, comfortable bed. Yacub and his wife are very kind and welcoming. Parking is located right opposite and free."

review_text: "아담하면서 깨끗하고 친절한 직원분들의 응대가 이번여행에서 가장 감동적이었던곳 여행을 편안하게 도와준 호텔직원분들께 감사를 드립니다 작지만 강한호텔이었어요"

translated_text: "I was generally satisfied with the hotel, the location is very nice, you can easily go anywhere in the castle. They were clean and attentive. Only the room was a little small, but still preferable."

translated_text: "We had no problems, the service was very good, the employees were friendly and solution oriented, thank you for everything."

translated_text: "It's a bit of an old hotel. But the staff tries to help and is friendly. It's clean. It's a good hotel at its level, I would stay again if I had business again."

review_text: "Für ein paar Tage ganz in Ordnung, allerdings erwartet keinen Luxus"
translated_text: "Okay for a few days, but don't expect luxury"

review_text: "Hotellet ligger ca 30 min från flygplatsen. Nära till restauranger, parker och stranden. Trevlig personal."
translated_text: "The hotel is about 30 minutes from the airport. Close to restaurants, parks and the beach. Friendly staff."

translated_text: "Cleaning is done daily, it's very important to me. Breakfast is simple but very good."

review_text: "Si la musique des restaurants voisins jusqu’à minuit ne vous dérange pas, choisissez cet hôtel très bien situé dans la vieille ville avec une piscine vraiment appréciable. Mention spéciale au jus d’orange pressé frais chaque matin délicieux !"
translated_text: "If you don't mind the music from neighboring restaurants until midnight, choose this hotel very well located in the old town with a really nice swimming pool. Special mention to the delicious fresh squeezed orange juice every morning!"

review_text: "Het personeel is echt super. Altijd bereid om te helpen en advies te geven. Het ontbijt is goed en het hotel wordt elke ochtend grondig gekuist. Het hotel heeft een leuk zwembad en ligt in het centrum, vlakbij de haven.De budget kamers zijn basic, niet veel meer dan een bed en kleine douche met nauwelijks water. Vraag naar een kamer aan het zwembad. Aan de straatkant is er s nachts lawaai van het café aan de overkant van de straat."
translated_text: "The staff is really great. Always willing to help and give advice. The breakfast is good and the hotel is thoroughly cleaned every morning. The hotel has a nice swimming pool and is located in the center, near the harbour. The budget rooms are basic, not much more than a bed and a small shower with hardly any water. Ask for a room by the pool. On the street side, there is noise at night from the café across the street."

review_text: "Супер хозяин ! Хороший отель ! Местоположение ! Единственное на выходные будет играть громко музыка в соседнем баре !"
translated_text: "Super host! Nice hotel! Location! The only thing on the weekend will be loud music in the next bar!"

Personal und Service ebenso nett, hilfsbereit und zuvorkommend! Wir können es nur mit gutem Gewissen allen weiterempfehlen."
translated_text: "Super great hotel! Beautiful, old stone house with a charming courtyard and small garden + small swimming pool. Everything is so indescribably tasteful! The staff and service are just as nice, helpful and courteous! We can only recommend it to everyone with a clear conscience."

The variety at breakfast was sufficient. Only the breakfast area was very hot. Overall, I was satisfied."

review_text: "Ya çok iyi otelleri tercih edin ya da butik olanları. Bu seviyedeki oteller hiçbir konuda profesyonel de değiller veya yardımcı da olmuyorlar. Garip bir soğukluk var genel olarak. Ama daha iyilerini gördüyseniz bunlar yerine daha butik ve samimi olan oteller tercih edebilirsiniz."
translated_text: "Either choose very good hotels or boutique ones. Hotels at this level are not professional or helpful in any way. There is a strange coldness in general. The employees are mostly interns. There are a few older people, and they are in important places. If you are vacationing with zero expectations from the hotel, this is suitable. But if you have seen better ones, you can choose more boutique and friendly hotels instead."

review_text: "Kahvalti salonunda ve lobide klima yasagi var otelde. Insanlar ter içinde ve klimalar süs olarak duruyor. Gece 01 e kadar otel disindan bir dans okulu gecesi. Muxikler harika ancak uyku sıfır"

review_text: "Havuzu dışında ekstra bir özelliği yok . Spor salonu çok eski ve yetersiz. Kendi beachlerine 50 dk yürüme mesafesinde oysa ki odayı satarken 15 dk demişlerdi. Kahvaltı güzeldi."

review_text: "Ich habe kurzfristig ein Zimmer für eine Nacht gebucht. In dieser Preiskategorie erwarte ich keinen Luxus, jedoch ist Sauberkeit eine Grundvoraussetzung. Das Zimmer war nicht gereinigt, und das Bad befand sich in einem unhygienischen Zustand. Offenbar wurde es nach den vorherigen Gästen nicht ordnungsgemäß gesäubert."
translated_text: "I booked a room for one night at short notice. I don't expect luxury in this price category, but cleanliness is a basic requirement. The room was not cleaned and the bathroom was in an unhygienic condition. Apparently it was not cleaned properly after previous guests."

review_text: "Sokak arası bir otel. Girişi bulmak zor. Park sorunu var. Personel sanırım. Oda anahtarı çalışmıyordu. Bina eski bir Antalya evi, güzel. Şehrin ortasında kalmasına rağmen sessiz. Merkeze çok yakın olması avantajlı. Kısa süreli kalmak için uygun."
translated_text: "It is a hotel across the street. It is difficult to find the entrance. There is a parking problem. I think it is the staff. The room key was not working. The building is an old Antalya house, it is beautiful. It is quiet even though it is in the middle of the city. It is advantageous to be very close to the center. Suitable for short-term stay."

review_text: "Odamız gerek zemin kat olması gerek aydınlatmanın kötü olması kaynaklı gece gündüz karanlıktı bu da sizde ferah bir ortamdaymışsınız hissi vermiyor. translated_text: "Our room was dark day and night due to the fact that it was on the ground floor and the lighting was bad, which does not give you the feeling of being in a spacious environment. The cleanliness of the sheets, curtains and bathroom could have been better. The breakfast is served on a plate, not as in the picture. The staff is extremely polite, thank you."

review_text: "Ruhige Gegend"

review_text: "Fint hotell ligger väldigt bra centralt och nära till Mark Antalya centrum med knappt 10 min promenad. Trevliga personal som ler och hälsar. translated_text: "Nice hotel located very well centrally and close to Mark Antalya center with just under 10 minutes' walk. Nice staff who smile and greet. The room was nice, a little minus that it took extra time to cool down the room at the beginning but after a few minutes the room was cooled and comfortable. One more thing to keep in mind is that there is no elevator in this hotel and we were on the fourth and highest floor."

It may cause problems for the elderly or those with walking difficulties who will go to the upper floors. Generally, it is a clean hotel."

review_text: "Her geçen gün daha kötü oluyor personel ilgisiz"

translated_text: "The bed comfort was very good, the minibar cabinet in our room was not working, we just couldn't see enough cleaning attention, everything else was great, it was a price-performance hotel (Also, the colleagues at the reception were very attentive and friendly, we were pleased)"

review_text: "Das Personal ist freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Hotel ist stark in die Jahre gekommen und entspricht nicht einem 4 Sterne Hotel. Die nächtliche Beschallung der Gaststätte gegenüber ist sehr laut, genauso wie die lautstarken Nachbarn der Zimmer. Zur Ruhe gekommen sind wir nicht. Das Frühstück entspricht nicht mal einfachem türkischem Standard."
translated_text: "The staff is friendly and helpful. The hotel is very old and does not correspond to a 4 star hotel. The nighttime sound system in the restaurant opposite is very loud, as are the noisy neighbors of the rooms. We didn't get any rest. The breakfast doesn't even meet simple Turkish standards."

review_text: "Le séjour très bien passé l’hôtel très bien. Dans le réception mR berkay très serviable. Juste le soir musique très tardive. On attend jusqu’à la chambre. Et petit déjeuner à revoir pas trop choix. Jus de fruit en option"
translated_text: "The stay was very good, the hotel was very good. In the reception Mr Berkay very helpful. Just in the evening very late music. We wait until the room. And breakfast to review not too much choice. Fruit juice optional"

review_text: "Genel olarak memmun kaldım. Sanırım en üst katta olmamdan dolayı, biraz rutubet kokusu vardı. Denize sıfır olması, plajının güzelliği ve yeme içme alternatiflerinin çok fazla olması güzeldi."
translated_text: "Overall, I was satisfied. I think there was a bit of a damp smell because I was on the top floor. It was nice that it was right by the sea, the beauty of the beach, and the abundance of food and beverage alternatives."

review_text: "Vasat. Temizlik iyi, kalitesiz ve turizmci olmayan personel... İdare eder şeklinde bir hizmet"
translated_text: "Mediocre. Cleanliness is good, staff is of poor quality and not touristic... Service is okay"

review_text: "Otel genel olarak normaldi ama giriş resepsiyondakiler biraz suratsızdı idare eder bir gün kaldım yeterli oldu"
translated_text: "The hotel was generally normal, but the people at the entrance reception were a bit grumpy. It was okay. I stayed for one day, it was enough."

review_text: "Hotel Lage ist eigentlich top. Sehr gute Locale in der Umgebung.Allerdngs ist das Hotel in einem schlechten Zustand."
translated_text: "Hotel location is actually great. Very good locale in the area. However, the hotel is in a bad condition."

review_text: "Bu otelde 4 gün kaldım emin olun fırsatım olsaydı uzatırdım. O kadar güzel ilgi görüyorsunuzki anlatamam yemekler nefis. Hijyen mükemmel hiçbir sorun yaşamadık herşey çok güzeldi."
translated_text: "I stayed at this hotel for 4 days, rest assured, I would have extended it if I had the opportunity. You receive such good attention that I cannot describe it, the food is delicious. The hygiene is perfect, we had no problems, everything was great."

review_text: "Guzel bir yer, beach i de cok guzel ama, biraz kalabalik bir yer"
translated_text: "It's a nice place, the beach is also very nice, but it's a bit crowded."

review_text: "Çalışanları yardımsever, özellikle Şinasi bey 3 günlük konaklama sürecinde çok ilgilendi. Nazik ve yardımsever, kendisine özel teşekkür ediyorum ve memnun ayrıldık. Spa bölümünde çalışanlar profesyonel bir şekilde işini yaptılar."
translated_text: "The staff is helpful, especially Mr. Şinasi was very attentive during our 3-day stay. He is kind and helpful, I would like to thank him specially and we left satisfied. The staff in the spa department did their job professionally."

review_text: "Die Anlage ist sehr alt und wenig einladend. Essen leider auch nicht…. Sehr enttäuschend für ein 5 Sterne Hotel. Max 3 Sterne wenn überhaupt"
translated_text: "The facility is very old and not very inviting. Unfortunately there is no food either... Very disappointing for a 5 star hotel. Max 3 stars if at all"

review_text: "Meget fornøyd med hotellet og personalet. Alle var hyggelige og behjelpelige. Kjempe fin beliggenhet, gangavstand til gamlebyen og parken var rett ved hotellet."
translated_text: "Very satisfied with the hotel and the staff. Everyone was nice and helpful. Great location, walking distance to the old town and the park was right next to the hotel."

review_text: "Wir waren zu dritt dort. Zwei Erwachsene und ein Kind. Nachts um zwei waren wir im Hotel. Und der Check in wäre am Tag davor gewesen….trotzdem mussten wir darauf warten, dass das Zusatzbett gemacht wird. Das fand ich schon ziemlich anstrengend. Schöner wäre es gewesen, wenn alles schon fertig gewesen wäre. Schließlich wissen die, wann wer kommt. Das Frühstück war sehr gut. Man hat sehr viel Auswahl und alles war frisch"
translated_text: "There were three of us there. Two adults and one child. We were at the hotel at two in the morning. And the check-in would have been the day before... but we still had to wait for the extra bed to be made. I found that quite tiring. It would have been nicer if everything had already been ready. After all, they know when who is coming. The breakfast was very good. There is a lot to choose from and everything was fresh."

review_text: "Geen 5 sterren waard. Netheid is een serieus aandachtspunt. Schoonmaken kamer is niet ok, zwembadwater meeste dagen troubel,, de vloer van het zwembad is glad, schermen naast zwembad worden nooit schoon gemaakt, etc. Jammer eigenlijk, want het is een heel mooi hotel op een hele mooie locatie met lekker eten en dranken."
translated_text: "Not worth 5 stars. Cleanliness is a serious point of attention. Room cleaning is not ok, pool water is cloudy most days, the floor of the pool is slippery, screens next to the pool are never cleaned, etc. A shame really, because it is a very nice hotel in a very nice location with good food and drinks."

review_text: "Alles super"
translated_text: “Come on great”

review_text: "Bra hotell med meget bra beliggenhet. Gode fasiliteter."
translated_text: "Good hotel in a very good location. Good facilities."

review_text: "Iyi bir Hotel, ama yinede ödedigim rakamla karsilastirinca beklentim daha fazlaydi."
translated_text: "It's a good hotel, but still, my expectations were higher compared to what I paid."

review_text: "Tekrar konaklamayı düşünmem."
translated_text: "I wouldn't consider staying again."

review_text: "Otel premium hizmet kalitesinde sunuldu ve ona göre ücret alındı fakat personelin alakasız tavırları ve konaklama sürecinde deneyimlerimiz olumsuz ve sunulan herşey ücretli alakalı alakasız çok kötü bir deneyimdi
translated_text: "The hotel was offered with premium service quality and the fee was charged accordingly, but the irrelevant attitudes of the staff and our experience during the stay were negative and everything offered was paid and irrelevant, it was a very bad experience

review_text: "Çok güzel konakladık. Mutlu ayrıldık. Odamız çok güzeldi. Otel temiz konforluydu."
translated_text: "We had a great stay. We left happy. Our room was very nice. The hotel was clean and comfortable."

review_text: "Mooi zwembad en goede toegang tot de zee. Keurige kamers. Erg vriendelijk personeel. Geweldig ontbijt."
translated_text: "Nice pool and good access to the sea. Neat rooms. Very friendly staff. Great breakfast."

review_text: "El hotel es grande y bien ubicado lo único que creo es que está un poco descuidado con la limpieza"
translated_text: "The hotel is large and well located, the only thing I think is that it is a little neglected with cleanliness"

review_text: "Güzel bir konaklama geçirdim . Bir üst kategori odayı oteli müsaitliğine göre ücretsiz verdiler . Deniz manzaralı güzel bir oda idi . Lavaboda bile televizyon sesini dinleyebilmek ayrıntısını dusunmelerine şaşırdım :) Kahvaltıları otel içinden karşıya geçilen denize sıfır restarauntta yeniliyor . Kahvaltıda eksik bisey yoktu . Kahvaltı alırken yoruldum . Ucu bucağı yok . Kesinlikle tekrar gelip daha uzun süre konaylayacagım ."
translated_text: "I had a nice stay. They gave me a higher category room free of charge, depending on the hotel's availability. It was a nice room with a sea view. I was surprised that they thought of the detail of being able to listen to the television sound even in the sink :) Breakfast is served at the seaside restaurant across the hotel. There was nothing missing at breakfast. I was tired while eating breakfast. It was endless. I will definitely come again and stay for a longer time."

review_text: "Cok iyi otel ve çalışanlar"
translated_text: "Very good hotel and staff"

review_text: "Çok güzel ve keyifli bir tatildi. Teşekkür ederiz."
translated_text: "It was a very nice and enjoyable holiday. Thank you."

review_text: "Otelde adına yakışmayacak kadar kötü bir odada konaklamak durumunda kaldım. Oda havasız küçücük bir penceresi olan klostrofobik bir odaydı ve tuvalette sifonu sürekli su akıtıyordu. Otellerin nispeten farklı kalitede odaları olabilir ancak diğer odalarla aynı fiyata satmamalısınız. 10-15 gün önce adını vermeyeceğim başka bir otelde benzer fiyatla konakladım. Karşılaştırırsam diğer otel 4 ise bu konaklama 1 maalesef."
translated_text: "I had to stay in a bad room that did not live up to its name. The room was airless, a claustrophobic room with a tiny window, and the toilet was constantly flushing water. Hotels may have rooms of relatively different quality, but you should not sell them for the same price as other rooms. I stayed in another hotel, which I will not name, 10-15 days ago, with a similar price. If I compare it, if the other hotel is 4, this stay is 1, unfortunately."

review_text: "War ganz okay"
translated_text: "It was okay"

review_text: "Guzel ve temiz bir otel açık büfe kahvaltısında aradığınızı bulabilirsiniz"
translated_text: "You can find what you are looking for in a nice and clean hotel's open buffet breakfast."

review_text: "Konumu,otel olarak yeterli güzel rahatsız eden personelin kendi aralarında yüksek sesle konuşması,havuz başı deniz kenarında menü yeterli değildi. Doymadık. Bunu tüm personel için diyemem çok kibar olanlar da vardı Beach de rahatsız olduk ve açık büfede kahvaltı da. Bu güzel otele yatırıma yazık olmasın."

translated_text: "If you are going to go, think not twice but 10 times. There is no service, there is a lot of indifference, zero friendliness, zero cleanliness."

review_text: "Hotellet var mycket väl beläget precis utanför spårvagnshållplatsen Dogugaraj, (kom hit med spårvagn - det var svårt att ta sig hit med taxi.) Incheckningen gick snabbt! Hotellet har ingen hiss så vi lämnade vår tunga resväska i receptionen. Rummet var lagom för tre personer, den hade en dubbelsäng och enkelsäng, en liten garderob och ett bord med stol och spegel samt en liten tv på väggen. Rummet hade en egen toalett med en liten dusch med hyfsat bra tryck (i alla fall nattetid.) Vårt rum var tyst, vi hörde inga ljud alls utifrån eller från närliggande rum, hotellet kändes säkert. Det fanns ingen minibar, men sängarna var bekväma och möblerna kändes ganska nya så det störde inte så mycket. Tvål fanns på toaletten och små flaskor med vad jag tror schampo och duschtvål, vi använde dem dock inte. Frukost vet jag inte om det fanns, men wifi fungerade bra! Inget fel heller på luftkonditioneringen, blev tillochmed lite kallt mitt i barten. Det finns många matställen i direkta närheten och även en Starbucks mittemot spårvagnsspåret. Helt klart värt att bo ett par nätter eftersom det är så centralt beläget! Ladda ner appen Moovit så tar du dig runt enkelt och billigt med härligt sval spårvagn (eller buss)."
translated_text: "The hotel was very well located right outside the Dogugaraj tram stop, (came here by tram - it was difficult to get here by taxi.) Check-in was quick! The hotel has no lift so we left our heavy suitcase at the reception. The room was adequate for three people, it had a double and single bed, a small wardrobe and a table with a chair and mirror and a small TV on the wall. The room had its own toilet with a small shower with decent pressure (at least our room was quiet, we didn't hear any noise from outside, the hotel didn't have a mini-bar, but the furniture was quite new, and there were small bottles of shampoo and shower gel, I don't know if they were there, but the air conditioner was a bit cold eateries in the immediate vicinity and even a Starbucks opposite the tram track. Definitely worth staying for a couple of nights because it's so centrally located! Download the Moovit app and you'll get around easily and cheaply by tram (or bus)."

translated_text: "Never again!!! Hygiene is catastrophic, there are cockroaches in the bathroom and the breakfast buffet is very poor. The hotel definitely needs a renovation."

review_text: "Freundlicher Empfang, sehr hilfsbereites Personal. Danke"

review_text: "Pour une 1 nuit parfait ! Trop de parfum de lit dans la chambre A réveillée mon asthme Pas d’ascenseur"
