review_text: "Odalar küçük, tuvalet ve banyo yerleri sıkıntılı ancak personel güler yüzlü ve yardımcı."
translated_text: "The rooms are small, the toilet and bathroom areas are problematic, but the staff is friendly and helpful."

review_text: "Jätte nöjd med hotellet, rent och fräscht. Personalen är trevliga och är jätte välkomnande. Skulle starkt rekommendera. 10/10"
translated_text: "Very happy with the hotel, clean and fresh. The staff are nice and very welcoming. Would highly recommend. 10/10"

review_text: "otel çok güzel ama antalya merkeze uzak eğer yüzmek için bir tatile geldiyseniz tercih edilebilir onun dışında fiyatına göre çok güzel bir oteldi personelleri çok güler yüzlü ve yardımseverlerdi"
translated_text: "The hotel is very nice, but it is far from the center of Antalya. If you are on a holiday to swim, it may be preferred. Apart from that, it was a very nice hotel for its price. The staff was very friendly and helpful."

review_text: "Beş gecelik bir tatil için tercih ettik genel olarak google üstünden yapılan yorumlardan dolayı korkmuştuk ama genel olarak bir sıkıntı yaşamadık. Sabah kahvaltısı açık büfe ve yeterli geldi bize. Odadaki klimalara bakım yapılması gerektiğini düşünüyoruz ama iki odaya tek klima biraz yetersiz gibiydi ama yine kalınamayacak kadar sıcak olmadığı için mutluyuz. Odalardaki tekli yataklar kesinlikle değiştirilmeli telleri batıyordu gerçekten. Temizliği üç güne bir yapıyolarmış ikiye falan düşürülebilir bence ayrıca ön kısımdaki havuzun temizliği gayet iyiydi ama arka kısımdaki havuza da aynı özenin gösterilmesi gerektiğini düşünüyorum. Otelin kendi plajı var ücretsiz kullanıyorsunuz okeydi gayet. Biz hizmetten yana da herhangi bir saygısızlık ya da zorluk yaşamadık kaba davranışları yoktu. Genel olarak fiyat performans bir yer tercih edilebilir."
translated_text: "We chose it for a five-night holiday, we were generally afraid because of the comments made on Google, but in general we did not have any problems. The breakfast was an open buffet and it was sufficient for us. We think that the air conditioners in the room need to be maintained, but only one air conditioner in two rooms seemed a little inadequate, but we are happy that it was not too hot to stay. The single beds in the rooms should definitely be replaced, the wires were really sinking. I think they do the cleaning every three days, it can be reduced to two or so. Also, I think the cleaning of the pool in the front was very good, but the pool in the back was the same." "I think care should be taken. The hotel has its own beach, you can use it free of charge. It was fine. We did not experience any disrespect or difficulty in terms of service, and there was no rude behavior. In general, it is a good place to stay."

review_text: "Bir gece kaldık aile için rahat bir yer. Fotoğrafında göründüğü gibi deniz kenarı değil, sadece anlaşmalı plajı varmış biz kullanmadık."
translated_text: "We stayed for one night, it is a comfortable place for the family. It is not by the sea as it appears in the photo, it only has a contracted beach, we did not use it."

review_text: "Petit déjeuner bon , wifi ne fonctionne pas, chambre plutôt bien agencé matelas confortable, nous avons séjourné 4 jours avec 3 enfants dans une chambre familiale le ménage n’a pas été fait pendant tout le séjour aucun réapprovisionnement"
translated_text: "Breakfast good, wifi does not work, room rather well appointed comfortable mattress, we stayed 4 days with 3 children in a family room cleaning was not done during the entire stay no restocking"

review_text: "War alles in Ordnung"
translated_text: “Everything was fine”

review_text: "Alleen airco deed wat minder cooler , de rest was goed."
translated_text: "Only the air conditioning was a little less cooler, the rest was good."

review_text: "Hôtel très bien situé, chambre très propre, lit confortable et personnel très gentil, je recommande"
translated_text: “Hotel very well located, very clean room, comfortable bed and very kind staff, I recommend”

review_text: "Her şey çok güzeldi ilgi alaka temizlik"
translated_text: "Everything was great, care, cleanliness"

review_text: "genel olarak sessiz fakat otele gelen Arap müşteriler çok ses yapıyor ve otel de uyarmıyor diğer müşterilerim rahatsız olduğu bariz belli , temizlik 3 gün kaldık ve hiç yapılmadı odadan çıkış yaptığınızda giriyorlar genel puan 10 üzerinden 3-4 civarı ona göre değerlendirin ."
translated_text: "It is generally quiet, but the Arab customers coming to the hotel make a lot of noise and the hotel does not warn them. It is obvious that my other customers are disturbed. We stayed for 3 days and the cleaning was not done at all. They enter the room when you check out. The general score is around 3-4 out of 10, rate accordingly."

review_text: "Hygienische Zimmer und nettes Personal"
translated_text: "Hygienic rooms and friendly staff"

review_text: "Wir sind am späten Abend angereist und nur für eine Nacht zum schlafen. Vielleicht deswegen haben wir ein Zimmer bekommen mit einer Aussicht auf die 10 m entfernte Baustelle, einem dreckigen Balkon und Badezimmer ohne Fenster UND keiner Beleuchtung :) Aber sonst hat die Anlage einen netten Eindruck gemacht. Das Frühstück war ganz gut."
translated_text: "We arrived late in the evening and only slept for one night. Maybe that's why we got a room with a view of the construction site 10 meters away, a dirty balcony and a bathroom with no windows AND no lighting :) But otherwise the facility made a nice impression. The breakfast was quite good."

review_text: "Genel olarak orta kalitede bir otel diyebiliriz. Fiyatıyla orantılı sayılabilir. İmkanlar kısıtlı olsa da hizmet kalitesi arttırılabilir diye düşünüyorum."
translated_text: "In general, we can say that it is a medium quality hotel. It can be considered commensurate with its price. Even though the facilities are limited, I think the service quality can be improved."

review_text: "Ich habe mich im Lara Beach Hotel sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Sauberkeit im gesamten Hotel war auf höchstem Niveau, überall roch es angenehm frisch. Das hat mir direkt beim Ankommen einen sehr guten Eindruck vermittelt. Ein großes Lob an Ferdi und Abdullah – beide waren immer freundlich, hilfsbereit und gut gelaunt. Man konnte sich jederzeit an sie wenden und bekam sofort Unterstützung. Das Frühstück war jeden Tag ein bisschen anders und sehr abwechslungsreich. Es gab reichlich Auswahl, sowohl warme als auch kalte Speisen, und alles war frisch zubereitet. Die zwei Swimmingpools waren sauber und schön angelegt. Besonders positiv fand ich, dass ein Bereich etwas abgegrenzt war, sodass Babys und Kleinkinder sicher planschen konnten. Auch das Hamam hat mir gut gefallen – gepflegt und professionell geführt. Was die Lage betrifft: Das Hotel liegt zentral in einer ruhigen Gegend. Der Lara Beach mit seinem wunderschönen Sandstrand ist nur etwa 3 Minuten mit dem Auto entfernt. Auch für Nichtschwimmer ist der Strand geeignet. Es gibt dort Liegen, eine Bar und Snacks – alles ab etwa 200 TL. Der Flughafen ist nur rund 14 Minuten mit dem Auto entfernt, was die An- und Abreise sehr unkompliziert macht. Der Hotelbesitzer war jederzeit präsent, professionell und zuvorkommend. Man merkt, dass hier alles gut organisiert ist. Insgesamt war mein Aufenthalt sehr angenehm, und ich würde das Hotel definitiv wieder buchen."
translated_text: "I felt very comfortable in the Lara Beach Hotel. The cleanliness of the entire hotel was at the highest level, it smelled pleasantly fresh everywhere. That gave me a very good impression as soon as I arrived. A big compliment to Ferdi and Abdullah - they were both always friendly, helpful and in a good mood. You could contact them at any time and get immediate support. The breakfast was a little different every day and very varied. There was plenty of choice, both hot and cold dishes, and everything was freshly prepared. The The two swimming pools were clean and nicely laid out. I particularly liked the fact that one area was somewhat separated so that babies and small children could splash around safely. As for the location, the hotel is centrally located in a quiet area. The beach is also suitable for non-swimmers "It's only about 14 minutes away by car, which makes arrival and departure very easy. The hotel owner was always present, professional and courteous. You can tell that everything is well organized here. Overall, my stay was very pleasant and I would definitely book the hotel again."

review_text: "Temiz ferah huzurlu sesiz"
translated_text: "Clean, spacious, peaceful and quiet"

review_text: "Otelinizde çok keyifli bir konaklama yaptık. Odamızdan kahvaltıdaki açık büfeye kadar her şeyden çok memnun kaldık. Spa’da geçirdiğimiz vakit de bizim için çok rahatlatıcı ve güzeldi. Misafirperverliğiniz için teşekkür ederiz."
translated_text: "We had a very pleasant stay at your hotel. We were very pleased with everything, from our room to the open buffet at breakfast. The time we spent at the spa was also very relaxing and nice for us. Thank you for your hospitality."

review_text: "Хороший отель в тихом месте. Приятный бассейн, чистые номера, кондиционер в каждой комнате. Завтрак простой без изысков. Море далековато, но ездит трансфер 2 раза в день. Рядом магазины и кафе. Что не понравилось: очень плохая шумоизоляция, соседи приходили поздно вечером и шумели так, что невозможно было заснуть. Еще и дети бегали по коридору и звонили в звонки всех комнат. Мы сами были с маленькими детьми и уложить их под этот звон и грохот было нереально. Отель заявлен как аппартаменты с кухней, но по факту ни плиты ни посуды нет, только 2 кружки и 2 стакана. Пришлось есть доширак или ходить в кафе. В целом, отель только на переночевать и на весь день ехать на море."
translated_text: "Nice hotel in a quiet location. Nice swimming pool, clean rooms, air conditioning in each room. Breakfast is simple without any frills. The sea is a bit far away, but the shuttle runs 2 times a day. Shops and cafes are nearby. What we didn’t like: very poor sound insulation, neighbors came late at night and made such noise that it was impossible to sleep. Children also ran along the corridor and rang the bells of all rooms. We ourselves were with small children and put them under this The ringing and noise was unrealistic. The hotel is advertised as an apartment with a kitchen, but in fact there is no stove or dishes, only 2 mugs and 2 glasses. I had to eat bread or go to a cafe. In general, the hotel is only for an overnight stay and for the whole day to go to the sea."

review_text: "Godt hotel, men morgenmadsbuffeten var lidt kedelig og så skulle vi selv henvende os op til to gange i receptionen for at få rengøring på værelset. Vi fik kun rengøring én gang på 5 nætter, hvilket var lidt ulækkert da vi lige pludselig manglede både rene håndklæder og toiletpapir.."
translated_text: "Good hotel, but the breakfast buffet was a bit boring and then we had to go to reception twice to have the room cleaned. We only got cleaning once in 5 nights, which was a bit disgusting as we suddenly lacked both clean towels and toilet paper.."

review_text: "İyiydi fakat havuza girme saat aralığı biraz daha artirilabilirdi.Kahvalti çok güzeldi.Odalar temiz ve hazırdı.İki klima olması da çok iyiydi."
translated_text: "It was good, but the time interval for swimming in the pool could have been increased a little more. The breakfast was very good. The rooms were clean and ready. It was also very good to have two air conditioners."

review_text: "Sehr sehr gutes Hotel weiterzuempfehlen"
translated_text: “Very, very good hotel, recommended”

review_text: "Utmärkt personal hjälper med allt speciellt Aleyna som sitter receptionen Grym Spa chefen som heter Mehmet o hans personal Fifri Riska grymma massörer o Turkisk hamam Tack för allt syns nästa år"
translated_text: "Excellent staff helps with everything especially Aleyna who sits at the reception Grym Spa the manager named Mehmet o his staff Fifri Riska awesome masseuses o Turkish hammam Thanks for everything see you next year"

review_text: "Her şey cok güzeldi cok ilgilendiler tekrar giderim dediğim bir yer"
translated_text: "Everything was great, they took great care of me, it's a place I want to go back to"

review_text: "Tolles Frühstück, Pool und komplette Anlage sehr sauber. Große Zimmer. Bar am Pool nicht in Betrieb, da Recht neues Hotel."
translated_text: "Great breakfast, pool and entire area very clean. Large rooms. Bar by the pool not in operation as the hotel is quite new."

review_text: "Met mijn gezin zijn we 3 nachten in Laristone Suite Spa Hotel verbleven. Personeel is zeer vriendelijk en de accommodatie is vrij rustig. Voor Turkse begrip krijg je een gevarieerd en goed ontbijt. Vooral mijn complementen aan Ahmet die elke dag met een glimlach je te woord staat en vragen die je hebt voor je oplost. Daarom hebben we voor de terugweg wederom voor twee nachten geboekt."
translated_text: "We stayed with my family for 3 nights at the Laristone Suite Spa Hotel. The staff is very friendly and the accommodation is quite quiet. For Turkish standards, you get a varied and good breakfast. I would especially like to compliment Ahmet, who speaks to you every day with a smile and solves any questions you may have. That is why we have booked again for two nights on the way back."

review_text: "Çok temiz düzenli ve güzel bir otel , kesinlikle tavsiye edilebilir Karşılama da gayet kibar ve güzeldi."
translated_text: "A very clean, tidy and nice hotel, can definitely be recommended. The welcome was also very polite and nice."

review_text: "Otel resimlerdeki gibiydi. Yeni temiz ve güzeldi. Çalişanlar ilgiliydi. Misafirlerinin isteklerini dikkate aliyorlar. Park sorunu yok. Beklentisi yüksek olmayanlar icin dogru ve güzel bir tercih olacaktir."
translated_text: "The hotel was just like in the pictures. It was new, clean and beautiful. The employees were attentive. They take into account the wishes of their guests. There is no parking problem. It will be a good and correct choice for those who do not have high expectations."

review_text: "Utmärkt hotel"
translated_text: "Excellent hotel"

review_text: "Ich hatte ein Standard Einzelzimmer gebucht und direkt beim Check-in ein kostenloses Upgrade auf das Deluxe Zimmer erhalten. Ich hatte somit ein komplettes 2 Zimmer Apartment mit Küche für mich zur Verfügung . Das Zimmer war sehr gut ausgestattet und sogar eine Waschmaschine war vorhanden. Das Personal war immer freundlich und hilfsbereit und die Lage ist ausgezeichnet. Zum Strand sowie zu Einkaufs- und Essensmöglichkeiten sind es nur 1-2 Minute. Kurz gesagt war ich mit meinem Aufenthalt sehr zufrieden und kann es nur weiter empfehlen"
translated_text: "I had booked a standard single room and received a free upgrade to the deluxe room immediately upon check-in. This gave me a complete 2-room apartment with a kitchen at my disposal. The room was very well equipped and there was even a washing machine. The staff were always friendly and helpful and the location is excellent. It is only 1-2 minutes to the beach as well as shopping and dining options. In short, I was very satisfied with my stay and can only recommend it."

review_text: "Wij verbleven 4 dagen in Elysium. Het hotel is prachtig, schoon en netjes. Ook het ontbijt was gevarieerd. We hebben met veel plezier hier gelogeerd. Wat we minder vonden: • Op de onderste verdieping hing een vieze lucht • Het eten in het restaurant viel erg tegen: het was niet lekker en bovendien erg duur. Zo betaalden we €7 voor een bordje patat dat ook nog eens koud werd geserveerd. • Het hotel ligt vrij afgelegen, waardoor je echt een auto nodig hebt."
translated_text: "We stayed in Elysium for 4 days. The hotel is beautiful, clean and tidy. The breakfast was also varied. We enjoyed staying here. What we didn't like: • There was a bad smell on the bottom floor • The food in the restaurant was very disappointing: it was not tasty and also very expensive. For example, we paid €7 for a plate of fries that were also served cold. • The hotel is quite remote, so you really need a car."

review_text: "Alles bestens, nur sehr weit vom Zentrum entfernt"
translated_text: “Everything was fine, just very far from the center”

review_text: "Je recommande vivement Elysium Deluxe Suites pour toute personne en quête de confort, de calme et de qualité. Situé dans un quartier paisible de Kepez, cet établissement est un véritable havre de paix. Les suites sont modernes, spacieuses et impeccablement propres, avec tout le nécessaire pour un séjour agréable : kitchenette, climatisation, Wi-Fi rapide… tout est pensé pour le bien-être du client. Le personnel est d'une gentillesse remarquable, toujours disponible et à l’écoute, ce qui rend l’expérience encore plus chaleureuse. Mention spéciale pour l’accueil attentionné et les petites attentions qui font la différence. C’est l’adresse idéale pour se ressourcer loin de l’agitation, tout en étant à proximité de l’aéroport. Le rapport qualité/prix est excellent, et je n’hésiterai pas à y revenir lors d’un prochain séjour à Antalya."
translated_text: "I highly recommend Elysium Deluxe Suites for anyone looking for comfort, calm and quality. Located in a peaceful area of Kepez, this establishment is a true haven of peace. The suites are modern, spacious and impeccably clean, with everything necessary for a pleasant stay: kitchenette, air conditioning, fast Wi-Fi… everything is designed for the well-being of the guest. The staff is remarkably kind, always available and attentive, which makes the experience even warmer. Special mention for the attentive welcome and the little touches that make the difference. It is the ideal place to relax away from the hustle and bustle, while being close to the airport. The quality/price ratio is excellent, and I will not hesitate to return there during a future stay in Antalya.

review_text: "Çok memnunuz otelden ve görevlilerden"
translated_text: "We are very pleased with the hotel and the staff"

review_text: "Vi vart jätte nöjda! Jag var där med mina 2 döttrar. Allt var perfekt! Det hade kattungar då mina barn lekte med dem. Ren pool , bra fruskot ett perfekt familje ställe."
translated_text: "We were very satisfied! I was there with my 2 daughters. Everything was perfect! There were kittens when my children played with them. Clean pool, good breakfast, a perfect family place."

review_text: "Çok güzel bir oteldi oda çok temizve güzel di Havuz gayet yeterli ve güzel çalişan arkadaşlar güler yüZlü tekrar kalmayı düşündügüm bir otel Dişardan yitecek ve içeçek getirilmesi ayrıca iyi"
translated_text: "It was a very nice hotel, the room was very clean and nice. The pool was quite adequate and the staff were friendly. It's a hotel I'm considering staying at again. It's also nice to bring outside food and drinks."

review_text: "Det beste hotellet jeg har vært på. Ligger litt unna alt rushet, men i en utviklende området. Gå avstand til super marked og spise steder. Beste servicen du kan tenke deg å få. Jeg har allerede planlagt å dra dit til neste sommer. Jeg anbefaler dette hotellet på det sterkeste."
translated_text: "The best hotel I've been to. Located a bit away from all the rush, but in a developing area. Walking distance to super market and eating places. Best service you can imagine. I've already planned to go there next summer. I highly recommend this hotel."

review_text: "Fantastisk service, hyggelige ansatte og meget hjelpsomme. Flott hotell. Anbefales."
translated_text: "Fantastic service, nice staff and very helpful. Great hotel. Recommended."

review_text: "Alles wirklich sehr schön, aber die Klimaanlage war nachts sehr laut! Man konnte schlecht schlafen. Wir waren allerdings nur eine Nacht"
translated_text: "Everything was really nice, but the air conditioning was very loud at night! It was difficult to sleep. However, we only stayed one night"

review_text: "Trés bel hôtel, personnels agréable surtout Mr ALI. propreté, calme, excellent breakfast. Le top."
translated_text: "Very nice hotel, pleasant staff especially Mr ALI. cleanliness, quiet, excellent breakfast. The best."

review_text: "Helt okej hotel, man måste ta taxi eller ha bil för att ta sig till stan."
translated_text: "Perfectly okay hotel, you have to take a taxi or have a car to get to town."

review_text: "Dette hotellet ligger ikke sentralt. Om du har planer om å være mye ute og reise til steder burde du finne et annet hotel med mindre du ønsket å betale for taxi hver dag. Renhold ligger på en 2’er da sengetøy, støv og gulvet ikke ble vasket. Eneste du fikk var rene håndklær. Hotellrommet er fint og stort, du får vaskemaskin og stue + kjøkken og soverom. Men det følger ikke med noe bestikk osv så du må kjøpe alt av vaskemiddel osv selv. Frokosten er det samme hver dag, ingen variasjon i det. Alt i alt et helt ok hotel om du ikke skal tilbringe tid der. Beliggenhet er et stort minus da det er langt unna alt."
translated_text: "This hotel is not centrally located. If you plan to be out a lot and travel to places, you should find another hotel unless you wanted to pay for a taxi every day. Cleaning is at a 2 as bed linen, dust and the floor were not washed. The only thing you got were clean towels. The hotel room is nice and big, you get a washing machine and living room + kitchen and bedroom. But it doesn't come with any cutlery etc so you have to buy all the detergent etc yourself. The breakfast is the same every day, no variation in that. All in all, a perfectly fine hotel if you're not going to spend time there. The location is a big minus as it's far from everything."

review_text: "Hotel er meget god og meget ren , god service . Reception mand Mohamad er meget hjælpful og flink . God morgenmad ."
translated_text: "Hotel is very good and very clean, good service. Reception man Mohamad is very helpful and nice. Good breakfast."

review_text: "Gayet temizdi otel. Apart tarzında odaları, geniş ve konforlu. Tekrar tercih ederim."
translated_text: "The hotel was very clean. Apartment style rooms, large and comfortable. I would choose it again."

review_text: "Bu otelde bir kaç gün konakladım, tam olarak fiyat performans oteli diyebiliriz. Otel araba ile merkeze 15 dk uzaklıkta bir mesafede. Apart Hotel tarzında. Odalar 1+1, Mutfağınız, çamaşır makinesi, buzdolabı, fırın hepsi mevcut. Ancak çatal bıçak tabak vs hiç biri yok. 2 bloktan oluşuyor. Açık Havuzu var. Kahvaltısı standart açık büfe kahvaltı. Her gün aynı değişen bir ürün yok. Sıcaklarda omlet, haşlanmış yumurta, ve biber kızartması her gün standart olarak çıkıyor başka bir şey yok. Tüm imkanlar otelin -1. Katında, yemek yeme, fitness, spa, masaj vs. Fiyatından dolayımıdır bilmem oteldeki misafirlerin büyük bir çoğunluğu Suriyeli, İranlı vs. Arap kökenli. Çalışanlarda keza öyle ve gençler. Olumsuz söyleyebileceğim giriş katından rezervasyon yaptırmayın, yabancı turistler hayvan gibi ses çıkardığı için gecenin yarısı uykunuzdan uyanıyorsunuz. Onun haricinde dışarda kendiniz gezip sadece konaklama amacıyla bir otel arıyorsanız fiyatına göre gayet makul bir seçenek. Odaların büyük olması ve havuzu olması güzeldi. Otel yöneticileri lütfen havuza bonesiz girmeyi yasaklayın havuzun dibinde her yerde saç kılları mevcut."
translated_text: "I stayed in this hotel for a few days, we can say that it is a price-performance hotel. The hotel is 15 minutes away from the center by car. It is in the style of an Apart Hotel. The rooms are 1+1, your kitchen, washing machine, refrigerator, oven are all available. However, there are no cutlery, plates, etc. It consists of 2 blocks. It has an outdoor pool. Le seul bémol c’est le manque de civisme des voisins de chambre qui claque la porte à tout va et qui font du bruit jusque tard comme s’ils étaient seuls. Il faudrait donner certaines directives et poser des conditions vis à vis du tapage nocturne."
translated_text: "Superb hotel, modern and clean. The apartments are friendly and spacious. The staff is friendly and very helpful. The breakfast is good and plentiful, as well as the catering service. The only downside is the lack of civility of the roommates who slam the door all the time and who make noise until late as if they were alone. Certain guidelines should be given and conditions set regarding the noise at night."

They start working at around 9 am and there is shaking like an earthquake. There is a strange smell in the corridors. It resembles a cheap aftershave. A toast costs 7 euros, a coffee costs 5 euros. Turkish "There isn't even a menu in lira."

Kahvaltı konusuna gelecek olursam peynirler kurumuş durumda çeşitlilik zayıf ve özensizdi . Bu konaklama benim için hayal kırıklığıydı…"
translated_text: "It was a hotel that my wife and I chose for the holiday. Even though our accommodation was a standard room, Mr. Sinan at the reception upgraded our stay and took us to a higher room. I would like to thank him and the other employees. Everything was fine so far, but the cleanliness in general was very bad, the pillows and blankets had an incredibly strong odor. I could not sleep at night, I requested a new one, but the pillows and quilts that were brought were no different from it. The pillows were literally full of the hair and feathers of the people staying there. I can say that sleeping at night was forbidden." There were stains on the towels. The cleaning cloths left a strong smell in the room. As for the breakfast, the cheeses were dried and the variety was poor and careless. "

review_text: "Oda biraz nem kokuyordu. Yataklar rahat. Oda içerisinde mini buzdolabı var. Klima yeteri derecede odayı soğutuyordu. Özel araç park yeri yok ancak sokak çok işlek olmadığı için istediğiniz yere koyabilirsiniz."

review_text: "Tüm deneyim ödediğiniz miktarın karşılığı şeklinde yansıyor. Odamız basit ama konforluydu. Kasa ve gardırop bulunmuyor fakat sıcak su, klima, askılık ve televizyon bulunuyor. Bizim gibi Antalya dışından gelecek misafirler için otel gayet merkezi çevresinde de market, restoran, kuaför gibi birçok hizmet bulunmakta."
translated_text: "The whole experience is reflected in the value of the money you pay. Our room was simple but comfortable. There is no safe or wardrobe, but there is hot water, air conditioning, hangers and television. Unfortunately, there is no breakfast service. We had no difficulty in finding street parking around the hotel. For a very affordable hotel, you definitely get your money's worth, but there is definitely nothing more. For guests coming from outside Antalya like us, the hotel is very central and there are many services such as markets, restaurants and hairdressers in its surroundings."

review_text: "Güler yüzlü ve yardımsever personel, merkezi konum ve ulaşım kolaylığı harikaydı. Ancak, klimanın yeterince etkili olmaması büyük bir sorun yarattı. Klimanın çalışmasına rağmen, odayı bir türlü soğutamadık ve bu durum rahatsızlık verdi. Diğer her şey çok iyiydi."
translated_text: "The friendly and helpful staff, the central location and the ease of transportation were great. However, the fact that the air conditioning was not effective enough created a big problem. Although the air conditioning was working, we could not cool the room and this caused discomfort. Everything else was very good."

review_text: "İstasyonlara çok yakın olması nedeniyle tercih ettim. Temiz bir otel olmasının yanında çalışanlarıda çok cana yakındı. Ücretsiz kahve servisinin olması çok hoşuma gitti. Ücretli olan kahvaltı ise diğer otellere karşılaştırıldığında çeşitli ve yeterliydi."

review_text: "Odalarda televizyonlar çalışmıyor. Işıklarda da sorun çıkabilir. Bunları kontrol ettikten sonra odanızı seçin. Neticede tek gecelik kalmak için iyi bir yer çünkü fiyatı uygun ve temizlik olarak fena değil."

The room smelled like cigarette smoke even though it was a non-smoking room. The beds are hard as chipboard. Comfort, hot water and air conditioning."

In terms of location, it is close to everywhere, I recommend it, my next stop will be this place again."

I felt very comfortable throughout my stay and can recommend your hotel I can only recommend it. I would love to come back! Thank you for the great time and the excellent service!"

It was not an accommodation worth the money, a standard 2-star hotel was like a city hotel, the cleanliness was mediocre, the breakfast was a very cheap breakfast consisting of ready-packaged margarine (not even butter), jam, and cheap fat-free cheese. When checking out When we mentioned credit card, he tried to charge a commission, then he gave up and tried to make it seem like he was doing us a favor. I do not recommend it at all, I cannot understand how it got so many stars."
